lotr01153.lore: A foe who is willing to kill or die outright is a foe to be feared indeed.

lotr01154.name: Uruk Soldier
lotr01154.game_text: Damage +1. When you play this minion, you may make the Free Peoples player discard the top card of his draw deck.
lotr01154.lore: Saruman's Uruk-hai band together as an extremely effective fighting unit.

lotr01155.name: Uruk Spy
lotr01155.game_text: Response: If the Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, exert this minion. Discard a card from the top of your draw deck for each [ISENGARD] minion you spot. Add a burden for each Shadow card discarded in this way.
lotr01155.lore: A wary eye on the mission could undo the quest.

lotr01156.name: Uruk Warrior
lotr01156.game_text: Damage +1. Maneuver: Spot 6 companions to make this minion fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr01156.lore: Powerful and fearless, Uruk-hai warriors are not intimidated by the weapons or numbers of their enemies.

lotr01157.name: Uruk-hai Armory
lotr01157.game_text: Plays to your support area. While you can spot an Uruk-hai, the fellowship archery total is -1.
lotr01157.lore: The ranks of Saruman's army include forgers of weapons and armour.

lotr01158.name: Uruk-hai Raiding Party
lotr01158.lore: “‘Imagine, Gandalf, an army – born from the earth of Isengard.'”

lotr01159.name: Uruk-hai Rampage
lotr01159.game_text: To play, spot an Uruk-hai. Plays to your support area. Response: If your Uruk-hai wins a skirmish, remove (3) to make him fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr01159.lore: Victory breeds rage in Saruman's foul creations.

lotr01160.name: Uruk-hai Sword
lotr01160.game_text: Bearer must be an Uruk-hai. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must discard the top card of his draw deck.
lotr01160.lore: Their malevolent strength worsens the wounds from the gruesome weapons of the Uruks.

lotr01161.name: Wariness
lotr01161.game_text: Search. Response: If a stealth event is played, exert or discard your Uruk-hai to cancel that event.
lotr01161.lore: Even Hobbits have trouble evading the Uruk-hai.

lotr01162.name: Worry
lotr01162.game_text: To play, exert an Uruk-hai. Plays to your support area. Each time an Uruk-hai wins a skirmish, the opponent must choose to either exert the Ring-bearer or add a burden.
lotr01162.lore: “‘One by one, regardless of their strength to good or evil... they fell.'”

lotr01163.name: Ancient Chieftain
lotr01163.game_text: For each other [MORIA] Orc you can spot, Ancient Chieftain is strength +1.
lotr01163.lore: “...a huge orc-chieftain, almost man-high, clad in black mail from head to foot, leaped into the chamber; behind him his followers clustered in the doorway.”

lotr01164.name: Bitter Hatred
lotr01164.game_text: Archery: Spot a [MORIA] archer to wound an Elf.
lotr01164.lore: Bitter and long is the hatred of the Orcs for the Elves, and thus they prefer Elves as targets.

lotr01165.name: Cave Troll of Moria, Scourge of the Black Pit
lotr01165.subtitle: Scourge of the Black Pit
lotr01165.game_text: Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot a [MORIA] Orc. At an underground site, Cave Troll of Moria's twilight cost is -3.
lotr01165.lore: Frodo's quest nearly ended before his companions halted the Cave Troll's ferocious attack.

lotr01166.name: Cave Troll's Hammer
lotr01166.game_text: Bearer must be Cave Troll of Moria. Cave Troll of Moria is damage +1.
lotr01166.lore: Suddenly the door burst into fragments and the Cave Troll was among them, his huge hammer striking like thunder.

lotr01167.name: Denizens Enraged
lotr01167.game_text: Skirmish: Make a [MORIA] Orc strength +1 for each other [MORIA] Orc you spot (limit +4).
lotr01167.lore: “...there came a great noise: a rolling Boom that seemed to come from depths far below, and to tremble in the stone at their feet.”

lotr01168.name: Drums in the Deep
lotr01168.game_text: Skirmish: Make a [MORIA] Orc strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a Dwarf).
lotr01168.lore: “The drum-beats broke out wildly: doom-boom, doom-boom, and then stopped... Doom, doom went the drum-beats again....”

lotr01169.name: The End Comes
lotr01169.game_text: Assignment: Spot 5 [MORIA] minions to make the Free Peoples player assign the Ring-bearer to a skirmish.
lotr01169.lore: “‘They have taken the Bridge and the second hall; we have barred the gates – but cannot hold them for long....'”

lotr01170.name: Fool of a Took!
lotr01170.game_text: Shadow: Spot a Hobbit (except the Ring-bearer) to reveal cards from the top of your draw deck until you reveal one that is not a [MORIA] minion. Take the revealed cards into hand.
lotr01170.lore: “‘Fool of a Took! Throw yourself in next time and rid us of your stupidity!'”

lotr01171.name: Frenzy
lotr01171.game_text: Assignment: Assign an exhausted companion (except the Ring-bearer) to skirmish a [MORIA] Orc.
lotr01171.lore: The Goblins of the Misty Mountains, like all of their race, use their teeming numbers to slaughter their foes.

lotr01172.name: Goblin Archer
lotr01172.game_text: Archer. While you can spot another [MORIA] Orc, the fellowship archery total is -6.

lotr01173.name: Goblin Armory
lotr01173.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time you play a [MORIA] weapon, add (1). Response: If a [MORIA] Orc is about to take a wound, discard this condition to prevent that wound.
lotr01173.lore: For scavenging vermin, the weapons of fallen foes are prized possessions.

lotr01174.name: Goblin Backstabber
lotr01174.game_text: This minion is damage +2 while in the same skirmish as another [MORIA] Orc.
lotr01174.lore: An attack from behind provides a cowardly Goblin with a boldness much like courage.

lotr01175.name: Goblin Domain
lotr01175.game_text: Search. To play, spot a [MORIA] minion. Plays to your support area. Each time a companion is played to site 4 or higher, that companion comes into play exhausted.
lotr01175.lore: The once beautiful kingdom of Khazad-dûm has become Moria, the black pit.

lotr01176.name: Goblin Marksman
lotr01176.lore: “Arrows fell among them. One struck Frodo and sprang back. Another pierced Gandalf's hat and stuck there like a black feather.”

lotr01177.name: Goblin Patrol Troop
lotr01177.lore: “As they ran they heard the beat and echo of many hurrying feet behind. A shrill yell went up: they had been seen. There was a ring and clash of steel.”

lotr01178.name: Goblin Runner
lotr01178.game_text: When you play this minion, you may add (2).
lotr01178.lore: “...a great horn was blown in the hall, and answering horns and harsh cries were heard further off. There was a hurrying sound of many feet.”

lotr01179.name: Goblin Scavengers
lotr01179.game_text: When you play this minion, you may play a weapon from your discard pile on your [MORIA] Orc.
lotr01179.lore: “‘The Orcs have often plundered Moria; there is nothing left in the upper halls.'”

lotr01180.name: Goblin Scimitar
lotr01180.game_text: Bearer must be a [MORIA] Orc. When you play this possession, you may draw a card.
lotr01180.lore: “Some of the swords were crooked: orc-scimitars with blackened blades.”

lotr01181.name: Goblin Sneak
lotr01181.game_text: When you play this minion, you may place a [MORIA] Orc from your discard pile beneath your draw deck.
lotr01181.lore: Their limber forms allow the Goblins of Moria to slither past barred doors and collapsed passageways.

lotr01182.name: Goblin Spear
lotr01182.game_text: Bearer must be a [MORIA] minion. If bearer kills a companion in a skirmish, add 1 burden (or 2 burdens if that companion was a Hobbit).
lotr01182.lore: Simple creatures with simple weapons can be as deadly as an armoured warrior with a fine sword.

lotr01183.name: Goblin Swarms
lotr01183.game_text: Plays to your support area. Response: If your [MORIA] Orc wins a skirmish, discard cards and wounds on that Orc and stack that Orc on this condition. Shadow: Play an Orc stacked here as if played from hand.
lotr01183.lore: “Beyond the fire he saw swarming black figures....”

lotr01184.name: Goblin Wallcrawler
lotr01184.game_text: While at an underground site, this minion is strength +2. While you can spot another [MORIA] Orc, the fellowship archery total is -1.
lotr01184.lore: Skittering along the walls of Moria, Goblins attack without warning.

lotr01185.name: Goblin Warrior
lotr01185.game_text: When you play this minion, you may discard a [DWARVEN] ally or [DWARVEN] condition.
lotr01185.lore: The ancient enmity between Goblins and Dwarves burns brightly still.

lotr01186.name: Guard Commander
lotr01186.game_text: Skirmish: Remove (3) to make a [MORIA] Orc strength +2.
lotr01186.lore: “His broad flat face was swart, his eyes were like coals, and his tongue was red....”

lotr01187.name: Host of Thousands
lotr01187.game_text: Shadow: Play a [MORIA] Orc from your discard pile.
lotr01187.lore: Killing one is no victory, since a dozen from the warrens below will take his place.

lotr01188.name: The Long Dark
lotr01188.game_text: Plays to your support area. When the fellowship moves to site 4 or 5, add (2) for each Dwarf companion. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make your [MORIA] Orc strength +2.
lotr01188.lore: “‘So ended the attempt to retake Moria! It was valiant but foolish. The time is not come yet.'”

lotr01189.name: Lost to the Goblins
lotr01189.game_text: Response: If the Ring-bearer exerts or takes a wound, discard a card from the top of your draw deck for each [MORIA] minion you spot. For each Shadow card discarded in this way, add a burden (limit 3 burdens).
lotr01189.lore: Dwarven graves stood open in plundered disarray.

lotr01190.name: Moria Axe
lotr01190.game_text: Bearer must be a [MORIA] Orc. Bearer is damage +1. Skirmish: Exert bearer to make him strength +2.
lotr01190.lore: Goblins without scimitars wrest axes from the remains of fallen Dwarves.

lotr01191.name: Moria Scout
lotr01191.game_text: When you play this minion, spot an Elf to add (2).
lotr01191.lore: Like their kindred in the North, the Orcs of Moria have keen noses, often following their prey by scent.

lotr01192.name: Pinned Down
lotr01192.game_text: Plays to your support area. While you can spot a [MORIA] archer, the fellowship archery total is -1.
lotr01192.lore: “Arrows whined and whistled down the corridor as he sprang back.”

lotr01193.name: Plundered Armories
lotr01193.game_text: Plays to your support area. Response: If your [MORIA] weapon is discarded, play it from your discard pile (that weapon's twilight cost is -1).
lotr01193.lore: The Goblins of Moria have oft plundered the deep armouries of Durin's folk.

lotr01194.name: Relentless
lotr01194.game_text: Search. Response: If a stealth event is played, spot 3 [MORIA] minions to cancel that event.
lotr01194.lore: “‘Then dig a hole in the ground,' said Legolas, ‘if that is more after the fashion of your kind. But you must dig swift and deep, if you wish to hide from Orcs.'”

lotr01195.name: Relics of Moria
lotr01195.game_text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (2) to play a [MORIA] possession from your discard pile.
lotr01195.lore: “By both the doors they could now see that many bones were lying, and among them were broken swords and axe-heads, and cloven shields and helms.”

lotr01196.name: They Are Coming
lotr01196.game_text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Discard 3 cards from hand to play a [MORIA] Orc from your discard pile.
lotr01196.lore: “‘The last thing written is in a trailing scrawl of elf-letters: they are coming.'”

lotr01197.name: Threat of the Unknown
lotr01197.game_text: Shadow: Exert your [MORIA] Orc to draw 2 cards.
lotr01197.lore: The danger of what lay hidden in the dark was more terrifying than the known perils of Moria.

lotr01198.name: Through the Misty Mountains
lotr01198.game_text: Search. To play, exert a [MORIA] minion. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves to site 4, 5, or 6 and contains a Dwarf or Elf, the Free Peoples player discards 2 cards at random from hand.
lotr01198.lore: “‘One must tread the path that need chooses.'”

lotr01199.name: Troll's Keyward
lotr01199.game_text: Cave Troll of Moria's twilight cost is -2.
lotr01199.lore: Though shorter than a Man, the Troll's Keyward is a deadly adversary.

lotr01200.name: The Underdeeps of Moria
lotr01200.game_text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (3) to reveal the bottom card of your draw deck. If it is a [MORIA] Orc, take it into hand. Otherwise, discard it.
lotr01200.lore: “‘I am afraid Balin is buried deep, and maybe something else is buried there too.'”

lotr01201.name: Unfamiliar Territory
lotr01201.game_text: Skirmish: Make a [MORIA] Orc strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing an archer).
lotr01201.lore: Knowing the dark terrain of Moria gives Orcs a strategic advantage when attacking their foes.

lotr01202.name: What Is This New Devilry?
lotr01202.game_text: Search. To play, exert a [MORIA] Orc. Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at site 5 or higher, each companion's twilight cost is +2.

lotr01203.name: All Blades Perish
lotr01203.game_text: Response: If a Nazgul is about to take a wound, prevent that wound.
lotr01203.lore: “‘...all blades perish that pierce that dreadful King. More deadly to him was the name of Elbereth.'”

lotr01204.name: All Veils Removed
lotr01204.game_text: Skirmish: Make a Nazgul strength +2 (or +5 if the Ring-bearer wears The One Ring).

lotr01205.name: Beauty Is Fading
lotr01205.game_text: Maneuver: Exert a Nazgul to discard a Free Peoples possession or Free Peoples condition. If you can spot no such card, discard an ally or companion (except the Ring-bearer) instead.
lotr01205.lore: “‘...the Three will fail, and many fair things will fade and be forgotten.'”

lotr01206.name: Bent on Discovery
lotr01206.game_text: Search. Plays to your support area. At the beginning of each of your Shadow phases, draw 1 card. At the end of each of your Shadow phases, exert a Nazgul or discard this condition.
lotr01206.lore: “The riding figure sat quite still.... From inside the hood came a noise as of someone sniffing....”

lotr01207.name: Black Breath
lotr01207.game_text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a character skirmishing a Nazgul. Burdens and wounds may not be removed from bearer.
lotr01207.lore: Vile breath infects the living with Shadow.

lotr01208.name: Black Steed
lotr01208.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. While at a plains site, bearer is strength +2. Discard this possession when at an underground site.
lotr01208.lore: “‘...these horses are born and bred to the service of the Dark Lord in Mordor.'”

lotr01209.name: Blade Tip
lotr01209.game_text: Plays to your support area. Response: If your Nazgul wins a skirmish, transfer this condition from your support area to the losing character. Limit 1 per character. Wound bearer at the start of each fellowship phase. (If bearer is the Ring-bearer, add a burden instead )

lotr01210.name: Dark Whispers
lotr01210.game_text: Skirmish: Spot 3 burdens to make a Nazgul strength +1 and damage +1, or spot 6 burdens to make a Nazgul strength +3 and damage +2.

lotr01211.name: Drawn to Its Power
lotr01211.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time a Nazgûl wins a skirmish, add a burden.

lotr01212.name: Fear
lotr01212.game_text: Search. Maneuver: Exert your Nazgul to discard an ally.
lotr01212.lore: “‘Never has such a thing happened in my time!... Guests unable to sleep in their beds, and good bolsters ruined and all! What are we coming to?'”

lotr01213.name: Frozen by Fear
lotr01213.game_text: Skirmish: Make a Nazgul strength +2 (or +3 if the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish that has not resolved).
lotr01213.lore: “...he was quaking as if he was bitter cold, but his terror was swallowed up in a sudden temptation to put on the Ring.”

lotr01214.name: In the Ringwraith's Wake
lotr01214.game_text: Response: If a Nazgul wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player chooses to either exert the Ring-bearer or add a burden.
lotr01214.lore: “‘He is fading.... We must get him to my father.'”

lotr01215.name: The Master's Will
lotr01215.game_text: Search. Shadow: Spot X Nazgul to reveal the top X cards of your draw deck. Take into your hand all [WRAITH] cards revealed and discard the rest.
lotr01215.lore: “...something seemed to be compelling him to disregard all warnings, and he longed to yield.”

lotr01216.name: Morgul Blade
lotr01216.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. This weapon may be borne in addition to 1 other hand weapon. Skirmish: Discard this possession to transfer Blade Tip from your support area or discard pile to a companion bearer is skirmishing.

lotr01217.name: Morgul Gates
lotr01217.game_text: Shadow: Play a Nazgul. His twilight cost is -2.
lotr01217.lore: The gates of Minas Morgul issued Nine Riders into the free lands, a blasphemy to ancient kings.

lotr01218.name: Nazgul Sword
lotr01218.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. While you can spot 3 burdens, bearer is damage +1.
lotr01218.lore: The weapons of the Nine are wielded by unseen hands willed by Sauron's hate.

lotr01219.name: The Nine Servants of Sauron
lotr01219.game_text: Search. Plays to your support area. Each time you play a Nazgul, you may exert a Hobbit (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr01219.lore: “‘That Black Rider was looking for something... or someone – Frodo?'”

lotr01220.name: Not Easily Destroyed
lotr01220.game_text: Plays to your support area. Maneuver or Skirmish: Remove (3) to heal a Nazgul.
lotr01220.lore: “‘They were Kings... great Kings of Men. Sauron gave to them Nine Rings of Power and with them the promise of eternal rule... unending life.'”

lotr01221.name: The Pale Blade
lotr01221.game_text: Bearer must be The Witch-king. He is damage +1. Response: If The Witch-king wins a skirmish, exert him to discard a Free Peoples condition.
lotr01221.lore: In his wretched grip, the Captain raised a Pale Sword.

lotr01222.name: Paths Seldom Trodden
lotr01222.game_text: Search. To play, spot a Nazgul. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (3) to replace the fellowship's site with your version of the same site.
lotr01222.lore: “‘You will have to leave the open road after tonight; for the horsemen will watch it night and day.'”

lotr01223.name: Relentless Charge
lotr01223.game_text: Maneuver: Exert a Nazgul to wound every archer companion.
lotr01223.lore: Even the fastest arrows are of no avail against the Black Steeds of the Nine Riders.

lotr01224.name: Return to Its Master
lotr01224.game_text: Response: If the Ring-bearer wears The One Ring at the end of a skirmish phase, cancel all remaining assignments and assign a Nazgul to skirmish the Ring-bearer; The One Ring's game text does not apply during this skirmish.

lotr01225.name: Sword of Minas Morgul
lotr01225.game_text: Bearer must be Ulaire Lemenya. He is damage +1. Skirmish: Exert Ulaire Lemenya to discard a possession borne by a character he is skirmishing.
lotr01225.lore: The Morgul hilt seared the flesh that would touch it, but the pierce was painless.

lotr01226.name: Their Power Is in Terror
lotr01226.game_text: Maneuver: Exert a Nazgul to wound every ally.
lotr01226.lore: “‘In dark and loneliness they are strongest... and already some in Bree are in their clutch.'”

lotr01227.name: Threshold of Shadow
lotr01227.game_text: Skirmish: Make a Nazgul strength +2 (or +4 if you spot 5 burdens).
lotr01227.lore: “‘They did not need the guidance of their horses any longer: you had become visible to them....”'

lotr01228.name: The Twilight World
lotr01228.game_text: Response: If Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, exert a Nazgul to add 2 burdens.
lotr01228.lore: “Immediately, though everything else remained as before, dim and dark, the shapes became terribly clear. He was able to see beneath their black wrappings.”

lotr01229.name: Ulaire Attea, Keeper of Dol Guldur
lotr01229.subtitle: Keeper of Dol Guldur
lotr01229.game_text: Fierce. Skirmish: Remove (1) to make Ulaire Attea strength +1 (limit +5).
lotr01229.lore: Those that knew the most power as kings were placed in particular ways for the Will of Sauron.

lotr01230.name: Ulaire Cantea, Lieutenant of Dol Guldur
lotr01230.subtitle: Lieutenant of Dol Guldur
lotr01230.game_text: Fierce. Skirmish: Exert Ulaire Cantea to discard a weapon borne by a character he is skirmishing.
lotr01230.lore: The Ringwraith has no semblance to the Man, its being passed into twilight, life spirit into void.

lotr01231.name: Ulaire Enquea, Lieutenant of Morgul
lotr01231.subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
lotr01231.game_text: Fierce. Maneuver: Spot 6 companions (or 5 burdens) and exert Ulaire Enquea to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr01231.lore: The Nine Riders were embodiments of Sauron's will, searching all of Middle-earth for his prize.

lotr01232.name: Ulaire Lemenya, Lieutenant of Morgul
lotr01232.subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
lotr01232.game_text: Each companion or ally who bears a [WRAITH] condition is strength -2.
lotr01232.lore: “‘Do you wish them to find you? They are terrible!'”

lotr01233.name: Ulaire Nelya, Lieutenant of Morgul
lotr01233.subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
lotr01233.game_text: Fierce. Shadow: Exert Ulaire Nelya and spot an opponent's site to replace it with your site of the same number.
lotr01233.lore: Many of the Nine were princes of majesty and power.

lotr01234.name: Ulaire Nertea, Messenger of Dol Guldur
lotr01234.subtitle: Messenger of Dol Guldur
lotr01234.game_text: When you play Ulaire Nertea, for each companion over 4, you may play 1 minion from your discard pile.
lotr01234.lore: Some accepted Sauron's gift for glory and a notion of great deeds.

lotr01235.name: Ulaire Otsea, Lieutenant of Morgul
lotr01235.subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
lotr01235.game_text: Shadow: Exert Ulaire Otsea to make a [WRAITH] minion fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr01235.lore: “...under their mantles were long grey robes; upon their grey hairs were helms of silver; in their haggard hands were swords of steel.”

lotr01236.name: Ulaire Toldea, Messenger of Morgul
lotr01236.subtitle: Messenger of Morgul
lotr01236.game_text: Fierce. Assignment: Spot 4 burdens to assign a companion (except the Ring-bearer) to skirmish Ulaire Toldea.
lotr01236.lore: “‘Open, in the name of Mordor!' said a voice thin and menacing.”

lotr01237.name: The Witch-king, Lord of Angmar
lotr01237.subtitle: Lord of Angmar
lotr01237.game_text: Fierce. For each other Nazgul you can spot, The Witch-king is strength +2.
lotr01237.lore: “...his hair was long and gleaming and on his helm was a crown.”

lotr01238.name: Wreathed in Shadow
lotr01238.game_text: To play, spot a Nazgul. Plays to your support area. Archery: Remove (1) to make the fellowship archery total -1.
lotr01238.lore: They are beings in twilight, without form to catch the points of weapons.

lotr01239.name: All Thought Bent on It
lotr01239.game_text: Search. Maneuver: Spot a [SAURON] Orc and 5 companions to make the Free Peoples player exert a companion for each companion over 4.
lotr01239.lore: “‘...for the Ring yearns, above all else, to return to the hand of its Master: they are one....'”

lotr01240.name: Band of the Eye
lotr01240.game_text: Response: If this minion wins a skirmish, remove (2) to make the Free Peoples player discard a card at random from hand.
lotr01240.lore: Far more Orcs has Sauron bred in the pits under Barad-dûr than Saruman could ever imagine.

lotr01241.name: Curse From Mordor
lotr01241.game_text: Shadow: Spot a [SAURON] Orc to discard an [ELVEN] condition.
lotr01241.lore: The Dark Lord harbors an ancient hatred for descendants of Gil-galad and those that marched with his gleaming host.

lotr01242.name: The Dark Lord's Summons
lotr01242.game_text: Search. To play, spot a [SAURON] Orc. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (3) to reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is a [SAURON] card, take it into hand. Otherwise, discard it and one other card from hand.
lotr01242.lore: Orcs obey the Dark Lord unquestioningly.

lotr01243.name: Despair
lotr01243.game_text: Maneuver: If the total number of burdens and companions in the dead pile is at least 12, spot a [SAURON] Orc to corrupt the Ring-bearer.
lotr01243.lore: “‘The Nameless Enemy has arisen again. Smoke rises once more from Orodruin that we call Mount Doom.'”

lotr01244.name: Desperate Defense of the Ring
lotr01244.game_text: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays on a companion. Each time bearer is assigned to a skirmish, the Free Peoples player chooses to either discard 3 cards from hand or add a burden.
lotr01244.lore: The Company must defend the Ring at all costs.

lotr01245.name: Desperate Measures
lotr01245.game_text: Maneuver: Spot a [SAURON] Orc and remove a burden to make the Free Peoples player discard top 5 cards from his draw deck.
lotr01245.lore: “‘Go back, Sam. You can't swim. I'm going to Mordor alone.'”

lotr01246.name: Enduring Evil
lotr01246.game_text: Skirmish: Spot X burdens to make a character skirmishing a [SAURON] Orc strength -X.
lotr01246.lore: “‘The Dark Tower was broken, but its foundations were not removed; for they were made with the power of the Ring, and while it remains they will endure.'”

lotr01247.name: Enheartened Foe
lotr01247.game_text: Response: If a [SAURON] Orc wins a skirmish, make that Orc fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr01247.lore: Orcs feed on their own success. The greater their exploits in battle, the greater their confidence grows.

lotr01248.name: Forces of Mordor
lotr01248.game_text: Shadow: Spot X [SAURON] minions to add (X).
lotr01248.lore: “‘....the Dark Lord is not without allies. The Easterlings and Haradrim now pay tribute to Mordor.'”

lotr01249.name: Gleaming Spires Will Crumble
lotr01249.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each [SAURON] Orc skirmishing a [GONDOR] character is strength +2. Discard this condition if your [SAURON] Orc loses a skirmish.
lotr01249.lore: Gondor has long been a target for the wrath of Sauron the Great.

lotr01250.name: Hate
lotr01250.game_text: Maneuver: Exert a [SAURON] Orc to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr01250.lore: Orcs are filled with hatred not only for their foes, but for all that lives.

lotr01251.name: A Host Avails Little
lotr01251.game_text: Search. Maneuver: Spot a [SAURON] Orc and 6 companions to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Do this once for each companion over 5.
lotr01251.lore: “‘Had I a host of Elves in armour of the Elder Days, it would avail little....'”

lotr01252.name: The Irresistible Shadow
lotr01252.game_text: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays to your support area. If you can spot 5 burdens and the Free Peoples player has no cards in his or her draw deck, the Ring-bearer is corrupted.
lotr01252.lore: “Once more the desire to slip on the Ring came over Frodo; but this time it was stronger than before.”

lotr01253.name: Journey Into Danger
lotr01253.game_text: Search. To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays to your support area. While you can spot 5 companions, each companion's twilight cost is +2.
lotr01253.lore: “‘I do not foretell, for all foretelling is now vain: on the one hand lies darkness, on the other only hope.'”

lotr01254.name: Mordor Enraged
lotr01254.game_text: Plays on a [SAURON] minion. Shadow: Exert bearer to add (1) for each archer companion.
lotr01254.lore: The armies of Elendil and Gil-galad inflamed Sauron's anger and hatred.

lotr01255.name: Mordor's Strength
lotr01255.game_text: Skirmish: Exert a [SAURON] Orc to wound a character he is skirmishing.
lotr01255.lore: “‘It should have ended that day, but evil was allowed to endure.'”

lotr01256.name: Morgul Hunter
lotr01256.game_text: For each companion you can spot, this minion is strength +1.
lotr01256.lore: Sauron's hatred lives in the hearts of his minions.

lotr01257.name: Morgul Skirmisher
lotr01257.game_text: Maneuver: Remove (3) to exert a Hobbit (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr01257.lore: The Orcs of Mordor, heartened by the promise of blood and plunder, are dangerous foes in battle.

lotr01258.name: Morgul Skulker
lotr01258.game_text: When you play this minion, you may shuffle up to 2 [WRAITH] cards from your discard pile into your draw deck.
lotr01258.lore: Sly servants of the Ringwraiths of Morgul Vale, Morgul Orcs are alert to the desires of their masters.

lotr01259.name: Morgul Warden
lotr01259.game_text: For each other [SAURON] Orc you can spot, Morgul Warden is strength +1.
lotr01259.lore: With blind devotion, the Orcs of Mordor follow orders issued from the Dark Tower.

lotr01260.name: The Number Must Be Few
lotr01260.game_text: Search. Plays to your support area. While you can spot 7 companions, the move limit for this turn is -1 (to a minimum of 1).
lotr01260.lore: “‘The number must be few, since your hope is in speed and secrecy.'”

lotr01261.name: Orc Ambusher
lotr01261.game_text: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [SAURON] minion you play is -1. Response: If a Free Peoples regroup event is played, exert this minion to cancel that event.
lotr01261.lore: “‘Orcs will often pursue foes for many leagues....'”

lotr01262.name: Orc Assassin
lotr01262.game_text: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [SAURON] minion you play is -1. Assignment: Spot 2 Hobbit companions to make the Free Peoples player assign a Hobbit to skirmish this minion.

lotr01263.name: Orc Banner
lotr01263.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time a [SAURON] Orc wins a skirmish, each [SAURON] Orc is strength +1 until the regroup phase.
lotr01263.lore: Tribes of Orcs from throughout Mordor rally to the banner of the Dark Tower.

lotr01264.name: Orc Bowmen
lotr01264.game_text: Plays to your support area. While you can spot a [SAURON] Orc, add 1 to the minion archery total.
lotr01264.lore: Where volleys of Orcish arrows fly, the defenders of the West fall.

lotr01265.name: Orc Butchery
lotr01265.game_text: Response: If a companion is killed by a [SAURON] Orc, the Free Peoples player must discard 3 cards from the top of his draw deck for each card in the dead pile.
lotr01265.lore: For sport, Orcs hew cruelly at the bodies of those they slay.

lotr01266.name: Orc Chieftain
lotr01266.game_text: When you play a weapon on this minion, add (2) (limit once per turn).
lotr01266.lore: Orc chieftains are the most cruel of a heartless race. Both strength and malice are needed to lead such followers.

lotr01267.name: Orc Hunters
lotr01267.game_text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character he is skirmishing.
lotr01267.lore: Bred for battle, Sauron's soldiers live for the thrill of the fight – and the spoils of victory.

lotr01268.name: Orc Inquisitor
lotr01268.game_text: When you play this minion, you may make the Free Peoples player discard a card at random from hand.
lotr01268.lore: Cruel questioners of Mordor tore the secret from poor Gollum, that Sauron's most prized possession once again was found.

lotr01269.name: Orc Scimitar
lotr01269.game_text: Bearer must be a [SAURON] Orc. Skirmish: Remove (1) to make bearer strength +1 (limit +3).
lotr01269.lore: An Orc's weapon reflects his passion for war and cruelty.

lotr01270.name: Orc Scouting Band
lotr01270.game_text: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [SAURON] minion you play is -1. Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character it is skirmishing.
lotr01270.lore: The cunning Ambushes of the Orc armies rely upon scouts first finding the enemy.

lotr01271.name: Orc Soldier
lotr01271.game_text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character he is skirmishing.
lotr01271.lore: Bearing cruel weapons, Orcs go forth from Mordor to serve the Eye.

lotr01272.name: Orc War Band
lotr01272.game_text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character it is skirmishing.
lotr01272.lore: Sauron has countless armies of Orcs at his disposal.

lotr01273.name: The Ring's Oppression
lotr01273.game_text: Response: If a [SAURON] Orc kills a companion, add 1 burden (or 3 if the Ring-bearer wears The One Ring).
lotr01273.lore: “The Ring that hung upon its chain about his neck grew heavy, heavier than a great stone, and his head was dragged downwards.”

lotr01274.name: Sauron's Defenses
lotr01274.game_text: To play, exert [SAURON] a Orc. Plays to your support area. While there are 3 or more companions in the dead pile, the move limit for this turn is -1 (to a minimum of 1).
lotr01274.lore: Sauron's minions are everywhere. Few roads escape the gaze of the Lidless Eye.

lotr01275.name: Seeking It Always
lotr01275.game_text: Search. Plays to your support area. Response: If a stealth event is played, exert a [SAURON] tracker to cancel that event.
lotr01275.lore: “‘...the only measure that he knows is desire, desire for power; and so he judges all hearts.'”

lotr01276.name: Seeking Its Master
lotr01276.game_text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Exert a [SAURON] Orc and remove (2) to draw a card.
lotr01276.lore: “‘This at least is plain: the evil of the Ring is already at work even in the Company, and the Ring must leave them before it does more harm.'”

lotr01277.name: Shadow's Reach
lotr01277.game_text: Shadow: Exert a [SAURON] Orc to discard a Free Peoples condition.

lotr01278.name: Strength Born of Fear
lotr01278.game_text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Remove (3) to make a [SAURON] Orc strength +1.
lotr01278.lore: Fear of death in Barad-dûr's dungeons spurs Mordor's servants to even greater savagery.

lotr01279.name: Thin and Stretched
lotr01279.game_text: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays on the Ring-bearer. Add a burden at the end of each turn during which bearer was not assigned to a skirmish (and another companion was).
lotr01279.lore: “‘I am old, Gandalf. I don't look it....'”

lotr01280.name: Tower Lieutenant
lotr01280.game_text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player discards 2 cards at random from hand.
lotr01280.lore: Sauron shows favour to those in his dungeons with the ambition to squeeze the information he needs from those caught spying out his borders.

lotr01281.name: Under the Watching Eye
lotr01281.game_text: Search. To play, exert a [SAURON] tracker. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion.
lotr01281.lore: What the Lidless Eye of Sauron does not see, his countless minions observe and report.

lotr01282.name: The Weight of a Legacy
lotr01282.game_text: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays on Aragorn.
lotr01282.lore: “‘It is because of Men, the Ring survives.... I was there the day the strength of Men failed.'”

lotr01283.name: You Bring Great Evil
lotr01283.game_text: To play, spot a [SAURON] Orc. Plays on a companion (except an Elf). While at a sanctuary, bearer cannot heal.
lotr01283.lore: “‘And what is this? We have not had dealings with the Dwarves since the Dark Days.'”

lotr01284.name: Bilbo, Retired Adventurer
lotr01284.subtitle: Retired Adventurer
lotr01284.game_text: Fellowship: Exert Bilbo to shuffle a [SHIRE] card from your discard pile into your draw deck.
lotr01284.lore: “‘...I don't suppose I have the strength or luck left to deal with the Ring. It has grown, and I have not.'”

lotr01285.name: Bilbo's Pipe
lotr01285.game_text: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to shuffle X tales from your discard pile into your draw deck.
lotr01285.lore: Bilbo has a fine pipe, carved for him by his Dwarven friends.

lotr01286.name: Bounder
lotr01286.game_text: Skirmish: Exert this ally to prevent a Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless that Hobbit's strength is tripled.
lotr01286.lore: “‘Aye, reckon we're in for a quiet night... mind how you go.'”

lotr01287.name: Extraordinary Resilience
lotr01287.game_text: Response: If the Ring-bearer is about to heal, remove a burden instead.
lotr01287.lore: “‘Don't despair!' said Strider. ‘You must trust me now. Your Frodo is made of sterner stuff than I had guessed....'”

lotr01288.name: Farmer Maggot, Chaser of Rascals
lotr01288.subtitle: Chaser of Rascals
lotr01288.game_text: Fellowship: Exert Farmer Maggot to heal Merry or Pippin.
lotr01288.lore: “‘Old Maggot is really a stout fellow – if you leave his mushrooms alone.'”

lotr01289.name: Frodo, Old Bilbo's Heir
lotr01289.subtitle: Old Bilbo's Heir
lotr01289.game_text: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). At the start of each of your turns, you may heal a Hobbit ally.
lotr01289.lore: “‘But be that as it may, Mr. Frodo is as nice a young hobbit as you could wish to meet.'”

lotr01290.name: Frodo, Son of Drogo
lotr01290.subtitle: Son of Drogo
lotr01290.game_text: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). Fellowship: Exert another companion who has the Frodo signet to heal Frodo.
lotr01290.lore: “‘I think you'll find there's more to this Hobbit than meets the eye.'”

lotr01291.name: The Gaffer, Sam's Father
lotr01291.subtitle: Sam's Father
lotr01291.game_text: Fellowship: Exert The Gaffer to heal Frodo or Sam.
lotr01291.lore: “No one had a more attentive audience than old Ham Gamgee, commonly known as the Gaffer. He held forth at The Ivy Bush, a small inn on the Bywater road; and he spoke with some authority, for he had tended the garden at Bag End for forty years....”

lotr01292.name: The Gaffer's Pipe
lotr01292.game_text: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to remove (X).
lotr01292.lore: “‘This... is the one art that we certainly claim to be our own invention. When Hobbits first began to smoke is not known....'”

lotr01293.name: Halfling Deftness
lotr01293.game_text: Skirmish: Exert a Hobbit to make him strength +3.
lotr01293.lore: “...though they are inclined to be fat and do not hurry unnecessarily, they are nonetheless nimble and deft in their movements.”

lotr01294.name: Hobbit Appetite
lotr01294.game_text: Fellowship: Add (X) to heal a Hobbit companion X times.
lotr01294.lore: “‘What about Elevenses, Luncheon, Afternoon Tea and Supper – he knows about them, doesn't he?'”

lotr01295.name: Hobbit Farmer
lotr01295.game_text: While you can spot your site 1, this ally has the game text of that site. Fellowship: Exert this ally and spot opponent's site 1 to replace it with your site 1.
lotr01295.lore: “‘...where our hearts truly lie is in peace and quiet and good-tilled earth....'”

lotr01296.name: Hobbit Intuition
lotr01296.game_text: Stealth. Skirmish: At sites 1 to 4, cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit. At any other site, make a Hobbit strength +3.
lotr01296.lore: “‘What? That were just a little detour, that's all... a shortcut.'”

lotr01297.name: Hobbit Party Guest
lotr01297.game_text: At the start of each of your turns, heal this ally. Fellowship: Exert this ally to heal another Hobbit ally whose home is site 1.
lotr01297.lore: “‘More promising still (to the hobbits' mind): an enourmous open-air kitchen was erected....'”

lotr01298.name: Hobbit Stealth
lotr01298.game_text: Stealth. Skirmish: At sites 1 to 5, cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit. At any other site, make a Hobbit strength +2.
lotr01298.lore: “They possessed from the first the art of disappearing swiftly and silently, when large folk whom they do not wish to meet come blundering by....”

lotr01300.name: Longbottom Leaf
lotr01300.game_text: Pipeweed. Plays to your support area. When you play this possession, you may discard up to 2 cards from hand.
lotr01300.lore: Longbottom Leaf is the pipeweed enjoyed by most Hobbits throughout the Shire.

lotr01301.name: Master Proudfoot, Distant Relative of Bilbo
lotr01301.subtitle: Distant Relative of Bilbo
lotr01301.game_text: Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 3 twilight tokens, add (2) to reveal the top 3 cards of your draw deck. Take all [SHIRE] cards revealed into hand and discard the rest.
lotr01301.lore: “His name, of course, was Proudfoot, and well merited; his feet were large, exceptionally furry....”

lotr01302.name: Merry, Friend to Sam
lotr01302.subtitle: Friend to Sam
lotr01302.game_text: Skirmish: If Merry is not assigned to a skirmish, exert him twice to add his strength to another companion.
lotr01302.lore: “‘We're coming too! You'll have to send us home tied up in a sack to stop us!'”

lotr01303.name: Merry, From O'er the Brandywine
lotr01303.subtitle: From O'er the Brandywine
lotr01303.game_text: While Merry bears a weapon, he is strength +2.
lotr01303.lore: “‘I don't know why he's so upset, it's only a few carrots... my point is, he's overreacting.'”

lotr01304.name: Noble Intentions
lotr01304.game_text: Skirmish: Exert a companion (except a Hobbit) to make a Hobbit strength +3.
lotr01304.lore: “‘You carry the fate of us all, little one.... If this is indeed the will of the Council, then Gondor will see it done.'”

lotr01305.name: Old Toby
lotr01305.game_text: Pipeweed. Plays to your support area. When you play this possession, you may draw a card.
lotr01305.lore: Bilbo's favorite pipeweed is Old Toby, the finest weed in the Southfarthing.

lotr01306.name: Pippin, Friend to Frodo
lotr01306.subtitle: Friend to Frodo
lotr01306.game_text: Your opponent may not discard your [SHIRE] tales from play.
lotr01306.lore: “‘Baggins? Sure I know a Baggins – Frodo's my second cousin once-removed, on his mother's side and my third cousin twice-removed on his father's side, if you follow me.'”

lotr01307.name: Pippin, Hobbit of Some Intelligence
lotr01307.subtitle: Hobbit of Some Intelligence
lotr01307.game_text: When you play Pippin, remove a burden or wound from a companion.
lotr01307.lore: “‘Anyway, you need people of intelligence on this sort of mission... quest... thing.'”

lotr01308.name: Power According to His Stature
lotr01308.game_text: Skirmish: Add 1 burden to wound each minion skirmishing the Ring-bearer.
lotr01308.lore: “‘The ring had given him power according to his stature.'”

lotr01309.name: Rosie Cotton, Hobbiton Lass
lotr01309.subtitle: Hobbiton Lass
lotr01309.game_text: Sam is strength +1. Fellowship: Exert Rosie to heal Sam.
lotr01309.lore: “‘Go on Sam, ask Rosie for a dance.'”

lotr01310.name: Sam, Faithful Companion
lotr01310.subtitle: Faithful Companion
lotr01310.game_text: Fellowship: Play Bill the Pony from your draw deck. Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).
lotr01310.lore: “‘Mr. Frodo's not going anywhere without me!'”

lotr01311.name: Sam, Son of Hamfast
lotr01311.subtitle: Son of Hamfast
lotr01311.game_text: Fellowship: Exert Sam to remove a burden. Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).
lotr01311.lore: “‘Oh, I've never held a girl's hand before. I... I think I might just have myself another ale.'”

lotr01312.name: Sorry About Everything
lotr01312.game_text: Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit companion to remove a burden.
lotr01312.lore: “‘I am sorry that I brought this upon you... sorry you must carry this burden.'”

lotr01313.name: Sting
lotr01313.game_text: Bearer must be Frodo. Fellowship or Regroup: Exert Frodo to reveal an opponent's hand. Remove (1) for each Orc revealed (limit (4)).
lotr01313.lore: “‘This is Sting.... Take it, if you like.'”

lotr01314.name: Stone Trolls
lotr01314.game_text: Tale. To play, spot Bilbo. Plays on any character. Limit 1 per character. Each time bearer skirmishes a Troll or Uruk-hai, bearer is strength +3.
lotr01314.lore: ‘“For a couple o' pins,' says Troll, and grins, / ‘I'll eat thee too, and gnaw thy shins. / A bit o' fresh meat will go down sweet!'”

lotr01315.name: Stout and Sturdy
lotr01315.game_text: Maneuver or Skirmish: Heal a Hobbit.
lotr01315.lore: “‘You have a stout heart, little hobbit, but your courage alone will not save you.'”

lotr01316.name: A Talent for Not Being Seen
lotr01316.game_text: Stealth. To play, exert a Hobbit. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves, spot 2 Hobbit companions to make the shadow number -1 (or spot 4 to make it -2).
lotr01316.lore: With their small size, Hobbits use any hole to hide in, and their trail is difficult to detect.

lotr01317.name: There and Back Again
lotr01317.game_text: Tale. Bearer must be a Hobbit companion. Maneuver: Discard this condition to make each Hobbit companion strength +2 until the regroup phase.
lotr01317.lore: “‘So there I was – at the mercy of three monstrous trolls....'”

lotr01318.name: Thror's Map
lotr01318.game_text: Plays to your support area. Fellowship or Regroup: Exert a Hobbit to play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary).
lotr01318.lore: Bilbo still keeps a map of Erebor, the Lonely Mountain, as a memento of his journey with the Dwarves many years ago.

lotr01319.name: Bag End
lotr01319.game_text: Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit to play The Gaffer from your draw deck.

lotr01321.name: Farmer Maggot's Fields
lotr01321.game_text: Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit to play Merry or Pippin from your draw deck.

lotr01322.name: Green Dragon Inn
lotr01322.game_text: Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit to play Sam from your draw deck.

lotr01323.name: Green Hill Country
lotr01323.game_text: The twilight cost of each Hobbit is -1.

lotr01324.name: The Prancing Pony
lotr01324.game_text: Fellowship: Add a burden to play Aragorn from your draw deck.

lotr01325.name: Shire Lookout Point
lotr01325.game_text: Fellowship: Spot Gandalf to play Gandalf's Cart from your draw deck.

lotr01326.name: Westfarthing
lotr01326.game_text: Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit to play a companion or ally; that character's twilight cost is -1.

lotr01327.name: Bree Gate
lotr01327.game_text: While you can spot a ranger, the move limit is +1 for this turn.

lotr01328.name: Bree Streets
lotr01328.game_text: The roaming penalty for each Nazgul you play to Bree Streets is -2.

lotr01329.name: Breeland Forest
lotr01329.game_text: Forest. Stealth events may not be played.

lotr01330.name: Buckleberry Ferry
lotr01330.game_text: River. While only Hobbits are in the fellowship, there are no assignment and skirmish phases at Buckleberry Ferry.

lotr01331.name: Ettenmoors
lotr01331.game_text: Plains. Skirmish: Exert a companion or minion to make that character strength +2.

lotr01332.name: Midgewater Marshes
lotr01332.game_text: Marsh. Each time a Hobbit moves to Midgewater Marshes, that Hobbit must exert.

lotr01333.name: Midgewater Moors
lotr01333.game_text: Plains. Each time a minion is played, the Free Peoples player discards a card from hand.

lotr01334.name: Trollshaw Forest
lotr01334.game_text: Forest. Each time you play a possession or artifact on your companion, draw a card.

lotr01336.name: Weathertop
lotr01336.game_text: Each Nazgul at Weathertop is fierce.

lotr01337.name: Council Courtyard
lotr01337.game_text: Sanctuary. When the fellowship moves from Council Courtyard, remove (2).

lotr01338.name: Ford of Bruinen
lotr01338.game_text: River. Sanctuary. The twilight cost of the first Nazgul played at Ford of Bruinen each turn is -5.

lotr01339.name: Frodo's Bedroom
lotr01339.game_text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Play a Hobbit to draw a card.

lotr01340.name: Rivendell Terrace
lotr01340.game_text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Play a Man to draw a card.

lotr01341.name: Rivendell Valley
lotr01341.game_text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Play an Elf to draw a card.

lotr01342.name: Rivendell Waterfall
lotr01342.game_text: Forest. Sanctuary. While you can spot a ranger at Rivendell Waterfall, the move limit is +1 for this turn.

lotr01343.name: Balin's Tomb
lotr01343.game_text: Underground. Maneuver: Discard a tale from play or from hand to heal your companion.

lotr01344.name: Dwarrowdelf Chamber
lotr01344.game_text: Underground. When the fellowship moves to Dwarrowdelf Chamber, Gimli or 2 other companions must exert.

lotr01345.name: Mithril Mine
lotr01345.game_text: Underground. Shadow: Remove (1) to play a Shadow weapon from your discard pile.

lotr01346.name: Moria Lake
lotr01346.game_text: Marsh. When the fellowship moves to Moria Lake, Frodo or 2 other companions must exert.

lotr01347.name: Moria Stairway
lotr01347.game_text: Underground. Each companion and minion bearing a hand weapon is damage +1.

lotr01348.name: Pass of Caradhras
lotr01348.game_text: Mountain. Shadow: Spot a [ISENGARD] minion to play a weather card from your draw deck (limit one per turn).

lotr01349.name: The Bridge of Khazad-dum
lotr01349.game_text: Underground. Shadow: Play The Balrog from your draw deck or hand; The Balrog's twilight cost is -6.

lotr01350.name: Dimrill Dale
lotr01350.game_text: Sanctuary. The twilight cost of the first [MORIA] Orc played each Shadow phase is -2.

lotr01351.name: Galadriel's Glade
lotr01351.game_text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Exert an Elf to look at an opponent's hand.

lotr01352.name: Lothlorien Woods
lotr01352.game_text: Forest. Sanctuary. Each ally whose home is site 6 is strength +3.

lotr01353.name: Anduin Confluence
lotr01353.game_text: River. When the fellowship moves to Anduin Confluence, discard every ally.

lotr01354.name: Anduin Wilderland
lotr01354.game_text: Forest. River. While the fellowship is at Anduin Wilderland, skip the archery phase.

lotr01355.name: Silverlode Banks
lotr01355.game_text: River. When the fellowship moves to Silverlode Banks without a ranger, every companion must exert.

lotr01356.name: Anduin Banks
lotr01356.game_text: River. For each companion in the fellowship over 4, add 2 to the minion archery total.

lotr01357.name: Brown Lands
lotr01357.game_text: River. For each minion archer at Brown Lands, the minion archery total is +1 (limit +4).

lotr01358.name: Pillars of the Kings
lotr01358.game_text: River. Fellowship: Discard a [GONDOR] card from hand to heal a [GONDOR] companion.

lotr01359.name: Shores of Nen Hithoel
lotr01359.game_text: River. Shadow: Spot 5 Orc minions to prevent the fellowship from moving again this turn.

lotr01360.name: Emyn Muil
lotr01360.game_text: Maneuver: Exert a minion to make that minion fierce until the regroup phase.

lotr01361.name: Slopes of Amon Hen
lotr01361.game_text: The twilight cost of each [ISENGARD] minion is -1.

lotr01362.name: Summit of Amon Hen
lotr01362.game_text: When the fellowship moves to Summit of Amon Hen, each Shadow player may draw a card for each burden.

lotr01363.name: Tol Brandir
lotr01363.game_text: River. Shadow: Play up to 3 trackers from your discard pile; end your Shadow phase.

lotr01364.name: Gandalf, The Grey Wizard
lotr01364.subtitle: The Grey Wizard
lotr01364.game_text: Fellowship: Exert Gandalf to play a companion who has the Gandalf signet. The twilight cost of that companion is -2.
lotr01364.lore: “...his long white hair, his sweeping silver beard, and his broad shoulders, made him look like some wise king of ancient legend.”

lotr01365.name: Aragorn, King in Exile
lotr01365.subtitle: King in Exile
lotr01365.game_text: Ranger. At the start of each of your turns, you may heal another companion who has the Aragorn signet.
lotr01365.lore: “‘He turned from that path a long time ago. He has chosen exile....'”

lotr02001.name: The Witch-king, Lord of the Nazgul
lotr02001.subtitle: Lord of the Nazgul
lotr02001.game_text: Twilight. Return to Its Master may not be played. Each time The Witch-king wins a skirmish, you may exert him to wound the Ring-bearer twice.
lotr02001.lore: “‘A great king and sorcerer he was of old, and now he wields a deadly fear.'”

lotr02002.name: Frodo, Reluctant Adventurer
lotr02002.subtitle: Reluctant Adventurer
lotr02002.game_text: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). The cost of each artifact, possession, and [SHIRE] tale played on Frodo is -1.
lotr02002.lore: “‘I am not made for perilous quests. I wish I had never seen the Ring! Why did it come to me? Why was I chosen?'”

lotr02003.name: Sam, Proper Poet
lotr02003.subtitle: Proper Poet
lotr02003.game_text: Maneuver: Exert Sam twice to make him defender +1 until the regroup phase. Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).
lotr02003.lore: “‘First he was a conspirator, now he's a jester. He'll end up by becoming a wizard – or a warrior!'”

lotr02004.name: Gimli, Dwarf of the Mountain-race
lotr02004.subtitle: Dwarf of the Mountain-race
lotr02004.game_text: Damage +1. Each underground site's Shadow number is -2.
lotr02004.lore: “‘In the ruins of the Dwarves, a dwarf's head will be less easy to bewilder than Elves or Men or Hobbits.'”

lotr02005.name: Flurry of Blows
lotr02005.game_text: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or +4 and damage +1 if bearing 2 hand weapons).
lotr02005.lore: With a second axe, a warrior of Erebor can parry on either flank and counter quickly.

lotr02006.name: Fror, Gimli's Kinsman
lotr02006.subtitle: Gimli's Kinsman
lotr02006.game_text: To play, spot a Dwarf. While skirmishing an Uruk-hai, Fror is strength +3.
lotr02006.lore: “It appeared that amid the splendour of their works of hand the hearts of the Dwarves of the Lonely Mountain were troubled.”

lotr02007.name: Gloin, Friend to Thorin
lotr02007.subtitle: Friend to Thorin
lotr02007.game_text: For each [DWARVEN] tale you can spot, Gloin is strength +1 (limit +4).
lotr02007.lore: “‘But what then would happen, if the Ruling Ring were destroyed, as you counsel?'”

lotr02008.name: Golden Light on the Land
lotr02008.game_text: To play, spot a Dwarf. Plays to your support area. At a site which is not underground, each [MORIA] Orc's twilight cost is +2. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.
lotr02008.lore: “‘The Orcs will not, maybe, come out till after dusk, but we must be far away before nightfall.'”

lotr02009.name: Great Works Begun There
lotr02009.game_text: Tale. Plays to your support area. Each time you play a Dwarf, you may discard the top 2 cards from your draw deck to take a [DWARVEN] event into hand from your discard pile.
lotr02009.lore: “‘Moria! Moria!... Long have its vast mansions lain empty since the children of Durin fled.'”

lotr02010.name: Hand Axe
lotr02010.game_text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. This weapon may be borne in addition to 1 other hand weapon. Archery: Discard this weapon to make the fellowship archery total +1.
lotr02010.lore: Their captain rallied two other orcs to attack. In answer, Gimli's side axe brought him down.

lotr02011.name: Make Light of Burdens
lotr02011.game_text: Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf companion and discard the top 3 cards from your draw deck to discard either a Shadow condition from a Dwarf or a weather condition.
lotr02011.lore: A Dwarf does not readily notice the weight on his back, or in his heart.

lotr02012.name: Realm of Dwarrowdelf
lotr02012.game_text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Discard the top 3 cards from your draw deck to make a Dwarf strength +1 (limit +3) and, if underground, damage +1 (limit +3).
lotr02012.lore: “‘There must have been a mighty crowd of dwarves here... and every one of them busier than badgers....'”

lotr02013.name: Tidings of Erebor
lotr02013.game_text: Regroup: Spot a Dwarf to draw 3 cards. Any Shadow player may remove (3) to prevent this.
lotr02013.lore: “‘...we have so far been fortunate, though we do not escape the shadow of these times.'”

lotr02014.name: Till Durin Wakes Again
lotr02014.game_text: Tale. Plays to your support area. Each time a Dwarf companion moves from an underground site, you may heal that Dwarf.
lotr02014.lore: “Gimli was silent. Having sung his song, he would say no more.”

lotr02015.name: What Are We Waiting For?
lotr02015.game_text: Fellowship: Exert a Dwarf to make an opponent draw 2 cards. That player then chooses to either discard 2 Shadow cards from hand or skip his or her next Shadow phase.

lotr02016.name: A Blended Race
lotr02016.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. Plays to your support area. Each Uruk-hai is strength -2 and loses all damage bonuses. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.
lotr02016.lore: “‘...he has been doing something to them.... For these Isengarders are more like wicked Men.'”

lotr02017.name: Dismay Our Enemies
lotr02017.game_text: Response: If an Elf archer wins a skirmish, make an opponent choose a minion to discard. That opponent may remove (3) to prevent this.
lotr02017.lore: Reeling from the bite of an arrow, the Cave Troll became enraged trying to strike the nimble Elf.

lotr02018.name: Hosts of the Last Alliance
lotr02018.game_text: Tale. Plays to your support area. While you can spot an Elf companion, the minion archery total is -1. Response: If an Elf is about to take a wound, discard this condition to prevent that wound.
lotr02018.lore: “‘...many great princes and captains were assembled.'”

lotr02019.name: Release the Angry Flood
lotr02019.game_text: Maneuver: Exert an Elf to wound each Nazgul once (or twice if at a river).
lotr02019.lore: “The three Riders that were still in the midst of the Ford were overwhelmed.... Their piercing cries were drowned in the roaring of the river as it carried them away.”

lotr02020.name: Secret Sentinels
lotr02020.game_text: Maneuver: Exert an Elf ally to discard a condition (or 2 conditions if you spot an Orc).
lotr02020.lore: “‘Yet so little faith and trust do we find now in the world beyond Lothlórien... that we dare not by our own trust endanger our land.'”

lotr02021.name: Erland, Advisor to Brand
lotr02021.subtitle: Advisor to Brand
lotr02021.game_text: To play, spot Gandalf. Shadow players may not look at or reveal cards in your hand.
lotr02021.lore: “‘They are good folk the Bardings. The grandson of Bard the Bowman rules them, Brand son of Bain son of Bard.'”

lotr02022.name: Gandalf's Staff
lotr02022.game_text: Bearer must be Gandalf. The twilight cost of each [GANDALF] spell is -1. Skirmish: Exert Gandalf twice to cancel a skirmish involving him.
lotr02022.lore: “As the wizard passed on ahead up the great steps, he held his staff aloft, and from its tip there came a faint radiance.”

lotr02023.name: Gandalf's Wisdom
lotr02023.game_text: Plays to your support area. The twilight cost of each possession or artifact played on Gandalf or a character who has the Gandalf signet is -1.
lotr02023.lore: “Now as the companions sat or walked together they spoke of Gandalf, and all that each had known and seen of him came clear before their minds.”

lotr02024.name: Hugin, Emissary from Laketown
lotr02024.subtitle: Emissary from Laketown
lotr02024.game_text: To play, spot Gandalf. Fellowship: Exert Hugin to reveal a Free Peoples card from your discard pile and place it beneath your draw deck.
lotr02024.lore: Several wise Bardings were sent to Elrond to tell of the Dark Lord's new offer.

lotr02025.name: Jarnsmid, Merchant from Dale
lotr02025.subtitle: Merchant from Dale
lotr02025.game_text: To play, spot Gandalf. Each time you play a shield, armor, helm, or hand weapon, its twilight cost is -1.
lotr02025.lore: The Men of Dale freely traded with the Dwarves of the Lonely Mountain for fine metalwork.

lotr02026.name: Speak "Friend" and Enter
lotr02026.game_text: Fellowship or Regroup: Spot Gandalf to play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary). Draw a card if you play an underground site.
lotr02026.lore: “Picking up his staff he stood before the rock and said in a clear voice: Mellon!”

lotr02027.name: Staff Asunder
lotr02027.game_text: Spell. Skirmish: Discard a staff Gandalf is bearing and then exert him twice to discard a minion he is skirmishing.
lotr02027.lore: “At that moment Gandalf lifted his staff, and crying aloud he smote the bridge before him.”

lotr02028.name: Wielder of the Flame
lotr02028.game_text: Spell. Maneuver: Spot Gandalf to make a companion defender +1 until the regroup phase. Any Shadow player may remove (3) to prevent this.
lotr02028.lore: “The Balrog made no answer. The fire in it seemed to die, but the darkness grew.”

lotr02029.name: Wizard Staff
lotr02029.game_text: Bearer must be a Wizard. Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to make a minion strength -3.
lotr02029.lore: “‘We must have power – power to order things as we will for that Good which only the Wise can see.'”

lotr02030.name: You Cannot Pass!
lotr02030.game_text: Spell. Maneuver: Spot Gandalf bearing a staff to prevent a minion from being fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr02030.lore: “The Balrog fell back and its sword flew up in molten fragments. The wizard swayed on the bridge, stepped back a pace, and then again stood still.”

lotr02031.name: Blood of Numenor
lotr02031.game_text: To play, exert a [GONDOR] companion. Plays to your support area. Each [SAURON] Orc comes into play exhausted. Skip the archery phase. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.
lotr02031.lore: “‘I do not know what strength is in my blood, but I swear to you – I will not let the White City fall....'”

lotr02032.name: Flaming Brand
lotr02032.game_text: Bearer must be a Man. This weapon may be borne in addition to 1 other hand weapon. Bearer is strength +2 and damage +1 while skirmishing a Nazgul.
lotr02032.lore: “...a glimpse of Strider leaping out of the darkness with a flaming brand of wood in either hand.”

lotr02033.name: Flee in Terror
lotr02033.game_text: Response: If a [GONDOR] companion wins a skirmish, discard an exhausted Orc. That minion's owner may remove (3) to prevent this.
lotr02033.lore: “Aragorn smote to the ground the captain that stood in his path, and the rest fled in terror of his wrath.”

lotr02034.name: Gondor Will See It Done
lotr02034.game_text: Response: If a companion is about to take a wound, exert a [GONDOR] companion to prevent that wound.
lotr02034.lore: “‘Boromir!... Go after those two young hobbits, and guard them at the least, even if you cannot find Frodo.'”

lotr02035.name: Natural Cover
lotr02035.game_text: To play, spot a ranger. Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at a forest, the minion archery total is -2.
lotr02035.lore: The tree, the bough, the leaf. To a ranger, these are all defenses against the enemy.

lotr02036.name: No Mere Ranger
lotr02036.game_text: Skirmish: Exert Aragorn to make another companion strength +2 (or +3 if that companion has the Aragorn signet).
lotr02036.lore: “‘If by my life or death, I can protect you, I will....'”

lotr02037.name: Sentinels of Numenor
lotr02037.game_text: Skirmish: Make a [GONDOR] companion strength +2 (or +4 if in a fierce skirmish).
lotr02037.lore: “...they still preserved through the suns and rains of forgotten years the mighty likenesses in which they had been hewn.”

lotr02038.name: Shield of Boromir
lotr02038.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] companion. The minion archery total is -1. If bearer is Boromir, each minion skirmishing him does not gain strength bonuses from weapons.
lotr02038.lore: Boromir bore the heirlooms of the Steward's house with pride.

lotr02039.name: Beyond the Height of Men
lotr02039.game_text: Maneuver: Exert an Uruk-hai to discard an armor possession, helm possession, or shield possession (or all such Free Peoples possessions if you can spot 6 companions).

lotr02040.name: Demands of the Sackville-Bagginses
lotr02040.game_text: To play, spot an [ISENGARD] minion. Plays to your support area. Each time a [SHIRE] ally exerts, add (1).
lotr02040.lore: “In the middle of the commotion, the Sackville-Bagginses arrived.”

lotr02041.name: Evil Afoot
lotr02041.game_text: Shadow: Exert an Uruk-hai and spot X burdens to shuffle X minions from your discard pile into your draw deck.
lotr02041.lore: “‘It is not the Eastern Shore I am worried about. A shadow and a threat has been growing in my mind. Something draws near, I can feel it.'”

lotr02042.name: Goblin Man
lotr02042.game_text: Discard this minion if underground. Shadow: Exert this minion to look at the Free Peoples player's hand.
lotr02042.lore: “‘He looks more than half like a goblin.'”

lotr02043.name: Lurtz's Sword
lotr02043.game_text: Bearer must be Lurtz. He is damage +1. Each time Lurtz wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must discard the top 2 cards of his or her draw deck.
lotr02043.lore: The Uruk giant laid down his bow and drew a broad-bladed weapon.

lotr02044.name: No Business of Ours
lotr02044.game_text: To play, spot an [ISENGARD] minion. Plays to your support area. The Free Peoples player may not look at or reveal cards in any Shadow player's hand.
lotr02044.lore: “‘Goblins? Cobblers! Far-off tales and children's stories, that's all that is!'”

lotr02045.name: Too Much Attention
lotr02045.game_text: Response: If the Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, spot an [ISENGARD] minion to make the Free Peoples player discard the top 5 cards of his or her draw deck.
lotr02045.lore: “‘A little more caution from you – that is not a trinket you carry.'”

lotr02046.name: Uruk Captain
lotr02046.game_text: Damage +1. Shadow: Remove (1) and exert Uruk Captain to play an Uruk-hai from your discard pile.
lotr02046.lore: The captains marched the Uruk-hai to the great river without halting.

lotr02047.name: Uruk Scout
lotr02047.game_text: Tracker. Damage +1. The roaming penalty for each [ISENGARD] minion you play is -1. Response: If an event is played that spots or exerts a ranger, exert this minion to cancel that event.
lotr02047.lore: Forward Uruk troops caught the fellowship unaware.

lotr02048.name: Wizard Storm
lotr02048.game_text: Spell. Weather. To play, exert an [ISENGARD] minion. Plays on a site. Limit 1 per site. When the fellowship moves from this site, every companion must exert. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.
lotr02048.lore: “There was a black look in the sky, and the sun was wan. The wind had gone now round to the north-east.”

lotr02049.name: Archer Commander
lotr02049.game_text: Archer. Each other [MORIA] archer is strength +2.
lotr02049.lore: Their commander led the Goblin bowmen to the highest rise across the gap.

lotr02050.name: The Balrog's Sword
lotr02050.game_text: Bearer must be The Balrog. It is damage +1. This weapon may be borne in addition to 1 other hand weapon.
lotr02050.lore: “In its right hand was a blade like a stabbing tongue of fire....”

lotr02051.name: The Balrog, Durin's Bane
lotr02051.subtitle: Durin's Bane
lotr02051.game_text: Damage +1. Fierce. While you can spot The Balrog, discard all other minions. Skip the archery phase. Discard The Balrog if not underground.
lotr02051.lore: “‘Indeed I saw upon the bridge that which haunts our darkest dreams....'”

lotr02052.name: The Balrog, Flame of Udun
lotr02052.subtitle: Flame of Udun
lotr02052.game_text: Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot a [MORIA] Orc. Discard The Balrog if not underground. Shadow: Exert The Balrog and remove (2) to play a [MORIA] Orc from your discard pile.
lotr02052.lore: “...suddenly it drew itself up to a great height, and its wings were spread from wall to wall....”

lotr02053.name: Cave Troll's Chain
lotr02053.game_text: Bearer must be Cave Troll of Moria. The Free Peoples player may choose for the archery phase to be skipped. Each time Cave Troll of Moria takes a wound during the archery phase, you may wound an archer companion.

lotr02054.name: Dark Fire
lotr02054.game_text: To play, spot The Balrog. Plays on Gandalf. Each time the fellowship moves, Gandalf must exert.
lotr02054.lore: “...he seemed small, and altogether alone: grey and bent, like a wizened tree before the onset of a storm.”

lotr02055.name: Dark Places
lotr02055.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each unique [MORIA] minion is strength +1. Shadow: Spot an opponent's site to replace it with your marsh or underground site of the same number.
lotr02055.lore: “‘There is some new devilry here... devised for our welcome, no doubt.'”

lotr02056.name: Fill With Fear
lotr02056.game_text: Plays to your support area. While you can spot The Balrog, skip the archery phase. Maneuver: Exert The Balrog to discard a ranged weapon.
lotr02056.lore: “He drew, but his hand fell, and the arrow slipped to the ground. He gave a cry of dismay and fear.”

lotr02057.name: Final Cry
lotr02057.game_text: Response: If a skirmish that involved The Balrog bearing Whip of Many Thongs is about to end, wound a companion in that skirmish twice.
lotr02057.lore: “...it swung its whip, and the thongs lashed and curled about the wizard's knees, dragging him to the brink.”

lotr02058.name: Foul Tentacle
lotr02058.game_text: Tentacle. When you play this minion, you may play a tentacle from your draw deck. This minion may not bear possessions and is discarded if not at a marsh.
lotr02058.lore: “Its fingered end had hold of Frodo's foot, and was dragging him into the water.”

lotr02059.name: Foul Things
lotr02059.game_text: Shadow: Play a [MORIA] minion from your discard pile.
lotr02059.lore: “‘Something has crept, or has been driven out of dark waters under the mountains.'”

lotr02060.name: Goblin Bowman
lotr02060.lore: The crude arrows of the Goblins served notice of the dangers of Moria.

lotr02061.name: Goblin Flankers
lotr02061.game_text: When you play this minion, you may add (3) if the fellowship has moved more than once this turn.
lotr02061.lore: “‘There are Orcs, very many of them.... And some are large and evil....'”

lotr02062.name: Goblin Pursuer
lotr02062.game_text: If the fellowship has moved more than once this turn, this minion is strength +3.
lotr02062.lore: Had the fellowship remained in Dimrill Dale, pursuers from Moria would have overwhelmed them.

lotr02063.name: Goblin Reinforcements
lotr02063.game_text: When you play this minion, you may heal a [MORIA] minion.
lotr02063.lore: “‘We don't have a moment! Come nightfall these hills will swarm with Orcs!'”

lotr02064.name: Goblin Scrabbler
lotr02064.game_text: When you play this minion, you may discard an [ELVEN] condition. The roaming penalty for each [MORIA] Orc you play is -1.
lotr02064.lore: “Orcs were as keen as hounds on a scent, it was said, but they could also climb.”

lotr02065.name: Goblin Spearman
lotr02065.game_text: While bearing a Goblin Spear, this minion is damage +2.
lotr02065.lore: “...with the speed of a striking snake, he charged into the Company and thrust with his spear....”

lotr02066.name: Huge Tentacle
lotr02066.game_text: Tentacle. Damage +1. When you play this minion, you may play Watcher in the Water from your draw deck. This minion may not bear possessions and is discarded if not at a marsh.
lotr02066.lore: “Out from the water a long sinuous tentacle had crawled; it was pale-green and luminous and wet.”

lotr02067.name: Moria Archer Troop
lotr02067.game_text: Archer. While you can spot another [MORIA] archer, add 1 to the minion archery total.
lotr02067.lore: Most of the Goblin arrows flew harmlessly into the chasm, but there were so many!

lotr02068.name: Must Do Without Hope
lotr02068.game_text: Maneuver: Exert The Balrog to add a burden.
lotr02068.lore: “His enemy halted again, facing him, and the shadow about it reached out like two vast wings.”

lotr02069.name: Old Differences
lotr02069.game_text: Skirmish: Make an Elf or Dwarf skirmishing a [MORIA] Orc strength -1 (or -3 if you spot an Elf and a Dwarf).
lotr02069.lore: “‘I'll be dead before I see the Ring in the hands of an Elf!'”

lotr02070.name: Power and Terror
lotr02070.game_text: Shadow: Reveal any number of [MORIA] Orcs from your hand to play The Balrog. Its twilight cost is -2 for each Orc revealed.
lotr02070.lore: “The ranks of the orcs had opened, and they crowded away, as if they themselves were afraid.”

lotr02071.name: Throw Yourself in Next Time
lotr02071.game_text: To play, spot a [MORIA] Orc. Plays on a Hobbit companion. Bearer may be exerted only by Shadow cards.
lotr02071.lore: “‘This is a serious journey, not a hobbit walking-party....Now be quiet!'”

lotr02072.name: Troubled Mountains
lotr02072.game_text: Shadow: Exert a [MORIA] minion and spot X burdens to add (X) (limit (5)).
lotr02072.lore: “‘The Dimrill Dale is full of vapour and clouds of smoke....There are noises in the deeps of the earth.'”

lotr02073.name: Watcher in the Water, Keeper of Westgate
lotr02073.subtitle: Keeper of Westgate
lotr02073.game_text: Damage +1. While you can spot Watcher in the Water, discard all other minions (except tentacles). Each tentacle is strength +2 and damage +1. This minion may not bear possessions and is discarded if not at a marsh.
lotr02073.lore: “The dark water boiled... there was a hideous stench.”

lotr02074.name: Whip of Many Thongs
lotr02074.game_text: Bearer must be The Balrog. Skirmish: Exert The Balrog to discard a helm, shield, or armor borne by a character The Balrog is skirmishing.
lotr02074.lore: “It raised the whip, and the thongs whined and cracked.”

lotr02075.name: Bill Ferny, Swarthy Sneering Fellow
lotr02075.subtitle: Swarthy Sneering Fellow
lotr02075.game_text: Nazgul are not roaming. The Free Peoples player may not assign a character to skirmish Bill Ferny. Discard Bill Ferny if underground.
lotr02075.lore: “‘...as for Ferny, he would sell anything to anybody; or make mischief for amusement.'”

lotr02076.name: Helpless
lotr02076.game_text: To play, spot Frodo and a Nazgul. Plays on Sam. Sam's game text does not apply.
lotr02076.lore: “He heard Frodo's voice, but it seemed to come from a great distance, or from under the earth, crying out strange words.”

lotr02077.name: His Terrible Servants
lotr02077.game_text: Plays to your support area. Response: If a twilight Nazgul is about to take a wound, remove (1) to prevent that wound.
lotr02077.lore: “‘...in the dark they perceive many signs and forms that are hidden from us: then they are most to be feared.'”

lotr02078.name: It Wants to be Found
lotr02078.game_text: Maneuver: Spot a twilight Nazgul to add a burden.
lotr02078.lore: “...perhaps it had tried to reveal itself in response to some wish or command that was felt in the room.”

lotr02079.name: Resistance Becomes Unbearable
lotr02079.game_text: Maneuver: Exert a twilight Nazgul to exert the Ring-bearer.If the Ring-bearer is then exhausted, he puts on The One Ring until the regroup phase.
lotr02079.lore: “Not with the hope of escape, or of doing anything, either good or bad: he simply felt that he must take the Ring and put it on his finger.”

lotr02080.name: Stricken Dumb
lotr02080.game_text: Maneuver: Exert The Witch-king to discard a tale or weapon.
lotr02080.lore: “He felt his tongue cleave to his mouth and his heart labouring. His sword broke and fell out of his shaking hand.”

lotr02081.name: They Will Find the Ring
lotr02081.game_text: Maneuver: Exert 2 Nazgul and spot X burdens to exert X companions.
lotr02081.lore: “...to the dismay of Frodo and his friends out from the trees and rocks away on the left four other Riders came flying.”

lotr02082.name: Ulaire Attea, The Easterling
lotr02082.subtitle: The Easterling
lotr02082.game_text: Twilight. When you play Ulaire Attea, you may wound an ally.
lotr02082.lore: “‘They had words with Harry at Westgate on Monday.... He was white and shaking when they left him.'”

lotr02083.name: Ulaire Enquea, Ringwraith in Twilight
lotr02083.subtitle: Ringwraith in Twilight
lotr02083.game_text: Twilight. Each time Ulaire Enquea wins a skirmish, you may exert him to wound the Ring-bearer once (or twice if you spot 5 burdens).
lotr02083.lore: “In their white faces burned keen and merciless eyes....”

lotr02084.name: Ulaire Nelya, Ringwraith in Twilight
lotr02084.subtitle: Ringwraith in Twilight
lotr02084.game_text: Twilight. While you can spot 2 burdens or 2 wounds on the Ring-bearer, Ulaire Nelya is fierce and damage +1.
lotr02084.lore: “Over the lip of the little dell, on the side away from the hill, they felt, rather than saw, a shadow rise, one shadow or more than one.”

lotr02085.name: The Witch-king, Lord of the Nazgul
lotr02085.subtitle: Lord of the Nazgul
lotr02085.game_text: Twilight. Return to Its Master may not be played. Each time The Witch-king wins a skirmish, you may exert him to wound the Ring-bearer twice.
lotr02085.lore: “‘A great king and sorcerer he was of old, and now he wields a deadly fear.'”

lotr02086.name: Wraith-world
lotr02086.game_text: Skirmish: Spot a twilight Nazgul and the Ring-bearer wearing The One Ring to add 3 burdens.
lotr02086.lore: “‘He is passing into the shadow world, he will soon become a wraith like them.'”

lotr02087.name: The Eye of Sauron
lotr02087.game_text: Shadow: Exert a [SAURON] Orc and spot X burdens to draw X cards (limit 5).
lotr02087.lore: “‘...he has indeed arisen again and left his hold in Mirkwood and returned to his ancient fastness in the Dark Tower of Mordor.'”

lotr02088.name: Memory of Many Things
lotr02088.game_text: Maneuver: Exert a [SAURON] Orc to discard an ally (or 2 [ELVEN] allies).
lotr02088.lore: “‘But my memory reaches back even to the Elder Days.... I have seen three ages in the West of the world, and many defeats, and many fruitless victories.'”

lotr02089.name: Orc Scout
lotr02089.game_text: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [SAURON] minion you play is -1. Response: If an event is played that spots or exerts a ranger, exert or discard this minion to cancel that event.
lotr02089.lore: “‘Orc!...Not very near, and yet too near, it seems.'”

lotr02090.name: Orc Taskmaster
lotr02090.game_text: Shadow: Exert this minion to add (1).
lotr02090.lore: An Orc acts when the taskmaster promises reward or the whip.

lotr02091.name: Southern Spies
lotr02091.game_text: Response: If the Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, spot a [SAURON] minion to make the Free Peoples player discard his or her hand.
lotr02091.lore: “‘They will know all the news now, for they have visited Bill Ferny; and probably that Southerner was a spy as well.'”

lotr02092.name: Spies of Mordor
lotr02092.game_text: Search. To play, spot a [SAURON] Orc. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may draw a card (or 2 cards if you spot a [SAURON] tracker).
lotr02092.lore: “‘Mordor Orcs patrol the Eastern Shore. We must wait for the cover of darkness.'”

lotr02093.name: Tower Assassin
lotr02093.game_text: Maneuver: Exert Tower Assassin to wound an ally.
lotr02093.lore: A Ring of Power would not stop the blade of an assassin lying in wait.

lotr02094.name: Verily I Come
lotr02094.game_text: To play, exert a [SAURON] Orc. Plays on the Ring-bearer. Each time the Free Peoples player draws a card (or takes a card into hand) during the fellowship phase, add a burden.
lotr02094.lore: “There was an eye in the Dark Tower that did not sleep. He knew that it had become aware of his gaze.”

lotr02095.name: Vile Blade
lotr02095.game_text: Bearer must be a [SAURON] Orc. Bearer is strength +2 while skirmishing a Man or Elf.
lotr02095.lore: The blood of enemies slain that day blackened the edge of the commander's blade.

lotr02096.name: Bilbo, Well-spoken Gentlehobbit
lotr02096.subtitle: Well-spoken Gentlehobbit
lotr02096.game_text: Fellowship: Exert Bilbo and discard a tale to discard a Shadow condition from an opponent's support area.
lotr02096.lore: “...as Mr. Baggins was generous with his money, most people were willing to forgive him his oddities and his good fortune.”

lotr02097.name: Consorting With Wizards
lotr02097.game_text: Tale. Bearer must be Bilbo. Bilbo may not take wounds (except during the archery phase). Fellowship or Regroup: Exert Bilbo or discard this condition to remove (1).
lotr02097.lore: “‘He wasn't always this peculiar! When I were a lad, old Bilbo was a most respectable Hobbit.'”

lotr02098.name: Dear Friends
lotr02098.game_text: Fellowship: Exert a companion to place a Free Peoples card from your discard pile beneath your draw deck (or 2 Free Peoples cards if that companion has the Frodo signet).
lotr02098.lore: “He pressed him for news of himself and of the wide world... and they stayed up far into the night.”

lotr02099.name: Deft in Their Movements
lotr02099.game_text: Stealth. Regroup: Spot 2 Hobbits to make each site's Shadow number -2 until the end of the turn.
lotr02099.lore: “They possessed from the first the art of disappearing swiftly and silently, when large folk who they do not wish to meet come blundering by.”

lotr02100.name: Fearing the Worst
lotr02100.game_text: Stealth. To play, exert 2 Hobbits. Plays to your support area. The twilight cost of each search card and each tracker is +2.
lotr02100.lore: “‘Even if we are allowed to leave Bree unhindered, we can hardly hope now to leave it unnoticed.'”

lotr02101.name: Filibert Bolger, Wily Rascal
lotr02101.subtitle: Wily Rascal
