lotr05111.game_text: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). Fellowship: Add a burden to play Smeagol from your discard pile.
lotr05111.lore: “‘We promises, yes I promise!... Good master, good Sméagol, gollum, gollum!'”

lotr05112.name: No Help for It
lotr05112.game_text: Regroup: Spot Sam and discard Smeagol or Gollum to remove 3 burdens.
lotr05112.lore: “‘...he'll come back, you'll see. The promise will hold yet a while. And he won't leave his Precious, anyway.'”

lotr05113.name: No Use That Way
lotr05113.game_text: Skirmish: Add 3 burdens to wound a minion skirmishing a companion who has the Frodo signet twice.
lotr05113.lore: “‘Don't take the Precious to Him!... Keep it, nice master, and be kind to Sméagol.'”

lotr05114.name: Rare Good Ballast
lotr05114.game_text: Plays on Sam. Response: If a regroup special ability is used, discard Smeagol or Gollum to cancel that action.
lotr05114.lore: “‘What a hobbit needs with coney... is some herbs and roots, especially taters – not to mention bread.'”

lotr05115.name: Sam, Nice Sensible Hobbit
lotr05115.subtitle: Nice Sensible Hobbit
lotr05115.game_text: Ring-bound. While you can spot Frodo and Smeagol, Sam may not be overwhelmed unless is strength is tripled. Response: If Frodo is killed, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).

lotr05116.name: Sting, Baggins Heirloom
lotr05116.subtitle: Baggins Heirloom
lotr05116.game_text: Bearer must be Frodo. Skirmish: Exert Frodo to make Smeagol strength +2 or Gollum strength -2.
lotr05116.lore: “‘This is Sting. You have seen it before once upon a time.'”

lotr05117.name: You Must Help Us
lotr05117.game_text: Fellowship: Play Smeagol from your discard pile to heal each Ring-bound Hobbit twice.
lotr05117.lore: “‘You will have to come with us, that's all, while we keep an eye on you.'”

lotr05118.name: Hornburg Wall
lotr05118.game_text: Regroup: Spot your minion and remove (9) to make the fellowship move again this turn (if the move limit allows).

lotr05119.name: Nan Curunir
lotr05119.game_text: Plains. Response: If your mounted minion is about to take a wound, remove (2) to prevent that wound.

lotr05120.name: Caverns of Isengard
lotr05120.game_text: Underground. The Free Peoples player wins the game only if the Ring-bearer survives until Shadow players reconcile.

lotr05121.name: Legolas, Archer of Mirkwood
lotr05121.subtitle: Archer of Mirkwood
lotr05121.game_text: Archer. Each time Legolas wins a skirmish, you may heal a Dwarf companion or another Elf companion.
lotr05121.lore: “‘...even more would I give for a hundred good archers of Mirkwood. We shall need them.'”

lotr05122.name: Eowyn, Daughter of Eomund
lotr05122.subtitle: Daughter of Eomund
lotr05122.game_text: Valiant. Maneuver: Play a [ROHAN] possession on Eowyn to heal her.
lotr05122.lore: “‘Let the heralds announce to the folk that the Lady Éowyn will lead them!'”

lotr05123.name: Baruk Khazad (AI)
lotr05123.game_text: Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf to wound a minion. You may take the next maneuver action.
lotr05123.lore: “Axes of the Dwarves!” cried Gimli in the secret tongue of his kin.

lotr05124.name: Break the Charge (AI)
lotr05124.game_text: Archery: Exert 3 Elf companions to make the fellowship archery total +2.
lotr05124.lore: A wall of Elven arrows met the attackers before they reached the Hornburg itself.

lotr05125.name: Foul Horde (AI)
lotr05125.game_text: Warg-rider. While Foul Horde is not exhausted, it is fierce. While Foul Horde has at least 3 vitality, it is ambush (1). While Foul Horde has at least 4 vitality, it is damage + 1.

lotr05126.name: Army of Haradrim (AI)
lotr05126.game_text: Southron. Skirmish: Remove (3) to play a [RAIDER] mount from your discard pile.
lotr05126.lore: Lacking shields and armor, Southron forces rely on speed and numbers.

lotr05127.name: Rohirrim Helm (AI)
lotr05127.game_text: Bearer must be [ROHAN] Man. Skirmish: Discard this possession to cancel a skirmish involving bearer. A minion in this skirmish may exert to prevent this.
lotr05127.lore: A helm split by an Uruk blade often still saves the rider who wears it.

lotr05128.name: Thundering Host (AI)
lotr05128.game_text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a mounted [ROHAN] Man strength +3 (and heal that man if at a plains).
lotr05128.lore: The roar of hooves was enough to rout the Uruk-hai without sword or spear.

lotr06001.name: Treebeard, Guardian of the Forest
lotr06001.subtitle: Guardian of the Forest
lotr06001.game_text: Unhasty. Assignment: Exert an unbound Hobbit to allow Treebeard to skirmish. Skirmish: Exert Treebeard to make an Ent damage +1.
lotr06001.lore: “‘The little that I know of his long slow story would make a tale for which we have no time now.'”

lotr06002.name: Aragorn, Defender of Free Peoples
lotr06002.subtitle: Defender of Free Peoples
lotr06002.game_text: Skirmish: Remove an [ELVEN] token to make a minion skirmishing Aragorn strength -3. Skirmish: Remove a [DWARVEN] token to heal a Dwarf. Regroup: If Aragorn is mounted, remove a [ROHAN] token to wound a minion twice.
lotr06002.lore: “‘...this is the hour when we draw swords together.'”

lotr06003.name: Merry, Impatient Hobbit
lotr06003.subtitle: Impatient Hobbit
lotr06003.game_text: Regroup: Discard Merry to heal a [GANDALF] companion.
lotr06003.lore: “‘Don't talk to it Merry. Don't encourage it.'”

lotr06004.name: Dunlending Headman
lotr06004.game_text: When you play this minion, you may spot 2 other [DUNLAND] Men to take control of a site. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 cards from hand to prevent this.
lotr06004.lore: The diminished Rohirrim offered little resistance to the advancing Dunland horde.

lotr06005.name: Dunlending Reserve
lotr06005.game_text: The twilight cost of this minion during a skirmish phase is -2.
lotr06005.lore: The relentless campaign of the hillmen drove citizens of the Westfold to the shelter of their capital.

lotr06006.name: Hill Clan
lotr06006.game_text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may play a [DUNLAND] Man from hand. That Man is fierce and damage +2 until the regroup phase.

lotr06007.name: Ready to Fall
lotr06007.game_text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Spot 2 sites you control and remove (2) to play a [DUNLAND] Man from your discard pile.
lotr06007.lore: “‘Why do you lay these troubles on an already troubled mind?'”

lotr06008.name: Too Long Have These Peasants Stood
lotr06008.game_text: Response: If a [DUNLAND] Man wins a skirmish, discard all conditions.
lotr06008.lore: The rabble of Dunland pillaged their way across the Mark.

lotr06009.name: Lend Us Your Aid
lotr06009.game_text: Maneuver: Exert Gimli twice to make him and each Elf companion strength +3 until the regroup phase.
lotr06009.lore: “He hewed a two-handed stroke and laid the last Orc before his feet. ‘Now my count passes Master Legolas again.'”

lotr06010.name: Suspended Palaces
lotr06010.game_text: Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, you may spot a Dwarf to place 2 [DWARVEN] tokens here. Fellowship: Discard this condition or remove a [DWARVEN] token from here to stack the top card of your draw deck on a [DWARVEN] condition that has a card stacked on it.

lotr06011.name: Toss Me
lotr06011.game_text: While this card is stacked on a [DWARVEN] condition, Gimli is strength +1. Fellowship: Place this card or another [DWARVEN] card from hand on top of or beneath your draw deck.

lotr06012.name: Agility
lotr06012.game_text: Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, you may spot an Elf to place 2 [ELVEN] tokens here. Skirmish: Discard this condition or remove an [ELVEN] token from here to make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -1.
lotr06012.lore: Elves rely upon more than strength in combat.

lotr06013.name: Arwen, Evenstar of Her People
lotr06013.subtitle: Evenstar of Her People
lotr06013.game_text: Skirmish: Exert an Elf to make a minion skirmishing Arwen strength -1.
lotr06013.lore: “‘If you trust nothing else, trust this... trust us.'”

lotr06014.name: Banner of Elbereth
lotr06014.game_text: Bearer must be an Elf companion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may draw a card. Response: If bearer wins a skirmish, discard this possession to liberate a site.
lotr06014.lore: “‘First name the four, the free peoples: / Eldest of all, the elf-children...'”

lotr06015.name: Elrond, Keeper of Vilya
lotr06015.subtitle: Keeper of Vilya
lotr06015.game_text: At the start of each turn, heal Elrond. Fellowship: Exert Elrond to discard the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [ELVEN] card, you may take it into hand and heal an Elf companion.
lotr06015.lore: “‘You have foreseen it. War is coming... many will die.'”

lotr06016.name: Forearmed
lotr06016.game_text: Skirmish: Reveal the top card of your draw deck to make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -X, where X is the twilight cost of the revealed card.

lotr06017.name: Forewarned
lotr06017.game_text: To play, spot 2 Elves. Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Add (1) to look at the top card of your draw deck. You may discard this condition to discard that card.
lotr06017.lore: “‘Whether by the sword or the slow decay of time, Aragorn will die.'”

lotr06018.name: Galadriel, Keeper of Nenya
lotr06018.subtitle: Keeper of Nenya
lotr06018.game_text: At the start of each turn, heal Galadriel. Skirmish: Exert Galadriel to discard the top card of your draw deck. If it is a Shadow card, make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -3.
lotr06018.lore: “‘In Dwimordene, in Lórien / More fair than thoughts of Mortal Men.'”

lotr06019.name: Gift of Foresight
lotr06019.game_text: Fellowship: Spot an Elf to reveal the top card of your draw deck. You may discard it, return it to the top of your draw deck, or take it into hand.
lotr06019.lore: “‘Here you will dwell, bound to your grief, under the fading trees.'”

lotr06020.name: Must Be a Dream
lotr06020.game_text: Fellowship: Spot an Elf to reveal the top card of your draw deck. Heal up to 2 companions whose culture matches the revealed card. You may discard the revealed card.
lotr06020.lore: “‘May the Grace of the Valar protect you.'”

lotr06021.name: Naith Longbow
lotr06021.game_text: Bearer must be an Elf companion. Archery: Exert bearer to discard the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [ELVEN] card, exert a minion.
lotr06021.lore: “‘Show them no mercy, for you shall receive none.'”

lotr06022.name: Naith Troop
lotr06022.game_text: To play, spot 3 Elf companions. Skirmish: Exert Naith Troop to discard the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [ELVEN] card, make a minion skirmishing Naith Troop strength -2.
lotr06022.lore: Now only the bow and the sword can forestall the coming of the Shadow.

lotr06023.name: Naith Warband
lotr06023.game_text: To play, spot 3 Elf companions. While Naith Warband bears a ranged weapon, it takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase and does not add to the fellowship archery total.
lotr06023.lore: “‘But do not think that only by singing amid the trees... is Lothlórien maintained and defended....'”

lotr06024.name: Boomed and Trumpeted
lotr06024.game_text: Skirmish: Make an Ent strength +X and damage +X, where X is the number of unbound Hobbits you can spot.
lotr06024.lore: “‘For bole and bough are burning now, the furnace roars-we go to war!'”

lotr06025.name: Crack Into Rubble
lotr06025.game_text: Regroup: Exert 2 Ents to liberate a site and discard a Shadow condition.
lotr06025.lore: “‘To Isengard! Though Isengard be ringed and barred with doors of stone; / Though Isengard be strong and hard, as cold as stone and bare as bone....'''

lotr06026.name: Enraged
lotr06026.game_text: Bearer must be an Ent. Limit 1 per bearer. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.

lotr06027.name: Ent Avenger
lotr06027.game_text: While you can spot 3 Ents, this companion is strength +2.
lotr06027.lore: “As they drew near the flash and flicker of their eyes could be seen.”

lotr06028.name: Ent Horde
lotr06028.game_text: To play, spot 2 Ent companions. Ent Horde's twilight cost is -2 for each Ent or unbound Hobbit you can spot. While you can spot more minions than companions, Ent Horde is defender +1.
lotr06028.lore: “‘With doom we come, with doom we come!'”

lotr06029.name: Ent Moot
lotr06029.game_text: To play, exert an unbound Hobbit. Bearer must be an Ent. Limit 1 per bearer.
lotr06029.lore: “But when the Ents all gathered round Treebeard,... then the Hobbits saw that they were all of the same kindred, and all had the same eyes....”

lotr06030.name: Gandalf, Mithrandir
lotr06030.subtitle: Mithrandir
lotr06030.game_text: Damage +1. Each time the fellowship moves, wound Gandalf.
lotr06030.lore: “‘The Dark Lord has Nine. But we have One, mightier than they: the White Rider. He has passed through the fire and the abyss, and they shall fear him.'”

lotr06031.name: Glamdring, Lightning Brand
lotr06031.subtitle: Lightning Brand
lotr06031.game_text: Bearer must be Gandalf. He is damage +1. Each time you play a spell during a skirmish, you may make Gandalf damage +1 until the end of that skirmish.
lotr06031.lore: “‘Thunder they heard, and lightning... smote upon Celebdil, and leaped back broken into tongues of fire.'”

lotr06032.name: Host of Fangorn
lotr06032.game_text: To play, spot 2 Ent companions. Host of Fangorn's twilight cost is -2 for each Ent or unbound Hobbit you can spot.
lotr06032.lore: “‘Of course, it is likely enough, my friends...that we are going to our doom, the last march of the Ents.'”

lotr06033.name: Quickbeam, Bregalad
lotr06033.subtitle: Bregalad
lotr06033.game_text: Quickbeam's twilight cost is -1 for each Ent and unbound Hobbit you can spot.
lotr06033.lore: “‘But if we stayed home and did nothing, doom would find us anyway, sooner or later.'”

lotr06034.name: Roused
lotr06034.game_text: Skirmish: Exert an Ent to make him strength +1 for each Ent you spot (limit +4).
lotr06034.lore: “‘To Isengard!' the Ents cried in many voices.”

lotr06035.name: Skinbark, Fladrif
lotr06035.subtitle: Fladrif
lotr06035.game_text: Skinbark's twilight cost is -1 for each Ent or unbound Hobbit you can spot. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is about to take a wound, exert Skinbark to prevent that wound.
lotr06035.lore: “‘He was wounded by Orcs, and many of his folk and tree-herds have been murdered and destroyed.'”

lotr06036.name: Threw Down My Enemy
lotr06036.game_text: Spell. Skirmish: Make a minion skirmishing Gandalf strength -1 for each wound on each character in the skirmish.
lotr06036.lore: “‘...he fell from the high place and broke the mountain-side where he smote it in his ruin.'”

lotr06037.name: Treebeard, Guardian of the Forest
lotr06037.subtitle: Guardian of the Forest
lotr06037.game_text: Unhasty. Assignment: Exert an unbound Hobbit to allow Treebeard to skirmish. Skirmish: Exert Treebeard to make an Ent damage +1.
lotr06037.lore: “‘The little that I know of his long slow story would make a tale for which we have no time now.'”

lotr06038.name: Don't Follow the Lights
lotr06038.game_text: Response: If Smeagol wins a skirmish, add a burden to discard a minion.
lotr06038.lore: “‘Careful, careful now or Hobbits go down to join the dead ones and light little candles.'”

lotr06039.name: Don't Look at Them
lotr06039.game_text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to wound a minion Smeagol is skirmishing once (or twice if that minion is a [WRAITH] minion).
lotr06039.lore: “‘You should not look in when the candles are lit.'”

lotr06040.name: Gollum, Old Villain
lotr06040.subtitle: Old Villain
lotr06040.game_text: Skirmish: Discard a card from hand to make Gollum strength +1 (or +2 if skirmishing a Ring-Bound companion).
lotr06040.lore: “‘Must take it. The Wraiths are searching. Must take it.'”

lotr06041.name: Master Broke His Promise
lotr06041.game_text: Regroup: Exert Gollum 3 times to wound each companion. The move limit for this turn is -1.
lotr06041.lore: “‘Kill them! Kill them! Kill them both! And then we take the Precious! We be the Master!'”

lotr06042.name: Nasty, Foul Hobbitses
lotr06042.game_text: Response: If Gollum wins a skirmish, add a burden.
lotr06042.lore: “‘We ought to wring their filthy little necks!'”

lotr06043.name: Not Listening
lotr06043.game_text: Response: If Smeagol wins a skirmish, heal him and remove 2 burdens.
lotr06043.lore: “‘They'll wake too quick and kill us... Not now. Not yet.'”

lotr06044.name: Safe Paths
lotr06044.game_text: Regroup: Exert Smeagol 3 times and discard him to wound each minion. The move limit for this turn is +1. If the fellowship moves, each Shadow player may take up to 3 Shadow cards into hand from his or her discard pile.
lotr06044.lore: “‘Soft and quick as shadows we must be!'”

lotr06045.name: Smeagol, Poor Creature
lotr06045.subtitle: Poor Creature
lotr06045.game_text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Skirmish: Discard a card from hand to make Smeagol strength +1.
lotr06045.lore: “‘And we're so lonely... We'll be nice to them, very nice, if they'll be nice to us, won't we, yes, yess.'”

lotr06046.name: They Stole It
lotr06046.game_text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to wound a companion Gollum is skirmishing once (or twice if that companion is a [SHIRE] companion).
lotr06046.lore: “‘Where iss it, where iss it: my precious....'”

lotr06047.name: You're a Liar and a Thief
lotr06047.game_text: Response: If Gollum wins a skirmish, wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr06047.lore: “‘No, sweet one. See, my precious: if we has it, then we can escape, even from Him, eh?'”

lotr06048.name: Anborn, Skilled Huntsman
lotr06048.subtitle: Skilled Huntsman
lotr06048.game_text: Ring-bound. Ranger. Each time Anborn wins a skirmish, you may make a minion's site number +3 until the regroup phase.
lotr06048.lore: “‘Perhaps under the shadow of the Unnamed some of the beasts of Mirkwood are wandering hither to our woods.'”

lotr06049.name: Ancient Roads
lotr06049.game_text: Plays to your support area. While you can spot 3 rangers, the site number of each minion skirmishing a ranger is +2.
lotr06049.lore: “‘...they go ever more heedlessly, we learn, thinking that the power of their new master is great enough....'”

lotr06050.name: Aragorn, Defender of Free Peoples
lotr06050.subtitle: Defender of Free Peoples
lotr06050.game_text: Skirmish: Remove an [ELVEN] token to make a minion skirmishing Aragorn strength -3. Skirmish: Remove a [DWARVEN] token to heal a Dwarf. Regroup: If Aragorn is mounted, remove a [ROHAN] token to wound a minion twice.
lotr06050.lore: “‘...this is the hour when we draw swords together.'”

lotr06051.name: Banner of Westernesse
lotr06051.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] companion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may heal another [GONDOR] companion. Response: If bearer wins a skirmish, discard this possession to liberate a site.
lotr06051.lore: “‘What brought they from the foundered land / Over the flowing sea?... / and one white tree.'”

lotr06052.name: Garrison of Osgiliath
lotr06052.game_text: Fortification. Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, you may spot a [GONDOR] Man to place 2 [GONDOR] tokens here. Skirmish: Discard this condition or remove a [GONDOR] token from here to make a [GONDOR] Man strength +1.
lotr06052.lore: “‘So ever do we watch the shores nigh Osgiliath....'”

lotr06053.name: Mortal Men
lotr06053.game_text: Skirmish: Make a [GONDOR] Man strength +2 (and exert a minion if you spot a [ROHAN] token).

lotr06054.name: Perilous Ventures
lotr06054.game_text: Regroup: Exert 2 rangers to discard a minion (or 2 [WRAITH] minions).
lotr06054.lore: “‘But still we will not sit idle and let Him do all as He would....'”

lotr06055.name: Ring of Barahir
lotr06055.game_text: Bearer must be Aragorn. At the start of each of your turns, you may spot a culture token to heal a companion of that culture.
lotr06055.lore: “‘This is a thing of worth beyond your reckoning. For its ancientry alone. It has no power, save the esteem in which those hold it who love my house.'”

lotr06056.name: Trust
lotr06056.game_text: Skirmish: Make a [GONDOR] Man strength +2 (and heal a companion if you spot an [ELVEN] token).

lotr06057.name: Agents of Orthanc
lotr06057.game_text: This minion is strength +2 and damage +1 for each Free Peoples culture that you can spot over 2.
lotr06057.lore: “‘How long is it since Saruman bought you?'”

lotr06058.name: Assault Ladder
lotr06058.game_text: Machine. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Exert an Uruk-hai to place an [ISENGARD] token on this card. Skirmish: Spot 3 [ISENGARD] tokens here to make an Uruk-hai strength +3. Discard this condition.

lotr06059.name: Banner of Isengard
lotr06059.game_text: Bearer must be an [ISENGARD] minion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion for each site you control.
lotr06059.lore: “...blazoned upon every helm and shield the ghastly hand of Isengard was seen.”

lotr06060.name: Berserk Butcher
lotr06060.game_text: Damage +1. Berserk Butcher is strength +1 for each wound on each character in its skirmish. Maneuver: Remove an [ISENGARD] token from a machine and exert Berserk Butcher twice to prevent all wounds to Uruk-hai until the assignment phase.

lotr06061.name: Desertion
lotr06061.game_text: To play, spot an [ISENGARD] Man. Plays on a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Assignment: Assign an [ISENGARD] minion with less strength than bearer to skirmish bearer. Discard this condition.
lotr06061.lore: “‘Who knows what you've spoken to the darkness in the bitter watches of the night?'”

lotr06062.name: Fires and Foul Fumes
lotr06062.game_text: Regroup: Discard 4 [ISENGARD] orcs to wound a companion 4 times (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr06062.lore: “‘One of them... got caught in a spray of some liquid fire and burned like a torch: a horrible sight.'”

lotr06063.name: Gnawing, Biting, Hacking, Burning
lotr06063.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time a regroup action discards an [ISENGARD] Orc, you may stack that Orc on this card. Shadow: Discard 2 cards stacked here and remove (1) to play an [ISENGARD] Orc from your discard pile.

lotr06064.name: Iron Fist of the Orc
lotr06064.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time a regroup action discards an [ISENGARD] Orc, you may stack that Orc on this card. Regroup: Discard 3 cards stacked here and remove (1) to discard a Free Peoples possession.
lotr06064.lore: “‘The old world will burn in the fires of industry.'”

lotr06065.name: Isengard Artisan
lotr06065.game_text: Regroup: Discard an [ISENGARD] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lotr06065.lore: Minions of Orthanc shared their master's fascination with machines.

lotr06066.name: Isengard Builder
lotr06066.game_text: Regroup: If stacked on an [ISENGARD] card, discard this card to add (2).
lotr06066.lore: “‘They were all singing with harsh voices, and laughing, making a hideous din.'”

lotr06067.name: Isengard Journeyman
lotr06067.game_text: Regroup: Discard an [ISENGARD] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lotr06067.lore: Drudgery and toil at Isengard left Saruman's minions hungry for sport.

lotr06068.name: Isengard Mechanics
lotr06068.game_text: Regroup: Discard an [ISENGARD] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion (or 2 companions if you spot 6 companions). Regroup: If this minion is stacked on an [ISENGARD] card, spot an [ISENGARD] Orc and discard this minion to add (3).

lotr06069.name: Isengard Plodder
lotr06069.game_text: Regroup: Discard an [ISENGARD] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lotr06069.lore: Saruman dispatched his trusted Orcs to aid in the sack of Rohan.

lotr06070.name: Isengard Tender
lotr06070.game_text: Regroup: If stacked on an [ISENGARD] card, discard this card and remove (2) to exhaust a companion.
lotr06070.lore: Unfortunate Orcs assisted in Saruman's foul wizardry.

lotr06071.name: Isengard Tinker
lotr06071.game_text: Regroup: Discard an [ISENGARD] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lotr06071.lore: “‘I wonder if his fame was... due to his cleverness in settling at Isengard.'”

lotr06072.name: Rohirrim Traitor
lotr06072.game_text: While you can spot a companion bearing an [ISENGARD] condition, this minion is strength +2.
lotr06072.lore: “‘Once it was a man, and did you service in its fashion.'”

lotr06073.name: Scaffolding
lotr06073.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time a regroup action discards an [ISENGARD] Orc, you may stack that Orc on this card. Response: If an [ISENGARD] Orc is about to take a wound, discard 2 cards stacked here to prevent that wound.
lotr06073.lore: Towers marked the inner ring, implements of industry.

lotr06074.name: Sharku, Vile Marauder
lotr06074.subtitle: Vile Marauder
lotr06074.game_text: Warg-rider. While Sharku is not exhausted, he is fierce. Regroup: Exert Sharku to add (1).

lotr06075.name: Twisted Tales
lotr06075.game_text: Plays to your support area. Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish involving a [ISENGARD] Man, you may spot a possession to stack that possession here.
lotr06075.lore: “‘Too long have you sat in the shadows....'”

lotr06076.name: The Balrog, Terror of Flame and Shadow
lotr06076.subtitle: Terror of Flame and Shadow
lotr06076.game_text: Damage +2. The twilight cost of The Balrog is -3 if you can spot a [MORIA] minion. The Balrog cannot be assigned to skirmish companions or allies of strength less than 6.

lotr06077.name: Durin's Tower
lotr06077.game_text: Plays to your support area. At sites 2T and 3T, The Balrog's twilight cost is -3. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a unique [MORIA] minion strength +3.
lotr06077.lore: “‘...carved in the living rock of Zirakzigil, the pinnacle of the Silvertine.'”

lotr06078.name: Easterling Army
lotr06078.game_text: Easterling. Fierce. Skirmish: Spot 2 burdens and exert this minion to make an Easterling strength +1. Skirmish: Spot 4 burdens and exert this minion to make an Easterling strength +2. Skirmish: Spot 6 burdens and exert this minion to make an Easterling strength +3.

lotr06079.name: Easterling Polearm
lotr06079.game_text: Bearer must be an Easterling. While you can spot 2 burdens, bearer cannot take wounds. While you can spot 5 burdens, bearer is damage +1.

lotr06080.name: Southron Archer Legion
lotr06080.game_text: Southron. Archer. Archery: Remove (3) to add 1 to the minion archery total for each companion over 4 (limit +4).
lotr06080.lore: “‘But I've heard tales of the big folk down away in the Sunlands.'”

lotr06081.name: Southron Invaders
lotr06081.game_text: Southron. Ambush (1). When you play this minion, you may spot another Southron to play a minion with ambush from your discard pile.
lotr06081.lore: “‘So when you said “Men out of the South, all in red and gold,” I said “were there any oliphaunts?” For if there was, I was going to take a look....'”

lotr06082.name: Trample
lotr06082.game_text: Maneuver: Spot a mounted [RAIDER] Man to discard a companion (except the Ring-bearer). The Free Peoples player may add (4) to prevent this.
lotr06082.lore: “‘...I stomp round and round, / Never lie on the ground, / Not even to die. / Oliphaunt am I....'”

lotr06083.name: Fell Beast
lotr06083.game_text: To play, discard 2 cards from hand. Bearer must be a Nazgul. Bearer is fierce.
lotr06083.lore: “‘And these winged creatures that they ride on now, they can probably see more than any other creature. They are like great carrion birds.'”

lotr06084.name: Spied From Above
lotr06084.game_text: Plays to your support area. Regroup: Exert a Nazgul twice to play a [WRAITH] or [SAURON] minion. That minion's twilight cost is -8 and it comes into play exhausted.
lotr06084.lore: “It leaped into all of their minds that the Black Wings had spied them and had sent armed soldiers to seize them....”

lotr06085.name: Sword of Dol Guldur
lotr06085.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. While bearer is Ulaire Toldea, each time he wins a skirmish the Free Peoples player must discard a possession or condition.
lotr06085.lore: The weapons of the Nine are wrought with sorcery.

lotr06086.name: Ulaire Lemenya, Winged Hunter
lotr06086.subtitle: Winged Hunter
lotr06086.game_text: Regroup: Exert Ulaire Lemenya and discard 3 cards from hand to return a companion (except the Ring-bearer) to owner's hand.
lotr06086.lore: “...the helpless horror that had come with the cry in the wind and the shadow on the moon....”

lotr06087.name: Ulaire Nertea, Winged Hunter
lotr06087.subtitle: Winged Hunter
lotr06087.game_text: When you play Ulaire Nertea, spot another Nazgul to make the Free Peoples player exert a Ring-bound companion for each Free Peoples culture you can spot over 2.
lotr06087.lore: “A vast winged shape passed over the moon like a black cloud... The stars fainted before it....”

lotr06088.name: Ulaire Toldea, Winged Sentry
lotr06088.subtitle: Winged Sentry
lotr06088.game_text: Fierce. Each time Ulaire Toldea wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion or add a burden.
lotr06088.lore: “‘They are calling for it. Calling for the precious.'”

lotr06089.name: Winged and Ominous
lotr06089.game_text: Plays to your support area. Regroup: Exert a Nazgul to place a [WRAITH] token on this card. Shadow: Remove 3 [WRAITH] tokens from here to add (2).
lotr06089.lore: “It scudded across the moon... outrunning the wind in its fell speed.”

lotr06090.name: Banner of the Mark
lotr06090.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] companion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert a minion. Response: If bearer wins a skirmish, discard this possession to liberate a site.
lotr06090.lore: “‘Fell deeds awake. Now for wrath. Now for ruin, and the red dawn.'”

lotr06091.name: Blood Has Been Spilled
lotr06091.game_text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Discard a mount borne by a [ROHAN] Man to prevent that Man from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.
lotr06091.lore: “They were hemming the Orcs in, preventing them from scattering, and driving them....”

lotr06092.name: Eomer, Rohirrim Captain
lotr06092.subtitle: Rohirrim Captain
lotr06092.game_text: Valiant. While you can spot a [ROHAN] Man, Eomer's twilight cost is -1. Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to make a [ROHAN] Man strength +2 for each wound on each minion in his or her skirmish.

lotr06093.name: Ever the Hope of Men
lotr06093.game_text: Regroup: Exert 2 mounted [ROHAN] Men to discard up to 2 wounded minions.
lotr06093.lore: “‘Would that day was here and we might ride down upon them like a storm out of the mountains!'”

lotr06094.name: Hama, Doorward of Theoden
lotr06094.subtitle: Doorward of Theoden
lotr06094.game_text: To play, spot a [ROHAN] Man. Skirmish: Exert Hama to discard a possession borne by a minion he is skirmishing.
lotr06094.lore: “‘Yet in doubt a man of worth will trust to his own wisdom. I believe you are friends and folk worthy of honour, who have no evil purpose.'”

lotr06095.name: Hrethel, Rider of Rohan
lotr06095.subtitle: Rider of Rohan
lotr06095.game_text: To play, spot a [ROHAN] Man. Skirmish: Heal a minion skirmishing Hrethel to make Hrethel strength +3 (limit +3).
lotr06095.lore: “...gaining on the Orcs, gaining on them like a tide over the flats on folk straying in a quicksand.”

lotr06096.name: News From the Mark
lotr06096.game_text: Fellowship: Spot 3 mounted [ROHAN] Men to make the move limit for this turn +2. Each Shadow player may draw 6 cards.
lotr06096.lore: “‘We are friends of Rohan, and of Théoden, your king.'”

lotr06097.name: We Left None Alive
lotr06097.game_text: Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, you may spot a [ROHAN] Man to place 2 [ROHAN] tokens here. Skirmish: Discard this condition or remove a [ROHAN] token from here to make a [ROHAN] Man skirmishing an exhausted minion strength +2.

lotr06098.name: Banner of the Eye
lotr06098.game_text: Bearer must be an [SAURON] Orc. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may add (1) for each site you control.
lotr06098.lore: “Stony-faced they were, with dark window-holes staring north and east and west, and each window was full of sleepless eyes.”

lotr06099.name: Corpse Lights
lotr06099.game_text: Twilight. Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a [SAURON] or twilight minion strength +1 for each twilight minion you can spot.
lotr06099.lore: “‘I tried once; but you cannot reach them. Only shapes to see, perhaps, not to touch.'”

lotr06100.name: Dead Ones
lotr06100.game_text: Twilight. Damage +1. To play this minion, remove a burden or spot a twilight minion.
lotr06100.lore: “‘The Dead can't really be there! Is it some devilry hatched in the Dark Land?'”

lotr06101.name: Gate Picket
lotr06101.game_text: Maneuver: Exert this minion twice to make the Free Peoples player name 3 cultures. Wound each companion and ally not of a named culture.
lotr06101.lore: “Now the watch-towers, which had fallen into decay, were repaired, and filled with arms, and garrisoned with ceaseless vigilance.”

lotr06102.name: Gate Sentry
lotr06102.game_text: Maneuver: Exert this minion twice and spot another [SAURON] minion to discard a condition.
lotr06102.lore: “In it there was a single gate of iron, and upon its battlement sentinels paced unceasingly.”

lotr06103.name: Gate Troll
lotr06103.game_text: Fierce. While you can spot a Troll, Gate Troll's twilight cost is -4. For each other [SAURON] minion you can spot, this minion is strength +1.
lotr06103.lore: “This was Cirith Gorgor, the Haunted Pass, the entrance to the land of the Enemy.”

lotr06104.name: Orc Insurgent
lotr06104.game_text: Shadow: Exert this minion to draw X cards and add (X), where X is the number of Free Peoples cultures you spot over 2.
lotr06104.lore: “‘You've spoken more than enough, Uglúk,' sneered the evil voice. ‘I wonder how they would like it in Lugbúrz.'”

lotr06105.name: Peril
lotr06105.game_text: Plays to your support area. Regroup: Exert a [SAURON] Orc to play a Nazgul or [SAURON] minion. Its twilight cost is -4 and it comes into play exhausted.
lotr06105.lore: “‘A winged Nazgûl awaits us northward on the east-bank.'”

lotr06106.name: Troll of Udun
lotr06106.game_text: Fierce. While you can spot a Troll, this minion's twilight cost is -4. Skirmish: Discard a [SAURON] card from hand to make this minion strength +1.
lotr06106.lore: “‘...Trolls are only counterfeits, made by the Enemy in the Great Darkness, in mockery of Ents....'”

lotr06107.name: Troll's Chain
lotr06107.game_text: Bearer must be a [SAURON] Troll. When you play this possession, you may draw a card.
lotr06107.lore: “Trolls they were, but filled with the evil will of their master.”

lotr06108.name: Wisp of Pale Sheen
lotr06108.game_text: Twilight. Regroup: Spot another [SAURON] or twilight minion and discard this minion to add a burden.
lotr06108.lore: “‘They do not see what lies ahead / When Sun has failed and Moon is dead.'”

lotr06109.name: Held
lotr06109.game_text: Bearer must be Frodo. Each time Frodo is about to be killed by a wound, add a burden instead. When the fellowship moves to site 9, Frodo is corrupted. Regroup: If you can spot no minions, discard this condition.

lotr06110.name: It Burns Us
lotr06110.game_text: Regroup: Spot Sam and Smeagol (or Gollum) to choose an opponent who must reveal his or her hand. Wound a minion X times, where X is the number of different cultures revealed.

lotr06111.name: Kept Safe
lotr06111.game_text: Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, place 2 [SHIRE] tokens here. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is about to take a wound, discard this condition or remove a [SHIRE] token from here to prevent that wound.

lotr06112.name: Long Slow Wrath
lotr06112.game_text: Skirmish: Exert an unbound Hobbit to make him strength +1 and damage +1 for each [GANDALF] companion you can spot.
lotr06112.lore: “‘The coming of the hobbits and the tidings that they brought have spilled it: it will soon be running like a flood....'”

lotr06113.name: Merry, Impatient Hobbit
lotr06113.subtitle: Impatient Hobbit
lotr06113.game_text: Regroup: Discard Merry to heal a [GANDALF] companion.
lotr06113.lore: “‘Don't talk to it Merry. Don't encourage it.'”

lotr06114.name: Pippin, Hastiest of All
lotr06114.subtitle: Hastiest of All
lotr06114.game_text: Regroup: Discard Pippin to choose a Shadow player who must wound one of his or her minions.
lotr06114.lore: “‘By root and twig, but this is a strange business: up sprout a little folk that are not in the old lists....'”

lotr06115.name: Rocks of Emyn Muil
lotr06115.game_text: Fellowship: Play a companion with the Frodo signet to remove a burden.

lotr06116.name: Westfold
lotr06116.game_text: Fellowship: Exert Aragorn twice to play a companion with the Aragorn signet from your draw deck.

lotr06117.name: Meduseld
lotr06117.game_text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Exert 3 companions with the Gandalf signet to play an unbound companion from your dead pile.

lotr06118.name: Hornburg Hall
lotr06118.game_text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Spot 3 companions with the Theoden signet and discard your hand to draw 4 cards.

lotr06119.name: Valley of Saruman
lotr06119.game_text: When the fellowship moves to this site, discard all allies.

lotr06120.name: Saruman's Laboratory
lotr06120.game_text: Response: If your minion is about to take a wound, discard 2 cards from hand to prevent that wound.

lotr06121.name: Faramir, Ithilien Ranger
lotr06121.subtitle: Ithilien Ranger
lotr06121.game_text: Ring-bound. Ranger. If Faramir is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -1. Fellowship: Play a ranger to heal a Ring-bound companion.
lotr06121.lore: “‘Not while Faramir is Captain... his life is charmed, or fate spares him for some other end.'”

lotr06122.name: The Witch-king, Deathless Lord
lotr06122.subtitle: Deathless Lord
lotr06122.game_text: Fierce. Each time a companion is killed in a skirmish involving a Nazgul, wound an ally twice or exert a companion.

lotr06123.name: Enraged (AI)
lotr06123.game_text: Bearer must be an Ent. Limit 1 per bearer. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.
lotr06123.lore: “‘They pushed, pulled, tore, shook, and hammered....'”

lotr06124.name: Skinbark, Fladrif (AI)
lotr06124.subtitle: Fladrif (AI)
lotr06124.game_text: Skinbark's twilight cost is -1 for each Ent or unbound Hobbit you can spot. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is about to take a wound, exert Skinbark to prevent that wound.
lotr06124.lore: “‘He has gone up into the high places, among the birches that he loves best....'”

lotr06125.name: Don't Look at Them (AI)
lotr06125.game_text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Spot Smeagol and discard 3 cards from hand to wound a minion Smeagol is skirmishing once (or twice if that minion is a [WRAITH] minion).
lotr06125.lore: “‘You should not look in when the candles are lit.'”

lotr06126.name: Ancient Roads (AI)
lotr06126.game_text: Plays to your support area. While you can spot 3 rangers, the site number of each minion skirmishing a ranger is +2.
lotr06126.lore: “Presently the noise of fighting broke out near at hand, just above their hiding-place.”

lotr06127.name: Isengard Mechanics (AI)
lotr06127.game_text: Regroup: Discard an [ISENGARD] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion (or 2 companions if you spot 6 companions). Regroup: If this minion is stacked on an [ISENGARD] card, spot an [ISENGARD] Orc and discard this minion to add (3).

lotr06128.name: Gate Troll (AI)
lotr06128.game_text: Fierce. While you can spot a Troll, Gate Troll's twilight cost is -4. For each other [SAURON] minion you can spot, this minion is strength +1.
lotr06128.lore: “‘...what the plague did you bring us here for?'”

lotr07001.name: The One Ring, The Ruling Ring
lotr07001.subtitle: The Ruling Ring
lotr07001.game_text: Response: If bearer is about to take a wound in a skirmish, he wears The One Ring until the regroup phase. While wearing The One Ring, each time the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound during a skirmish, add a burden instead.

lotr07002.name: The One Ring, Such a Weight to Carry
lotr07002.subtitle: Such a Weight to Carry
lotr07002.game_text: Maneuver: Add a burden to wear The One Ring until the regroup phase. While wearing The One Ring, each time the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound, add a burden instead.

lotr07003.name: Battle Tested
lotr07003.game_text: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (+4 if you spot a card stacked on a [DWARVEN] condition).
lotr07003.lore: “‘We're going to follow you, lad – even on the dark Road....'”

lotr07004.name: Calculated Risk
lotr07004.game_text: Spot a Dwarf and add a threat to draw 3 cards.
lotr07004.lore: “‘Beyond the eyes of Dwarves are such fortellings....'”

lotr07005.name: Dark Ways
lotr07005.game_text: To play, spot a Dwarf. Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition. Regroup: Discard this condition to heal a Dwarf twice and take a [DWARVEN] skirmish event into hand from your discard pile.

lotr07006.name: Gimli, Faithful Companion
lotr07006.subtitle: Faithful Companion
lotr07006.game_text: Damage +1. While you have initiative, Gimli is strength +2.

lotr07007.name: Gimli, Feared Axeman
lotr07007.subtitle: Feared Axeman
lotr07007.game_text: Damage +1. Response: if a [DWARVEN] condition is about to be discarded by an opponent, exert a Dwarf or discard a [DWARVEN] card from hand to prevent that.

lotr07008.name: Gimli's Armor
lotr07008.game_text: Bearer must be Gimli. Response: If you have initiative and Gimli is about to take a wound, discard 2 cards from hand to prevent that wound.

lotr07009.name: Gimli's Battle Axe, Trusted Weapon
lotr07009.subtitle: Trusted Weapon
lotr07009.game_text: Bearer must be a dwarf. While you can spot a threat, bearer is damage +1. While you can spot 2 threats, bearer is strength +1. While you can spot 3 threats, the fellowship archery total is +1.

lotr07010.name: Loyalty Unshaken
lotr07010.game_text: When you play this condition, you may stack 2 cards from hand here. Draw a card for each [DWARVEN] card you stack. Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2. Also, make that Dwarf damage +2 for each [DWARVEN] card stacked on this condition. Discard this condition.

lotr07011.name: Out of Darkness
lotr07011.game_text: Make a Dwarf strength +2. You may also exert that Dwarf to draw 2 cards.
lotr07011.lore: “‘Had I known what was before me, I think that not for any friendship would I have taken the Paths of the Dead.'”

lotr07012.name: Preparations
lotr07012.game_text: Regroup: Exert a Dwarf companion to stack a card from your discard pile here. Skirmish: Wound a minion skirmishing a Dwarf once for each [DWARVEN] card stacked here. Discard this condition.

lotr07013.name: Reckless Pride
lotr07013.game_text: Bearer must be a [DWARVEN] companion. Each minion gains this ability: 'Assignment: Assign this minion to bearer of Reckless Pride.' Regroup: Discard this condition to draw 4 cards.

lotr07014.name: Slaked Thirsts
lotr07014.game_text: Spot a Dwarf to draw a card, or if this card is stacked on a [DWARVEN] condition, spot a Dwarf companion and discard this event to exert a minion twice.
lotr07014.lore: “‘Food and drink would pay off some of my score against you.'”

lotr07015.name: Ancient Blade
lotr07015.game_text: Bearer must be an [ELVEN] companion. Each minion gains this ability: 'Assignment: Assign this minion to bearer of Ancient Blade.' Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a minion and reconcile your hand.

lotr07016.name: Arwen, Fair Elf Maiden
lotr07016.subtitle: Fair Elf Maiden
lotr07016.game_text: While skirmishing a fierce minion, Arwen is strength +3.
lotr07016.lore: “‘But she also sends word to you... Fair well, Elfstone!'”

lotr07017.name: Asfaloth, Elven Steed
lotr07017.subtitle: Elven Steed
lotr07017.game_text: Bearer must be an Elf. Skirmish: If bearer is Arwen, exert her to make each minion skirmishing her strength -2.

lotr07018.name: Bow of the Galadhrim, Gift of Galadriel
lotr07018.subtitle: Gift of Galadriel
lotr07018.game_text: Bearer must be Legolas. Each time you play an [ELVEN] skirmish event during a skirmish involving Legolas, you may heal him.

lotr07019.name: Careful Study
lotr07019.game_text: Spot an Elf and discard 3 cards from hand to reconcile your hand.
lotr07019.lore: “‘If thou art in haste, remember the Paths of the Dead.'”

lotr07020.name: Defiance
lotr07020.game_text: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a Nazgul).

lotr07021.name: Elrond, Elven Lord
lotr07021.subtitle: Elven Lord
lotr07021.game_text: To play, spot Aragorn or an Elf. At the start of each turn, you may exert Elrond to heal a character bearing an artifact.

lotr07022.name: Hope Comes
lotr07022.game_text: To play, spot 2 Elves. Response: If an [ELVEN] skirmish event is played, discard this condition to draw 3 cards.

lotr07023.name: Into the West
lotr07023.game_text: Regroup: Exert an Elf to reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [ELVEN] card, remove 3 threats. Place the revealed card beneath your draw deck.

lotr07024.name: Leaving Forever
lotr07024.game_text: To play, spot 3 Elves. Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition. Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a condition or draw 2 cards.

lotr07025.name: Legolas, Fearless Marksman
lotr07025.subtitle: Fearless Marksman
lotr07025.game_text: Archer. Archery: If you have initiative, discard 4 cards from hand to wound a minion.

lotr07026.name: Legolas, Nimble Warrior
lotr07026.subtitle: Nimble Warrior
lotr07026.game_text: Archer. Archery: If you cannot spot a threat, add a threat to make the fellowship archery total +1.

lotr07027.name: Mirkwood Bowman
lotr07027.game_text: Exert 2 [ELVEN] companions to discard the top 3 cards of your draw deck. Make the fellowship archery total +1 for each [ELVEN] card discarded.
lotr07027.lore: “‘Thus we passed over Gilrain, driving the allies of Mordor in rout before us....'”

lotr07028.name: Shadow Between
lotr07028.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. At the start of your regroup phase, you may discard this condition or a card from hand to heal an Elf.

lotr07029.name: Still Needed
lotr07029.game_text: Make an Elf strength +2. You may place this event on top of your draw deck.
lotr07029.lore: “‘You must not go to the Havens Legolas. There will always be some folk... who need you.'”

lotr07030.name: Uncertain Paths
lotr07030.game_text: Make an Elf strength +2 and you may shuffle your draw deck.
lotr07030.lore: “‘But defenders and foes alike gave up the battle....'”

lotr07031.name: All Save One
lotr07031.game_text: Make Gandalf strength +2 (or +4 and damage +1 if you have initiative).

lotr07032.name: The Board Is Set
lotr07032.game_text: Spell. If an event is played, exert Gandalf to make that opponent remove (2) or cancel that event.

lotr07033.name: Citadel to Gate
lotr07033.game_text: Exert Gandalf twice to remove all threats and to heal all companions of one culture (except [GANDALF]).
lotr07033.lore: “Wherever he came men's hearts would lift again, and the winged shadows pass from memory.”

lotr07034.name: Echoes of Valinor
lotr07034.game_text: Each time Gandalf wins a skirmish, you may exert him to draw 2 cards.
lotr07034.lore: “‘Here in the Court of the Kings, Isildur grew a white tree, from a seed brought over the waters....'”

lotr07035.name: Fool's Hope
lotr07035.game_text: Spot Gandalf and discard 2 cards from hand to make an opponent discard all but 2 Shadow conditions.

lotr07036.name: Gandalf, Defender of the West
lotr07036.subtitle: Defender of the West
lotr07036.game_text: While you cannot spot 3 companions of the same culture, Gandalf is strength -2.
lotr07036.lore: “‘I come with counsel and tidings in this dark hour.'”

lotr07037.name: Gandalf, Manager of Wizards
lotr07037.subtitle: Manager of Wizards
lotr07037.game_text: Skirmish: Place 3 cards from hand on top of your draw deck to make a minion skirmishing an unbound companion strength -3. Any Shadow player may place 3 cards from his or her hand on top of his or her draw deck to prevent this.

lotr07038.name: Gandalf's Staff, Focus of Power
lotr07038.subtitle: Focus of Power
lotr07038.game_text: Bearer must be Gandalf. While you can spot 4 twilight tokens, Gandalf is strength +1.

lotr07039.name: Glamdring, Elven Blade
lotr07039.subtitle: Elven Blade
lotr07039.game_text: Bearer must be Gandalf. He is damage +1. Skirmish: If you have more cards in hand than each opponent, discard 2 cards from hand to make an opponent exert a minion.

lotr07040.name: Have Patience
lotr07040.game_text: Spot Gandalf to heal an unbound companion twice.

lotr07041.name: Intimidate
lotr07041.game_text: Spell. If a companion is about to take a wound, spot Gandalf to prevent that wound.

lotr07042.name: King's Advisor
lotr07042.game_text: Exert Gandalf twice to make an opponent exert a minion for each [ROHAN] companion you spot.
lotr07042.lore: “‘Will they answer the summons, think you?'”

lotr07043.name: Light the Beacons
lotr07043.game_text: Exert Gandalf three times (or twice if you have initiative) to make all unbound companions of one culture (except [GANDALF]) strength +3 until the regroup phase.
lotr07043.lore: “‘Theoden will honour your old alliance and come with a mighty army.'”

lotr07044.name: Moment of Respite
lotr07044.game_text: At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard 2 cards from hand to heal Gandalf.
lotr07044.lore: “‘...Gandalf says you must go ere nightfall, and the Lord of the Mark is eager for his own house.'”

lotr07045.name: Numenor's Pride
lotr07045.game_text: To play, spot Gandalf and add 3 threats. Gandalf is defender +1 and cannot take wounds. Discard this condition at the start of the regroup phase.

lotr07046.name: Peace of Mind
lotr07046.game_text: Spot Gandalf to heal an unbound Hobbit 3 times.
lotr07046.lore: “‘All Wizards should have a Hobbit or two in their care... to teach them the meaning of humility!'”

lotr07047.name: Sharpen Your Swords
lotr07047.game_text: Spot Gandalf to make a [GONDOR] companion strength +1 for each [GONDOR] companion you spot (limit +4).
lotr07047.lore: “‘Courage will now be your best defence against the storm that is at hand....'”

lotr07048.name: Stay This Madness
lotr07048.game_text: To play, spot Gandalf. Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition. Regroup: Discard this condition to wound 2 minions.

lotr07049.name: Steadfast Champion
lotr07049.game_text: Bearer must be Gandalf. Each minion gains this ability: 'Assignment: Assign this minion to Gandalf.' Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a minion and heal a companion 3 times.

lotr07050.name: Terrible and Evil
lotr07050.game_text: Spell. Exert Gandalf X times to wound a minion X times. If that minion is a Nazgul, wound it again.

lotr07051.name: Undaunted
lotr07051.game_text: Exert Gandalf to make him strength +1 for each twilight token you spot (limit +8).

lotr07052.name: Wizard Staff
lotr07052.game_text: Bearer must be a Wizard. Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to make a minion strength -3.

lotr07053.name: Captured by the Ring
lotr07053.game_text: Play Gollum from your draw deck or discard pile to add a threat.

lotr07054.name: Clever Hobbits
lotr07054.game_text: Discard any number of [GOLLUM] conditions. For each condition discarded, make Smeagol strength +3 and damage +1.
lotr07054.lore: “‘Clever hobbits to climb so high, very clever hobbits!'”

lotr07055.name: Days Growing Dark
lotr07055.game_text: Fellowship: Discard 3 cards from hand to play Smeagol from your discard pile.
lotr07055.lore: “‘Come on, we must go, no time to lose!'”

lotr07056.name: The Dead City
lotr07056.game_text: Stealth. Bearer must be Smeagol. If Smeagol is about to be killed in a skirmish, he is discarded instead.

lotr07057.name: Fat One Wants It
lotr07057.game_text: Each time Gollum or Smeagol is played, add a threat. Regroup: Discard this condition to return Gollum to his owner's hand.

lotr07058.name: Gollum, Plotting Deceiver
lotr07058.subtitle: Plotting Deceiver
lotr07058.game_text: If you have initiative during the Shadow phase, you may play this minion from your discard pile.
lotr07058.lore: “‘Let Her deal with them... she must eat. All She gets is filthy Orcses.'”

lotr07059.name: Gollum, Vile Creature
lotr07059.subtitle: Vile Creature
lotr07059.game_text: Skirmish: Exert Gollum twice or remove a threat to make him strength +2.
lotr07059.lore: “‘When they come to the bridge they will see us. Come away! Climb, climb!'”

lotr07060.name: Heavy Burden
lotr07060.game_text: Regroup: Discard Gollum and remove a threat to add a burden.
lotr07060.lore: “‘Sméagol knows... Sméagol carried burden many years.'”

lotr07061.name: Hobbitses Are Dead
lotr07061.game_text: Spot Gollum or Smeagol to make a Nazgul, [SAURON] minion, or [GOLLUM] minion strength +2. If you have initiative, you may play this event from your discard pile; place it under your draw deck instead of discarding it.

lotr07062.name: It's Mine
lotr07062.game_text: Shadow: Remove (1) and exert Gollum to discard the top card of your draw deck. If that card is a [GOLLUM] or [WRAITH] card, take it into hand.
lotr07062.lore: “‘See! See! He wants it for himself.'”

lotr07063.name: Let Her Deal With Them
lotr07063.game_text: To play, spot Gollum or Smeagol. Bearer must be a minion. Limit 1 per bearer. Bearer is damage +1. If you have initiative during the Shadow phase, you may play this condition from your discard pile.

lotr07064.name: Nasty
lotr07064.game_text: Make Smeagol strength +1 for each [GOLLUM] card you spot.
lotr07064.lore: “‘He's a fat, horrid Hobbit, who hates Sméagol, who makes up nasty lies.'”

lotr07065.name: Never
lotr07065.game_text: To play, spot Smeagol. Regroup: Discard Smeagol to remove 2 threats.

lotr07066.name: No Safe Places
lotr07066.game_text: Exert Smeagol to reveal an opponent's hand. That opponent must discard a card for each culture revealed.
lotr07066.lore: “‘...they are watching... eyes will see us.'”

lotr07067.name: Plotting
lotr07067.game_text: To play, spot Gollum and add up to 9 threats. Gollum is strength +2. Discard this condition and remove 9 threats at the start of the regroup phase.

lotr07068.name: Scouting
lotr07068.game_text: To play, spot Smeagol. Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition. Maneuver: Discard Smeagol to discard a minion. An opponent may exert a minion twice to prevent this.

lotr07069.name: Secret Paths
lotr07069.game_text: To play, spot Smeagol and add 2 threats. The move limit for this turn is +1. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.

lotr07070.name: Serving the Precious
lotr07070.game_text: Discard Smeagol to play a companion from your discard pile.
lotr07070.lore: “‘Sméagol look after Master. Sméagol serve Master well!'”

lotr07071.name: Smeagol, Always Helps
lotr07071.subtitle: Always Helps
lotr07071.game_text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Assignment: Assign a minion to Smeagol and add 2 threats to exhaust that minion.

lotr07072.name: Smeagol, Hurried Guide
lotr07072.subtitle: Hurried Guide
lotr07072.game_text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Skirmish: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from your hand. Smeagol cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.

lotr07073.name: Sneaking!
lotr07073.game_text: Stealth. Heal Smeagol (or cancel Smeagol's skirmish if he has more vitality than the minion or minions he is skirmishing).

lotr07074.name: So Polite
lotr07074.game_text: Play Gollum from your discard pile to add (1) for each threat you spot.
lotr07074.lore: “‘Sméagol shows them secret ways that nobody else could find and they say, ‘Sneak!''”

lotr07075.name: Sweeter Meats
lotr07075.game_text: If a minion is about to take a wound, spot Gollum to prevent that wound.
lotr07075.lore: “‘It may well be, oh yes, it may very well be, that when She throws away the bones and the empty clothes... we shall find It!'”

lotr07076.name: Very Nice Friends
lotr07076.game_text: Play Smeagol from your discard pile to play the fellowship's next site (replacing an opponent's site if necessary). If you do not move again this turn, discard your hand.

lotr07077.name: We Hates Them
lotr07077.game_text: Bearer must be Smeagol. Each minion gains this ability: 'Assignment: Assign this minion to Smeagol.' Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a minion and play a companion from your discard pile.

lotr07078.name: Where Shall We Go
lotr07078.game_text: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from hand to wound a minion Smeagol is skirmishing twice.
lotr07078.lore: “‘If you scare him off, we are lost.'”

lotr07079.name: Anduril, Flame of the West
lotr07079.subtitle: Flame of the West
lotr07079.game_text: Bearer must be Aragorn. Discard any other weapon he bears. He is damage +1 and cannot bear other weapons. Fellowship or Regroup: If the fellowship is at any site 2 or any site 5, play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary).

lotr07080.name: Anduril, King's Blade
lotr07080.subtitle: King's Blade
lotr07080.game_text: Bearer must be Aragorn. If you cannot spot a threat, Aragorn is defender +1.
lotr07080.lore: "The Sword of Elendil was forged anew by Elvish smiths... for Aragorn son of Arathorn was going to war upon the marches of Morder."

lotr07081.name: Aragorn, Captain of Gondor
lotr07081.subtitle: Captain of Gondor
lotr07081.game_text: Knight. At the start of each fellowship phase, you may add (2) to heal another [GONDOR] companion.

lotr07082.name: Cirion
lotr07082.game_text: While you have only 4 or 5 cards in hand, Cirion is strength +2.
lotr07082.lore: “So now at last the City was besieged...”

lotr07083.name: City of Men
lotr07083.game_text: Make a [GONDOR] Man strength +2. If that Man is skirmishing a [SAURON] minion, discard that minion at the end of the skirmish.
lotr07083.lore: “‘I will gladly give my life to defend her beauty, her memory... her wisdom.'”

lotr07084.name: Dagger Strike
lotr07084.game_text: Make a [GONDOR] or [SHIRE] companion bearing a hand weapon strength +2 and damage +1.

lotr07085.name: Denethor, Steward of the City
lotr07085.subtitle: Steward of the City
lotr07085.game_text: Fellowship: Play a [GONDOR] knight. That knight's twilight cost is -2. Each time a Shadow card adds a threat, add a burden. Each time a Shadow card adds a burden, add a threat.

lotr07086.name: Denethor, Wizened Steward
lotr07086.subtitle: Wizened Steward
lotr07086.game_text: Denethor is strength +1 for each other [GONDOR] Man you can spot (limit +4).
lotr07086.lore: “‘...in desperate hours gentleness may be repaid with death.'”

lotr07087.name: Derufin
lotr07087.game_text: Regroup: While you have exactly 5 cards in hand, you may exert Derufin to discard an engine, machine, or possession.

lotr07088.name: Dervorin
lotr07088.game_text: At the start of the regroup phase, if you have only 4 cards in hand, you may spot another [GONDOR] Man to discard a minion.
lotr07088.lore: “The men of Ringló Vale behind the son of their lord....”

lotr07089.name: Duty of Two
lotr07089.game_text: Add 3 threats to heal all [GONDOR] companions.
lotr07089.lore: “‘...for himself, and for the one that will not return.'”

lotr07090.name: Faramir, Stout Captain
lotr07090.subtitle: Stout Captain
lotr07090.game_text: Ranger. To play, spot a [GONDOR] Man. Each time Faramir wins a skirmish involving a fierce minion, you may exert Faramir to discard that minion.

lotr07091.name: Faramir, Wizard's Pupil
lotr07091.subtitle: Wizard's Pupil
lotr07091.game_text: Ranger. Fellowship: Play a [ROHAN] Man to heal Faramir. Skirmish: Exert Faramir to make an unbound Hobbit strength +2. Skirmish: Exert Gandalf to prevent all wounds to Faramir.

lotr07092.name: First Level
lotr07092.game_text: Fortification. Maneuver: Exert a [GONDOR] Man or spot a knight to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion.

lotr07093.name: Footman's Armor
lotr07093.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. Response: if bearer is about to be overwhelmed, discard a [GONDOR] fortification or a card from hand to make bearer strength +2.

lotr07094.name: Gondor Bow
lotr07094.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. If bearer is a knight, he or she is strength +1. Skirmish: Exert bearer to wound a minion he or she is skirmishing if that minion bears a fortification.

lotr07095.name: Gondor Still Stands
lotr07095.game_text: To play, spot 3 [GONDOR] companions. While no opponent controls a site, wound a minion at the start of each regroup phase. Regroup: Discard this condition to place a [GONDOR] fortification from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.

lotr07096.name: Gondorian Captain
lotr07096.game_text: Knight. Fellowship: Discard a fortification to remove a threat.

lotr07097.name: Gondorian Merchant
lotr07097.game_text: Maneuver: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from hand to make the site number of a minion +2 until the regroup phase.
lotr07097.lore: “...they talked now of Gondor and its ways and customs....”

lotr07098.name: Gondorian Sword
lotr07098.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to make bearer damage +1.

lotr07099.name: Great Gate
lotr07099.game_text: Make a [GONDOR] companion strength +2 and, if you can spot 2 [GONDOR] fortifications, exert a minion that companion is skirmishing.
lotr07099.lore: “...and its iron doors rolled back before them.”

lotr07100.name: Greatest Stronghold
lotr07100.game_text: Exert a [GONDOR] Man and spot 3 fortifications to make the fellowship archery total +2.

lotr07101.name: Guarded
lotr07101.game_text: To play, spot 3 [GONDOR] Men. Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition. Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a minion (or all roaming minions).

lotr07102.name: Hasty Repairs
lotr07102.game_text: To play, spot 3 [GONDOR] Men. Regroup: While you have only 4 cards in hand, you may discard 2 cards from hand to play a [GONDOR] fortification from your discard pile.

lotr07103.name: Hearts Raised
lotr07103.game_text: At the start of your regroup phase, you may spot a [GONDOR] Man and discard a card from hand to remove a threat.
lotr07103.lore: “...lifted for a while by the return of Faramir....”

lotr07104.name: Hidden Knowledge

lotr07105.name: I Will Go
lotr07105.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. If you have initiative, bearer is defender +1.

lotr07106.name: Ingold
lotr07106.game_text: Knight. Fellowship: Discard a fortification to heal Ingold twice.

lotr07107.name: Iorlas
lotr07107.game_text: Response: If a possession or engine is played by your opponent, remove a [GONDOR] token from your condition to make that opponent remove (1). If he or she cannot, discard that possession or engine.

lotr07108.name: Knight's Spear
lotr07108.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. Skirmish: If you cannot spot 2 threats, add a threat to make bearer strength +1.

lotr07109.name: Long Prepared
lotr07109.game_text: To play, add 2 threats. Skirmish: Exert a [GONDOR] Man to wound a roaming minion that Man is skirmishing. Discard this condition at the start of the regroup phase.

lotr07110.name: Madril, Faramir's Aide
lotr07110.subtitle: Faramir's Aide
lotr07110.game_text: Ranger. Skirmish: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from hand to wound a roaming minion Madril is skirmishing.

lotr07111.name: Man the Walls
lotr07111.game_text: The site number of each minion skirmishing a [GONDOR] Man is +1.
lotr07111.lore: “...their force was too weak to make any stroke of war on their own part....”

lotr07112.name: Noble Leaders
lotr07112.game_text: When you play this condition, place a [GONDOR] token here for each of the following characters you can spot: Aragorn, Boromir, Denethor or Faramir. Skirmish: Remove a token from here or discard this condition to make a [GONDOR] companion strength +1 and damage +1.

lotr07113.name: Pippin's Armor
lotr07113.game_text: Bearer must be Pippin. While you can spot 3 [GONDOR] Men, Pippin may take no more than 1 wound in a skirmish.

lotr07114.name: Pippin's Sword
lotr07114.game_text: Bearer must be Pippin. Skirmish: Exert Pippin twice make him strength +1 for each [GONDOR] companion you spot.

lotr07115.name: Ranger of Minas Tirith
lotr07115.game_text: Ranger. While skirmishing a roaming minion, this companion is strength +2 and damage +1.

lotr07116.name: Ranger of Osgiliath
lotr07116.game_text: Ranger. Regroup: Discard 2 cards from hand to exhaust a minion.

lotr07117.name: Reckless Counter
lotr07117.game_text: Spot 2 knights or exert 2 [GONDOR] Men to liberate a site or discard any number of cards from hand.
lotr07117.lore: “‘Do not throw your life away so rashly!'”

lotr07118.name: Second Level
lotr07118.game_text: Fortification. Maneuver: Exert a [GONDOR] Man or spot a ranger to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion.

lotr07119.name: Seventh Level
lotr07119.game_text: Fortification. Skirmish: Exert 3 [GONDOR] Men to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [GONDOR] Man.

lotr07120.name: Stand to Arms
lotr07120.game_text: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from hand to wound a roaming minion skirmishing a [GONDOR] Man twice.

lotr07121.name: Stout Resistance
lotr07121.game_text: Add a threat to make a [GONDOR] Man strength +3.
lotr07121.lore: “...the hardiest of the garrison stood at bay.”

lotr07122.name: Strong and Old
lotr07122.game_text: To play, spot 2 [GONDOR] Men. The twilight cost of each of your [GONDOR] fortifications is -1. Response: If an opponent is about to control a site, discard 2 [GONDOR] fortifications to prevent this.

lotr07123.name: Support of the City
lotr07123.game_text: Fellowship: Play a [GONDOR] Man to place a [GONDOR] token here. Fellowship: Play a [GONDOR] companion. That companion's twilight cost is -1 for each token here. Discard this condition.

lotr07124.name: Targon
lotr07124.game_text: Ranger. Skirmish: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from hand to wound a Man Targon is skirmishing.

lotr07125.name: Third Level
lotr07125.game_text: Fortification. Skirmish: Exert a [GONDOR] Man or spot 2 rangers to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [GONDOR] Man.

lotr07126.name: Unexpected Visitor
lotr07126.game_text: Bearer must be an [GONDOR] companion. Each minion gains this ability: 'Assignment: Assign this minion to bearer of Unexpected Visitor.' Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a minion and remove (4).

lotr07127.name: Vorondil
lotr07127.game_text: While no opponent controls a site, Vorondil is strength +2. Regroup: Exert 3 [GONDOR] Men or 2 knights to liberate a site.

lotr07128.name: While We Yet Live
lotr07128.game_text: Make a roaming minion skirmishing a [GONDOR] Man strength -3.
lotr07128.lore: “‘...not if the Nameless One himself should come, not even he could enter....'”

lotr07129.name: Bold Men and Grim
lotr07129.game_text: To play, spot 2 [RAIDER] Men and add a threat. Each time a companion is about to be killed, you may remove a threat to discard a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Discard this condition at the start of the regroup phase.

lotr07130.name: Dark Tidings
lotr07130.game_text: Regroup: Spot 2 [RAIDER] Men and remove (3) to add a threat (limit 1).

lotr07131.name: Desert Fighter
lotr07131.game_text: Southron. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may remove (1) to add a threat.

lotr07132.name: Desert Nomad
lotr07132.game_text: Southron. While you can spot 2 threats, this minion is damage +1.

lotr07133.name: Desert Runner
lotr07133.game_text: Southron. Ambush (1). When the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to a character and you have initiative, wound that character.

lotr07134.name: Desert Scout
lotr07134.game_text: Southron. Ambush (1). When the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to a character and you have initiative, wound that character.

lotr07135.name: Desert Sneak
lotr07135.game_text: Southron. Ambush (1). When the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to a character and you have initiative, wound that character.

lotr07136.name: Desert Soldier

lotr07137.name: Desert Spearman
lotr07137.game_text: Southron. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may remove (3) to wound a companion or ally he is skirmishing.

lotr07138.name: Desert Villain
lotr07138.game_text: Southron. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may remove (1) to add a threat.

lotr07139.name: Easterling Aggressor
lotr07139.game_text: Easterling. Skirmish: If you have initiative or you spot 3 Easterlings, discard 2 cards from hand to heal another Easterling.

lotr07140.name: Easterling Assailant
lotr07140.game_text: Easterling. Skirmish: Remove a burden and exert this minion to heal another Easterling (or 2 Easterlings if you have initiative).

lotr07141.name: Easterling Attacker
lotr07141.game_text: Easterling. Skirmish: Exert this minion to make him damage +1.

lotr07142.name: Easterling Blademaster
lotr07142.game_text: Easterling. Skirmish: Exert this minion to make him damage +1.

lotr07143.name: Easterling Footman
lotr07143.game_text: Easterling. Maneuver: If you cannot spot 2 burdens, spot another Easterling and discard a card from hand to add a burden.

lotr07144.name: Easterling Ransacker
lotr07144.game_text: Easterling. Skirmish: Exert this minion to make him damage +1.

lotr07145.name: Easterling Regiment
lotr07145.game_text: Easterling. Fierce. Each time Easterling Regiment wins a skirmish, you may add (1) for each burden.

lotr07146.name: Easterling Sergeant
lotr07146.game_text: Easterling. Maneuver: If you cannot spot a burden, spot another Easterling and exert this minion to add a burden.

lotr07147.name: Easterling Veteran
lotr07147.game_text: Easterling. Skirmish: Remove 2 burdens to heal another Easterling.

lotr07148.name: Fierce in Despair
lotr07148.game_text: Spot 2 [RAIDER] Men to discard a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr07148.lore: “...displaying his standard, black serpent upon scarlet....”

lotr07149.name: Great Beasts
lotr07149.game_text: To play, spot a [RAIDER] Man. Regroup: Remove (9) and spot 3 [RAIDER] Men to make the move limit -1.

lotr07150.name: Harsh Tongues
lotr07150.game_text: To play, spot a [RAIDER] Man. Regroup: Remove (3) and spot a [RAIDER] Man to place a [RAIDER] token here. While there are 3 [RAIDER] tokens here, the Shadow has initiative regardless of the Free Peoples player's hand.

lotr07151.name: Hosts Still Unfought
lotr07151.game_text: To play, spot 2 [RAIDER] Men. Discard any number of cards from hand. The Free Peoples player then discards any number of cards from hand. For each card you discarded more than the Free Peoples player, add (1).

lotr07152.name: Mumak Commander
lotr07152.game_text: Southron. To play, spot a [RAIDER] Man. While you can spot 6 threats, each time this minion wins a skirmish, the companion he was skirmishing is killed.

lotr07153.name: Mumakil of the Harad
lotr07153.game_text: Spot a [RAIDER] minion to add (2) for each threat.
lotr07153.lore: “...dragging through the lanes amid the fires....”

lotr07154.name: New Strength Came Now
lotr07154.game_text: Make a [RAIDER] Man strength +3 (or +6 if you have initiative).

lotr07155.name: Raider Bow
lotr07155.game_text: Bearer must be a [RAIDER] Man. Bearer is an archer and ambush (5).

lotr07156.name: Raider Halberd
lotr07156.game_text: Bearer must be a [RAIDER] Man. Skirmish: Exert bearer to add (2).

lotr07157.name: Red Wrath
lotr07157.game_text: Exert a [RAIDER] Man to wound a companion he is skirmishing twice.
lotr07157.lore: “...he came against the white horse and the green with great press of men....”

lotr07158.name: Rout
lotr07158.game_text: To play, spot a [RAIDER] Man. Each time the fellowship moves, the Free Peoples player must exert 2 companions if you have initiative.

lotr07159.name: Small Hope
lotr07159.game_text: Maneuver: If you cannot spot 2 burdens, exert an Easterling to add a burden. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make an Easterling strength +2.

lotr07160.name: Southron Bandit
lotr07160.game_text: Southron. Maneuver: Exert this minion to add (5). The Free Peoples player may add a threat to prevent this.

lotr07161.name: Southron Brigand
lotr07161.game_text: Southron. Shadow: Remove (3) and spot 3 [RAIDER] Men to make one of those Men damage +1 until the regroup phase.

lotr07162.name: Southron Captain
lotr07162.game_text: Southron. While you can spot 4 threats, this minion is damage +2.

lotr07163.name: Southron Chieftain
lotr07163.game_text: Southron. To play, spot a [RAIDER] Man. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to a character, the Shadow has initiative until the end of the turn.

lotr07164.name: Southron Conqueror
lotr07164.game_text: Southron. Archer. While you can spot 6 twilight tokens, other [RAIDER] Men are damage +1. While you can spot 9 twilight tokens, other [RAIDER] Men are damage +1.

lotr07165.name: Southron Intruder
lotr07165.game_text: Southron. Archer. While you can spot 3 twilight tokens, all [RAIDER] Men are strength +1. While you can spot 6 twilight tokens, all [RAIDER] Men are strength +1. While you can spot 9 twilight tokens, all [RAIDER] Men are strength +1.

lotr07166.name: Southron Leader
lotr07166.game_text: Southron. Archery: Spot 4 Free Peoples cultures and either exert this minion or remove a threat to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).

lotr07167.name: Southron Marksmen
lotr07167.game_text: Southron. Archer. Fierce. To play, spot a [RAIDER] Man. Archery: Exert this minion and remove a threat to make the minion archery total +1.

lotr07168.name: Southron Thief
lotr07168.game_text: Southron. Archery: Spot another [RAIDER] Man, spot 6 companions, and remove a threat to exert a companion.
