lotr07170.name: Suzerain of Harad
lotr07170.game_text: Southron. Archer. While you have initiative, the Ring-bearer cannot take wounds during the archery phase and this minion is ambush (8).

lotr07171.name: Thrice Outnumbered
lotr07171.game_text: Spot a threat and X [RAIDER] Men to make the Free Peoples player exert X companions (limit 3).
lotr07171.lore: “Southward beyond the road lay the main force of the Haradrim....”

lotr07172.name: Troop of Haradrim
lotr07172.game_text: Southron. While you can spot 2 threats, this minion is an archer. While you can spot 3 threats, this minion is fierce. While you can spot 4 threats, this minion is damage +1.

lotr07173.name: War Towers
lotr07173.game_text: Spot a [RAIDER] minion to add a threat. Add an additional threat for each companion over 4.
lotr07173.lore: “...behind them rose the huge backs of the mûmakil....”

lotr07174.name: Called
lotr07174.game_text: Assignment: Remove 5 threats to assign a Nazgul to a companion (except the Ring-bearer). The Free Peoples player may discard that companion.
lotr07174.lore: “...sensing some other power within his valley.”

lotr07175.name: Corrupt
lotr07175.game_text: Make a Nazgul strength +1 for each Free Peoples culture you spot.
lotr07175.lore: “Figures stood there at its head, carven with cunning in forms human and bestial, but all corrupt and loathsome.”

lotr07176.name: Disposable Servants
lotr07176.game_text: Spot a Nazgul to discard any number of cards from your hand. The Free Peoples player then discards any number of cards from his or her hand. For each card you discarded more than the Free Peoples player, add a threat.

lotr07177.name: Feel His Blade
lotr07177.game_text: Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a character skirmishing a Nazgul. During the turn this card is transferred, the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples player's hand.

lotr07178.name: Foul Clutches
lotr07178.game_text: Discard 3 cards from hand to make a Nazgul strength +3.
lotr07178.lore: “‘Ah! there one of the foul things is stooping on him.'”

lotr07179.name: Ghastly Host
lotr07179.game_text: Shadow: Spot a Nazgul and remove a threat to play a Nazgul. Its twilight cost is -2.
lotr07179.lore: “And out of the gate an army came.”

lotr07180.name: Gorbag, Lieutenant of Cirith Ungol
lotr07180.subtitle: Lieutenant of Cirith Ungol
lotr07180.game_text: While you can spot a Nazgul, Gorbag is strength +2 and damage +1.
lotr07180.lore: “‘If there's any game, me and my lads must be in it.'”

lotr07181.name: Held Ground
lotr07181.game_text: To play, spot 2 Nazgul and add up to 3 threats. Each time a companion is about to be killed, you may remove a threat to discard up to 2 possessions. Discard this condition and remove 3 threats during the regroup phase.

lotr07182.name: Loathsome
lotr07182.game_text: If a skirmish involving a Nazgul is about to end, discard a possession borne by a companion in that skirmish.
lotr07182.lore: “Frodo felt his senses reeling and his mind darkening.”

lotr07183.name: Mind and Body
lotr07183.game_text: If a Nazgul kills a character, wound each character bearing a [WRAITH] condition.
lotr07183.lore: “Weariness and more than weariness oppressed him...”

lotr07184.name: More Unbearable
lotr07184.game_text: To play, spot a Nazgul. Regroup: Discard a Nazgul to place a [WRAITH] token on this card. While there are 3 [WRAITH] tokens on this card, the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples player's hand.

lotr07185.name: Morgul Answers
lotr07185.game_text: To play, spot a Nazgul. Skirmish: Remove (3) and spot 3 Nazgul to discard a possession or condition borne by a companion a Nazgul is skirmishing.

lotr07186.name: Morgul Axe
lotr07186.game_text: Bearer must be a [WRAITH] Orc. While you can spot 2 wounds on the Ring-bearer, bearer is damage +1.

lotr07187.name: Morgul Brawler
lotr07187.game_text: While the Ring-bearer is exhausted, this minion is strength +3, fierce and damage +1.

lotr07188.name: Morgul Brute
lotr07188.game_text: When you play this minion, you may spot a Nazgul to add a burden. The Free Peoples player may wound the Ring-bearer to prevent this. Skirmish: Remove a burden to make this minion strength +3.

lotr07189.name: Morgul Cur
lotr07189.game_text: While you can spot a Nazgul, this minion is strength +2.

lotr07190.name: Morgul Destroyer
lotr07190.game_text: When you play this minion, you may spot a Nazgul to add 2 threats. The Free Peoples player may wound the Ring-bearer to prevent this. Skirmish: Remove a threat to make this minion strength +3.

lotr07191.name: Morgul Detachment
lotr07191.game_text: While you can spot a Nazgul, this minion is fierce and damage +1.
lotr07191.lore: “‘His own folk quail at him, and they would slay themselves at his bidding.'”

lotr07192.name: Morgul Hound
lotr07192.game_text: While you can spot 2 wounds on the Ring-bearer, this minion is strength +4 and fierce.
lotr07192.lore: “All that host was clad in sable, dark as the night.”

lotr07193.name: Morgul Lackey
lotr07193.game_text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a Nazgul or [WRAITH] Orc strength +1.

lotr07194.name: Morgul Mongrel
lotr07194.game_text: While you can spot 3 wounds on the Ring-bearer, this minion is fierce and damage +1.
lotr07194.lore: “The old wound throbbed with pain and a great chill spread towards Frodo's heart.”

lotr07195.name: Morgul on the March
lotr07195.game_text: To play, spot a Nazgul. Each time the Free Peoples player draws a card (except during the regroup phase), add a threat. Regroup: Discard a Nazgul and this condition to add a threat.

lotr07196.name: Morgul Predator
lotr07196.game_text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a Nazgul or [WRAITH] Orc strength +1.
lotr07196.lore: “‘...driving his slaves in madness on before.'”

lotr07197.name: Morgul Regiment
lotr07197.game_text: For each Nazgul you can spot, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion to assign this minion to a skirmish. Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a Nazgul or [WRAITH] Orc strength +1.
lotr07197.lore: “...a host had issued from Minas Morgul....”

lotr07198.name: Morgul Ruffian
lotr07198.game_text: While you can spot a Nazgul, this minion may only take wounds during skirmish phases.
lotr07198.lore: “...while the less stout-hearted quailed and wept.”

lotr07199.name: Morgul Soldier
lotr07199.lore: “...ever and anon, high above the city, a faint cry would come....”

lotr07200.name: Morgul Spawn
lotr07200.game_text: While you can spot a Nazgul, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion to assign this minion to a skirmish.
lotr07200.lore: “‘...the fear of him has passed before him over the River.'”

lotr07201.name: Morgul Spearman
lotr07201.game_text: While you can spot a Nazgul, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion to assign this minion to a skirmish.
lotr07201.lore: “‘And we have learned... that the Black Captain leads them once again....'”

lotr07202.name: Morgul Whelp
lotr07202.game_text: While you can spot a wound on the Ring-bearer, this minion is strength +6.

lotr07203.name: Nazgul Scimitar
lotr07203.game_text: Bearer must be a [WRAITH] minion. While you can spot 5 threats, bearer is damage +1.

lotr07204.name: Out of Sight and Shot
lotr07204.game_text: To play, spot a Nazgul. Each time a companion is played, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion. Shadow: Spot a Nazgul and discard this condition to play a Nazgul from your discard pile.

lotr07205.name: Put Forth His Strength
lotr07205.game_text: To play, spot a Nazgul. Shadow: If you have initiative and there are 3 characters in the dead pile, spot 3 burdens, 3 threats and a Nazgul to corrupt the Ring-bearer.

lotr07206.name: Stronghold of Minas Morgul
lotr07206.game_text: Response: If your [WRAITH] minion wins a skirmish, place a [WRAITH] token here (limit 1 per site). Regroup: Spot 3 [WRAITH] tokens here to exhaust the Ring-bearer. Discard this condition.

lotr07207.name: Their Power Is in Terror
lotr07207.game_text: Exert a Nazgul to wound each ally.

lotr07208.name: There Came a Cry
lotr07208.game_text: Spot a Nazgul to add a threat (or 3 threats if you have initiative).
lotr07208.lore: “Mingled with harsh high voices as of birds of prey....”

lotr07209.name: Too Late
lotr07209.game_text: Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a character skirmishing a Nazgul. Each time bearer exerts, add (1).

lotr07210.name: Ulaire Attea, Wraith on Wings
lotr07210.subtitle: Wraith on Wings
lotr07210.game_text: Fierce. Shadow: If you have initiative, exert Ulaire Attea and spot another [WRAITH] minion to add a burden.

lotr07211.name: Ulaire Cantea, Faster Than Winds
lotr07211.subtitle: Faster Than Winds
lotr07211.game_text: Fierce. When you play Ulaire Cantea, add a threat for each companion over 4. Maneuver: Remove 2 threats and spot another [WRAITH] minion to discard a possession.

lotr07212.name: Ulaire Enquea, Faster Than Winds
lotr07212.subtitle: Faster Than Winds
lotr07212.game_text: Fierce. While you can spot 6 companions, Ulaire Enquea is damage +1. Each time a companion is killed, you may exert Ulaire Enquea to exert the Ring-bearer.

lotr07213.name: Ulaire Lemenya, Assailing Minion
lotr07213.subtitle: Assailing Minion
lotr07213.game_text: Ulaire Lemenya is strength +1 for each other [WRAITH] minion you spot. While you can spot 3 [WRAITH] minions Ulaire Lemenya is fierce. While you can spot 4 [WRAITH] minions Ulaire Lemenya is damage +1.

lotr07214.name: Ulaire Lemenya, Wraith on Wings
lotr07214.subtitle: Wraith on Wings
lotr07214.game_text: Regroup: If you have initiative, discard Ulaire Lemenya to discard a possession.
lotr07214.lore: “And even at that moment the sun for a second faltered and was obscured, as though a dark wing had passed across it.”

lotr07215.name: Ulaire Nelya, Assailing Minion
lotr07215.subtitle: Assailing Minion
lotr07215.game_text: Fierce. Skirmish: Discard a [WRAITH] minion to make Ulaire Nelya strength +2.

lotr07216.name: Ulaire Nelya, Black-Mantled Wraith
lotr07216.subtitle: Black-Mantled Wraith
lotr07216.game_text: Fierce. Regroup: If you have initiative, discard Ulaire Nelya to exert each Ring-bound companion.

lotr07217.name: Ulaire Nertea, Black-Mantled Wraith
lotr07217.subtitle: Black-Mantled Wraith
lotr07217.game_text: Regroup: If you have initiative, discard Ulaire Nertea to add a burden.
lotr07217.lore: “‘I fear that Minas Tirith shall fall. Night comes. The very warmth of my blood seems stolen away.'”

lotr07218.name: Ulaire Otsea, Black-Mantled Wraith
lotr07218.subtitle: Black-Mantled Wraith
lotr07218.game_text: Regroup: If you have initiative, discard Ulaire Otsea to make the Free Peoples player exert a Ring-bound companion twice or return and unbound companion to his or her hand.
lotr07218.lore: “...horrible as carrion-fowl yet greater than eagles, cruel as death.”

lotr07219.name: Ulaire Toldea, Wraith on Wings
lotr07219.subtitle: Wraith on Wings
lotr07219.game_text: Fierce. While you have initiative and can spot a Nazgul, Ulaire Toldea?s twilight cost is -6.

lotr07220.name: War Long Planned
lotr07220.game_text: Make a [WRAITH] Orc strength +2 (or +4 if you spot 2 wounds on the Ring-bearer).
lotr07220.lore: “‘Through many ages Sauron has hated the West....'”

lotr07221.name: The Witch-king, Morgul King
lotr07221.subtitle: Morgul King
lotr07221.game_text: Fierce. When you play the Witch-King, you may remove a threat to take a [WRAITH] card into hand from your discard pile. The Ring-bearer cannot take threat wounds.

lotr07222.name: Deor
lotr07222.game_text: Villager. Skirmish: If you have initiative, discard a card from hand to make a [ROHAN] Man strength +1.

lotr07223.name: Death They Cried
lotr07223.game_text: Spot a mounted [ROHAN] Man to exert a minion. That minion's owner may exert a companion and if he or she does so, you may exert a minion; repeat this until a player does not exert a character.
lotr07223.lore: “But the Rohirrim sang no more. Death they cried with one voice....”

lotr07224.name: Elfhelm, Marshal of Rohan
lotr07224.subtitle: Marshal of Rohan
lotr07224.game_text: Valiant. Skirmish: Exert Elfhelm to make him strength +1 for each uncontrolled plains site you can spot.

lotr07225.name: Elite Rider
lotr07225.game_text: When this companion is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -1. While skirmishing a wounded minion, this companion is strength +2.

lotr07226.name: Enraged Horseman
lotr07226.game_text: While you can spot another [ROHAN] Man and this companion is skirmishing a wounded minion, this companion is strength +2 and damage +1.
lotr07226.lore: “Doom drove them on. Darkness took them, / horse and horseman; hoofbeats afar / sank into silence: so the songs tell us.”

lotr07227.name: Eomer, Skilled Tactician
lotr07227.subtitle: Skilled Tactician
lotr07227.game_text: Valiant. While you can spot a [ROHAN] Man, Eomer's twilight cost is -1. Fellowship: Play a [ROHAN] companion to take a [ROHAN] possession or [ROHAN] skirmish event into hand from your discard pile.

lotr07228.name: Eowyn, Dernhelm
lotr07228.subtitle: Dernhelm
lotr07228.game_text: Valiant. While skirmishing a mounted minion, Eowyn is strength +2. While skirmishing a fierce minion, Eowyn is strength +2.

lotr07229.name: Eowyn, Restless Maiden
lotr07229.subtitle: Restless Maiden
lotr07229.game_text: Skirmish: Discard a possession borne by Eowyn to make her strength +2.
lotr07229.lore: “He turned and saw her as a glimmer... for she was clad in white; but her eyes were on fire.”

lotr07230.name: Eowyn's Sword, Dernhelm's Blade
lotr07230.subtitle: Dernhelm's Blade
lotr07230.game_text: Bearer must be Eowyn. You may play this possession anytime you could play a skirmish event. When you play this possession, you may wound a minion Eowyn is skirmishing.

lotr07231.name: Fey He Seemed
lotr07231.game_text: Make a [ROHAN] Man strength +2 (or +3 and damage +1 if skirmishing a wounded minion).
lotr07231.lore: “...the battle-fury of his fathers ran like new fire in his veins....”

lotr07232.name: Firefoot, Eomer's Steed
lotr07232.subtitle: Eomer's Steed
lotr07232.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert. Regroup: If bearer is Eomer, exert him to discard a condition. Any Shadow player may remove (1) to prevent this.

lotr07233.name: Grimbold, Marshal of Rohan
lotr07233.subtitle: Marshal of Rohan
lotr07233.game_text: Valiant. Skirmish: Replace the fellowship's site with your plains site of the same number to discard a card from hand.

lotr07234.name: Guarded Fastness
lotr07234.game_text: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from hand to heal all [ROHAN] allies.
lotr07234.lore: “‘...for I will not leave my strongholds all unguarded.'”

lotr07235.name: Guthlaf, Herald
lotr07235.subtitle: Herald
lotr07235.game_text: Skirmish: Discard a [ROHAN] condition to make Guthlaf strength +1.
lotr07235.lore: “And straightaway all the horns in the host were lifted up in music....”

lotr07236.name: Herugrim, Sword of the Mark
lotr07236.subtitle: Sword of the Mark
lotr07236.game_text: Bearer must be Theoden. He is damage +1. Response: If Theoden is about to take a wound and you cannot spot 3 threats, add 2 threats to prevent that wound.

lotr07237.name: His Golden Shield
lotr07237.game_text: Spot 3 [ROHAN] Men to make an opponent remove (1) or place a random card from hand beneath his or her draw deck. Do this once for each card in that player's hand when you play this event.
lotr07237.lore: “...even as Oromë the Great in the battle of the Valar when the world was young.”

lotr07238.name: Knights of His House
lotr07238.game_text: Choose an opponent. For each mounted companion you spot, that opponent must remove (1) or place a random card from hand beneath his or her draw deck.
lotr07238.lore: “Éomer rode there, and the white horsetail on his helm floating in his speed....”

lotr07239.name: Leowyn
lotr07239.game_text: Villager. Fellowship: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from hand to heal a [ROHAN] Man.
lotr07239.lore: “...when they saw the king they cried with glad voices: ‘Théoden King! Théoden King!”

lotr07240.name: Long Spear
lotr07240.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. You may add a threat to play this possession anytime you could play a skirmish event.

lotr07241.name: Merry's Armor
lotr07241.game_text: Bearer must be Merry. While you can spot 3 [ROHAN] Men, Merry cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.

lotr07242.name: Merry's Sword
lotr07242.game_text: Bearer must be Merry. Maneuver: Exert Merry twice to exert a minion once for each [ROHAN] companion you spot.

lotr07243.name: Morning Came
lotr07243.game_text: Make a [ROHAN] Man strength +4. Any Shadow player may place a random card from hand beneath his or her draw deck to make that Man strength +2 instead.
lotr07243.lore: “...morning and a wind from the sea; and darkness was removed, and the hosts of Mordor wailed....”

lotr07244.name: Mustering for Battle
lotr07244.game_text: To play, spot 3 [ROHAN] Men. Maneuver: Exert a [ROHAN] companion twice or discard this condition to play a [ROHAN] possession from your discard pile.

lotr07245.name: Riding Armor
lotr07245.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. Response: If you have initiative and bearer is about to take a wound in a skirmish, discard 3 cards from hand to prevent that wound.

lotr07246.name: Rohirrim Guard
lotr07246.game_text: Skirmish: Discard a card from hand to exert a minion skirmishing this companion.
lotr07246.lore: “...and strengthened his host by some three score of Riders that came late to the weapontake.”

lotr07247.name: Rohirrim Herdsman
lotr07247.game_text: Villager. To play, spot 2 [ROHAN] Men. Regroup: Discard 3 cards from hand to remove a threat.

lotr07248.name: Rohirrim Javelin
lotr07248.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. Archery: Discard this possession to make the fellowship archery total +1.

lotr07249.name: Seeking New Foes
lotr07249.game_text: Skirmishes are resolved in an order decided by the first Shadow player. Each time a [ROHAN] Man wins a skirmish, place a [ROHAN] token here. Each [ROHAN] Man is strength +1 for each token here. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.

lotr07250.name: Snowmane
lotr07250.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert. Regroup: If bearer is Theoden, exert him to liberate a site. Any Shadow player may remove (2) to prevent this.

lotr07251.name: Stern People
lotr07251.game_text: To play, spot 2 [ROHAN] Men. Regroup: Discard cards from hand equal to the number of cards in an opponent's hand to make the move limit +1 for this turn. Each Shadow player may take up to 4 cards into hand from his or her discard pile. Discard this condition.

lotr07252.name: Strong Arms
lotr07252.game_text: To play, spot a [ROHAN] Man. Plays on a site. This site is a plains. Each [ROHAN] Man is strength +1 at this site.

lotr07253.name: Swift Steed
lotr07253.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. While at a plains site, bearer takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.

lotr07254.name: Theoden, Leader of Spears
lotr07254.subtitle: Leader of Spears
lotr07254.game_text: Valiant. While you can spot a [ROHAN] Man, Theoden's twilight cost is -1. Each time the fellowship moves, you may exert a [ROHAN] companion to exert a minion.

lotr07255.name: Theoden, Rekindled King
lotr07255.subtitle: Rekindled King
lotr07255.game_text: While you can spot a [ROHAN] Man, Theoden's twilight cost is -1. Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 2 twilight tokens, play a [ROHAN] possession on Theoden and add (2) to heal another [ROHAN] companion.

lotr07256.name: They Sang as They Slew
lotr07256.game_text: Exert X mounted companions to wound X minions.
lotr07256.lore: “...for the joy of battle was on them, and the sound of their singing that was fair and terrible came even to the City.”

lotr07257.name: Veteran Horseman
lotr07257.game_text: Skirmish: Exert this companion to make him strength +1 for each mounted companion you spot.
lotr07257.lore: “...through Folde and Fenmarch and the Firienwood, six thousand speards to Sunlending....”

lotr07258.name: White Hot Fury
lotr07258.game_text: Make a mounted [ROHAN] Man strength +1 for each mounted companion. If that Man is skirmishing a [RAIDER] minion, also make him or her strength +2 and damage +2.
lotr07258.lore: “Fewer were they but they clove through the Southrons like a fire-bolt in a forest.”

lotr07259.name: Wind in His Face
lotr07259.game_text: Make a [ROHAN] Man strength +2. If that Man is mounted, choose an opponent who must place a random card from hand beneath his or her draw deck.
lotr07259.lore: “Far, far away, in the South the clouds could be dimly seen as remote grey shapes, rolling up, drifting: morning lay beyond them.”

lotr07260.name: Windfola
lotr07260.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert. Skirmish: If bearer is Eowyn, exert her twice to wound a fierce minion she is skirmishing.

lotr07261.name: With Strength to Fight
lotr07261.game_text: To play, spot a [ROHAN] companion. Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition. Regroup: Discard this condition to heal up to 2 [ROHAN] companions.

lotr07262.name: Above the Battlement
lotr07262.game_text: Play a bieseger stacked on a site you control or remove a burden to play a [SAURON] Orc from your discard pile.
lotr07262.lore: “...they began to throw missiles marvellously high....”

lotr07263.name: Anguish
lotr07263.game_text: Remove 3 threats to make a character skirmishing a [SAURON] Orc strength -3.
lotr07263.lore: “‘...the Rammas is breached far and wide...'”

lotr07264.name: Army of Udun
lotr07264.game_text: Shadow: Discard a [SAURON] Orc to add a threat. Skirmish: Remove a threat to make Army of Udun strength +1. Regroup: Discard Army of Udun and X other [SAURON] Orcs to add X threats.

lotr07265.name: Besieging Pike
lotr07265.game_text: Bearer must be a [SAURON] Orc. If you have initiative, bearer is strength +3.

lotr07266.name: Breached
lotr07266.game_text: Remove 4 threats and spot 2 [SAURON] Orcs to make the Free Peoples player spot a companion and place that companion in the dead pile.
lotr07266.lore: “‘Yet now under the Lord of Barad-dûr the most fell of all his captains is already master of your outer walls....'”

lotr07267.name: Din of Arms
lotr07267.game_text: Choose an opponent to discard the top card of his or her draw deck. If the twilight cost of that card is less than the number of besiegers you spot, take control of a site and all besiegers are strength +3 until the regroup phase.

lotr07268.name: Encirclement
lotr07268.game_text: For each 2 sites you control, the twilight cost of each of your [SAURON] cards is -1. Regroup: Spot a [SAURON] minion to draw a card (or draw 2 cards instead if that minion is a besieger). Discard this condition.

lotr07269.name: Fires Raged Unchecked
lotr07269.game_text: The site number of each [SAURON] Orc is -1 for each threat. While you can spot 3 threats, each [SAURON] Orc that is not roaming is strength +1

lotr07270.name: Gorgoroth Attacker
lotr07270.game_text: Besieger. When you play this minion from a site you control, add a burden for each site you control.

lotr07271.name: Gorgoroth Axeman
lotr07271.game_text: Besieger. Skirmish: Discard this minion to make a [SAURON] minion strength +1 for each site you control (or +2 if you have initiative).

lotr07272.name: Gorgoroth Engineer
lotr07272.game_text: Besieger. When you play this minion from a site you control, add 2 threats.

lotr07273.name: Gorgoroth Garrison
lotr07273.game_text: Besieger. Regroup: Discard 2 cards from hand to stack a [SAURON] Orc on a site you control (or discard 1 card from hand if that Orc is a besieger).

lotr07274.name: Gorgoroth Officer
lotr07274.game_text: Besieger. Skirmish: Discard 2 cards from hand to play a [SAURON] Orc stacked on a site you control. That Orc is fierce and strength +6 until the regroup phase.

lotr07275.name: Gorgoroth Pillager
lotr07275.game_text: Besieger. While this minion is stacked on a site you control, besiegers are fierce.

lotr07276.name: Gorgoroth Ransacker
lotr07276.game_text: Besieger. Skirmish: If this minion is stacked on a site you control, discard him to make a [SAURON] Orc strength +5 (or +10 if you have initiative).

lotr07277.name: Gorgoroth Sapper
lotr07277.game_text: Besieger. Shadow: Discard 2 cards from hand to play a [SAURON] Orc stacked on a site you control (discard 1 card from hand instead if that Orc is a besieger).

lotr07278.name: Gorgoroth Soldier
lotr07278.game_text: Besieger. Response: If a besieger is about to take a wound, discard 2 cards from hand to prevent it.

lotr07279.name: Gorgoroth Troop
lotr07279.game_text: Besieger. Skirmish: Stack your besieger on a site you control to make Gorgoroth Troop strength +2.

lotr07280.name: Great Peril of Fire
lotr07280.game_text: To play, spot a besieger or a site you control. Maneuver: Discard an engine to discard a condition from the Free Peoples support area.

lotr07281.name: Great Siege-towers
lotr07281.game_text: Engine. Shadow: Play a besieger to place a [SAURON] token here. Skirmish: Remove a [SAURON] token from a condition to make a [SAURON] Orc strength +1 (limit +2).

lotr07282.name: Host of Udun
lotr07282.game_text: When you play Host of Udun, you may remove X threats to make its twilight cost -X.

lotr07283.name: Legions of Morgul

lotr08038.name: King of the Dead, Oathbreaker
lotr08038.subtitle: Oathbreaker
lotr08038.game_text: Enduring. To play, spot a [GONDOR] Wraith and add 2 threats. Response: If Aragorn is about to take a wound in a skirmish, exert King of the Dead to prevent that wound.
lotr08038.lore: “‘...crying out that the King of the Dead was upon them.'”

lotr08039.name: Knight of Dol Amroth
lotr08039.game_text: Knight. Each time this companion wins a skirmish, you may wound a minion he is skirmishing.

lotr08040.name: Knight's Mount
lotr08040.game_text: Bearer must be a knight. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may wound a minion who is not assigned to a skirmish.
lotr08040.lore: “Like thunder they broke upon the enemy....”

lotr08041.name: Oathbreaker
lotr08041.game_text: Enduring. To play, add a threat. Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to discard a possession borne by a minion skirmishing this companion.
lotr08041.lore: “at the Stone of Erech they shall stand again / and hear there a horn in the hills ringing.”

lotr08042.name: A Path Appointed
lotr08042.game_text: Fellowship: Exert a [GONDOR] Man and either a [DWARVEN] companion or a [ROHAN] companion to add a [GONDOR] token here. Regroup: Remove a [GONDOR] token here to discard a minion.
lotr08042.lore: “‘...those who follow me do so of their free will....'”

lotr08043.name: Shadow Host
lotr08043.game_text: Enduring. To play, spot 2 exhausted [GONDOR] Wraiths and add 2 threats. While Shadow Host is exhausted, it is defender +1.
lotr08043.lore: “...fear went on before them, until they came to Calembel upon Ciril, and the sun went down like blood behind Pinnath Gelin....”

lotr08044.name: Sixth Level
lotr08044.game_text: Fortification. Regroup: Exert a [GONDOR] Man to play a [GONDOR] fortification from your discard pile (limit 1).
lotr08044.lore: “...and in each wall was a gate.”

lotr08045.name: Sleepless Dead
lotr08045.game_text: Enduring. To play, add a threat. Each time this companion wins a skirmish, you may exert him to discard a minion he is skirmishing.
lotr08045.lore: “‘...for the Dead needed no longer any weapon but fear. None would withstand them.'”

lotr08046.name: Spectral Sword
lotr08046.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Wraith. Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to heal bearer.
lotr08046.lore: “‘...pale banners like shreds of cloud, and spears like winter-thickets on a misty night.'”

lotr08047.name: Stronger and More Terrible
lotr08047.game_text: To play, add a threat. Each time your [GONDOR] Wraith wins a skirmish, you may remove a threat.
lotr08047.lore: “‘And lo! in the darkness of Mordor my hope rose....'”

lotr08048.name: Swept Away
lotr08048.game_text: Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition. While you have initiative, exhausted [GONDOR] Wraiths cannot take wounds.
lotr08048.lore: “‘And suddenly the Shadow Host that had hung back at the last came up like a grey tide, sweeping all away before it.'”

lotr08049.name: Black Numenorean
lotr08049.game_text: Corsair. Fierce. Skirmish: If you have initiative, remove a [RAIDER] token to discard a possession borne by a character skirmishing this minion.
lotr08049.lore: “...corrupted by Sauron, and who hated above all the followers of Elendil.”

lotr08050.name: Black Sails of Umbar
lotr08050.game_text: When you play this possession, you may add a [RAIDER] token here. Shadow: Remove X [RAIDER] tokens here to play a corsair from your discard pile; its twilight cost is -X. Discard this possession.

lotr08051.name: Castamir of Umbar
lotr08051.game_text: Corsair. Enduring. Fierce. Shadow: Exert Castamir of Umbar and play a corsair to add 2 [RAIDER] tokens to a card that already has a [RAIDER] token on it.
lotr08051.lore: “‘They have long ceased to fear the might of Gondor.'”

lotr08052.name: Corsair Ballista
lotr08052.game_text: Bearer must be a corsair. While you have initiative, bearer is an archer and fierce.
lotr08052.lore: Ranged weapons bristled from the warships and aided the Cosairs' plunder of coastal cities.

lotr08053.name: Corsair Buccaneer
lotr08053.game_text: Corsair. When you play this minion, you may remove a threat to add 2 [RAIDER] tokens to a card that already has a [RAIDER] token on it.
lotr08053.lore: “‘...a great fleet drawing near to the mouths of Anduin....'”

lotr08054.name: Corsair Freebooter
lotr08054.game_text: Corsair. When you play this minion, you may remove 2 culture tokens to add 2 [RAIDER] tokens to a card that already has a [RAIDER] token on it.
lotr08054.lore: “...the strength of the rebels in Umbar was a great peril to Gondor....”

lotr08055.name: Corsair Gunners
lotr08055.game_text: Corsair. Skirmish: If you have initiative, remove a [RAIDER] token to make a corsair fierce until the regroup phase.

lotr08056.name: Corsair Lookout
lotr08056.game_text: Corsair. When you play this minion, if you have initiative, you may discard an ally to add 2 [RAIDER] tokens to a card that already has a [RAIDER] token on it.
lotr08056.lore: “...watchmen on the walls saw afar a new sight of fear, and their last hope left them.”

lotr08057.name: Corsair Marauder
lotr08057.game_text: Corsair. When you play this minion, if you can spot another corsair, you may discard a possession to add 2 [RAIDER] tokens to a card that already has a [RAIDER] token on it.
lotr08057.lore: “Umbar remained at war with Gondor for many lives of men....”

lotr08058.name: Corsair Plunderer
lotr08058.game_text: Corsair. When you play this minion, you may discard 2 cards from hand to add 2 [RAIDER] tokens to a card that already has a [RAIDER] token on it.
lotr08058.lore: “...Umbar... fell into the hands of the Men of Harad.”

lotr08059.name: Corsair War Galley
lotr08059.game_text: When you play this possession, you may add a [RAIDER] token here. While you can spot 6 [RAIDER] tokens and a [RAIDER] Man, the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples player?s hand. Regroup: Add (1) for each [RAIDER] token you can spot. Discard this possession.

lotr08060.name: Haradrim Marksman
lotr08060.game_text: Southron. Archer. While you can spot another [RAIDER] Man, Ring-bound companions cannot take archery wounds.
lotr08060.lore: Archers from Harad rode atop the great war-beasts on the Fields of Pelennor.

lotr08061.name: Haradwaith
lotr08061.game_text: While you can spot a [RAIDER] minion at site 4K, the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples player?s hand. Response: If a companion is played, discard a [RAIDER] card from hand to add (5). Discard this condition.

lotr08062.name: Heavy Axeman
lotr08062.game_text: Easterling. While you can spot 4 burdens, Heavy Axeman is strength +4 and fierce.
lotr08062.lore: “...the Easterlings were strong and war-hardened and asked for no quarter.”

lotr08063.name: Line of Defense
lotr08063.game_text: While you can spot a mounted [RAIDER] Man, [RAIDER] Men cannot take wounds (except during skirmishes).

lotr08064.name: Mumakil
lotr08064.game_text: Bearer must be a Southron. Bearer is fierce. While you have initiative or can spot 4 threats, bearer is damage +1.
lotr08064.lore: “But wherever the mûmakil came there the horses would not go, but blenched and swerved away....”

lotr08065.name: Ships of Great Draught
lotr08065.game_text: Shadow: Remove a threat or discard a [RAIDER] card from hand to add a [RAIDER] token here. Regroup: Remove 2 [RAIDER] tokens here to place a [RAIDER] card from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.

lotr08066.name: Wind That Sped Ships
lotr08066.game_text: Make a corsair strength +1 for each [RAIDER] token you spot (limit +6). If you have initiative, you may place this event on top of your draw deck.
lotr08066.lore: “...black against the glittering stream... a fleet borne up on the wind....”

lotr08067.name: Between Nazgul and Prey
lotr08067.game_text: Exert an enduring [WRAITH] minion twice to assign that minion to an unbound companion.

lotr08068.name: Beyond All Darkness
lotr08068.game_text: Exert a Nazgul to make him strength +2 and damage +1. If the character he is skirmishing is killed, the Free Peoples player must place his or her hand beneath his or her draw deck.

lotr08069.name: Black Dart
lotr08069.game_text: Archery: Spot your enduring or mounted Nazgul to transfer this condition from your support area to an unbound companion. Discard a mount borne by that companion. Bearer cannot heal.

lotr08070.name: Black Flail
lotr08070.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. Skirmish: If bearer is The Witch-king, exert him and spot a possession borne by a character he is skirmishing to discard that possession.

lotr08071.name: Flung Into the Fray
lotr08071.game_text: When you play a minion stacked here, you may exert a companion. Regroup: If no minion is stacked here, spot your [WRAITH] minon to stack it here. Shadow: Spot 2 [WRAITH] minions to play a [WRAITH] minion stacked here as if played from hand.
lotr08071.lore: “With a cry of hatred that stung the very ears like venom he let fall....”

lotr08072.name: Gothmog, Morgul Commander
lotr08072.subtitle: Morgul Commander
lotr08072.game_text: While you have initiative, each [WRAITH] minion is an archer.

lotr08073.name: Mastered By Madness
lotr08073.game_text: Make a Nazgul strength +2. If that Nazgul wins this skirmish, you may discard a Free Peoples mount.
lotr08073.lore: “...then Windfola had thrown them in his terror, and now ran wild upon the plain.”

lotr08074.name: Morgul Ambusher
lotr08074.game_text: While you can spot 3 threats, the minion archery total is +2.
lotr08074.lore: “‘Fear, the City is rank with it.'”

lotr08075.name: Morgul Creeper
lotr08075.game_text: While you can spot 3 burdens, the minion archery total is +2.

lotr08076.name: Morgul Lurker
lotr08076.game_text: While you have initiative, the minion archery total is +2.

lotr08077.name: Morgul Squealer
lotr08077.game_text: Shadow: Discard this minion to play a [WRAITH] minion from your discard pile. Shadow: Spot 6 companions and discard this minion to play up to 2 [WRAITH] minions from your draw deck; their twilight costs are each -1.
lotr08077.lore: “‘The time of the Orc has come.'”

lotr08078.name: Streaming to the Field
lotr08078.game_text: For each [WRAITH] Orc you can spot, the Free Peoples player must have an additional card in hand to have initiative. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [WRAITH] Orc strength +2.

lotr08079.name: Ulaire Attea, Thrall of the One
lotr08079.subtitle: Thrall of the One
lotr08079.game_text: Enduring. Regroup: Exert Ulaire Attea and spot your [WRAITH] minion to return that minion to your hand.

lotr08080.name: Ulaire Nertea, Thrall of the One
lotr08080.subtitle: Thrall of the One
lotr08080.game_text: Enduring. Fierce. The site number of each [WRAITH] minion is -1.

lotr08081.name: Ulaire Otsea, Thrall of the One
lotr08081.subtitle: Thrall of the One
lotr08081.game_text: Enduring. Fierce. Regroup: Discard Ulaire Otsea to add (X), where X is the current site number.

lotr08082.name: Unhindered
lotr08082.game_text: Make a Nazgul strength +2. If that Nazgul wins this skirmish, the Shadow has initiative until the end of the turn, regardless of the Free Peoples player?s hand.

lotr08083.name: Winged Mount
lotr08083.game_text: To play, discard 2 cards from hand. Bearer must be a Nazgul. Response: If bearer is about to take a wound, remove a threat to prevent that wound.
lotr08083.lore: “A creature of an older world maybe it was....”

lotr08084.name: The Witch-king, Black Captain
lotr08084.subtitle: Black Captain
lotr08084.game_text: Enduring. Each Man skirmishing The Witch-king loses all strength bonuses from weapons.
lotr08084.lore: “...the Nazgûl Lord like a shadow of despair.”

lotr08085.name: Charged Headlong
lotr08085.game_text: If you have initiative, discard a [ROHAN] possession to play a [ROHAN] possession from your discard pile.
lotr08085.lore: “Sea-kings' city in the South-kingdom / foe-beleaguered, fire-encircled.”

lotr08086.name: Doom Drove Them
lotr08086.game_text: Fellowship: Exert a [ROHAN] companion and either a [GONDOR] Man or a [SHIRE] companion to add a [ROHAN] token here. Skirmish: Remove a [ROHAN] token here to exert a minion skirmishing a companion.
lotr08086.lore: "He bent over her like a cloud, and his eyes glittered...."

lotr08087.name: Eomer, Keeper of Oaths
lotr08087.subtitle: Keeper of Oaths
lotr08087.game_text: Valiant. When you play Eomer (except in your starting fellowship), you may reveal the top 10 cards of your draw deck. You may play each [ROHAN] possession revealed. Shuffle your draw deck.
lotr08087.lore: "'Need brooks no delay, yet late is better than never.'"

lotr08088.name: Eowyn's Shield
lotr08088.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. The minion archery total is -1. Skirmish: If bearer is Eowyn, add a threat and discard Eowyn?s Shield to discard a hand weapon borne by a minion she is skirmishing.

lotr08089.name: Fury of the Northmen
lotr08089.game_text: Exert a minion skirmishing a mounted [ROHAN] Man.
lotr08089.lore: “Another long screech rose and fell, and he threw himself back again from the wall, panting like a hunted animal.”

lotr08090.name: No Living Man
lotr08090.game_text: Exert Theoden to exert a minion for each Theoden signet you spot.

lotr08091.name: Rohirrim Army
lotr08091.game_text: To play, spot 3 [ROHAN] companions. You may play Rohirrim Army any time you could play a regroup event. When you play Rohirrim Army, you may discard a minion.

lotr08092.name: Theoden, Tall and Proud
lotr08092.subtitle: Tall and Proud
lotr08092.game_text: Valiant. While you can spot a [ROHAN] Man, Theoden?s twilight cost is -1. When Theoden is killed, you may play a [ROHAN] companion from your discard pile or draw deck.
lotr08092.lore: “...into their minds a blackness came, and they thought no more of war, but only of hiding and of crawling, and of death.”

lotr08093.name: Called Away
lotr08093.game_text: Regroup: Discard a [SAURON] minion, spot a companion (except the Ring-bearer), and remove X burdens, where X is that companion?s vitality, to return that companion to its owner?s hand.
lotr08093.lore: “‘...spear shall be shaken, shield shall be splintered....'”

lotr08094.name: Gorgoroth Agitator
lotr08094.game_text: Besieger. To play, spot a [SAURON] Orc. When you play this minion, if you can spot another besieger, you may add a threat for each companion over 4. Shadow: Remove a threat to play a [SAURON] engine from your discard pile.

lotr08095.name: Gorgoroth Assassin
lotr08095.game_text: Besieger. Assignment: Spot a [SAURON] engine or a site you control to assign this minion to an unbound companion.
lotr08095.lore: “...they could endure the Sun, so long as the will of Sauron held sway over them.”

lotr08096.name: Gorgoroth Berserker
lotr08096.game_text: Besieger. Enduring. To play, spot a [SAURON] Orc. Maneuver: If you have initiative, exert this minion twice to take control of a site. Maneuver: Remove a threat and exert this minion twice to take control of a site.
lotr08096.lore: “...and wielded heavy hammers in their knotted hands.”

lotr08097.name: Gorgoroth Breaker
lotr08097.game_text: Besieger. Archery: Exert this minion or stack it on a site you control to make the fellowship archery total -2.
lotr08097.lore: “...like a storm upon the plain and a thunder in the mountains.”

lotr08098.name: Gorgoroth Looter
lotr08098.game_text: Besieger. When you play this minion, you may remove a burden to play a besieger stacked on a site you control.

lotr08099.name: Gorgoroth Patrol
lotr08099.game_text: Besieger. Regroup: If this minion is stacked on a site you control, discard this minion to make the move limit for this turn -1.
lotr08099.lore: “...hurrying orcs were digging... just out of bowshot from the walls....”

lotr08100.name: Gorgoroth Servitor
lotr08100.game_text: Besieger. Archery: Return this minion to your hand to make the fellowship archery total -2 and prevent the Free Peoples player from using archery special abilities.

lotr08101.name: Gorgoroth Stormer
lotr08101.game_text: Besieger. Shadow: If you have initiative, exert this minion to add a burden and make the Free Peoples player draw a card.
lotr08101.lore: “...filled with malice, hating even their own kind....”

lotr08102.name: Great Hill Troll
lotr08102.game_text: Besieger. Fierce. The twilight cost of this minion is -1 for each [SAURON] engine you spot. When you play this minion at sites 5K to 9K, you may discard a Free Peoples condition.
lotr08102.lore: “...and soon yet more companies of the enemy were swiftly setting up....”

lotr08103.name: Grond, Hammer of the Underworld
lotr08103.subtitle: Hammer of the Underworld
lotr08103.game_text: Engine. Shadow: Play a [SAURON] minion to add a [SAURON] token here. Regroup: Remove X [SAURON] tokens here to discard a Free Peoples card (except a companion) with a twilight cost of X. Discard a [SAURON] minion or this possession.

lotr08104.name: Morgai
lotr08104.game_text: While you can spot a [SAURON] minion at site 5K, the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples player?s hand. Response: If a companion is played, discard a [SAURON] card from hand to take control of a site. Discard this condition.
lotr08104.lore: “‘Need brooks no delay, yet late is better than never....'”

lotr08105.name: Olog-hai of Mordor
lotr08105.game_text: Besieger. Fierce. The twilight cost of this minion is -2 for each [SAURON] minion stacked on a site. Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may play a besieger stacked on a site you control. That besieger is fierce and damage +1 until the regroup phase.

lotr08106.name: Siege Troop
lotr08106.game_text: Besieger. Regroup: Exert this minion twice to take control of a site.

lotr08107.name: Their Marching Companies
lotr08107.game_text: Engine. To play, spot a [SAURON] minion. Regroup: Remove a threat to stack your [SAURON] minion on a site you control. Shadow: Remove a threat to play a [SAURON] minion stacked on a site you control.
lotr08107.lore: “‘The City is all set about with flame, and the field is full of foes.'”

lotr08108.name: Troll of Gorgoroth, Abomination of Sauron
lotr08108.subtitle: Abomination of Sauron
lotr08108.game_text: Besieger. Fierce. To play, spot a [SAURON] Orc. The twilight cost of Troll of Gorgoroth is -2 for each [SAURON] engine you spot. Regroup: Exert Troll of Gorgoroth to stack your besieger on a site you control.

lotr08109.name: Closer and Closer He Bent
lotr08109.game_text: Regroup: Exert an unbound Hobbit and add a burden to reveal your hand. Place each Free Peoples card revealed this way beneath your draw deck.
lotr08109.lore: “...yet still driven as if by a madness....”

lotr08110.name: Morgai Foothills
lotr08110.game_text: When the fellowship moves from site 4K, remove (1) for each Ring-bound companion you spot. Regroup: Discard a card from hand for each Ring-bound companion you spot. Discard this condition.
lotr08110.lore: “‘The Ring is enough. This extra weight is killing me. It must go.'”

lotr08111.name: So Fair, So Desperate
lotr08111.game_text: If the Shadow has initiative, add a threat to make an unbound Hobbit strength +1 for each [SHIRE] card you spot.
lotr08111.lore: “‘King's man! King's man!' his heart cried within him.”

lotr08112.name: Song of the Shire
lotr08112.game_text: Fellowship: Exert a [SHIRE] companion and either a [ROHAN] companion or a [GANDALF] companion to add a [SHIRE] token here. Skirmish: Remove a [SHIRE] token here to prevent an unbound companion from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.
lotr08112.lore: “...the hosts of Mordor were enheartened, and filled with a new lust and fury they came yelling....”

lotr08113.name: Sting, Bane of the Eight Legs
lotr08113.subtitle: Bane of the Eight Legs
lotr08113.game_text: Bearer must be Frodo or Sam. Response: If a fierce skirmish involving bearer is about to end, add a threat to discard a minion involved in that skirmish.

lotr08114.name: Straining Towards Us
lotr08114.game_text: Exert Frodo to remove (1) for each Frodo signet you spot.
lotr08114.lore: “‘...they found the enemy already on the out-wall, or assailing it....'”

lotr08115.name: Unheeded
lotr08115.game_text: If a minion exerts, exert an unbound Hobbit to wound that minion.
lotr08115.lore: “...and passing up beneath the hauberk had pierced the sinew behind his mighty knee.”

lotr08116.name: We Shall Meet Again Soon
lotr08116.game_text: If the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, exert an unbound Hobbit to place a Shadow card from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.
lotr08116.lore: “Pippin sat with his knees drawn up and the ball between them. He bent low over it, looking like a greedy child stooping over a bowl of food.”

lotr08117.name: The Dimholt
lotr08117.game_text: Sanctuary. Underground. Fellowship: Add 3 threats to play an enduring companion from your draw deck.
lotr08117.lore: “She should not die.... At least she should not die alone, unaided.”

lotr08118.name: City of the Dead
lotr08118.game_text: Underground. Shadow: Remove 2 burdens to play an enduring minion from your draw deck or discard pile.
lotr08118.lore: “‘He said: “Who are you?” I still did not answer, but it hurt me horribly; and he pressed me, so I said: “A hobbit.”'”

lotr08119.name: Crashed Gate
lotr08119.game_text: At the start of the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player must add 3 threats or choose an opponent who may take control of a site.
lotr08119.lore: “‘You're in the service of the Steward of Gondor now. You'll do as you're told.'”

lotr08120.name: Osgiliath Channel
lotr08120.game_text: River. Regroup: Spot your minion and 6 companions to make the Free Peoples player choose to move again this turn.
lotr08120.lore: “No such anguish had Shelob ever known, or dreamed of knowing....”

lotr08121.name: Merry, Noble Warrior
lotr08121.subtitle: Noble Warrior
lotr08121.game_text: To play, spot a [ROHAN] companion. Skirmish: Discard 4 cards from hand to make Merry strength +2 for each [ROHAN] companion you spot.

lotr08122.name: Pippin, Guard of Minas Tirith
lotr08122.subtitle: Guard of Minas Tirith
lotr08122.game_text: To play, spot a [GONDOR] Man. Skirmish: Discard 4 cards from hand to wound a minion Pippin is skirmishing twice if that minion bears a fortification.
lotr08122.lore: “‘...blind almost to all else that is moving. So we must keep it. Therein lies all our hope.'”

lotr09001.name: The One Ring, The Binding Ring
lotr09001.subtitle: The Binding Ring
lotr09001.game_text: Fellowship: Add 2 burdens to play a ring from your draw deck. Maneuver: Exert bearer to wear The One Ring until the regroup phase. While wearing The One Ring, each time the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound, add a burden instead.

lotr09002.name: Freca, Hungry Savage
lotr09002.subtitle: Hungry Savage
lotr09002.game_text: When you play Freca, you may spot another [DUNLAND] Man to take control of a site. When Freca is killed, the Free Peoples player may liberate a site.

lotr09003.name: Durin III, Dwarven Lord
lotr09003.subtitle: Dwarven Lord
lotr09003.game_text: Damage +1. While you can spot 2 Dwarves, Durin III is twilight cost -2. Durin III is strength +1 for each artifact and each possession he bears.
lotr09003.lore: “Durin is the name that the Dwarves used for the eldest of the Seven Fathers of their race....”

lotr09004.name: Gimli, Bearer of Grudges
lotr09004.subtitle: Bearer of Grudges
lotr09004.game_text: Damage +1. While Gimli is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or 2 threats. While Gimli is damage +X, he is resistance +X.

lotr09005.name: Linnar, Dwarven Lord
lotr09005.subtitle: Dwarven Lord
lotr09005.game_text: Each time a Dwarf wins a fierce skirmish, you may heal that Dwarf. Skirmish: Discard a [DWARVEN] card from hand to make a Dwarf damage +1.
lotr09005.lore: “...they were joined by great forces sent from the Houses of the other Fathers....”

lotr09006.name: Ring of Accretion
lotr09006.game_text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Bearer is damage +1. Maneuver: For each Dwarf you spot, reveal a card from the top of your draw deck. Take all Free Peoples cards revealed into hand and discard the rest. Discard this artifact.

lotr09007.name: Ring of Fury
lotr09007.game_text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Bearer is damage +2. Regroup: Spot a Dwarf that is damage +X to heal X Dwarves. Discard this artifact.
lotr09007.lore: “‘Azog! If you are in come out! Or is the play in the valley too rough?'”

lotr09008.name: Ring of Guile
lotr09008.game_text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Bearer is damage +1. Maneuver: Take a [DWARVEN] event into hand from your discard pile. Discard this artifact.
lotr09008.lore: “But, as Thrór had said, the Ring needed gold to breed gold....”

lotr09009.name: Ring of Retribution
lotr09009.game_text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Response: If bearer wins a skirmish, discard this artifact to exert each Orc.
lotr09009.lore: “‘We fought this war for vengeance, and vengeance we have taken. But it is not sweet.'”

lotr09010.name: Sindri, Dwarven Lord
lotr09010.subtitle: Dwarven Lord
lotr09010.game_text: You may play [DWARVEN] skirmish events stacked on [DWARVEN] conditions as if from hand.
lotr09010.lore: “Concerning the beginning of the Dwarves strange tales are told both by the Eldar and by the Dwarves themselves....”

lotr09011.name: Uri, Dwarven Lord
lotr09011.subtitle: Dwarven Lord
lotr09011.game_text: Skirmish: If Uri is damage +X, exert him to make him strength +X.
lotr09011.lore: “...the Dwarves had the victory through their strength, and their matchless weapons, and the fire of their anger, as they hunted for Azog in every den under mountain.”

lotr09012.name: Aiglos
lotr09012.game_text: Bearer must be an Elf. If bearer is Gil-galad, he is strength +1 for each [ELVEN] artifact you can spot (limit +6). Regroup: Discard Aiglos to wound a minion for each Elf you spot.
lotr09012.lore: “‘...for the Spear of Gil-galad... none could withstand.'”

lotr09013.name: Elven Rope
lotr09013.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. Bearer must be an Elf or Hobbit. Maneuver: Discard this possession to make a Shadow player return a minion with strength 6 or less to its owner's hand.
lotr09013.lore: “‘It freezes, it bites! Elves twisted it, curse them!'”

lotr09014.name: Galadriel, Bearer of Wisdom
lotr09014.subtitle: Bearer of Wisdom
lotr09014.game_text: While Galadriel bears an artifact or The One Ring, she is resistance +1 for each [ELVEN] companion you can spot.
lotr09014.lore: “‘...I shall not be dark, but beautiful and terrible as the Morning and the Night!...Dreadful as the Storm and the Lightning!'”

lotr09015.name: Gil-galad, Elven High King
lotr09015.subtitle: Elven High King
lotr09015.game_text: To play, spot 2 [ELVEN] companions. Regroup: Exert Gil-Galad to wound each wounded minion.
lotr09015.lore: “‘Gil-galad was an Elven-king. / Of him the harpers sadly sing: / the last whose realm was fair and free / between the Mountains and the Sea.'”

lotr09016.name: Glorfindel, Revealed in Wrath
lotr09016.subtitle: Revealed in Wrath
lotr09016.game_text: When Glorfindel is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -2. Skirmish: Reveal the top card of your draw deck. You may exert Glorfindel to make a Nazgul he is skirmishing strength -X, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.

lotr09017.name: Knife of the Galadhrim
lotr09017.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. If bearer is Aragorn, he may bear this hand weapon in addition to 1 other hand weapon. Skirmish: Discard this weapon to wound a minion bearer is skirmishing.
lotr09017.lore: “It was overlaid with a tracery of flowers and leaves wrought of silver and gold....”

lotr09018.name: Merry's Dagger
lotr09018.game_text: Bearer must be Merry. Skirmish: Exert Merry twice or discard this possession to wound a minion he is skirmishing. Any Shadow player may remove (1) to prevent this.
lotr09018.lore: “‘They have already seen service in war.'”

lotr09019.name: Narya, Ring of Fire
lotr09019.subtitle: Ring of Fire
lotr09019.game_text: Bearer must be Cirdan or Gandalf. Fellowship: Remove X culture tokens, where X is equal to bearer?s vitality. Discard this artifact.
lotr09019.lore: “...the Third Ring, Narya the Great, and the stone upon it was red as fire.”

lotr09020.name: Nenya, Ring of Adamant
lotr09020.subtitle: Ring of Adamant
lotr09020.game_text: Bearer must be Galadriel. Maneuver: Heal 2 companions and place up to 2 cards from hand on top of your draw deck. Discard this artifact.
lotr09020.lore: “...Nenya, the ring wrought of mithril, that bore a single white stone flickering like a frosty star.”

lotr09021.name: Pippin's Dagger
lotr09021.game_text: Bearer must be Pippin. Skirmish: Exert Pippin twice or discard this possession to wound a minion an Elf is skirmishing. Any Shadow player may remove (1) to prevent this.
lotr09021.lore: “‘These are the daggers of the Noldorin.'”

lotr09022.name: Strands of Elven Hair
lotr09022.game_text: To play, spot a Dwarf. When you play this possession, add 2 [ELVEN] tokens here. Fellowship: Discard this possession or remove an [ELVEN] token from here to reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is a [DWARVEN] or [ELVEN] card, you may take it into hand.

lotr09023.name: Vilya, Ring of Air
lotr09023.subtitle: Ring of Air
lotr09023.game_text: Bearer must be Elrond or Gil-galad. Skirmish: Discard the top card of your draw deck. Make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -X, where X is the twilight cost of the discarded card. Discard this artifact.
lotr09023.lore: “Gil-galad before he died gave his ring to Elrond....”

lotr09024.name: Ent Draught
lotr09024.game_text: To play, spot an Ent. Bearer must be a companion. Limit 1 per bearer. Skirmish: Exert bearer to make him or her damage +1.
lotr09024.lore: “Indeed the hobbits felt that the hair on their heads was actually standing up, waving and curling and growing.”

lotr09025.name: Huorn
lotr09025.game_text: Damage +1. This companion is strength +1 for each Ent you spot. Response: If this companion is about to take a wound, exert an Ent to prevent that.
lotr09025.lore: “‘...the Forest itself was moving behind us.'”

lotr09026.name: Radagast, The Brown
lotr09026.subtitle: The Brown
lotr09026.game_text: The move limit is +1. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, each opponent may discard 2 cards to draw 2 cards.
lotr09026.lore: “‘...a master of shapes and changes of hue; and he has much lore of herbs and beasts....'”

lotr09027.name: Sent Back
lotr09027.game_text: Skirmish: Discard this condition to discard each minion skirmishing a Wizard. Place that Wizard in your dead pile. Fellowship or Regroup: Play a Wizard (even if another copy of that Wizard is in your dead pile).

lotr09028.name: Gollum, Dark as Darkness
lotr09028.subtitle: Dark as Darkness
lotr09028.game_text: Shadow: Exert Gollum twice to exert the Ring-bearer. Shadow: Remove a burden to add (1). Skirmish: Remove a burden to add (2). Regroup: Remove a burden to add (3). Regroup: Exert Gollum twice to wound the Ring-bearer.

lotr09029.name: Slippery as Fishes
lotr09029.game_text: While Gollum is at a mountain, river, or underground site, he is strength +2. Regroup: Spot Gollum to reveal your hand. Place all Shadow cards revealed beneath your draw deck. Discard this condition.
lotr09029.lore: “‘I hoped the river-voyage would beat him, but he is too clever a waterman.'”

lotr09030.name: Smeagol, Bearer of Great Secrets
lotr09030.subtitle: Bearer of Great Secrets
lotr09030.game_text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Each time the fellowship moves, place an unbound companion in the dead pile. Regroup: If Smeagol is the Ring-bearer, add 2 burdens to discard each minion.
lotr09030.lore: “‘...he used it to find out secrets, and he put his knowledge to crooked and malicious uses.'”

lotr09031.name: Boromir, Bearer of Council
lotr09031.subtitle: Bearer of Council
lotr09031.game_text: While Boromir is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 3 burdens or wound him twice. Each time Boromir wins a skirmish, discard each minion he is skirmishing.
lotr09031.lore: “‘True-hearted Men, they will not be corrupted. We of Minas Tirith have been staunch....’”

lotr09032.name: Elendil, The Tall
lotr09032.subtitle: The Tall
lotr09032.game_text: To play, spot 2 [GONDOR] Men. Fellowship: Play an artifact on Elendil to make the move limit +1 for this turn. Regroup: Discard a [GONDOR] artifact to liberate a site.
lotr09032.lore: “...and the North-realm they made in Arnor, and the South-realm in Gondor....”

lotr09033.name: Isildur, Bearer of Heirlooms
lotr09033.subtitle: Bearer of Heirlooms
lotr09033.game_text: While Isildur is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or exert 3 companions. While Isildur bears The One Ring or an artifact, each [GONDOR] knight is strength +1.
lotr09033.lore: “‘“But for my part I will risk no hurt to this thing: of all the works of Sauron the only fair.”'”

lotr09034.name: Narsil, Blade of the Faithful
lotr09034.subtitle: Blade of the Faithful
lotr09034.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. If bearer is Elendil or Isildur, he is strength +1 for each [GONDOR] artifact you can spot (limit +6). Response: If bearer is about to take a wound, exert 2 [GONDOR] Men to prevent that.
lotr09034.lore: “‘...Isildur cut the Ring from his hand....'”

lotr09035.name: Sapling of the White Tree
lotr09035.game_text: To play, spot an unbound [GONDOR] Man. Response: If a [GONDOR] Man is about to take a wound, discard this artifact to prevent that.
lotr09035.lore: “‘Verily this is a sapling of the line of Nimloth the fair; and that was a seedling of Galathilion, and that a fruit of Telperion of many names, Eldest of Trees.'”

lotr09036.name: Scroll of Isildur
lotr09036.game_text: Tale.To play, spot a [GONDOR] Man. The Ring-bearer is resistance +1 for each [GONDOR] artifact you can spot (limit +3). Fellowship: Discard this artifact to play a ring from your discard pile.
lotr09036.lore: “What evil it saith I do not know; but I trace here a copy of it, lest it fade beyond recall.”

lotr09037.name: Seeing Stone of Minas Anor
lotr09037.game_text: To play, spot a [GONDOR] Man with 3 or more vitality (or spot a [GONDOR] Man and add 2 threats). Regroup: Exert a [GONDOR] Man or discard this artifact to discard your hand and draw 3 cards.
lotr09037.lore: “‘Didst thou think that the eyes of the White Tower were blind?'”

lotr09038.name: Seeing Stone of Orthanc
lotr09038.game_text: To play, spot a [GONDOR] Man with 3 or more vitality (or spot a [GONDOR] Man and add 2 threats). Regroup: Add a threat or discard this artifact to remove (2) or to draw a card.
lotr09038.lore: “‘I am the lawful master of the Stone, and I had both the right and the strength to use it, or so I judged.'”

lotr09039.name: Library of Orthanc
lotr09039.game_text: Shadow: Play an [ISENGARD] minion to stack the top card of your draw deck on this card. Skirmish: Remove(1) and discard a Free Peoples card stacked here to make an [ISENGARD] minion strength +1. Regroup: Remove (1) to take an [ISENGARD] card stacked here into hand.

lotr09040.name: Sack of the Shire
lotr09040.game_text: If an [ISENGARD] minion wins a skirmish, until the regroup phase, make that minion strength +1 for each site you control and fierce.
lotr09040.lore: “‘There's some devilry at work in the Shire....'”

lotr09041.name: Host of Moria, Legion of the Underdeeps
lotr09041.subtitle: Legion of the Underdeeps
lotr09041.game_text: When you play Host of Moria, you may play a [MORIA] card from your discard pile.
lotr09041.lore: “There was a horn-blast and a rush of feet, and orcs one after another leaped into the chamber.”

lotr09042.name: Ring of Asperity
lotr09042.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. When you play this artifact, you may wound an unwounded companion. Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.
lotr09042.lore: “‘The Nine, the Seven, and the Three... had each their proper gem.'”

lotr09043.name: Ring of Ire
lotr09043.game_text: Bearer must be The Witch-king. Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to make a [WRAITH] minion damage +1. Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.
lotr09043.lore: “‘Nine he gave to Mortal Men, proud and great, and so ensnared them.'”

lotr09044.name: Ring of Rancor
lotr09044.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. Maneuver: Remove a burden to heal each Nazgul. Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.
lotr09044.lore: “‘So it is now: the Nine he has gathered to himself....'”

lotr09045.name: Horn of the Mark
lotr09045.game_text: Bearer must be Merry or Pippin. Bearer gains the Theoden signet. Response: If bearer wins a skirmish, exert him to discard each minion involved in that skirmish.
lotr09045.lore: “‘He that blows it at need shall set fear in the hearts of his enemies and joy in the hearts of his friends....'”

lotr09046.name: The Red Arrow
lotr09046.game_text: Assignment: Exert a [GONDOR] Man to play a [ROHAN] Man. You may exert that [ROHAN] Man to play a possession on him or her. Discard this artifact.
lotr09046.lore: “‘The Red Arrow has not been seen in the Mark in all my years! Has it indeed come to that?'”

lotr09047.name: Ithil Stone
lotr09047.game_text: To play, exert a [WRAITH] or [SAURON] minion. At the start of each of your Shadow phases, you may draw a card. Shadow: Discard this artifact to play a [SAURON] minion. Its twilight cost is -3.
lotr09047.lore: “‘...and in it there was a stone like the Moon....'”

lotr09048.name: Sauron, The Lord of the Rings
lotr09048.subtitle: The Lord of the Rings
lotr09048.game_text: Damage +2. Enduring. Fierce. For each burden you spot, threat you spot, and site you control, Sauron's twilight cost is -1.
lotr09048.lore: “One for the Dark Lord on his dark throne / In the Land of Mordor where the Shadows lie.”

lotr09049.name: Bilbo, Bearer of Things Burgled
lotr09049.subtitle: Bearer of Things Burgled
lotr09049.game_text: Ring-bound. Each time the fellowship moves, if the twilight pool has 2 or fewer twilight tokens, add 2 burdens or add (3). Regroup: Add a burden to play a [SHIRE] tale.
lotr09049.lore: “‘But what has it got in its pocketses, eh?'”

lotr09050.name: Everyone Knows
lotr09050.game_text: Tale. Each unbound Hobbit is strength +1 for each vitality over 3 he or she has. Skirmish: Prevent an unbound Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled. Discard this condition.
lotr09050.lore: “‘...I'm the tall one, you're the short one.'”

lotr09051.name: Goldberry, River-daughter
lotr09051.subtitle: River-daughter
lotr09051.game_text: Each time the fellowship moves to a river, heal Goldberry and Tom Bombadil. Skirmish: If the fellowship is at a river, exert Goldberry to make a companion strength +1.
lotr09051.lore: “‘Slender as the willow-wand, clearer than the water.'”

lotr09052.name: Tom Bombadil, The Master
lotr09052.subtitle: The Master
lotr09052.game_text: To play, remove 2 burdens or 2 threats. Skirmish: Spot 2 [SHIRE] companions and exert Tom Bombadil X times, where X is the fellowship's site number, to cancel a skirmish involving a [SHIRE] companion.
lotr09052.lore: “‘Hey! Come derry dol! Can you hear me singing?'”

lotr10001.name: Aragorn, Elessar Telcontar
lotr10001.subtitle: Elessar Telcontar
lotr10001.game_text: When you play Aragorn, you may heal another companion. At the start of each fellowship phase, you may exert a companion of one culture to heal a companion of another culture.
lotr10001.lore: "'Now come the days of the King, and may they be blessed while the thrones of the Valar endure!'"

lotr10002.name: Memories of Darkness
lotr10002.game_text: To play, spot a Dwarf. Each time you lose initiative (except during the fellowship phase), you may play a [DWARVEN] condition from hand or from your discard pile.
lotr10002.lore: “‘Had I known what was before me, I think that not for any friendship would I have taken the Paths of the Dead.'”

lotr10003.name: More Yet to Come
lotr10003.game_text: If a Dwarf kills a minion in a skirmish and that minion did not take all wounds caused by that Dwarf's damage bonus, assign those remaining wounds to minions not assigned to a skirmish.
lotr10003.lore: “‘...whatever is still to do, I hope to have a part in it, for the honour of the folk of the Lonely Mountain.'”

lotr10004.name: Aegnor, Elven Escort
lotr10004.subtitle: Elven Escort
lotr10004.game_text: Skirmish: Exert Aegnor to make a minion skirmishing an unbound [ELVEN] companion strength -1 for each archer you spot.
lotr10004.lore: Affectionately referred to as ‘Figwit' by his contemporaries in Rivendell.

lotr10005.name: Arwen, Echo of Luthien
lotr10005.subtitle: Echo of Luthien
lotr10005.game_text: Skirmish: Discard a card from hand to discard the bottom card of your draw deck. If the bottom card was an [ELVEN] card, each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -3.
lotr10005.lore: “‘...mine is the choice of Lúthien, and as she so have I chosen, both the sweet and the bitter.'”

lotr10006.name: Arwen, Queen of Elves and Men
lotr10006.subtitle: Queen of Elves and Men
lotr10006.game_text: Each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -2 for each wounded minion you can spot.
lotr10006.lore: “‘“Often is it seen,” said Aragorn, “that in dangerous days men hide their chief treasure.”'”

lotr10007.name: Celeborn, Lord of the Galadhrim
lotr10007.subtitle: Lord of the Galadhrim
lotr10007.game_text: At the start of each skirmish involving Celeborn, you may reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [ELVEN] card, you may discard it to wound each minion in that skirmish.
lotr10007.lore: “...with him went the last living memory of the Elder Days in Middle-earth.”

lotr10008.name: Cirdan, The Shipwright
lotr10008.subtitle: The Shipwright
lotr10008.game_text: To play, spot 2 Elves. Skirmish: Exert Cirdan to make a minion he is skirmishing strength -1 for each [ELVEN] event in your discard pile.
lotr10008.lore: “...he was grey and old, save that his eyes were keen as stars....”

lotr10009.name: Elrond, Venerable Lord
lotr10009.subtitle: Venerable Lord
lotr10009.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. At the start of each skirmish involving Elrond, you may reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [ELVEN] card, you may heal another Elf.
lotr10009.lore: “‘To me then even our victory can bring only sorrow and parting – but to you hope of joy for a while.'”

lotr10010.name: Fleet-footed
lotr10010.game_text: Make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -2. Spot a site in a support area to place this event on top of your draw deck.
lotr10010.lore: Not all Elven weapons are carried in sheath or quiver.

lotr10011.name: Galadriel, Lady Redeemed
lotr10011.subtitle: Lady Redeemed
lotr10011.game_text: When Galadriel is in your starting fellowship, her twilight cost is -3. Fellowship or Regroup: Discard an [ELVEN] event from hand to discard a Shadow condition or Shadow possession.
lotr10011.lore: “‘I pass the test,' she said. ‘I will diminish, and go into the West, and remain Galadriel.'”

lotr10012.name: Glimpse of Fate
lotr10012.game_text: To play, spot 2 Elves. Each time you lose initiative, make a minion strength -4 until the regroup phase.
lotr10012.lore: “‘The uttermost choice is before you: to repent and go to the Havens... or else to abide the Doom of Men.'”

lotr10013.name: Phial of Galadriel, Star-glass
lotr10013.subtitle: Star-glass
lotr10013.game_text: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Skirmish: Until the regroup phase, remove the game text (except card type and race) from a minion skirmishing bearer and make it unable to gain game text. Discard this artifact.
lotr10013.lore: “...the hand that held it sparkled with white fire.”

lotr10014.name: Borne Far Away
lotr10014.game_text: Spot your Wizard to exchange a companion in hand with a companion in your dead pile or discard pile.
lotr10014.lore: “...the wanderers were lifted up and borne far away out of the darkness and the fire.”

lotr10015.name: Brooding on Tomorrow
lotr10015.game_text: Each time you lose initiative (except during the fellowship phase), you may spot a [GANDALF] companion to choose an opponent who must discard one of his or her conditions.
lotr10015.lore: “‘...tomorrow will be certain to bring worse than today, for many days to come.'”

lotr10016.name: Gathering Wind
lotr10016.game_text: Exert your Wizard and choose a number. Make each minion with that twilight cost strength -2 until the regroup phase.
lotr10016.lore: “...the rush of their wide wings as they passed over was like a gale.”

lotr10017.name: Out of the High Airs
lotr10017.game_text: If the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, exert your Wizard to discard each minion.
lotr10017.lore: “...the Nazgûl turned and fled, and vanished into Mordor's shadows....”

lotr10018.name: Treebeard, Keeper of the Watchwood
lotr10018.subtitle: Keeper of the Watchwood
lotr10018.game_text: To play, spot 3 [GANDALF] companions. Regroup: Exert Treebeard twice to play a [GANDALF] condition from your discard pile and make an opponent discard one of his or her conditions.
lotr10018.lore: “‘Leave it to the Ents!... Trees are coming back to live here, old trees, wild trees.'”

lotr10019.name: A Dark Shape Sprang
lotr10019.game_text: If an opponent plays a possession on a companion, play Gollum at twilight cost -2 from your discard pile or hand to suspend the current phase. Begin a skirmish phase involving Gollum and that companion. When it ends, resume the suspended phase.
lotr10019.lore: “Something struck Sam violently in the back....”

lotr10020.name: Final Strike
lotr10020.game_text: Any site 9 is a Mountain. Shadow: If the fellowship is at any site 9, play Gollum from your discard pile. Response: If the Free Peoples player uses a maneuver or archery special ability, exert Gollum to cancel its effect.

lotr10021.name: Gollum, Mad Thing
lotr10021.subtitle: Mad Thing
lotr10021.game_text: To assign Gollum to a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must make Gollum strength +3 until the regroup phase or add a burden.
lotr10021.lore: “...swiftly but warily, creeping on behind, a slinking shadow among the stones.”

lotr10022.name: Reclaim the Precious
lotr10022.game_text: Assignment: Assign Gollum to a companion bearing an artifact. The Free Peoples player may add a burden to prevent this and assign Gollum. Regroup: Exert Gollum twice to discard a possession. Discard this condition.
lotr10022.lore: “...white fangs gleamed, and then snapped as they bit.”

lotr10023.name: Shelob, Her Ladyship
lotr10023.subtitle: Her Ladyship
lotr10023.game_text: Enduring. Fierce. When you play Shelob, if you can spot Gollum, you may spot a companion. That companion cannot be assigned to a skirmish until the end of the turn.
lotr10023.lore: “...she served none but herself, drinking the blood of Elves and Men....”

lotr10024.name: Unabated in Malice
lotr10024.game_text: While you have initiative, each [GOLLUM] minion is damage +1. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [GOLLUM] minion strength +1 for each culture you can spot.
lotr10024.lore: “...she lusted for sweeter meat. And Gollum had brought it to her.”

lotr10025.name: Aragorn, Elessar Telcontar
lotr10025.subtitle: Elessar Telcontar
lotr10025.game_text: When you play Aragorn, you may heal another companion. At the start of each fellowship phase, you may exert a companion of one culture to heal a companion of another culture.
lotr10025.lore: “‘Now come the days of the King, and may they be blessed while the thrones of the Valar endure!'”

lotr10026.name: Cursed of Erech
lotr10026.game_text: Enduring. To play, add a threat. When you play Cursed of Erech, exert him twice. At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert another [GONDOR] Wraith to make Cursed of Erech defender +1 until the regroup phase.

lotr10027.name: Dead Man of Dunharrow
lotr10027.game_text: Enduring. To play, add a threat. When you play this companion, exert him twice.
lotr10027.lore: “...the Shadow Host pressed behind and fear went on before them....”

lotr10028.name: Denethor, Lord of Minas Tirith
lotr10028.subtitle: Lord of Minas Tirith
lotr10028.game_text: To play, spot 2 [GONDOR] Men. Fellowship: If at a sanctuary, exert Denethor to take a [GONDOR] card into hand from your draw deck, then reshuffle. Choose an opponent who may draw 2 cards.
lotr10028.lore: “There Denethor sat in a grey gloom, like an old patient spider....”

lotr10029.name: Drawing His Eye
lotr10029.game_text: For each [GONDOR] companion you spot, reveal 1 card at random from a Shadow player's hand. Choose a revealed Shadow card to be discarded, then its owner draws a card.
lotr10029.lore: “‘We cannot achieve victory by arms, but by arms we can give the Ring-bearer his only chance, frail though it be.'”

lotr10030.name: End of the Game
lotr10030.game_text: Make an exhausted [GONDOR] companion strength +2. If that companion wins this skirmish, heal that companion or make him or her damage +1.
lotr10030.lore: “...he drew Andúril and held it up glittering in the sun. ‘You shall not be sheathed again until the last battle is fought,' he said.”

lotr10031.name: Every Little is a Gain
lotr10031.game_text: Spot a [GONDOR] Man to discard a stacked Shadow card or to wound a minion bearing a fortification.
lotr10031.lore: “And so the companies came and were hailed and cheered and passed through the Gate, men of the Outlands marching to defend the City of Gondor in a dark hour....”

lotr10032.name: Fifth Level
lotr10032.game_text: Fortification. Bearer is strength -1 for each Fortification you can spot. Maneuver: Exert 2 [GONDOR] Men or spot 3 knights to transfer this condition to a minion.

lotr10033.name: Hardy Garrison
lotr10033.game_text: To play, spot 2 [GONDOR] Men. Each time you lose initiative, you may wound a minion.
lotr10033.lore: “All before the walls on either side of the Gate the ground was choked with wreck and with bodies of the slain....”

lotr10034.name: Last Throw
lotr10034.game_text: If no opponent controls a site, spot 2 [GONDOR] Men to make the move limit +1 for this turn.
lotr10034.lore: “‘We must push Sauron... We must march out to meet him at once.'”

lotr10035.name: Suffered Much Loss
lotr10035.game_text: Each site on the adventure path is a battleground. While you have initiative, each Uruk-hai is strength +1.
lotr10035.lore: “‘For we are already at war, as you may have seen....'”

lotr10036.name: Cast Unto the Winds
lotr10036.game_text: Regroup: Spot a Southron, remove a threat, and remove (3) to wound an unbound companion.
lotr10036.lore: “‘With horns in my mouth / I walk in the South....'”

lotr10037.name: Corsair Boatswain
lotr10037.game_text: Corsair. To play, spot a [RAIDER] Man. Shadow: Exert this minion to play a [RAIDER] support area possession from your draw deck.
lotr10037.lore: Promise of plunder and of the whip keep in line a lustful Corsair crew.

lotr10038.name: Corsair Brute
lotr10038.game_text: Corsair. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may remove a [RAIDER] token to wound a companion he is skirmishing.
lotr10038.lore: “...the region of South Gondor became a debatable land between the Corsairs and the Kings.”

lotr10039.name: Corsair Ruffian
lotr10039.game_text: Corsair. When you play this minion, you may spot another corsair and discard the top card of the Free Peoples player's draw deck to add 2 [RAIDER] tokens to a card that already has a [RAIDER] token on it.
lotr10039.lore: An incarnation of savagery was Ghynóh the Cruel.

lotr10040.name: Easterling Berserker
lotr10040.game_text: Easterling. To play, spot an Easterling. While this minion is unwounded, he is damage +2. Skirmish: Wound 2 other [RAIDER] Men to heal this minion.
lotr10040.lore: “...from nearby there marched up an army of Easterlings that had waited for the signal....”

lotr10041.name: Easterling Pillager
lotr10041.game_text: Easterling. Fierce. When you play this minion, you may spot another Easterling to add a burden for each companion you spot over 5.
lotr10041.lore: “...for the sack of the City and the rape of Gondor....”

lotr10042.name: Far Harad Mercenaries
lotr10042.game_text: Southron. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may spot 6 companions and another [RAIDER] Man to discard an unbound companion this minion is skirmishing.
lotr10042.lore: “...men like half-trolls, with white eyes and red tongues.”

lotr10043.name: Field of the Fallen
lotr10043.game_text: To play, spot a [RAIDER] Man. While there is a character in the dead pile, each companion of the same culture as that chastrength -1. Skirmish: Exert your Southron to make him strength +1.

lotr10044.name: High Vantage
lotr10044.game_text: Until the end of the assignment phase, each time a Southron is about to take a wound, prevent that.
lotr10044.lore: Southrons rain arrows down upon their enemies from their defended perch atop their great beasts of war.

lotr10045.name: Mumak Chieftain
lotr10045.game_text: Southron. When you play this minion, you may play a mount on him from your discard pile. Its twilight cost is -2.
lotr10045.lore: The commander of a mûmak never imagines he is in complete control of the beast.

lotr10046.name: Quelled
lotr10046.game_text: Exert a [RAIDER] Man to discard a Free Peoples condition. If you spot a [ROHAN] Man, discard an additional Free Peoples condition.
lotr10046.lore: Against the great mounts of the Southron army, Rohirrim steeds could not easily prevail.

lotr10047.name: Rallying Call
lotr10047.game_text: To play, spot a [RAIDER] Man. Threats cannot be removed by Free Peoples cards. Shadow: Remove (1) and play a Southron to add a threat.
lotr10047.lore: “Horns were blown and trumpets were braying....”

lotr10048.name: Seasoned Leader
lotr10048.game_text: Bearer must be a Southron. Bearer is enduring. Skirmish: Remove a threat to play a [RAIDER] condition from your discard pile.
lotr10048.lore: Only by many conquests and hardships does one rise to prominence in the army of the Haradrim.

lotr10049.name: Southron Fanatic
lotr10049.game_text: Southron. Each time a Man is assigned to skirmish this minion, wound that Man.
lotr10049.lore: Stirred by the Dark Lord, the fullness of Southron cruelty was leveled at the people of Gondor.

lotr10050.name: Southron Savage
