lotr10050.game_text: Southron. While the total number of other minions and twilight tokens is 3 or fewer, this minion is strength +3 and fierce.
lotr10050.lore: The merciless deserts of Haradwaith breed equally merciless fighters.

lotr10051.name: Stampeded
lotr10051.game_text: If a Free Peoples possession is played, spot a [RAIDER] card to discard that possession. If that possession was a [GONDOR] or [ROHAN] possession, wound an unbound Man.
lotr10051.lore: “...the Mûmak of Harad was indeed a beast of vast bulk, and the like of him does not walk now in Middle-earth....”

lotr10052.name: Under Foot
lotr10052.game_text: Shadow: If you have initiative, spot a [RAIDER] Man and discard this condition to reconcile your hand. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [RAIDER] Man strength +2.
lotr10052.lore: “‘I make the earth shake, / As I tramp through the grass; / Trees crack as I pass.'”

lotr10053.name: Black Marshal
lotr10053.game_text: Shadow: Exert a Nazgul and play a [WRAITH] minion to add (1) (or (2) if you have initiative).
lotr10053.lore: “...at their head was one greater than all the rest: a Rider, all black....”

lotr10054.name: Cirith Ungol Scavenger
lotr10054.game_text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert it to discard a possession borne by a character this minion is skirmishing.
lotr10054.lore: “A noise of tramping feet and harsh shouts: Orcs were coming up to the Cleft from the far side....”

lotr10055.name: Cirith Ungol Soldier
lotr10055.game_text: Shadow: Spot a possession to make this minion fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr10055.lore: “...not even the black shadows, lying deep where the red glow could not reach, would shield him long from the night-eyed orcs.”

lotr10056.name: Cirith Ungol Warrior
lotr10056.game_text: Shadow: Spot a possession to make this minion fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr10056.lore: “...deafening, roaring in his ears, the crash of the feet and the rending clamour of the Orcs before him.”

lotr10057.name: Cirith Ungol Watchman
lotr10057.game_text: Each companion skirmishing this minion loses all damage and strength bonuses from possessions.
lotr10057.lore: “Sam looked up towards the orc-tower, and suddenly from its narrow windows lights stared out like small red eyes.”

lotr10058.name: Dark Swooping Shadows
lotr10058.game_text: Heal an enduring [WRAITH] minion to add a burden or 2 threats.
lotr10058.lore: “‘...how can he win to the Gate, if these foul hell-hawks have other weapons than fear?'”

lotr10059.name: Gorbag, Covetous Captain
lotr10059.subtitle: Covetous Captain
lotr10059.game_text: For each wound on the Ring-bearer, each [WRAITH] Orc is strength +1.
lotr10059.lore: “‘I tell you, it's no game serving down in the city.'”

lotr10060.name: Gorbag's Sword
lotr10060.game_text: Bearer must be a [WRAITH] Orc. When you play this possession, you may discard a possession. Its owner may place it on top of his or her draw deck instead. If bearer is Gorbag, he is fierce.
lotr10060.lore: “‘You touch it and I'll stick this blade in your gut.'”

lotr10061.name: Houses of Lamentation
lotr10061.game_text: Make a [WRAITH] minion strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a companion of the same culture as a card in the dead pile).
lotr10061.lore: “‘...thy shrivelled mind be left naked to the Lidless Eye.'”

lotr10062.name: Morgul Banner-bearer
lotr10062.game_text: While the total number of other minions and twilight tokens is 3 or fewer, this minion is strength +3 and an archer.
lotr10062.lore: “So great an army had never issued from that vale since the days of Isildur's might....”

lotr10063.name: Morgul Vanguard
lotr10063.game_text: Assignment: Assign this minion to an unbound companion bearing a hand weapon.
lotr10063.lore: “‘...soon the host of Morgul will enter in at many points.'”

lotr10064.name: Stooping to the Kill
lotr10064.game_text: While you have initiative, each of your [WRAITH] minions is damage +1. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [WRAITH] minion strength +2.
lotr10064.lore: “And with a piercing cry out of the dim sky fell the winged shadows....”

lotr10065.name: Swarming Like Beetles
lotr10065.game_text: Maneuver: Spot a [WRAITH] Orc and remove a threat to wound an unwounded companion.
lotr10065.lore: “‘...in secret they have long been building floats and barges in great number in East Osgiliath.'”

lotr10066.name: Ten Times Outnumbered
lotr10066.game_text: Make a [WRAITH] Orc strength +2 for each wound on the Ring-bearer.
lotr10066.lore: “The passage of Anduin was won by the Enemy.”

lotr10067.name: Ulaire Cantea, Thrall of the One
lotr10067.subtitle: Thrall of the One
lotr10067.game_text: Enduring. Fierce. Shadow cards cannot exert Ulaire Cantea during a skirmish phase. Skirmish: Heal Ulaire Cantea to discard a possession borne by a character he is skirmishing.
lotr10067.lore: “...the shadows of death fell dark upon the earth.”

lotr10068.name: Ulaire Enquea, Thrall of the One
lotr10068.subtitle: Thrall of the One
lotr10068.game_text: Enduring. Shadow cards cannot exert Ulaire Enquea during a skirmish phase. Skirmish: If Ulaire Enquea is skirmishing, heal him to add a burden.
lotr10068.lore: “Ever they circled above the City, like vultures that expect their fill of doomed men's flesh.”

lotr10069.name: Ulaire Lemenya, Thrall of the One
lotr10069.subtitle: Thrall of the One
lotr10069.game_text: Enduring. Fierce. Shadow cards cannot exert Ulaire Lemenya during a skirmish phase. Skirmish: Heal Ulaire Lemenya to wound up to 3 other [WRAITH] minions.
lotr10069.lore: “It was no brigand or orc-chieftain that ordered the assault upon the Lord of Mordor's greatest foe.”

lotr10070.name: Ulaire Nelya, Thrall of the One
lotr10070.subtitle: Thrall of the One
lotr10070.game_text: Enduring. Fierce. Shadow cards cannot exert Ulaire Nelya during a skirmish phase. Skirmish: Heal Ulaire Nelya to add (1) for each burden.
lotr10070.lore: “Perching now on the wall beside the ruined gate the Nazgûl sent out its deadly cries. All the cliffs echoed.”

lotr10071.name: Ulaire Toldea, Thrall of the One
lotr10071.subtitle: Thrall of the One
lotr10071.game_text: Enduring. Shadow cards cannot exert Ulaire Toldea during a skirmish phase. Skirmish: Heal Ulaire Toldea to make him damage +1.
lotr10071.lore: “...like shadows of untimely night, he saw in the middle airs below him five birdlike forms...”

lotr10072.name: Eowyn, Lady of Ithilien
lotr10072.subtitle: Lady of Ithilien
lotr10072.game_text: Skirmish: Exert Eowyn to choose an opponent. That opponent must wound a minion for each wound on each minion skirmishing Eowyn.
lotr10072.lore: “‘Yet now that I have leave to depart, I would remain. For this House has become to me of all dwellings the most blessed.'”

lotr10073.name: Fell Deeds Awake
lotr10073.game_text: To play, spot a [ROHAN] Man. Each time you lose initiative, you may liberate a site.
lotr10073.lore: “...he seized a great horn from Guthláf his banner-bearer, and he blew such a blast upon it that it burst asunder.”

lotr10074.name: Unyielding
lotr10074.game_text: If your [ROHAN] Man wins a skirmish, discard a [ROHAN] possession to wound a minion or to liberate a site.
lotr10074.lore: “...they gathered and rallied and fought until the day wore away.”

lotr10075.name: Advance Captain
lotr10075.lore: The foe who gave him his scar soon after gave him the adornment for his helm.

lotr10076.name: Advance Marauder
lotr10076.game_text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a roaming [SAURON] minion strength +3.

lotr10077.name: Advance Regular
lotr10077.lore: “In vain men shook their fists at the pitiless foes that swarmed before the Gate.”

lotr10078.name: Advance Scout
lotr10078.game_text: Shadow: Exert or discard this minion to make each [SAURON] minion you spot roaming until the regroup phase.
lotr10078.lore: “The lines of fire became flowing torrents, file upon file of Orcs bearing flames....”

lotr10079.name: Barren Land
lotr10079.game_text: To play, spot a [SAURON] minion. Each time the fellowship moves to any site 8 or 9, exert each Ring-bound companion. Shadow: Discard this condition to play a [SAURON] minion. Its twilight cost is -2.
lotr10079.lore: “There the last living things gave up their struggle....”

lotr10080.name: Beaten Back
lotr10080.game_text: Make a [SAURON] minion strength +2 for each site you control. If you have initiative, that minion is fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr10080.lore: “The Rammas was broken, and all the Pelennor abandoned to the Enemy.”

lotr10081.name: Cirith Ungol Guard
lotr10081.lore: “...this stronghold had been built not to keep enemies out of Mordor, but to keep them in.”

lotr10082.name: Cirith Ungol Patroller
lotr10082.game_text: Damage +1. While you can spot 3 possessions, this minion is fierce.
lotr10082.lore: “‘A message came: “Nazgûl uneasy. Spies feared on stairs. Double vigiliance. Patrol to head of Stairs.'””

lotr10083.name: Cirith Ungol Sentinel
lotr10083.game_text: Damage +1. If you can spot another [SAURON] Uruk-hai, this minion is twilight cost -1 for each possession you can spot.
lotr10083.lore: “‘Any trespasser found by the guard is to be held at the tower.'”

lotr10084.name: Cirith Ungol Sentry
lotr10084.lore: “...treachery had yielded up the Tower to the Lord of the Ringwraiths, and now for long years it had been held by evil things.”

lotr10085.name: Flames Within
lotr10085.game_text: While you have initiative, each of your [SAURON] minions is strength +2. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [SAURON] minion strength +2 (or +4 if it is roaming).
lotr10085.lore: “Soon there was great peril of fire behind the wall....”

lotr10086.name: Gorgoroth Keeper
lotr10086.game_text: Besieger. While you control a site, this minion's twilight cost is -2. Regroup: Stack this minion on a site you control.

lotr10087.name: Gorgoroth Swarm
lotr10087.game_text: Besieger. When you play this minion, you may spot 6 companions and another besieger to play a besieger from your discard pile and control a site.

lotr10088.name: Gothmog, Lieutenant of Morgul
lotr10088.subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
lotr10088.game_text: Besieger. When you play Gothmog, the Free Peoples player must wound a companion for each site you control. While you control a site, Gothmog is fierce.
lotr10088.lore: “‘Move into the City. Kill all in your path.'”

lotr10089.name: Gothmog's Warg
lotr10089.game_text: Bearer must be a [SAURON] Orc. For each site you control, bearer is strength +1 (or +2 if bearer is Gothmog).

lotr10090.name: Mordor Brute
lotr10090.game_text: Each [SAURON] Orc bearing a possession cannot take wounds (except during skirmish phases).
lotr10090.lore: “There came a long rolling of great drums like thunder in the mountains....”

lotr10091.name: Mordor Fiend
lotr10091.game_text: Shadow: If you cannot spot another minion and there are 3 or fewer twilight tokens, add (3) (or (5) if this minion is roaming).
lotr10091.lore: “The onslaught of Mordor broke like a wave on the beleaguered hills....”

lotr10092.name: Mordor Pillager
lotr10092.game_text: Besieger. Fierce. Shadow: Exert this minion and spot another [SAURON] minion to control a site. If you cannot spot 3 Free Peoples cultures, the Free Peoples player may exert a companion to prevent this.

lotr10093.name: Mordor Wretch
lotr10093.game_text: Shadow: Spot 4 Free Peoples cultures and exert another [SAURON] minion twice to add (3) and draw a card.
lotr10093.lore: “...a braying of horns... shook the very stones and stunned men's ears.”

lotr10094.name: Orc Ravager
lotr10094.game_text: To play, spot a [SAURON] minion. Shadow: Remove 2 threats to discard a condition.
lotr10094.lore: “The Captains of the West were foundering in a gathering sea.”

lotr10095.name: Orc Slaughterer
lotr10095.game_text: Enduring. For each wound on this minion, it is strength +2.
lotr10095.lore: “All about the hills the hosts of Mordor raged.”

lotr10096.name: Rank and File
lotr10096.game_text: Each time a roaming [SAURON] minion takes a wound, you may add a [SAURON] token here. Regroup: Exert an Uruk-hai or discard a [SAURON] minion to add a [SAURON] token here. Skirmish: Remove 2 [SAURON] tokens from here to make a [SAURON] minion strength +2.
lotr10096.lore: “...even fear by night had scarcely over-counted them.”

lotr10097.name: The Ring is Mine!
lotr10097.game_text: If a burden is added, spot a [SAURON] minion to add an additional burden.
lotr10097.lore: “‘...I do not choose now to do what I came to do. I will not do this deed.'”

lotr10098.name: Ruinous Hail
lotr10098.game_text: If the Free Peoples player plays a possession, discard a [SAURON] minion from hand to prevent him or her from playing any more cards until the end of this phase.
lotr10098.lore: “...they began to throw missiles marvelously high, so that they passed right above the battlement and fell thudding within the first circle of the City....”

lotr10099.name: Shagrat, Captain of Cirith Ungol
lotr10099.subtitle: Captain of Cirith Ungol
lotr10099.game_text: Damage +1. Each time Shagrat loses a skirmish, you may exert a character.
lotr10099.lore: “‘If you think I'm so damaged that it's safe to flout me, you're mistaken.'”

lotr10100.name: Speak No More to Me
lotr10100.game_text: Exert a [SAURON] minion to return a Free Peoples condition to its owner's hand (or 2 if both are [SHIRE] conditions).
lotr10100.lore: “‘Go slow! Bring no fire to this place while Faramir lives! Do nothing until Gandalf comes!'”

lotr10101.name: Troll of Cirith Gorgor
lotr10101.game_text: Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot a [SAURON] minion. This minion is strength +1 for each possession you can spot.
lotr10101.lore: “...these fell creatures would bite the throats of those that they threw down.”

lotr10102.name: Uruk Axe
lotr10102.game_text: Bearer must be a [SAURON] Minion. If bearer is an Uruk-hai, it is strength +2.
lotr10102.lore: A sharp edge for the sharp-natured.

lotr10103.name: Window of the Eye
lotr10103.game_text: To play, spot a [SAURON] minion. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may remove a threat to wound an unbound companion.
lotr10103.lore: “...as from some great window immeasurably high there stabbed northward a flame of red, the flicker of a piercing Eye....”

lotr10104.name: Birthday Present
lotr10104.game_text: Fellowship: Add a burden to choose 2 [SHIRE] events with different card titles from your discard pile. Choose an opponent and make him or her choose 1 of those cards for you to take into hand.
lotr10104.lore: “‘...he caught Déagol by the throat and strangled him, because the gold looked so bright and beautiful.'”

lotr10105.name: Brave and Loyal
lotr10105.game_text: If a Hobbit companion is not assigned to a skirmish, exert that Hobbit to have him or her replace a companion (except the Ring-bearer) in a skirmish.
lotr10105.lore: “‘Now come, you filth!' he cried. ‘You've hurt my master, you brute, and you'll pay for it.'”

lotr10106.name: Chance Observation
lotr10106.game_text: If there are 4 or more [SHIRE] cards in your discard pile, make a Hobbit strength +1 for each Hobbit you can spot.
lotr10106.lore: “‘...he thought he saw something shining in the river-bed; and holding his breath he grabbed at it.'”

lotr10107.name: Great Heart
lotr10107.game_text: Play this condition only during a skirmish. Bearer must be a Hobbit. When this condition is played, wound a minion skirmishing bearer.
lotr10107.lore: “And there stood Meriadoc the hobbit in the midst of the slain, blinking like an owl in the daylight, for tears blinded him....”

lotr10108.name: A Light in His Mind
lotr10108.game_text: Each time you lose initiative, you may spot 2 [SHIRE] companions to remove a burden.
lotr10108.lore: “Far off, as in a little picture drawn by elven-fingers, he saw the Lady Galadriel standing on the grass in Lórien, and gifts were in her hands.”

lotr10109.name: Make Haste
lotr10109.game_text: Stealth. Spot a [SHIRE] companion and return him or her to your hand to make a Shadow player choose to remove (2) or discard a minion.
lotr10109.lore: “‘There's something still alive in that place, something with eyes, or a seeing mind, if you take me; and the longer we stay in one spot, the sooner it will get on to us.'”

lotr10110.name: A Marvel
lotr10110.game_text: Exert a Hobbit to make another Hobbit strength +3.
lotr10110.lore: “Howling with pain and fear but desperate the orc charged head-down at him.”

lotr10111.name: Narrow Escape
lotr10111.game_text: Spot 2 Hobbit companions to make a Shadow player discard a minion (or spot 4 Hobbit companions to make that player discard 2 minions).
lotr10111.lore: “‘If those two had seen us, they would have dropped all their quarrel until we were dead.'”

lotr10112.name: Nine-fingered Frodo and the Ring of Doom
lotr10112.game_text: Tale. Exert a [SHIRE] character to remove a burden or 2 threats.
lotr10112.lore: “‘What a tale we have been in, Mr. Frodo, haven't we?'”

lotr10113.name: Orc Armor
lotr10113.game_text: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Each Orc and each Uruk-hai skirmishing bearer is strength -1.
lotr10113.lore: “‘Well, there you are, Mr. Frodo. A perfect little orc, if I may make so bold....'”

lotr10114.name: Shadowplay
lotr10114.game_text: To play, spot 2 [SHIRE] companions. Each time a minion is played, you may exert a Hobbit companion to exert that minion (limit once per turn).
lotr10114.lore: “...it saw a great silent shape, cloaked in a grey shadow, looming against the wavering light behind....”

lotr10115.name: Slunk Out of Sight
lotr10115.game_text: Stealth. If there are 6 or more [SHIRE] cards in your discard pile, cancel a skirmish involving your Hobbit and a minion who is not fierce. Each minion in that skirmish is fierce until the regroup phase.

lotr10116.name: The Tale of the Great Ring
lotr10116.game_text: Tale. Skirmish: Prevent a Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless a Shadow event is (or was) played during this skirmish. Discard this condition.
lotr10116.lore: “‘I have quite finished, Sam,' said Frodo. ‘The last pages are for you.'”

lotr10117.name: Base of Mindolluin
lotr10117.game_text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: If you cannot spot 2 threats, add a threat to play a fortification from your draw deck.

lotr10118.name: Pelennor Prairie
lotr10118.game_text: Plains. Shadow: Exert a minion and remove a burden to make the Free Peoples player discard one of his or her conditions.

lotr10119.name: Steward's Tomb
lotr10119.game_text: Wounds cannot be prevented or healed. Burdens cannot be removed.

lotr10120.name: Watchers of Cirith Ungol
lotr10120.game_text: Skirmish: Spot your [WRAITH] Orc and remove 2 threats to make that [WRAITH] Orc strength +3.

lotr10121.name: Frodo, Resolute Hobbit
lotr10121.subtitle: Resolute Hobbit
lotr10121.lore: “‘...if it's the only way, we must take it.'”

lotr10122.name: Sam, Great Elf Warrior
lotr10122.subtitle: Great Elf Warrior
lotr10122.game_text: Ring-bound. Sam is strength +1 for each [SHIRE] companion you can spot. Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).
lotr10122.lore: “‘...I'd say there's a large warrior on the loose, Elf most likely, with an elf-sword anyway....'”

lotr11001.name: The One Ring, The Ring of Rings
lotr11001.subtitle: The Ring of Rings
lotr11001.game_text: Response: If the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound, he or she wears The One Ring until the regroup phase. While the Ring-bearer is wearing The One Ring, each time he or she is about to take a wound, add a burden instead.

lotr11002.name: Elven Marksmanship
lotr11002.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. Toil 2. (For each [ELVEN] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Archery: Discard this condition to make the fellowship archery total +2.
lotr11002.lore: Sighted by keen vision and loosed with blinding swiftness, Elven arrows rarely miss their targets

lotr11003.name: Legolas, Woodland Emissary
lotr11003.subtitle: Woodland Emissary
lotr11003.game_text: At the start of the archery phase, you may spot another Elf to exert a minion.
lotr11003.lore: Traveling to the council at Imladris was only the beginning of a much greater journey for the Elven Prince. “‘Few can foresee whither their road will lead them, till they come to its end.'”

lotr11004.name: Glamdring, Foe-hammer
lotr11004.subtitle: Foe-hammer
lotr11004.game_text: Bearer must be Gandalf. Each time Gandalf wins a skirmish, you may remove a burden.
lotr11004.lore: “There was a ringing clash and a stab of white fire.”

lotr11005.name: Gollum, Skulker
lotr11005.subtitle: Skulker
lotr11005.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Skirmish: Exert Gollum twice to make another minion strength +2.
lotr11005.lore: “‘O yes, Shelob will get him, not Sméagol: he promised; he won't hurt Master at all.'”

lotr11006.name: Smeagol, Scout and Guide
lotr11006.subtitle: Scout and Guide
lotr11006.game_text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Each time Smeagol wins a skirmish, you may play the fellowship's next site. Skirmish: If Smeagol is at a marsh, exert him to cancel a skirmish involving him.
lotr11006.lore: “They would have foundered in the Dead Marshes but for Gollum.”

lotr11007.name: Aragorn, Strider
lotr11007.subtitle: Strider
lotr11007.game_text: Ranger. Each time the fellowship moves, add (1).
lotr11007.lore: “...in spite of the heat of the room he wore a hood that overshadowed his face; but the gleam of his eyes could be seen as he watched the hobbits.”

lotr11008.name: Bloodthirsty
lotr11008.game_text: Spot 2 [MEN] minions to wound an unbound companion.
lotr11008.lore: The ferocity of the Dunlendings is not easily slaked.

lotr11009.name: Fletcher of Harad
lotr11009.game_text: While this minion is at a plains site, it is an archer. While you can spot 6 companions, each [MEN] minion is an archer.
lotr11009.lore: Makers of bows and arrows have a strong trade for the raiders of Harad.

lotr11010.name: Porter Troll
lotr11010.game_text: Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot an [ORC] minion. When you play this minion, add a burden unless the Free Peoples player reveals a Free Peoples event from his or her hand.
lotr11010.lore: The mammoth battering ram Grond required equally mammoth strength to wield it.

lotr11011.name: Undisciplined
lotr11011.game_text: Toil 3. (For each [ORC] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -3.) Assign an [ORC] minion to a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr11011.lore: Easily caught by the heat of battle, Orc soldiers often break formation and attack where their bloodlust takes them.

lotr11012.name: Gamling, Defender of the Hornburg
lotr11012.subtitle: Defender of the Hornburg
lotr11012.game_text: At the start of the fellowship phase, you may add (1) to play a possession on Gamling from your draw deck.
lotr11012.lore: “‘If they come to bargain for our goods at Helm's Gate, they will pay a high price....'”

lotr11013.name: Sword Rack
lotr11013.game_text: Response: If a [ROHAN] possession is discarded from play and no more than one possession is stacked here, stack it here. Fellowship: Add (1) to play a possession stacked here as if from hand.
lotr11013.lore: In Rohan, equal craft is brought to the exhibition of a blade as to the forging.

lotr11014.name: Salt from the Shire
lotr11014.game_text: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Fellowship: Discard this possession to remove a burden. Skirmish: If bearer is an unbound Hobbit, discard this possession to prevent him or her from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.

lotr11015.name: Brawling Uruk
lotr11015.game_text: Damage +1. Response: If a special ability of a companion who has resistance 5 or less is used, exert this minion to cancel its effect.
lotr11015.lore: They are trained to parry the swords of their enemies.

lotr11016.name: Lurtz, Minion of the White Wizard
lotr11016.subtitle: Minion of the White Wizard
lotr11016.game_text: Archer. Damage +1. Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) Lurtz is strength +3 for each exhausted companion you can spot.
lotr11016.lore: Saruman bred this ruthless commander, whose brutality matched his own ambition, to track the Nine Walkers.

lotr11017.name: The Pale Blade, Sword of Flame
lotr11017.subtitle: Sword of Flame
lotr11017.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. If bearer is The Witch-king, each time he wins a skirmish, you may exert him to add a burden.
lotr11017.lore: “‘Die now and curse in vain!' And with that he lifted high his sword and flames ran down the blade.”

lotr11018.name: The Witch-king, Captain of the Nine Riders
lotr11018.subtitle: Captain of the Nine Riders
lotr11018.game_text: Fierce. Toil 2. (For each [WRAITH] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)

lotr11019.name: Farewell to Lorien
lotr11019.game_text: Spot an Elf to heal each companion who has resistance 5 or more.
lotr11019.lore: “‘...the memory of Lothlórien shall remain ever clear and unstained in your heart, and shall neither fade nor grow stale.'”

lotr11020.name: The Lady's Blessing
lotr11020.game_text: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +3 at a river site).
lotr11020.lore: “‘We have come to bid our last farewell,' she said, ‘and to speed you with blessings from our land.'”

lotr11021.name: Legolas, Companion of the Ring
lotr11021.subtitle: Companion of the Ring
lotr11021.game_text: While Legolas is at a battleground or forest site, he is strength +2 and resistance +2.
lotr11021.lore: “‘I am one of the Nine Companions who set out with Mithrandir from Imladris... and with this Dwarf, my friend, I came with the Lord Aragorn.'”

lotr11022.name: Legolas, Woodland Emissary
lotr11022.subtitle: Woodland Emissary
lotr11022.game_text: At the start of the archery phase, you may spot another Elf to exert a minion.
lotr11022.lore: Traveling to the council at Imladris was only the beginning of a much greater journey for the Elven Prince. “‘Few can foresee whither their road will lead them, till they come to its end.'”

lotr11023.name: Legolas' Bow
lotr11023.game_text: Bearer must be an Elf. Bearer is an archer. If bearer is Legolas, each time you exert him to play an [ELVEN] condition or [ELVEN] event, you may heal him (limit once per phase).
lotr11023.lore: Though not as sturdy as the bows of the Galadhrim, a Mirkwood bow is no less dangerous in skilled hands.

lotr11024.name: Might of the Elf-lords
lotr11024.game_text: Exert an Elf to reveal the top card of your draw deck. If that card's twilight cost is 3 or less, make a minion strength -3.
lotr11024.lore: “Dimly Frodo saw the river below him rise, and down along its course there came a plumed cavalry of waves.”

lotr11025.name: Nocked
lotr11025.game_text: Exert an Elf who has resistance 4 or more to wound a minion.
lotr11025.lore: Legolas can fit an arrow to his bowstring faster than most can clear a blade from its scabbard.

lotr11026.name: Uncertain Future
lotr11026.game_text: When you play this condition, spot an Elf to add 3 [ELVEN] tokens here. Maneuver: Discard this condition or remove an [ELVEN] token from here to reveal the top card of your draw deck. You may place that card beneath your draw deck.

lotr11027.name: Woodland Sentinel
lotr11027.game_text: While this companion is at a forest site, he is strength +2.
lotr11027.lore: “‘We drove them off after some time; they were many and fierce, but they cam over the mountains, and were unused to the woods.‘“

lotr11028.name: The Art of Gandalf
lotr11028.game_text: To play, spot a [GANDALF] Wizard. Regroup: Stack a spell from hand here. Fellowship: Discard a [GANDALF] card from hand to take a card stacked here into hand.
lotr11028.lore: “The fireworks were by Gandalf: they were not only brought by him, but designed and made by him....”

lotr11029.name: Ease the Burden
lotr11029.game_text: Exert a [GANDALF] Wizard to remove a burden (or 2 burdens, if the fellowship is at a dwelling site).
lotr11029.lore: “‘Bilbo was meant to find the Ring. In which case, you also were meant to have it. And that is an encouraging thought.'”

lotr11030.name: Erland, Dale Counselor
lotr11030.subtitle: Dale Counselor
lotr11030.game_text: To play, spot a [GANDALF] companion. Skirmish: Exert Erland to take a [GANDALF] skirmish event from your discard pile into hand.
lotr11030.lore: “‘They are valiant men and keep open the High Pass and the Ford of Carrock.'”

lotr11031.name: Final Account
lotr11031.game_text: To play, exert a [GANDALF] Wizard. Discard 2 cards from hand to take a Free Peoples card and a Shadow card from your discard pile into hand.
lotr11031.lore: "Gandalf lifted it carefully, but the leaves crackled and broke as he laid it on the slab."

lotr11032.name: G for Grand
lotr11032.game_text: While you can spot a [GANDALF] Wizard, each companion who has resistance 6 or more is strength +1.
lotr11032.lore: “To them he was just one of the ‘attractions' at the party. Hence the excitement of the hobbit-children.”

lotr11033.name: Gandalf, Leader of the Company
lotr11033.subtitle: Leader of the Company
lotr11033.game_text: While Gandalf is in region 1, each other companion is strength +2. While Gandalf is in region 2, each companion is strength +1. While Gandalf is in region 3, he is strength +2.
lotr11033.lore: “‘I will help you bear this burden, Frodo Baggins....'”

lotr11034.name: Gandalf's Staff, Ash-staff
lotr11034.subtitle: Ash-staff
lotr11034.game_text: Bearer must be a Wizard. If bearer is Gandalf, he gains muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) Each time bearer wins a skirmish, choose a Shadow player who must wound a minion.

lotr11035.name: Glamdring, Foe-hammer
lotr11035.subtitle: Foe-hammer
lotr11035.game_text: Bearer must be Gandalf. Each time Gandalf wins a skirmish, you may remove a burden.
lotr11035.lore: “There was a ringing clash and a stab of white fire.”

lotr11036.name: Inspiration
lotr11036.game_text: Spot a [GANDALF] Wizard to reveal your hand and make a minion strength -3 for each companion in your hand (or -4 for each if the fellowship is at a battleground site).
lotr11036.lore: Through his own strength, Gandalf spurred all the Free Peoples of Middle-earth to stand against the coming darkness.

lotr11037.name: New Authority
lotr11037.game_text: To play, spot a [GANDALF] Wizard. Each time a Shadow card adds a burden, you may remove (3). Response: If a minion uses its special ability, discard this condition to cancel the effect of that special ability.

lotr11038.name: New-awakened
lotr11038.game_text: Spell. Toil 2. (For each [GANDALF] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Spot a [GANDALF] Wizard to discard 2 conditions from play.
lotr11038.lore: “‘Too long have you sat in shadows and trusted to twisted tales and crooked promptings.'”

lotr11039.name: Prolonged Struggle
lotr11039.game_text: Exert a [GANDALF] Wizard and spot 2 companions who each have resistance 7 or more to wound a minion that Wizard is skirmishing twice.
lotr11039.lore: “‘We fought far under the living earth, where time is not counted.'”

lotr11040.name: Shadowfax, Unequaled Steed
lotr11040.subtitle: Unequaled Steed
lotr11040.game_text: Bearer must be Gandalf. Each time Gandalf is about to take a wound, you may add a burden to prevent that.
lotr11040.lore: “‘He has come for me: the horse of the White Rider. We are going to battle together.'”

lotr11041.name: Frenzied Attack
lotr11041.game_text: If a minion is skirmishing a Free Peoples character who has resistance 2 or less, spot Gollum to wound that character twice.
lotr11041.lore: Having been separated from the Precious for the better part of a century, Gollum tasted only the sweetness of its return.

lotr11042.name: Gollum, Skulker
lotr11042.subtitle: Skulker
lotr11042.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Skirmish: Exert Gollum twice to make another minion strength +2.
lotr11042.lore: “‘O yes, Shelob will get him, not Sméagol: he promised; he won't hurt Master at all.'”

lotr11043.name: Horribly Strong
lotr11043.game_text: Discard Gollum from play to wound an unbound companion who has resistance 6 or less.
lotr11043.lore: “Gollum hissed and spat, but he did not let go.”

lotr11044.name: Incited
lotr11044.game_text: Each time a companion loses a skirmish, you may exert Gollum to take a [GOLLUM] card into hand from your discard pile.
lotr11044.lore: “‘He's much more dangerous than he looks.'”

lotr11045.name: Led Astray
lotr11045.game_text: Spot Gollum to add (3) and exchange one of your sites on the adventure path with another site from your adventure deck.

lotr11046.name: Master Commands It
lotr11046.game_text: Make Smeagol strength +1 for each companion who has resistance 5 or more.
lotr11046.lore: “‘It's not sense to try and get into Mordor at all. But if master says I must go or I will go, then he must try some way.'”

lotr11047.name: No End of Wickedness
lotr11047.game_text: Exert Gollum to make another minion strength +2 (or +3 if Gollum is at a mountain site).
lotr11047.lore: “...a fear was growing on him, a menace which he could not see....”

lotr11048.name: Not Yet Vanquished
lotr11048.game_text: Each time a companion loses a fierce skirmish, you may exert Gollum to add a burden.
lotr11048.lore: “A sudden weight smote him and he crashed forward, tearing the backs of his hands that still clasped his master's.”

lotr11049.name: One Good Turn Deserves Another
lotr11049.game_text: Spot Smeagol to play the fellowship's next site. Then you may add a burden to take this card back into hand.
lotr11049.lore: “‘Nice hobbits! We will come with them. Find them safe paths in the dark, yes we will.'”

lotr11050.name: Safe Passage
lotr11050.game_text: When you play this condition, name forest, mountain, plains, or river. Each time the fellowship moves to a site that has the named keyword, you may exert Gollum or Smeagol to remove (4).
lotr11050.lore: “‘Here! We can get down here. Sméagol went this way once: I went this way, hiding from Orcs.'”

lotr11051.name: Smeagol, Scout and Guide
lotr11051.subtitle: Scout and Guide
lotr11051.game_text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Each time Smeagol wins a skirmish, you may play the fellowship's next site. Skirmish: If Smeagol is at a marsh, exert him to cancel a skirmish involving him.
lotr11051.lore: “They would have foundered in the Dead Marshes but for Gollum.”

lotr11052.name: Strange and Terrible
lotr11052.game_text: Spot a [GOLLUM] minion at a mountain site to play a minion from your discard pile.
lotr11052.lore: “Gollum on the edge of the abyss was fighting like a mad thing with an unseen foe.”

lotr11053.name: Aragorn, Guide and Protector
lotr11053.subtitle: Guide and Protector
lotr11053.game_text: Ranger. Each time a Free Peoples skirmish event is played, you may exert Aragorn to wound a minion he is skirmishing.
lotr11053.lore: “‘...I know all the lands between the Shire and the Misty Mountains, for I have wandered over them for many years.'”

lotr11054.name: Aragorn, Strider
lotr11054.subtitle: Strider
lotr11054.game_text: Ranger. Each time the fellowship moves, add (1).
lotr11054.lore: “...in spite of the heat of the room he wore a hood that overshadowed his face; but the gleam of his eyes could be seen as he watched the hobbits.”

lotr11055.name: Armor of the Citadel
lotr11055.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. Each minion skirmishing bearer loses all damage bonuses. While bearer is at a battleground site and unwounded, he or she is defender +1.
lotr11055.lore: “Upon the black surcoats were embroidered in white a tree blossoming like snow....”

lotr11056.name: Battle Cry
lotr11056.game_text: Make a ranger strength +2 (or +3 if he or she is skirmishing a minion who has a damage bonus).
lotr11056.lore: “...men were yelling and screaming, and one clear loud voice was calling ‘Gondor! Gondor!'”

lotr11057.name: Boromir, Hero of Osgiliath
lotr11057.subtitle: Hero of Osgiliath
lotr11057.game_text: Knight. Each time Boromir wins a skirmish, you may heal a [GONDOR] companion.
lotr11057.lore: “‘Let the armies of Mordor know this: never again will the land of my people fall into enemy hands!'”

lotr11058.name: Bow of Minas Tirith
lotr11058.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. At the start of the archery phase, if bearer is at a battleground site, you may exert him or her to make the fellowship archery total +1.
lotr11058.lore: From the ramparts of the Gondorian fortress, death rained down upon the servants of Sauron.

lotr11059.name: Gondorian Blade
lotr11059.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. While bearer is a ranger or at a river site, he or she is damage +1.
lotr11059.lore: While many knights of Gondor favor hand-and-a-half swords, lighter weapons are often preferred by the rangers who patrol Ithilien.

lotr11060.name: The Highest Quality
lotr11060.game_text: Exert any number of [GONDOR] companions who have total resistance 12 or more to make a minion skirmishing a [GONDOR] companion strength -3 for each companion exerted this way.
lotr11060.lore: “‘Captain Faramir, you have shown your quality, sir. The very highest.'”

lotr11061.name: Houses of Healing
lotr11061.game_text: When you play this condition, spot a [GONDOR] Man to add 3 [GONDOR] tokens here. Fellowship: Add (2) and either discard this condition or remove a [GONDOR] token from here to heal a [GONDOR] Man.
lotr11061.lore: “...the king was indeed come among them, and after war he brought healing....”

lotr11062.name: Madril, Ranger of Ithilien
lotr11062.subtitle: Ranger of Ithilien
lotr11062.game_text: Ranger. Fellowship: If Madril is at a forest site, exert him to play the fellowship's next site.
lotr11062.lore: “‘...we must look to our own borders. Faramir, Orcs are on the move.'”

lotr11063.name: Much-needed Rest
lotr11063.game_text: Heal each [GONDOR] companion who has resistance 5 or more.
lotr11063.lore: “‘A guest-house shall be made ready: there you shall sleep, when you have eaten.'”

lotr11064.name: Pledge of Loyalty
lotr11064.game_text: Make a [GONDOR] companion strength +2 (or +3 if he or she has resistance 4 or more).
lotr11064.lore: “‘I ask leave once again to be your companion, Frodo.'”

lotr11065.name: Ranger of Westernesse
lotr11065.game_text: Ranger. When you play this companion, you may play the fellowship's next site.
lotr11065.lore: “The road may pass, but they shall not!”

lotr11066.name: Well-traveled
lotr11066.game_text: To play, exert a ranger. If the fellowship is in region 1, play the fellowship's next 2 sites. Otherwise, play the fellowship's next site.
lotr11066.lore: With a great many years' experience in the wilds of Middle-earth, Aragorn's skills as guide and tracker were unmatched.

lotr11067.name: Archer of Harad
lotr11067.game_text: Archer. While you can spot a companion who has resistance 4 or less, the minion archery total is +1.
lotr11067.lore: Haradrim bowmen pick off stragglers who rout after losing a battle.

lotr11068.name: Armored Easterling
lotr11068.game_text: Skirmish: Remove (2) to make a lurker strength +1. Skirmish: Remove (2) to make a lurker fierce until the regroup phase. Skirmish: Remove (2) to make a lurker damage +1.
lotr11068.lore: The Men of the East were well-equipped.

lotr11069.name: Axeman of Harad
lotr11069.game_text: While you can spot a companion who has resistance 3 or less, this minion's twilight cost is -2.
lotr11069.lore: Tribes of Harad gather when their enemies appear weak.

lotr11070.name: Bloodthirsty
lotr11070.game_text: Spot 2 [MEN] minions to wound an unbound companion.
lotr11070.lore: The ferocity of the Dunlendings is not easily slaked.

lotr11071.name: Bold and Cunning
lotr11071.game_text: Toil 2. (For each [MEN] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Spot a [MEN] minion to discard a possession from play.
lotr11071.lore: “‘Even now he plays a game with peril and wins a throw.'”

lotr11072.name: Column of Easterlings
lotr11072.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Skirmish: Discard this minion to make a [MEN] minion strength +4.
lotr11072.lore: The military training of the Easterlings is evident in their marching formations.

lotr11073.name: Corps of Harad
lotr11073.game_text: While this minion is at a battleground site, it is fierce.
lotr11073.lore: When an enemy offers resistance, the Haradrim bloodlust rises to the occasion.

lotr11074.name: Detachment of Haradrim
lotr11074.game_text: Maneuver: Exert this minion to add (1) for each companion who has resistance 5 or less.
lotr11074.lore: No mere soldiers, all the Men of Harad are skilled assassins and raiders.

lotr11075.name: Easterling Host
lotr11075.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Skirmish: Exert Easterling Host and make it strength -2 until the regroup phase to make each other [MEN] minion strength +1 until the regroup phase.
lotr11075.lore: Men of the East mass soldiers into huge groups.

lotr11076.name: Easterling Shield Wall
lotr11076.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Response: If a [MEN] minion is about to take a wound in a skirmish, exert this minion and remove (1) to prevent that.
lotr11076.lore: Tight columns allow Easterlings to protect each other.

lotr11077.name: Elder of Dunland
lotr11077.game_text: While this minion is at a plains site, it is damage +1.
lotr11077.lore: Experienced warriors gather the disparate tribes for massive raids.

lotr11078.name: Elevated Fire
lotr11078.game_text: Toil 2. (For each [MEN] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Spot a [MEN] minion to make the minion archery total +3.
lotr11078.lore: The war towers of the mûmakil provide a great advantage for archers.

lotr11079.name: Fearsome Dunlending
lotr11079.game_text: Ambush (1). When you play this minion at a plains site, you may spot an unbound companion to make that companion resistance -1 until the end of the turn.
lotr11079.lore: Accustomed as they are to traveling afoot, Dunlending mobs can strike quickly, without warning.

lotr11080.name: Ferocious Haradrim
lotr11080.game_text: Archer. Each time a Free Peoples character is killed, each of your [MEN] minions is strength +3 until the regroup phase.
lotr11080.lore: The killing frenzy of the Southrons is in stark contrast to the cool efficiency of Easterling columns.

lotr11081.name: Fletcher of Harad
lotr11081.game_text: While this minion is at a plains site, it is an archer. While you can spot 6 companions, each [MEN] minion is an archer.
lotr11081.lore: Makers of bows and arrows have a strong trade for the raiders of Harad.

lotr11082.name: Footman of Dunland
lotr11082.game_text: The fellowship's current site gains plains.
lotr11082.lore: Their savage war bands move swiftly across flat terrain.

lotr11083.name: Force of Harad
lotr11083.game_text: When you cannot spot another [MEN] minion, discard this minion.
lotr11083.lore: Alliances between Haradrim tribes are fragile things which sometimes break down in battle.

lotr11084.name: Harad Standard-bearer
lotr11084.game_text: Skirmish: Remove (3) to make this minion damage +1.
lotr11084.lore: The strange craftsmen of Haradwaith fashion their war banners from woven wood.

lotr11085.name: Horde of Harad
lotr11085.game_text: While this minion is at a battleground site, it is fierce.
lotr11085.lore: Raiders and brigands they may be, but in force the Southron fighters are terrifying.

lotr11086.name: Invading Haradrim
lotr11086.game_text: Each time the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to a skirmish, add (1) for each Free Peoples character who has resistance 5 or less.
lotr11086.lore: The cruel Men of Harad slaughter the weak and infirm during their raids on Gondor.

lotr11087.name: Lathspell
lotr11087.game_text: To play, spot a [MEN] minion. Bearer must be a companion. While bearer is skirmishing a [MEN] minion, bearer loses from possessions all strength and damage bonuses.
lotr11087.lore: “‘...ill news is an ill guest they say.'”

lotr11088.name: Legion of Harad
lotr11088.game_text: Toil 2. (For each [MEN] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
lotr11088.lore: The bellicose families of Harad cannot often agree, but when they do, they form a formidable army.

lotr11089.name: Long Battle Bow
lotr11089.game_text: Bearer must be a [MEN] minion. Bearer is an archer. When you play this possession, you may make the Free Peoples player exert his or her Man.
lotr11089.lore: Southron accuracy with bows is legendary.

lotr11090.name: Man of Bree
lotr11090.game_text: This minion is strength +1 for each card in the Free Peoples player's hand.
lotr11090.lore: “One or two gave Frodo a blank look and departed muttering among themselves.”

lotr11091.name: Oath Sworn
lotr11091.game_text: At the start of the maneuver phase, if you have 2 or more cards in hand, you may spot 2 [MEN] minions and discard your hand to add (8).

lotr11092.name: Overrun
lotr11092.game_text: Make a [MEN] minion strength +2 (or +4 if that minion is at a battleground or plains site).
lotr11092.lore: An Easterling column strikes with terrific force.

lotr11093.name: Patroller of Haradrim
lotr11093.game_text: Each time this minion is assigned to a character who has resistance 5 or less, you may discard a possession borne by that character.
lotr11093.lore: Disarming strikes are common among the tactics of the Men of Harad.

lotr11094.name: Pavise
lotr11094.game_text: Bearer must be a [MEN] minion. The twilight cost of this possession is -1 for each Free Peoples possession you spot. Bearer cannot take wounds except during a skirmish.
lotr11094.lore: An Easterling shield covers almost the entire body.

lotr11095.name: Poleaxe
lotr11095.game_text: Bearer must be a [MEN] minion. Skirmish: Remove (2) to make a [MEN] minion fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr11095.lore: Many of the Men of the East march into battle carrying heavy bladed polearms.

lotr11096.name: Precision Targeting
lotr11096.game_text: Spot a [MEN] minion to make the minion archery total +1 and make the Free Peoples player choose 3 companions. Other companions cannot take archery wounds.
lotr11096.lore: Arrows fired in volleys will never be as effective as one loosed by a skilled archer.

lotr11097.name: Raging Dunlending
lotr11097.game_text: When you play this minion, you may exert it to make it fierce until the regroup phase. While you can spot 6 companions, each [MEN] minion is fierce.
lotr11097.lore: Furious hatred over the land they've lost drives the mobs of Dunland.

lotr11098.name: Rampaging Easterling
lotr11098.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Each time another [MEN] minion wins a skirmish, make this minion strength +3 until the regroup phase.
lotr11098.lore: The fury of the Eastern warriors grows in battle.

lotr11099.name: Squad of Haradrim
lotr11099.game_text: Regroup: Spot another [MEN] minion and 2 Free Peoples characters who each have resistance 5 or less to make the move limit -1 for this turn.
lotr11099.lore: Small, harassing bands of Haradrim skirmishers make moving troops difficult.

lotr11100.name: Strange-looking Men
lotr11100.game_text: Maneuver: Exert this minion to transfer a possession or condition borne by a character to another eligible bearer.
lotr11100.lore: “The strangers, especially those that had come up the Greenway, stared at them curiously.”

lotr11101.name: Swarthy Bree-lander
lotr11101.game_text: At the start of the maneuver phase, you may remove (2) to transfer a condition borne by a character to another eligible bearer.
lotr11101.lore: “But there was one... who stood looking at them with a knowing and half-mocking expression that made them feel very uncomfortable.”

lotr11102.name: Throng of Harad
lotr11102.game_text: Each time this minion is assigned to skirmish a character who has resistance 5 or less, it is fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr11102.lore: Only the strongest fighters can withstand a Southron attack.

lotr11103.name: Warrior of Dunland
lotr11103.game_text: Ambush (1). While this minion is at a plains site, it gains an additional ambush (1).
lotr11103.lore: The open plain affords no shelter, no defense against the Dunlendings.

lotr11104.name: Whistling Death
lotr11104.game_text: Wound a character skirmishing a [MEN] minion. If the fellowship is at a battleground site, you may remove (3) to wound that character again.
lotr11104.lore: As deadly as the Southron arrows, their polearms cut a whirling swath through their enemies.

lotr11105.name: Wielding the Ring
lotr11105.game_text: To play, spot a [MEN] minion. Bearer must be a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr11105.lore: “‘Why should we not think that the Great Ring has come into our hands to serve us in the very hour of need?'”

lotr11106.name: Armed for Battle
lotr11106.game_text: Spot your [ORC] minion to play an [ORC] possession from your discard pile (or, if that minion is at a battleground site, from your draw deck or discard pile).
lotr11106.lore: Fashioned by the hands of Orcs, or plundered from the hands of defeated enemies, the weaponry of Mordor is bounteous.

lotr11107.name: Barbarous Orc
lotr11107.game_text: Skirmish: Exert another [ORC] minion to make this minion strength +2 (or +4 if this minion is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less).
lotr11107.lore: Fiercely tribal, rival Orc bands unite only against a more hated enemy.

lotr11108.name: Beastly Olog-hai
lotr11108.game_text: Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot an [ORC] minion. Assignment: Exert this minion to assign it to a companion bearing an artifact. The Free Peoples player may discard an artifact from play to prevent this.
lotr11108.lore: “Some held that they were not Trolls, but giant Orcs...”

lotr11109.name: Bladed Gauntlets
lotr11109.game_text: Bearer must be an [ORC] minion. Bearer is a lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Skirmish: Exert bearer to make an [ORC] minion strength +2.
lotr11109.lore: One cannot easily discern Orc armor from weapon.

lotr11110.name: Bound to its Fate
lotr11110.game_text: Spot an [ORC] minion to reveal the Free Peoples player's hand. The Free Peoples player chooses to either discard a revealed Free Peoples event or add a burden.
lotr11110.lore: “‘Now it comes to it, I don't like parting with it at all, I may say.'”

lotr11111.name: Champion Orc
lotr11111.game_text: Toil 2. (For each [ORC] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)
lotr11111.lore: A few Orcs are veterans of single combats to settle disputes in the mountain tribes.

lotr11112.name: Conquered Halls
lotr11112.game_text: Make an [ORC] minion strength +1 for each underground site you can spot.
lotr11112.lore: “They brandished spears and scimitars which shone red as blood in the firelight.”

lotr11113.name: Cutthroat Orc
lotr11113.game_text: This minion is strength +1 for each companion who has resistance 5 or less.
lotr11113.lore: The smell of human flesh is often enough to frenzy an Orc warrior.

lotr11114.name: Demoralized
lotr11114.game_text: To play, spot an [ORC] minion. Each time a companion exerts, you may add (1) (or (2) if you can spot 6 companions).
lotr11114.lore: “But soon there were few left in Minas Tirith who had the heart to stand up and defy the hosts of Mordor.”

lotr11115.name: Denizen of Khazad-dum
lotr11115.game_text: While this minion is at an underground site, it is strength +2.
lotr11115.lore: The spiny helms forged by the Orcs of Moria can inflict as much damage as their scimitars.

lotr11116.name: Denizen of Moria
lotr11116.game_text: While this minion is at an underground site, it is strength +3.
lotr11116.lore: The vast tunnels of Khazad-dûm are the veins through which a foul Orc ichor can flow unchecked.

lotr11117.name: Denizen of the Black Pit
lotr11117.game_text: While this minion is at an underground site, it is strength +2.
lotr11117.lore: The great Dwarf mansion of Khazad-dûm is now more commonly known by other, darker names.

lotr11118.name: Dread and Despair
lotr11118.game_text: Spot 2 [ORC] minions to discard a condition from play. The Free Peoples player may discard the top 6 cards of his or her draw deck to prevent this.
lotr11118.lore: “...yet another weapon, swifter than hunger, the Lord of the Dark Tower had....”

lotr11119.name: Emboldened Orc
lotr11119.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) This minion is strength +1 for each companion who is not assigned to a skirmish.
lotr11119.lore: Orcs are seldom intimidated, and often goaded, by superior forces.

lotr11120.name: Entrapping Orc
lotr11120.game_text: Assignment: Assign this minion to an unbound companion who has resistance 4 or less.
lotr11120.lore: Orcs relish the kill more than the fight itself, and will often rush to engage a weakened foe.

lotr11121.name: Foraging Orc
lotr11121.game_text: When you play this minion, you may spot another [ORC] minion and a companion who has resistance 3 or less to add (2).
lotr11121.lore: Though most Orcs are small in stature, seldom can one be found without another nearby.

lotr11122.name: Frenzied Orc
lotr11122.game_text: While this minion is at an underground site, each character skirmishing it is strength -2. While you can spot 6 companions, each character skirmishing an [ORC] minion is strength -2.
lotr11122.lore: More enemies seem only to further fuel their rage.

lotr11123.name: Goblin Hordes
lotr11123.game_text: To play, spot an [ORC] minion. Each time the fellowship moves from an underground site, you may take an [ORC] minion from your discard pile into hand.
lotr11123.lore: “...he saw swarming black figures: there seemed to be hundreds of orcs.”

lotr11124.name: Hill Orc
lotr11124.game_text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert each companion who has resistance 4 or less.
lotr11124.lore: The foul Orcs who slaughtered the last of Balin's followers still thrive in the halls of Khazad-dûm and the surrounding countryside.

lotr11125.name: Isengard Underling
lotr11125.game_text: When you play this minion, you may take an [ORC] event from your discard pile into hand.
lotr11125.lore: Saruman's workers would exploit any resource to prepare for the coming battle.

lotr11126.name: Marauding Orcs
lotr11126.game_text: When you cannot spot another [ORC] minion, discard this minion from play.
lotr11126.lore: Orcs that would only seek out violence at random on their own were brought together to serve Sauron's purpose.

lotr11127.name: Mocking Goblin
lotr11127.game_text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, add a burden unless the Free Peoples player discards a Free Peoples event from hand.
lotr11127.lore: “There was a rush of hoarse laughter, like the fall of sliding stones into a pit....”

lotr11128.name: Mordor Scimitar
lotr11128.game_text: Bearer must be an [ORC] minion. Each time bearer is assigned to skirmish a companion, you may exert that companion.
lotr11128.lore: Though Orcs will employ a wide variety of weaponry, they tend to favor long, curved blades.

lotr11129.name: Mountain Orc
lotr11129.game_text: Each time this minion is assigned to skirmish a companion who has resistance 5 or less, exert that companion.
lotr11129.lore: Larger Orcs are strong enough to run for many miles, and can tire out their prey before attacking.

lotr11130.name: Orc Hammer
lotr11130.game_text: Bearer must be an [ORC] Orc. When you play this possession, you may exert a companion.
lotr11130.lore: The strongest members of an Orc tribe often wield hammers rather than blades.

lotr11131.name: Orc Miscreant
lotr11131.game_text: To play, spot an [ORC] minion. Regroup: Exert this minion to add a burden.
lotr11131.lore: “‘Some of the trees they just cut down and leave to rot – orc-mischief that....'”

lotr11132.name: Orkish Smith
lotr11132.game_text: When you play this minion, you may take an [ORC] condition from your discard pile into hand.
lotr11132.lore: “‘There is always a smoke rising from Isengard these days.'”

lotr11133.name: Orkish Worker
lotr11133.game_text: When you play this minion, you may spot another [ORC] minion to reveal the top card of the Free Peoples player's deck. If it is a Shadow card, add (X), where X is its twilight cost.
lotr11133.lore: Saruman's Orcs labor day and night to provide him with the resources he needs to wage war.

lotr11134.name: Persistent Orc
lotr11134.game_text: Each time this minion is about to be killed or discarded from play, you may spot another [ORC] card to place this minion on top of your draw deck instead.
lotr11134.lore: An enemy can do little worse to an Orc than what it would willingly have done to itself.

lotr11135.name: Porter Troll
lotr11135.game_text: Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot an [ORC] minion. When you play this minion, add a burden unless the Free Peoples player reveals a Free Peoples event from his or her hand.
lotr11135.lore: The mammoth battering ram Grond required equally mammoth strength to wield it.

lotr11136.name: Prowling Orc
lotr11136.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Skirmish: Remove (2) to make an [ORC] minion strength +1.
lotr11136.lore: Orcs use numbers to fell a powerful foe, though it would be generous to think of it as working together.

lotr11137.name: Scurrying Goblin
lotr11137.game_text: When you play this minion at an underground site, you may spot another [ORC] minion to add (2).
lotr11137.lore: “But it was not an echo, for when they halted it pattered on for a little all by itself, and then grew still.”

lotr11138.name: Skulking Goblin
lotr11138.game_text: The fellowship's current site gains underground.
lotr11138.lore: “‘It is a mark of evil things that came in the Great Darkness that they cannot abide the Sun....'”

lotr11139.name: Spurred to Battle
lotr11139.game_text: To play, exert an [ORC] minion. At the start of the Shadow phase, add (1).
lotr11139.lore: Even victory does not long slake the Orkish thirst for blood. It merely drives them onward to a new confrontation.

lotr11140.name: Strength in Shadows
lotr11140.game_text: Make an [ORC] minion strength +2 (or +4 if it is a lurker).
lotr11140.lore: Weakened by the Sun, Orcs thrive in darkness and shadow.

lotr11141.name: Undisciplined
lotr11141.game_text: Toil 3. (For each [ORC] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -3.) Assign an [ORC] minion to a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr11141.lore: Easily caught by the heat of battle, Orc soldiers often break formation and attack where their bloodlust takes them.

lotr11142.name: Unyielding Goblin
lotr11142.game_text: Skirmish: If this minion is at an underground site, exert it to exert a companion it is skirmishing.
lotr11142.lore: In the rush of battle, some Orcs can carry on heedless of their own wounds until their enemy is vanquished.

lotr11143.name: Watchful Orc
lotr11143.game_text: When you play this minion, you may spot another [ORC] minion to replace the fellowship's current site with an underground site from your adventure deck.
lotr11143.lore: Some Orcs have learned basic tracking skills.

lotr11144.name: Border Patrol
lotr11144.game_text: When you play this condition, spot a mounted [ROHAN] Man to add 3 [ROHAN] tokens here. Response: If a minion is played at a plains site, discard this condition or remove a [ROHAN] token from here to exert that minion.
lotr11144.lore: “‘Who are you, and what are you doing in this land?'”

lotr11145.name: Eomer, Guardian of the Eastmark
lotr11145.subtitle: Guardian of the Eastmark
lotr11145.game_text: While you can spot a [ROHAN] Man, Eomer's twilight cost is -1. Each time the fellowship moves, you may exert Eomer to return a minion to its owner's hand.
lotr11145.lore: “‘...wanderers in the Riddermark would be wise to be less haughty in these days of doubt.'”

lotr11146.name: Eowyn, Shieldmaiden of Rohan
lotr11146.subtitle: Shieldmaiden of Rohan
lotr11146.game_text: Each time Eowyn wins a skirmish, each other [ROHAN] Man is strength +1 until the regroup phase.
lotr11146.lore: “‘The women of this country learned long ago: those without swords can still die upon them.'”

lotr11147.name: Gamling, Defender of the Hornburg
lotr11147.subtitle: Defender of the Hornburg
lotr11147.game_text: At the start of the fellowship phase, you may add (1) to play a possession on Gamling from your draw deck.
lotr11147.lore: “‘If they come to bargain for our goods at Helm's Gate, they will pay a high price....'”

lotr11148.name: Hrothlac, Man of Rohan
lotr11148.subtitle: Man of Rohan
lotr11148.game_text: Response: If a [ROHAN] companion who has resistance 4 or more is about to take a wound, exert Hrothlac to prevent that.
lotr11148.lore: “‘...we desire only to be free, and to live as we have lived, keeping our own, and serving no foreign lord, good or evil.'”

lotr11149.name: Protecting the Hall
lotr11149.game_text: Toil 2. (For each [ROHAN] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. Assignment: Discard this condition from play to make bearer defender +1.
lotr11149.lore: “‘ are welcome here in days of war but our own folk....'”

lotr11150.name: Rally Cry
lotr11150.game_text: Make a [ROHAN] Man who has resistance 4 or more strength +2 for each wound on each minion he or she is skirmishing.
lotr11150.lore: “‘...a sword-day, a red day, ere the sun rises!”

lotr11151.name: Riddermark Javelin
lotr11151.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. Archery: Discard this possession to make the fellowship archery total +1 (or +2 if the fellowship is at a plains site).
lotr11151.lore: Short-hafted throwing spears are wielded by the Riders of Rohan in addition to their long lances.

lotr11152.name: Riddermark Soldier
lotr11152.game_text: When you play this companion, each [ROHAN] companion is strength +2 until the regroup phase.

lotr11153.name: Rider's Spear
lotr11153.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. If bearer is mounted, bearer is damage +1.
lotr11153.lore: “Shafts of the sun flared above the eastern hills and glimmered on their spears.”

lotr11154.name: Riders of the Mark
lotr11154.game_text: To play, spot 2 [ROHAN] companions. You may play Riders of the Mark any time you could play a skirmish event. When you play Riders of the Mark, you may exhaust a minion.
lotr11154.lore: “With astonishing speed and skill they checked their steeds, wheeled, and came charging round.”

lotr11155.name: Riding Like the Wind
lotr11155.game_text: To play, exert a [ROHAN] Man. While you can spot 2 [ROHAN] mounts, the move limit is +1. Each of your companions that is not mounted is strength -1.
lotr11155.lore: “The horsemen, following the trail, had turned from the river and were drawing near the downs.”

lotr11156.name: Rohirrim Mount
lotr11156.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert. While bearer is at a plains site, he or she is defender +1.
lotr11156.lore: The Eorlingas raise horses both peerless and cherished.

lotr11157.name: Rush of Steeds
lotr11157.game_text: To play, spot a [ROHAN] Man. Each time a Shadow condition is played, you may exert a minion. Response: If a minion exerts as a cost of its special ability, discard this condition to prevent that and return that minion to its owner's hand.
lotr11157.lore: “‘Ride now, ride now! Ride to Gondor!'”

lotr11158.name: Sword Rack
lotr11158.game_text: Response: If a [ROHAN] possession is discarded from play and no more than one possession is stacked here, stack it here. Fellowship: Add (1) to play a possession stacked here as if from hand.
lotr11158.lore: In Rohan, equal craft is brought to the exhibition of a blade as to the forging.

lotr11159.name: Theoden, King of the Eorlingas
lotr11159.subtitle: King of the Eorlingas
lotr11159.game_text: While you can spot a [GANDALF] companion, Theoden gains muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) While Theoden is at a battleground or plains site each [ROHAN] Man is strength +1.

lotr11160.name: War Now Calls Us
lotr11160.game_text: Exert a [ROHAN] companion to make him or her strength +3 (and damage +1 if he or she has resistance 5 or more).
lotr11160.lore: “‘Mourn not overmuch! Mighty was the fallen, / meet was his ending. When his mound is raised, / women then shall weep.'”

lotr11161.name: Concerning Hobbits
lotr11161.game_text: For each dwelling and forest site on the adventure path, make a Hobbit strength +1.
lotr11161.lore: “...they love peace and quiet and good tilled earth; a well-ordered and well-farmed countryside was their favorite haunt.”

lotr11162.name: Crouched Down
lotr11162.game_text: Stealth. Cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit and a minion whose strength is lower than that Hobbit's resistance.
lotr11162.lore: “Frodo felt a sudden chill running through him and clutching at his heart....”

lotr11163.name: Farmer Maggot, Hobbit of the Marish
lotr11163.subtitle: Hobbit of the Marish
lotr11163.game_text: While Farmer Maggot is at a dwelling or forest site, he is strength +4.
lotr11163.lore: “‘I didn't like the looks of him; and when Grip came out, he took one sniff and let out a yelp as if he had been stung....'”

lotr11164.name: Frodo, Protected by Many
lotr11164.subtitle: Protected by Many
lotr11164.game_text: Ring-bearer. Ring-bound. At the start of the regroup phase, you may exert Frodo to make him gain muster until the end of the regroup phase. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
lotr11164.lore: “‘I will take the Ring... though I do not know the way.'”

lotr11165.name: Habits of Home
lotr11165.game_text: Toil 2. (For each [SHIRE] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Bearer must be a Hobbit. Limit 1 per bearer. Each time the fellowship moves from a dwelling or forest site, remove (1).

lotr11167.name: Incognito
lotr11167.game_text: Stealth. If the fellowship is at a dwelling site, exert 2 Hobbits to cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit. At any other site, exert 2 Hobbits to make a Hobbit strength +3.
lotr11167.lore: “‘I am Mr. Underhill, if any name must be given.'”

lotr11168.name: Merry, Loyal Companion
lotr11168.subtitle: Loyal Companion
lotr11168.game_text: For each other unbound companion assigned to a skirmish, Merry is strength +2.
lotr11168.lore: “‘We can't leave Frodo! Pippin and I always intended to go wherever he went, and we still do.'”

lotr11169.name: The More, The Merrier
lotr11169.game_text: Toil 2. (For each [SHIRE] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Spot 2 [SHIRE] companions to remove 2 burdens.

lotr11170.name: Pippin, Brave Decoy
lotr11170.subtitle: Brave Decoy
lotr11170.game_text: Skirmish: If Pippin is not assigned to a skirmish, spot an unbound companion who has less resistance than Pippin to have Pippin replace him or her in a skirmish.
lotr11170.lore: “Merry and he had drawn their swords, but the Orcs did not wish to fight....”

lotr11171.name: Salt from the Shire
lotr11171.game_text: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Fellowship: Discard this possession to remove a burden. Skirmish: If bearer is an unbound Hobbit, discard this possession to prevent him or her from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.

lotr11172.name: Sam, Steadfast Friend
lotr11172.subtitle: Steadfast Friend
lotr11172.game_text: Ring-bound. Each other companion is resistance +1.
lotr11172.lore: “‘I'm coming too, or neither of us is going. I'll knock holes in all the boats first.'”

lotr11173.name: Sting, Weapon of Heritage
lotr11173.subtitle: Weapon of Heritage
lotr11173.game_text: Bearer must be Bilbo, Frodo, or Sam. Maneuver: If bearer is Bilbo or Frodo, exert him to make another companion resistance +2 until the regroup phase. If bearer is Sam, each time he wins a skirmish, you may remove a burden.
lotr11173.lore: This blade has dealt many wounds, by many hands.

lotr11174.name: Sworn Companion
lotr11174.game_text: Make a Hobbit strength +1 for each companion who has resistance 7 or more.
lotr11174.lore: “‘It's just something Gandalf said. ... “Don't you lose him, Samwise Gamgee.” And I don't mean to.'”

lotr11175.name: A Task Now to Be Done
lotr11175.game_text: Spot X Hobbits to make an unbound Hobbit resistance +X.
lotr11175.lore: “Another opportunity for one of the shire-folk to prove their great worth. You must not fail me.”

lotr11176.name: Unharmed
lotr11176.game_text: Heal a Hobbit for each minion you spot.
lotr11176.lore: “‘So far so good; but how are we to avoid being spitted?'”

lotr11177.name: Army of Uruk-hai
lotr11177.game_text: Damage +1. Each Free Peoples archer who has resistance 5 or less does not add to the Free Peoples archery total.
lotr11177.lore: Volleys of arrows are no defense against the onslaught of Saruman's servants.

lotr11178.name: Bloodthirsty Uruk
lotr11178.game_text: Damage +1. While you can spot an exhausted companion, this minion is strength +3.
lotr11178.lore: Bred for endurance, the Uruk-hai pursue their foes tirelessly.

lotr11179.name: Brawling Uruk
lotr11179.game_text: Damage +1. Response: If a special ability of a companion who has resistance 5 or less is used, exert this minion to cancel its effect.
lotr11179.lore: They are trained to parry the swords of their enemies.

lotr11180.name: Brutality
lotr11180.game_text: Make an [URUK-HAI] minion strength +1 for each battleground site you can spot.
lotr11180.lore: Uruks are drawn to the sounds of battle.

lotr11181.name: Determined Uruk
lotr11181.game_text: To play, spot a [URUK-HAI] minion. Each time a companion exerts, you may draw a card.
lotr11181.lore: As their prey grows tired, the Uruks gain the advantage.

lotr11182.name: Devastation
lotr11182.game_text: If your [URUK-HAI] minion wins a skirmish, discard a condition from play.
lotr11182.lore: The villages hold nothing of value to the Uruk-hai; they are simply things to be destroyed.

lotr11183.name: Feral Uruk
lotr11183.game_text: While this minion is at a battleground site, it is strength +1 and damage +1.
lotr11183.lore: Only in combat is an Uruk-hai truly fulfilling its purpose.

lotr11184.name: Force of Uruk-hai
lotr11184.game_text: Damage +1. Each time this minion is about to take a wound at a battleground site, you may spot another [URUK-HAI] card to make the Free Peoples player draw a card instead.
lotr11184.lore: Despite their bloodthirsty nature, Saruman's creations form armies and fight united for him.

lotr11185.name: Fortitude
lotr11185.game_text: When you play this condition, spot an [URUK-HAI] minion to add 3 [URUK-HAI] tokens here. Response: If an [URUK-HAI] minion is about to take a wound, discard this condition or remove an [URUK-HAI] token from here to prevent that.
lotr11185.lore: Resiliency is bred into the fighting Uruk-hai.

lotr11186.name: Furious Uruk
lotr11186.game_text: Damage +1. While this minion is assigned to a skirmish, each companion and Free Peoples possession loses its special abilities.
lotr11186.lore: The Uruk-hai attack with such ferocity that their victims find no way to strike back.

lotr11187.name: Furor
lotr11187.game_text: Make an [URUK-HAI] minion strength +2 (or +3 if you can spot an exhausted companion).
lotr11187.lore: Uruk soldiers have learned to save their rage for the field of battle.

lotr11188.name: Hounding Uruk
lotr11188.game_text: Damage +1. While you can spot an exhausted companion, this minion is strength +3.
lotr11188.lore: An enemy on the move is an enemy unprepared.

lotr11189.name: Intimidating Uruk
lotr11189.game_text: Damage +1. When you play this minion at a battleground site, spot an unbound companion to make that companion resistance -2 until the end of the turn.
lotr11189.lore: In battle, the Uruk-hai inspire terror in even the bravest of their enemies.

lotr11190.name: Invincible Uruk
lotr11190.game_text: Damage +1. While this minion is at a battleground site, it cannot take wounds. While you can spot 6 companions, each [URUK-HAI] minion cannot take wounds.
lotr11190.lore: Like a force of nature, the Uruks are unstoppable.

lotr11191.name: Isengard Siege Bow
lotr11191.game_text: Bearer must be an [URUK-HAI] minion. While bearer is at a battleground site, it is an archer.
lotr11191.lore: Saruman's machine works also makes formidable heavy bows for the Uruk-hai.

lotr11192.name: Isengard Sword
lotr11192.game_text: Bearer must be an [URUK-HAI] minion. Each character skirmishing bearer is strength -2.
lotr11192.lore: The heavy-backed Uruk blades hack through armor and flesh alike.

lotr11193.name: Lookout Uruk
lotr11193.game_text: Damage +1. The fellowship's current site gains battleground.
lotr11193.lore: Choice of terrain is important when engaging the enemy.

lotr11194.name: Lurtz, Minion of the White Wizard
lotr11194.subtitle: Minion of the White Wizard
lotr11194.game_text: Archer. Damage +1. Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) Lurtz is strength +3 for each exhausted companion you can spot.
lotr11194.lore: Saruman bred this ruthless commander, whose brutality matched his own ambition, to track the Nine Walkers.

lotr11195.name: Murderous Uruk
lotr11195.game_text: Damage +1. Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
lotr11195.lore: Like a machine of Saruman, his minions are created for one purpose – killing.

lotr11196.name: Our Foes Are Weak
lotr11196.game_text: To play, spot an [URUK-HAI] minion. Bearer must be an unbound companion. Limit 1 per bearer.
lotr11196.lore: Saruman's Uruk-hai are instilled with his ideas of destiny and supremacy.

lotr11197.name: Overpowering Uruk
lotr11197.game_text: Damage +1. Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) While this minion is skirmishing a character who has resistance 3 or less, this minion is strength +3.
lotr11197.lore: They make short work of the weak.

lotr11198.name: Patrol of Uruk-hai
lotr11198.game_text: Damage +1. While this minion is skirmishing a Free Peoples character who has resistance 5 or less, this minion cannot take wounds.
lotr11198.lore: Their toughness comes from both armor and hide.

lotr11199.name: Relentless Uruk
lotr11199.game_text: Damage +1. Each time a Free Peoples event is played during a skirmish involving this minion, this minion is strength -2 until the regroup phase.
lotr11199.lore: Single-minded in purpose, the Uruk-hai are not easily swayed from their intended path.

lotr11200.name: Ruthless Uruk
lotr11200.game_text: Each time this minion is assigned to skirmish a character who has resistance 3 or less, you may exert this minion to discard a possession borne by that character.
lotr11200.lore: Weapons mean little against the strength of Uruks.

lotr11201.name: Sentinel Uruk
lotr11201.game_text: Damage +1. Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Response: If an [URUK-HAI] minion is about to take a wound in a skirmish, exert or discard this minion to prevent that.
lotr11201.lore: Uruks are trained to safeguard their commanders.

lotr11202.name: Squad of Uruk-hai
lotr11202.game_text: Damage +1. While this minion is skirmishing a character who has resistance 4 or less, this minion is damage +1.
lotr11202.lore: Fighting in packs, the Uruk-hai feast on the weak.

lotr11203.name: Swarming Uruk
lotr11203.game_text: Damage +1. While you can spot another [URUK-HAI] minion assigned to a skirmish, this minion cannot take wounds.
lotr11203.lore: Like pack animals, the Uruk-hai find strength in numbers.

lotr11204.name: Tyrannical Uruk
lotr11204.game_text: Damage +1. Toil 1. (For each [URUK-HAI] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -1.)
lotr11204.lore: Huge, terrifying Uruks become tribal leaders.

lotr11205.name: Vigilant Uruk
lotr11205.game_text: Damage +1. Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) This minion is strength +2 for each [URUK-HAI] minion not assigned to a skirmish.
lotr11205.lore: Some of the Uruks watch for stragglers and make certain they don't escape alive.

lotr11206.name: Watchman Uruk
lotr11206.game_text: Damage +1. When you play this minion at a battleground site, you may draw a card.
lotr11206.lore: Advanced Uruk scouts search for enemy weaknesses.

lotr11207.name: Dark Powers Strengthen
lotr11207.game_text: Toil 2. (For each [WRAITH] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Spot a Nazgul to draw 3 cards.
lotr11207.lore: The Witch-king nearly seized the Ring in Frodo's moment of weakness.

lotr11208.name: Dark Wings
lotr11208.game_text: Each time your [WRAITH] minion wins a skirmish, you may discard this condition to discard a Free Peoples condition from play.
lotr11208.lore: The wicked, flying beasts of the Ringwraiths snatched warriors from the battlefield and flung them like leaves in the wind.

lotr11209.name: Drawn to its Power
lotr11209.game_text: Each time a companion is killed in a skirmish involving a Nazgul, add a burden.

lotr11210.name: Hatred Stirred
lotr11210.game_text: Each time a companion loses a fierce skirmish involving a [WRAITH] minion, you may shuffle a [WRAITH] card from your discard pile into your draw deck.
lotr11210.lore: “Suddenly the foremost Rider spurred his horse forward.”

lotr11211.name: Keening Wail
lotr11211.game_text: Toil 2. (For each [WRAITH] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Spot a Nazgul to add a burden.
lotr11211.lore: The piercing cries of the Nazgûl paralyze their enemies with fear.

lotr11212.name: Lost in the Woods
lotr11212.game_text: Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a companion your Nazgul is skirmishing. Limit 1 per companion. Each [WRAITH] minion skirmishing bearer is strength +1 for each forest site you can spot.

lotr11213.name: Moving This Way
lotr11213.game_text: Shadow: Spot a Nazgul and reveal a Nazgul from hand to place the revealed card beneath your draw deck and draw a card.
lotr11213.lore: “‘I thought there were two or three black shapes.'”

lotr11214.name: The Pale Blade, Sword of Flame
lotr11214.subtitle: Sword of Flame
lotr11214.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. If bearer is The Witch-king, each time he wins a skirmish, you may exert him to add a burden.
lotr11214.lore: “‘Die now and curse in vain!' And with that he lifted high his sword and flames ran down the blade.”

lotr11215.name: Riders in Black
lotr11215.game_text: Reveal your hand to make a [WRAITH] minion strength +1 for each [WRAITH] minion in your hand.

lotr11216.name: A Shadow Rises
lotr11216.game_text: Maneuver: Remove (5) to make this condition a fierce [WRAITH] minion until the start of the regroup phase that has 10 strength and 3 vitality, and cannot bear other cards. This card is still a condition. At the start of the regroup phase, remove all tokens from here.

lotr11217.name: Shapes Slowly Advancing
lotr11217.game_text: Regroup: Discard your Nazgul from play to add a [WRAITH] token here. The Free Peoples player may return a companion to hand to prevent the placement of that token. When you can spot 4 [WRAITH] tokens on this condition, the Ring-bearer is corrupted.

lotr11218.name: Surrounded by Wraiths
lotr11218.game_text: To play, spot a Nazgul. Each time the Free Peoples player plays a companion, that companion is exhausted unless the Free Peoples player pays its twilight cost again.
lotr11218.lore: Encircled, with nowhere to retreat, Aragorn could only hope to drive back the Nazgûl.

lotr11219.name: Ulaire Attea, Second of the Nine Riders
lotr11219.subtitle: Second of the Nine Riders
