lotr11219.game_text: Fierce. Each time Ulaire Attea is assigned to a fierce skirmish involving a character who has resistance 4 or less, you may exert Ulaire Attea to add a burden.
lotr11219.lore: “‘Hissed at me, he did. It gave me quite a shudder.'”

lotr11220.name: Ulaire Cantea, Fourth of the Nine Riders
lotr11220.subtitle: Fourth of the Nine Riders
lotr11220.game_text: While Ulaire Cantea is at a forest or dwelling site, he is strength +2 and fierce.
lotr11220.lore: “‘It's from Hobbiton that this here black rider comes, unless there's more than one.'”

lotr11221.name: Ulaire Lemenya, Fifth of the Nine Riders
lotr11221.subtitle: Fifth of the Nine Riders
lotr11221.game_text: Each character skirmishing Ulaire Lemenya who has resistance 5 or less is strength -3.
lotr11221.lore: “Terror overcame Pippin and Merry, and they threw themselves flat on the ground.”

lotr11222.name: Ulaire Nelya, Third of the Nine Riders
lotr11222.subtitle: Third of the Nine Riders
lotr11222.game_text: Fierce. Shadow: Exert Ulaire Nelya to replace the fellowship's current site with a site from your adventure deck.
lotr11222.lore: “‘There's been a strange customer asking for Mr. Baggins of Bag End, and he's only just gone.'”

lotr11223.name: Ulaire Nertea, Ninth of the Nine Riders
lotr11223.subtitle: Ninth of the Nine Riders
lotr11223.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) While Ulaire Nertea is at a forest site, he is strength +2. While you can spot 6 companions, each Nazgul is strength +2.
lotr11223.lore: Sauron's servants interrogate with terror and torture.

lotr11224.name: Ulaire Otsea, Seventh of the Nine Riders
lotr11224.subtitle: Seventh of the Nine Riders
lotr11224.game_text: When you play Ulaire Otsea, you may spot a companion who has X wounds to reveal the top X cards of your draw deck. Take each [WRAITH] card revealed this way into hand.
lotr11224.lore: “The riding figure sat quite still with its head bowed, as if listening.”

lotr11225.name: Ulaire Toldea, Eighth of the Nine Riders
lotr11225.subtitle: Eighth of the Nine Riders
lotr11225.game_text: Fierce. Each time Ulaire Toldea wins a skirmish, you may play the fellowship's next site.
lotr11225.lore: The terrifying pursuit of the Nazgûl on their Black Steeds drives their victims headlong into the wild.

lotr11226.name: The Witch-king, Captain of the Nine Riders
lotr11226.subtitle: Captain of the Nine Riders
lotr11226.game_text: Fierce. Toil 2. (For each [WRAITH] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)

lotr11227.name: Anduin Banks
lotr11227.game_text: River. The minion archery total is +2 for each companion in the fellowship over 4.

lotr11228.name: Anduin Confluence
lotr11228.game_text: River. When the fellowship moves to this site, discard each ally from play.

lotr11229.name: Barazinbar
lotr11229.game_text: Mountain. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may exert a Dwarf to play a [DWARF] possession from your draw deck.

lotr11230.name: Buckland Homestead
lotr11230.game_text: Dwelling. Shadow: Play a Nazgul to discard a condition from play.

lotr11231.name: Caras Galadhon
lotr11231.game_text: Forest. No more than 1 minion can be assigned to each skirmish.

lotr11232.name: Cavern Entrance
lotr11232.game_text: Underground. Skirmish special abilities cannot be used.

lotr11233.name: Chamber of Mazarbul
lotr11233.game_text: Underground. The Free Peoples player may transfer Free Peoples artifacts and possessions at no twilight cost.

lotr11234.name: Crags of Emyn Muil
lotr11234.game_text: Mountain. If this site is in region 2 when the fellowship moves from it during the regroup phase, wound each companion.

lotr11235.name: Dammed Gate-stream
lotr11235.game_text: Marsh. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may play a [GOLLUM] Free Peoples card from your draw deck.

lotr11236.name: East Road
lotr11236.game_text: Forest. Each companion is twilight cost +2.

lotr11237.name: Ettenmoors
lotr11237.game_text: Plains. Skirmish: Exert your character, (except an enduring character) to make it strength +2.

lotr11238.name: Expanding Marshland
lotr11238.game_text: Marsh. Shadow: If the total number of minions and twilight tokens is 3 or fewer, play a minion at twilight cost -3.

lotr11239.name: Fangorn Glade
lotr11239.game_text: Forest. When the fellowship moves to this site, add (1) for each Free Peoples weapon.

lotr11240.name: Flats of Rohan
lotr11240.game_text: Plains. Each unbound companion skirmishing more than 1 minion is strength +3.

lotr11241.name: Fortress of Orthanc
lotr11241.game_text: Battleground. When the fellowship moves to the site, add 2 for each companion over 5.

lotr11242.name: Green Dragon Inn
lotr11242.game_text: Dwelling. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may exert 2 Hobbits to play a Hobbit from your draw deck.

lotr11243.name: Harrowdale
lotr11243.game_text: Plains. Until the regroup phase, each minion skirmishing a [ROHAN] companion loses fierce and cannot gain fierce.

lotr11244.name: Heights of Isengard
lotr11244.game_text: Battleground. Each time a [GANDALF] companion wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player may discard a condition from play.

lotr11245.name: Helm's Gate
lotr11245.game_text: Battleground. Each character bearing a hand weapon is strength +2.

lotr11246.name: Mere of Dead Faces
lotr11246.game_text: Marsh. Regroup: Exert your Gollum or your Smeagol to play the fellowship's next site.

lotr11247.name: Moria Guardroom
lotr11247.game_text: Underground. When your fellowship moves from this site, you may spot a Dwarf to draw 2 cards.

lotr11248.name: Moria Stairway
lotr11248.game_text: Underground. Each character bearing a hand weapon is damage +1.

lotr11249.name: Neekerbreekers' Bog
lotr11249.game_text: Marsh. When the fellowship moves to here, heal each character who has resistance 5 or more and exert each other character.

lotr11250.name: North Undeep
lotr11250.game_text: River. The minion archery total is -3.

lotr11251.name: Old Forest Road
lotr11251.game_text: Forest. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may heal 2 Elves.

lotr11252.name: Osgiliath Reclaimed
lotr11252.game_text: Battleground. When the fellowship moves from this site, the Free Peoples player may spot 3 burdens to remove a burden.

lotr11254.name: Pelennor Flat
lotr11254.game_text: Plains. At the start of the maneuver phase, the Free Peoples player must add a burden or discard 3 cards from hand.

lotr11255.name: Pinnacle of Zirakzigil
lotr11255.game_text: Mountain. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may exert 3 companions to play a Wizard from your dead pile.

lotr11256.name: The Prancing Pony
lotr11256.game_text: Dwelling. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may add a burden to play a ranger from your draw deck.

lotr11257.name: Rohan Uplands
lotr11257.game_text: Plains. During the archery phase, [URUK] minions cannot take wounds.

lotr11258.name: Slag Mounds
lotr11258.game_text: Battleground. Each time a companion is killed, add a burden.

lotr11259.name: Stables
lotr11259.game_text: At the start of your fellowship phase, you may exert a [ROHAN] Man to play a [ROHAN] mount from your draw deck.

lotr11260.name: Trollshaw Forest
lotr11260.game_text: Forest. Each time you play an artifact or possession on your companion, you may draw a card.

lotr11261.name: Valley of the Silverlode
lotr11261.game_text: Dwelling. River. When your fellowship moves to this site, you may heal each Hobbit companion.

lotr11262.name: Watch-tower of Cirith Ungol
lotr11262.game_text: Mountain. Maneuver: Exert your [ORC] minion to discard a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand.

lotr11263.name: West Gate of Moria
lotr11263.game_text: Underground. When the fellowship moves from this site, remove (2).

lotr11264.name: Westemnet Village
lotr11264.game_text: Dwelling. When the fellowship moves to this site, the Free Peoples player wounds a companion for each ally.

lotr11265.name: Window on the West
lotr11265.game_text: Underground. Each unwounded [GONDOR] Man is defender +1.

lotr11266.name: Woody-End
lotr11266.game_text: Forest. Shadow: Remove a burden to play a Nazgul from your discard pile.

lotr12001.name: Elrond, Witness to History
lotr12001.subtitle: Witness to History
lotr12001.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: If Elrond is skirmishing a minion, exert him to place an [ELVEN] card from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.
lotr12001.lore: “‘I was there the day the strength of Men failed.'”

lotr12002.name: Hadafang
lotr12002.game_text: Bearer must be Arwen or Elrond. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert him or her to discard a condition from play.
lotr12002.lore: “This blade is called Hadafang, a noble defense against the enemy throng for a noble lady.”

lotr12003.name: Gandalf, The White Rider
lotr12003.subtitle: The White Rider
lotr12003.game_text: Skirmish: If Gandalf is not assigned to a skirmish, exert him and another unbound companion skirmishing a minion to make Gandalf strength +3 and have him replace that companion in that skirmish.
lotr12003.lore: “‘Look to my coming at first light on the fifth day.'”

lotr12004.name: Faramir, Dunadan of Gondor
lotr12004.subtitle: Dunadan of Gondor
lotr12004.game_text: Ranger. Skirmish: Exert Faramir to make him strength +1 for each wound on the Ring-bearer.
lotr12004.lore: “‘We do not want the escapes of Mirkwood in Ithilien.'”

lotr12005.name: Faramir's Sword
lotr12005.game_text: Bearer must be Faramir. He is damage +1. Each minion skirmishing Faramir at a battleground or forest site is roaming.
lotr12005.lore: “‘There will be hard handstrokes nigh at hand ere the day is full.'”

lotr12006.name: Castamir of Umbar, Corsair Vandal
lotr12006.subtitle: Corsair Vandal
lotr12006.game_text: Fierce. Toil 1. (For each [MEN] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -1) Each wounded [MEN] minion is strength +2.
lotr12006.lore: “‘...they have allied them with the Enemy, and now make a heavy stroke in his cause.'”

lotr12007.name: Grima, Betrayer of Rohan
lotr12007.subtitle: Betrayer of Rohan
lotr12007.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Each time a companion loses a skirmish involving a [MEN] minion, you may exert Grima to exert a companion.
lotr12007.lore: “In his eyes was the hunted look of a beast seeking some gap in the ring of his enemies.”

lotr12008.name: The Balrog, The Terror of Khazad-dum
lotr12008.subtitle: The Terror of Khazad-dum
lotr12008.game_text: Damage +1. While The Balrog is at an underground site, it is fierce and cannot take wounds or be exerted.
lotr12008.lore: “The fire in it seemed to die, but the darkness grew.”

lotr12009.name: Cave Troll of Moria, Savage Menace
lotr12009.subtitle: Savage Menace
lotr12009.game_text: Damage +1. Fierce. Toil 2. (For each [ORC] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2) Each time an [ORC] lurker wins a skirmish, you may make the Free Peoples player discard the top 2 cards of his or her draw deck.
lotr12009.lore: “‘There is no hope of escape that way.'”

lotr12010.name: Orc Artisan
lotr12010.game_text: Each time you play an [ORC] possession on an [ORC] Orc, you may add (1) (or (2) if that Orc is at a battleground or underground site).
lotr12010.lore: Much Orc weaponry is scavenged from fallen foes, but they still have ample need for smiths to outfit their troops.

lotr12011.name: The Mouth of Sauron, Lieutenant of Barad-dur
lotr12011.subtitle: Lieutenant of Barad-dur
lotr12011.game_text: Assignment: Assign The Mouth of Sauron to the companion who has the highest strength. (If two or more are tied for highest, choose one.)
lotr12011.lore: “‘Is there anyone in this rout with authority to treat with me?' he asked. ‘Or indeed with wit to understand me?'”

lotr12012.name: Bilbo, Melancholy Hobbit
lotr12012.subtitle: Melancholy Hobbit
lotr12012.game_text: Ring-bound. At the start of each skirmish involving Bilbo, you may exert him to take a [SHIRE] skirmish event into hand from your discard pile.
lotr12012.lore: “‘I want to see the wild country again before I die, and the Mountains....'”

lotr12013.name: Uruk Zealot
lotr12013.game_text: Damage +1. To play, spot an [URUK-HAI] minion. Each companion who has resistance 0 is strength -3. Each time Uruk Zealot wins a skirmish, you may draw 3 cards.
lotr12013.lore: The Uruk-hai do not question the authority of the White Hand. They know its cause is righteous.

lotr12014.name: Dark Approach
lotr12014.game_text: Play a Nazgul. His twilight cost is -1 for each forest site you can spot (limit -4).
lotr12014.lore: “Frodo hesitated for a second: curiosity or some other feeling was struggling with his desire to hide.”

lotr12015.name: Ulaire Attea, Black Predator
lotr12015.subtitle: Black Predator
lotr12015.game_text: Fierce. Skirmish: Remove (2) and discard a [WRAITH] card from hand to make Ulaire Attea strength +3.
lotr12015.lore: “Frodo thought that he heard a faint hiss as of venomous breath and felt a thin piercing chill.”

lotr12016.name: Ulaire Cantea, Black Assassin
lotr12016.subtitle: Black Assassin
lotr12016.game_text: Fierce. Assignment: Assign Ulaire Cantea to a companion who has resistance 0. Skirmish: Spot 6 companions and another [WRAITH] card to kill a companion Ulaire Cantea is skirmishing.
lotr12016.lore: “‘Flee them! Speak no words to them! They are deadly.'”

lotr12017.name: Ulaire Enquea, Black Threat
lotr12017.subtitle: Black Threat
lotr12017.game_text: Fierce.Toil 1. (For each [WRAITH] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -1) Response: If you are playing a [WRAITH] event that has toil X, exert Ulaire Enquea to reduce that event's twilight cost by X.
lotr12017.lore: “‘...the Shire is no longer any protection to you.'”

lotr12018.name: The Witch-king, Black Lord
lotr12018.subtitle: Black Lord
lotr12018.game_text: Fierce. The Witch-King is twilight cost -1 for each wound on the Ring-bearer. Each time a companion is played, you may reveal this card from hand to exert the Ring-bearer.
lotr12018.lore: “He sprang forward and bore down on Frodo.”

lotr12019.name: Long-knives of Legolas
lotr12019.game_text: Bearer must be Legolas. Each Orc or Uruk-hai skirmishing Legolas is strength -2.
lotr12019.lore: Sharp, bone-handled knives defend the Elves of Mirkwood at close quarters.

lotr12020.name: Orophin, Brother of Haldir
lotr12020.subtitle: Brother of Haldir
lotr12020.game_text: While Orophin is at a forest site and you can spot another Elf, Orophin is an archer.
lotr12020.lore: “...wolves were howling on the wood's borders: but on the land of Lórien no shadow lay.”

lotr12021.name: Refuge
lotr12021.game_text: To play, spot an Elf. Fellowship: Discard a companion from hand to heal a companion.
lotr12021.lore: “‘Now you shall rest, and we will not speak of your further road for a while.'”

lotr12022.name: Rumil, Brother of Haldir
lotr12022.subtitle: Brother of Haldir
lotr12022.game_text: Maneuver: Reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [ELVEN] card, Rumil is an archer until the regroup phase.
lotr12022.lore: “...the Elves feared and distrusted the world outside....”

lotr12023.name: Seclusion
lotr12023.game_text: Toil 2. (For each [ELVEN] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2) Spot an Elf companion to discard a condition from play.
lotr12023.lore: “‘We allow no strangers to spy out the secrets of the Naith. Few indeed are permitted even to set foot there.'”

lotr12024.name: Taking the High Ground
lotr12024.game_text: Toil 1. (For each [ELVEN] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -1) Archery: Discard an [ELVEN] character from hand to make the fellowship archery total +1. Each time the fellowship moves from an underground site, return your Elf to your hand.

lotr12025.name: Betrayal of Isengard
lotr12025.game_text: Each time an opponent draws a card (or takes a card into hand) during the Shadow phase, you may remove (1). Maneuver: Exert Gandalf to wound Saruman twice.
lotr12025.lore: “‘There is only one Lord of the Ring.'”

lotr12026.name: Discoveries
lotr12026.game_text: Toil 3. (For each [GANDALF] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -3) Spot a [GANDALF] wizard and X other companions to examine the top X cards of your draw deck. Replace those cards in any order.
lotr12026.lore: “‘I have come back from dark journeys and long search....'”

lotr12027.name: Gandalf, The White Rider
lotr12027.subtitle: The White Rider
lotr12027.game_text: Skirmish: If Gandalf is not assigned to a skirmish, exert him and another unbound companion skirmishing a minion to make Gandalf strength +3 and have him replace that companion in that skirmish.
lotr12027.lore: “‘Look to my coming at first light on the fifth day.'”

lotr12028.name: Gandalf's Hat
lotr12028.game_text: Bearer must be Gandalf. Each time the fellowship moves from a battleground site, add a burden. Regroup: Add 2 burdens to remove all twilight tokens from the twilight pool.
lotr12028.lore: “He wore a tall pointed blue hat....”

lotr12029.name: Introspection
lotr12029.game_text: Spell. Choose one: Spot a [GANDALF] Wizard to choose an opponent who must discard one of his or her conditions from play; or spot a [GANDALF] Wizard at a battleground site to discard a condition from play.
lotr12029.lore: “‘...I do not know the word – yet. But we shall soon see.'”

lotr12030.name: Jarnsmid, Barding Emissary
lotr12030.subtitle: Barding Emissary
lotr12030.game_text: At the start of each skirmish involving Jarnsmid, you may remove a burden (or 2 burdens if you can spot another [GANDALF] companion).
lotr12030.lore: Sauron's Easterling allies were another trial for the Bardings, still keenly aware of the great efforts to rebuild Dale.

lotr12031.name: Mysterious Wizard
lotr12031.game_text: Spell. Make Gandalf strength +2 (or +4 if you cannot spot 5 burdens).
lotr12031.lore: “‘...there are older and fouler things than Orcs in the deep places of the world.'”

lotr12032.name: Salve
lotr12032.game_text: Spell. To play, spot a [GANDALF] Wizard. Bearer must be a companion. Limit 1 per bearer. Response: If bearer is about to take a wound that would kill him or her, discard this condition to prevent that wound.
lotr12032.lore: “...the whole hall became suddenly dark as night.”

lotr12033.name: The Terror of His Coming
lotr12033.game_text: Make a [GANDALF] companion strength +2. Then, if that companion is at a battleground or dwelling site, you may take a [GANDALF] condition from your discard pile into hand.
lotr12033.lore: “The Orcs reeled and screamed and cast aside both sword and spear.”

lotr12034.name: Traveled Leader
lotr12034.game_text: Spot a [GANDALF] Wizard to replace a site in the fellowship's current region with a site from your adventure deck.
lotr12034.lore: “‘...the question is: who will follow me, if I lead you there?'”

lotr12035.name: Watch and Wait
lotr12035.game_text: To play, spot a [GANDALF] companion. Bearer must be a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Limit 1 per bearer. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may remove a burden.
lotr12035.lore: “‘I could not take it from him without doing greater harm; and I had no right to do so anyway.'”

lotr12036.name: With Doom We Come
lotr12036.game_text: While Gandalf is at an underground site, he gains muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) While the fellowship is at a battleground site, each [GANDALF] character gains muster.
lotr12036.lore: “‘We come, we come with roll of drum....'”

lotr12037.name: Come Away
lotr12037.game_text: While you can spot Smeagol, the Shadow number of each site is -1. Each time the fellowship moves, wound a companion or discard this condition.
lotr12037.lore: “‘All ways are watched, yes,' said Gollum. ‘Of course they are. But hobbits must try some way. This may be least watched.'”

lotr12038.name: From Deep in Shadow
lotr12038.game_text: Spot X [GOLLUM] cards to reveal the top X cards of your draw deck. You may play a revealed minion. Its twilight cost is -2.
lotr12038.lore: “...she moved with a horrible speed, now running on her creaking legs, now making a sudden bound.”

lotr12039.name: Not Alone
lotr12039.game_text: Each time the fellowship moves to a mountain or underground site, you may discard a [GOLLUM] event from hand to take a minion from your discard pile into hand.
lotr12039.lore: Gollum stalked the Ring-bearer over many leagues, awaiting the right opportunity to strike.

lotr12040.name: There's Another Way
lotr12040.game_text: To play, spot Smeagol. Smeagol is strength +1. Regroup: Discard this condition to replace the fellowship's current site with a site from your adventure deck.
lotr12040.lore: “Frodo felt a strange certainty that in this matter Gollum was for once not so far from the truth....”

lotr12041.name: Treacherous Little Toad
lotr12041.game_text: To play, spot a [GOLLUM] card. Bearer must be a wounded companion. While you can spot a [GOLLUM] character or a [GOLLUM] card in your support area, bearer cannot heal.
lotr12041.lore: “‘The Precious will be ours once the Hobbitses are dead!'”

lotr12042.name: Blade of Gondor, Sword of Boromir
lotr12042.subtitle: Sword of Boromir
lotr12042.game_text: Bearer must be Boromir. He is damage +1. Skirmish: If Boromir is not assigned to a skirmish, discard a [GONDOR] card borne by him to have him replace an unbound Hobbit skirmishing a minion.
lotr12042.lore: Its strength pales next to that of the man wielding it.

lotr12043.name: Boromir, Defender of Minas Tirith
lotr12043.subtitle: Defender of Minas Tirith
lotr12043.game_text: Ranger. Fellowship: Add (2) to heal Boromir.
lotr12043.lore: “...seated a little apart was a tall man with a fair and noble face... proud and stern of glance.”

lotr12044.name: Concealment
lotr12044.game_text: Make a [GONDOR] Man strength +1. If he or she is skirmishing a roaming minion, your opponents cannot use special abilities.
lotr12044.lore: “‘...your refuge is so hidden that perhaps he does not know that Men are concealed here.'”

lotr12045.name: Confronting the Eye
lotr12045.game_text: Fellowship: Spot a [GONDOR] Man and add (2) to make each unbound companion strength +1 until the regroup phase (limit +1).
lotr12045.lore: “‘To know that I lived and walked the earth was a blow to his heart, I deem; for he knew it not till now.'”

lotr12046.name: Elendil's Valor
lotr12046.game_text: Make a [GONDOR] companion defender +1 until the regroup phase.
lotr12046.lore: “‘In panoply of ancient kings, / in chainéd rings he armoured him; / his shining shield was scored with runes / to ward all wounds and harm from him....'”

lotr12047.name: Faramir, Dunadan of Gondor
lotr12047.subtitle: Dunadan of Gondor
lotr12047.game_text: Ranger. Skirmish: Exert Faramir to make him strength +1 for each wound on the Ring-bearer.
lotr12047.lore: “‘We do not want the escapes of Mirkwood in Ithilien.'”

lotr12048.name: Faramir's Sword
lotr12048.game_text: Bearer must be Faramir. He is damage +1. Each minion skirmishing Faramir at a battleground or forest site is roaming.
lotr12048.lore: “‘There will be hard handstrokes nigh at hand ere the day is full.'”

lotr12049.name: Gondorian Steed
lotr12049.game_text: Bearer must be a knight. Bearer is damage +1. Each time the fellowship moves from a mountain site, add (2).
lotr12049.lore: A skilled cavalry augments Minas Tirith's mighty defenses.

lotr12050.name: Guardian
lotr12050.game_text: Toil 2. (For each [GONDOR] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2) Skirmish: If a [GONDOR] companion is not assigned to a skirmish, discard this condition to have him or her replace an unbound companion skirmishing a minion.
lotr12050.lore: Boromir wouldn't fail the other Hobbits as he had Frodo.

lotr12051.name: Invigorated
lotr12051.game_text: Skirmish: Discard this condition to heal a [GONDOR] Man (or to heal 2 [GONDOR] Men if you can spot a roaming minion).
lotr12051.lore: “He sprang down the steps and away, leaping down the path.”

lotr12052.name: Tireless
lotr12052.game_text: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [GONDOR] Man strength +1 for each of the following that is true: he or she is at a battleground site; he or she has resistance 4 or more; he or she is bearing a hand weapon; he or she is skirmishing a roaming minion.
lotr12052.lore: So long as foes were standing, so too would Aragorn.

lotr12053.name: Valorous Leader
lotr12053.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] companion. Limit 1 per bearer. Skirmish: Discard this condition to discard a possession borne by a minion skirmishing bearer.
lotr12053.lore: Before he ever sat the throne, Aragorn had proven himself a great leader to the people of Gondor.

lotr12054.name: Saruman, Of Many Colours
lotr12054.subtitle: Of Many Colours
lotr12054.game_text: Damage +1. Fierce. Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) When you play Saruman, name a culture. Each companion of the named culture is strength -1.
lotr12054.lore: “‘“White!” he sneered. “It serves as a beginning.”'”

lotr12055.name: Brutal Easterling
lotr12055.game_text: Each time this minion is assigned to skirmish an exhausted companion, it is fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr12055.lore: “‘Out of some savage land in the wide East they come, we deem.'”

lotr12056.name: Castamir of Umbar, Corsair Vandal
lotr12056.subtitle: Corsair Vandal
lotr12056.game_text: Fierce. Toil 1. (For each [MEN] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -1) Each wounded [MEN] minion is strength +2.
lotr12056.lore: “‘...they have allied them with the Enemy, and now make a heavy stroke in his cause.'”

lotr12057.name: Corrupted Spy
lotr12057.game_text: This minion is strength +1 for each other character you can spot. While you can spot a companion who has resistance 3 or less, this minion is damage +1. While you can spot a companion who has resistance 0, this minion is fierce.

lotr12058.name: Countless Companies
lotr12058.game_text: Response: If a [MEN] possession is discarded from play, stack it here. Shadow: Remove (1) to play a possession stacked here as if from hand.
lotr12058.lore: “‘Not tall, but broad and grim... wielding great axes.'”

lotr12059.name: Covetous Easterling
lotr12059.game_text: While this minion is skirmishing a Man, it is damage +2.
lotr12059.lore: Long have the Men of Rhûn thirsted for the wealth of Gondor, and many times have they sought to claim it.

lotr12060.name: Crazed Hillman
lotr12060.game_text: Fierce. While this minion is in a fierce skirmish, it is strength +7 (or +10 if it is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less).
lotr12060.lore: Already given to fierce passions, a warrior of Dunland quickly frenzies in the heat of battle.

lotr12061.name: Crooked Townsman
lotr12061.game_text: This minion is strength +1 for each other character you can spot.
lotr12061.lore: “‘...the Riders can use men and other creatures as spies, as we found at Bree.'”

lotr12062.name: Dunlending Zealot
lotr12062.game_text: While this minion is exhausted, each unbound companion is resistance -1 (or -2 if the fellowship is at a battleground site).
lotr12062.lore: “...unfriendly to the Dúnedain, hating the Rohirrim.”

lotr12063.name: Easterling Banner-bearer
lotr12063.game_text: This minion is strength +1 for each wound on each companion he is skirmishing (or +2 for each if that companion has resistance 2 or less).
lotr12063.lore: “‘They hold the northward road; and many have passed on into Anórien. The Rohirrim cannot come.'”

lotr12064.name: Enraged Southron
lotr12064.game_text: Ambush (3). The move limit for this turn is +1.
lotr12064.lore: As with wild animals, fleeing prey seems only to incite the warriors of Harad.

lotr12065.name: Frenzied Dunlending
lotr12065.game_text: While this minion is bearing a possession, it is fierce.
lotr12065.lore: While Dunlendings lack the skills of the trained soldiers they attack, they carry in them a well-honed hatred.

lotr12066.name: Gathering Strength
lotr12066.game_text: Toil 2. (For each [MEN] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2) Make a [MEN] minion strength +6.
lotr12066.lore: “‘Always more people coming to Mordor. One day all the peoples will be inside.'”

lotr12067.name: Goaded to War
lotr12067.game_text: To play, spot a [MEN] minion. Each time the fellowship moves to a battleground or plains site, add (1).

lotr12068.name: Grima, Betrayer of Rohan
lotr12068.subtitle: Betrayer of Rohan
lotr12068.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Each time a companion loses a skirmish involving a [MEN] minion, you may exert Grima to exert a companion.
lotr12068.lore: “In his eyes was the hunted look of a beast seeking some gap in the ring of his enemies.”

lotr12069.name: Harrying Hillman
lotr12069.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Each time a companion loses a skirmish involving a [MEN] minion, add (2).
lotr12069.lore: Though Dunlendings are by no means cowardly, their prowess in battle seems to manifest more as victory grows more assured.

lotr12070.name: Hemmed In
lotr12070.game_text: While you can spot 6 companions, each companion skirmishing a [MEN] minion loses all strength bonuses from possessions. Maneuver: Spot your [MEN] minion and discard this condition to transfer a Free Peoples possession borne by a companion to another eligible bearer.

lotr12071.name: Last Days
lotr12071.game_text: Each time a [MEN] minion is killed or discarded from play (except during the regroup phase), you may play a [MEN] minion. Its twilight cost is -2, and it is fierce and strength +2 until the regroup phase.
lotr12071.lore: “‘Not long now shall stand the high hall which Brego son of Eorl built. Fire shall devour the high seat.'”

lotr12072.name: Messenger's Mount
lotr12072.game_text: Bearer must be The Mouth of Sauron. He is fierce. Response: If a [MEN] minion is about to take a wound, remove (3) to prevent that.
lotr12072.lore: “...it was huge and hideous, and its face was a frightful mask....”

lotr12073.name: The Mouth of Sauron, Messenger of Mordor
lotr12073.subtitle: Messenger of Mordor
lotr12073.game_text: Maneuver: Exert The Mouth of Sauron to play a [MEN] condition or [MEN] possession from your draw deck.
lotr12073.lore: “...he learned great sorcery, and knew much of the mind of Sauron; and he was more cruel than any orc.”

lotr12074.name: Mumak Rider
lotr12074.game_text: Archer. When you play this minion to a battleground or plains site, you may spot another [MEN] minion to discard a possession from play.
lotr12074.lore: Only the best marksmen can keep their aim true as they are carried along by the great beasts of the Haradrim.

lotr12075.name: Poisonous Words
lotr12075.game_text: Toil 2. (For each [MEN] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2) Add (1) for each [MEN] card you can spot.
lotr12075.lore: “‘So fair. So cold. Like a morning of pale spring still clinging to winter's chill.'”

lotr12076.name: Trail of Terror
lotr12076.game_text: At the start of the maneuver phase, you may spot 3 [MEN] minions and remove (1) to make each unbound companion resistance -1 until the regroup phase.
lotr12076.lore: “‘Now the Wild Men are moving through the Westfold, burning as they go.'”

lotr12077.name: War Trident
lotr12077.game_text: Bearer must be a [MEN] minion. While bearer is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 5 or less, bearer is strength +2. While bearer is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 3 or less, bearer is strength +2.

lotr12078.name: Wrathful Hillman
lotr12078.game_text: Each time this minion is assigned to a skirmish, if it is not at a plains site, remove (2) or discard this minion.
lotr12078.lore: “‘For behold! the storm comes, and now all friends should gather together, lest each singly be destroyed.'”

lotr12079.name: The Balrog, The Terror of Khazad-dum
lotr12079.subtitle: The Terror of Khazad-dum
lotr12079.game_text: Damage +1. While The Balrog is at an underground site, it is fierce and cannot take wounds or be exerted.
lotr12079.lore: “The fire in it seemed to die, but the darkness grew.”

lotr12080.name: Whip of Many Thongs, Weapon of Flame and Shadow
lotr12080.subtitle: Weapon of Flame and Shadow
lotr12080.game_text: Bearer must be The Balrog. It is fierce. When you play this artifact, the Free Peoples player reveals his or her hand and discards all Free Peoples cards from hand that have a twilight cost of 1 or less.
lotr12080.lore: “...it swung its whip, and the thongs lashed....”

lotr12081.name: Abiding Evil
lotr12081.game_text: Spot X burdens to make a character skirmishing an [ORC] Orc strength -X.
lotr12081.lore: “‘The Dark Tower was broken, but its foundations were not removed; for they were made with the power of the Ring, and while it remains they will endure.'”

lotr12082.name: Barrage
lotr12082.game_text: Toil 2. (For each [ORC] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2) Make each of your [ORC] minions strength +2 until the regroup phase.
lotr12082.lore: “Fires now raged unchecked in the first circle of the City....”

lotr12083.name: The Beckoning Shadow
lotr12083.game_text: To play, exert an [ORC] minion. If you can spot 5 burdens, and the Free Peoples player has no cards in his or her draw deck, the Ring-bearer is corrupted.
lotr12083.lore: “Once more the desire to slip on the Ring came over Frodo; but this time it was stronger than before.”

lotr12084.name: Bloodstained Field
lotr12084.game_text: Spot an [ORC] lurker to wound an Elf.
lotr12084.lore: Orcs will eagerly spill any blood, but Elven is the sweetest of all.

lotr12085.name: Cave Troll of Moria, Savage Menace
lotr12085.subtitle: Savage Menace
lotr12085.game_text: Damage +1. Fierce. Toil 2. (For each [ORC] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2) Each time an [ORC] lurker wins a skirmish, you may make the Free Peoples player discard the top 2 cards of his or her draw deck.
lotr12085.lore: “‘There is no hope of escape that way.'”

lotr12086.name: Cave Troll's Hammer, Unwieldy Cudgel
lotr12086.subtitle: Unwieldy Cudgel
lotr12086.game_text: Bearer must be an [ORC] Troll. When you play this possession, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion for each lurker you spot.
lotr12086.lore: Its weight is greater than any foe it has felled.

lotr12087.name: Goblin Aggressor
lotr12087.game_text: While this minion is bearing a possession, each [ORC] minion is strength +1.
lotr12087.lore: “‘The road may lead to Moria, but how can we hope that it will lead through Moria....'”

lotr12088.name: Great Cost
lotr12088.game_text: At the start of each skirmish involving an [ORC] minion, you may spot 6 companions to exert a companion in that skirmish. Shadow: Discard this condition and spot an [ORC] minion to make the Free Peoples player place a card from his or her hand on top of his or her draw deck.

lotr12089.name: Mordor Aggressor
lotr12089.game_text: While this minion is bearing a possession, each [ORC] minion is strength +2.
lotr12089.lore: “‘The enemy,' men murmured. ‘The dike is down. Here they come pouring through the breaches!'”

lotr12090.name: Morgul Tormentor
lotr12090.game_text: Each time the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to skirmish an unwounded companion, he or she must add a burden or discard a card from hand.
lotr12090.lore: Some Orcs go beyond savagery, taking pleasure in the suffering of their enemies.

lotr12091.name: Orc Artisan
lotr12091.game_text: Each time you play an [ORC] possession on an [ORC] Orc, you may add (1) (or (2) if that Orc is at a battleground or underground site).
lotr12091.lore: Much Orc weaponry is scavenged from fallen foes, but they still have ample need for smiths to outfit their troops.

lotr12092.name: Orc Dreg
lotr12092.game_text: Each time this minion is assigned to a skirmish, if it is not at an underground site, remove (2) or discard this minion.
lotr12092.lore: “...their Captain cared not greatly what they did or how many might be slain....”

lotr12093.name: Orc Footman
lotr12093.game_text: When this minion is discarded from play, you may spot a companion who has resistance 4 or less to shuffle this minion into your draw deck.
lotr12093.lore: “On they came, reckless of their loss as they approached....”

lotr12094.name: Orc Sapper
lotr12094.game_text: When you play this minion, you may spot a companion who has resistance 4 or less to prevent that companion from being assigned to this minion until the regroup phase.
lotr12094.lore: “...their purpose was only to test the strength of the defence and to keep the men of Gondor busy in many places.”

lotr12095.name: Orc Skulker
lotr12095.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Each skirmish event you play is twilight cost -1.
lotr12095.lore: “‘I have never heard before of Orcs upon Amon Hen. Yet who knows what may happen in these evil days....'”

lotr12096.name: Orc Spear
lotr12096.game_text: Bearer must be an [ORC] minion. When you play this possession on a minion that has a twilight cost of 4 or more, add (2).
lotr12096.lore: The flared backs of Orkish spearheads are crafted to inflict more damage as they are pulled out of a victim.

lotr12097.name: Orc Strategist
lotr12097.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Maneuver: Make an [ORC] lurker minion lose lurker until the regroup phase.
lotr12097.lore: It takes a strong will indeed to command an unruly band of Orcs.

lotr12098.name: Orc Tormentor
lotr12098.game_text: Each time the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to skirmish an unwounded companion, he or she must add a burden or discard a card from hand.
lotr12098.lore: “...orc-speech sounded at all times full of hate and anger....”

lotr12099.name: Pitiless Orc
lotr12099.game_text: When you play this minion, you may make the Free Peoples player exert a companion for each companion over 4.
lotr12099.lore: “Curses they heeded not, nor understood the tongues of western men...”

lotr12100.name: Rallying Orc
lotr12100.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Each time you play another [ORC] lurker at a battleground or underground site, you may make the Free Peoples player exert a companion.
lotr12100.lore: Orcs can spring from the shadows in surprising numbers.

lotr12101.name: Retribution
lotr12101.game_text: Each time an [ORC] minion bearing a weapon wins a skirmish, add a burden. Shadow: Discard this condition to play an [ORC] weapon from your discard pile.
lotr12101.lore: With his mighty army, the Dark Lord exacted a high price for resisting his will.

lotr12102.name: Scavenging Goblins
lotr12102.game_text: When you play this minion, you may play an [ORC] weapon from your discard pile on your [ORC] Orc.
lotr12102.lore: “‘The Orcs have often plundered Moria; there is nothing left in the upper halls.'”

lotr12103.name: Storming the Ramparts
lotr12103.game_text: Toil 2. (For each [ORC] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2) Spot an [ORC] minion to make the Free Peoples player discard one of his or her conditions from play.
lotr12103.lore: The defenses of Minas Tirith were daunting, but the siegecraft of the Orcs was equal to the challenge.

lotr12104.name: Taunt
lotr12104.game_text: Reveal the top 5 cards of your draw deck (or, if the fellowship is at a battleground site, the top 7 cards) to make an [ORC] minion strength +1 for each [ORC] card revealed.
lotr12104.lore: “‘Go on. Call for help. Squeal! No one's gonna save you now.'”

lotr12105.name: Troll's Keyward, Keeper of the Beast
lotr12105.subtitle: Keeper of the Beast
lotr12105.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Shadow: Exert Troll's Keyward and reveal your hand to add (1) for each [ORC] Troll revealed.
lotr12105.lore: Tending the Cave Troll is a task neither envied or respected within the tribes of Moria.

lotr12106.name: Vile Goblin
lotr12106.game_text: Each time this minion is assigned to skirmish a Dwarf, this minion is fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr12106.lore: The Orcs infesting Khazad-dûm despoiled and defiled the ancient Dwarven mansion.

lotr12107.name: Aldred, Eored Soldier
lotr12107.subtitle: Eored Soldier
lotr12107.game_text: At the start of each skirmish involving Aldred, you may discard a possession borne by a minion he is skirmishing.
lotr12107.lore: “‘We counted all the slain and despoiled them....'”

lotr12108.name: Cast Out
lotr12108.game_text: Toil 2. (For each [ROHAN] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2) Maneuver: Spot a [ROHAN] Man and discard this condition to exert a minion. Maneuver: Spot a mounted [ROHAN] Man and discard this condition to return an exhausted minion to its owner's hand.

lotr12109.name: Challenging the Orc-host
lotr12109.game_text: Make a [ROHAN] companion strength +2 (or +1 for each minion you can spot if that companion has resistance 5 or more).
lotr12109.lore: “‘...we overtook the Orcs at nightfall two days ago, near to the borders of the Entwood. There we surrounded them, and gave battle....'”

lotr12110.name: Cleaving a Path
lotr12110.game_text: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [ROHAN] companion strength +1 for each of the following that is true: he or she is at a plains site; he or she has resistance 4 or more; he or she is bearing armor; he or she is skirmishing a wounded minion.
lotr12110.lore: “Captains and champions fell or fled before them.”

lotr12111.name: Coif
lotr12111.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. Each time a Shadow card adds any number of twilight tokens, you may exert bearer to prevent that. Each time the fellowship moves from a forest site, exert a companion.
lotr12111.lore: “...the Hornburg still held fast, like an island in a sea.”

lotr12112.name: Eomer, Eored Leader
lotr12112.subtitle: Eored Leader
lotr12112.game_text: While you can spot a [ROHAN] Man, Eomer's twilight cost is -1. Maneuver: If you can spot more minions than companions, exert Eomer to play a [ROHAN] companion from your draw deck.
lotr12112.lore: “...the front of the first éored roared like a breaker foaming to the shore....”

lotr12113.name: Eored Warrior
lotr12113.game_text: While this companion is at a battleground or plains site, he is strength +3.
lotr12113.lore: “‘...suspecting what I most fear, a league between Orthanc and the Dark Tower, I led forth my éored, men of my own household....'”

lotr12114.name: For the Mark
lotr12114.game_text: Spot a [ROHAN] Man to discard a possession from play. You may exert a [ROHAN] Man who has resistance 3 or more to play this event during the maneuver phase.
lotr12114.lore: “South strode Éomer and men fled before his face, and they were caught between the hammer and the anvil.”

lotr12115.name: Golden Glimmer
lotr12115.game_text: Response: If a companion is about to take a wound, spot a [ROHAN] companion and add 2 burdens to prevent that.
lotr12115.lore: “‘Dark is the hour, yet maybe we shall return to the Golden Hall.'”

lotr12116.name: Haethen, Veteran Fighter
lotr12116.subtitle: Veteran Fighter
lotr12116.game_text: Haethen cannot take wounds during fierce skirmishes. Skirmish: Exert Haethen to make him strength +1.
lotr12116.lore: His years as a Rider of Rohan were long behind him, but the threat to Helm's Deep demanded this old warrior again take up arms.

lotr12117.name: Leofric, Defender of the Mark
lotr12117.subtitle: Defender of the Mark
lotr12117.game_text: Skirmish: If Leofric is in a skirmish, exert him to play a [ROHAN] skirmish event from your draw deck.
lotr12117.lore: “‘There is trouble now on all our borders, and we are threatened....'”

lotr12118.name: The Mouth of Sauron, Lieutenant of Barad-dur
lotr12118.subtitle: Lieutenant of Barad-dur
lotr12118.game_text: Assignment: Assign The Mouth of Sauron to the companion who has the highest strength. (If two or more are tied for highest, choose one.)
lotr12118.lore: “‘Is there anyone in this rout with authority to treat with me?' he asked. ‘Or indeed with wit to understand me?'”

lotr12119.name: Bilbo, Melancholy Hobbit
lotr12119.subtitle: Melancholy Hobbit
lotr12119.game_text: Ring-bound. At the start of each skirmish involving Bilbo, you may exert him to take a [SHIRE] skirmish event into hand from your discard pile.
lotr12119.lore: “‘I want to see the wild country again before I die, and the Mountains....'”

lotr12120.name: Diversion
lotr12120.game_text: Discard a Hobbit not assigned to a skirmish from play to discard a minion from play. If the fellowship is at a battleground site, you may add 2 burdens to play this event during a skirmish involving a Hobbit.
lotr12120.lore: Each member of the fellowship was willing to make any sacrifice to safeguard the Quest.

lotr12121.name: Flotsam and Jetsam
lotr12121.game_text: If a companion (except a Hobbit) wins a skirmish, heal a Hobbit.
lotr12121.lore: “‘Welcome, my lords, to Isengard!' he said. ‘We are the doorwardens.'”

lotr12122.name: Home and Hearth
lotr12122.game_text: Each time you play a Hobbit, you may remove a burden. Then, if the fellowship is at a dwelling site, heal the Ring-bearer.
lotr12122.lore: “He drew a deep breath. ‘Well, I'm back,' he said.”

lotr12123.name: Hope is Kindled
lotr12123.game_text: Make a Hobbit strength +2. If that Hobbit wins this skirmish, you may remove a burden.
lotr12123.lore: “‘Soft as butter they can be, and yet sometimes as tough as old tree-roots.'”

lotr12124.name: Long Live the Halflings
lotr12124.game_text: To play, spot a Hobbit. Skirmish: If your Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, discard this condition to make each companion who has resistance 7 or more strength +2 until the regroup phase.
lotr12124.lore: “‘My friends, you bow to no one.'”

lotr12125.name: Measure of Comfort
lotr12125.game_text: While you can spot a Hobbit, each unbound companion is resistance +1.
lotr12125.lore: Though fate had it that the fellowship would not accompany Frodo to his final goal, some reassurance came in knowing he did not have to make the journey alone.

lotr12126.name: No Worse for Wear
lotr12126.game_text: Prevent a Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled. Then, if the fellowship is at a dwelling site, you may discard 2 cards from hand to return this event to your hand.

lotr12127.name: Pippin, Hobbit of Some Intelligence
lotr12127.subtitle: Hobbit of Some Intelligence
lotr12127.game_text: When you play Pippin, remove a burden or heal a companion.
lotr12127.lore: “‘Anyway, you need people of intelligence on this sort of mission... quest... thing.'”

lotr12128.name: A Promise
lotr12128.game_text: While you can spot Frodo and Sam and neither is exhausted, each is strength +1.
lotr12128.lore: “‘But I'm glad, Sam. I cannot tell you how glad. Come along! It is plain that we were meant to go together.'”

lotr12129.name: Rosie Cotton, Barmaid
lotr12129.subtitle: Barmaid
lotr12129.game_text: Sam cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns Rosie Cotton to a skirmish, add 2 burdens.
lotr12129.lore: “‘It seems she didn't like my going abroad at all....'”

lotr12130.name: Simple Living
lotr12130.game_text: Response: If you play a [SHIRE] event, discard this condition to heal each Hobbit.
lotr12130.lore: “They do not and did not understand or like machines more complicated than a forge-bellows, a water-mill, or a hand-loom....”

lotr12131.name: Stand Together
lotr12131.game_text: Each time a Hobbit wins a skirmish, he or she gains muster until the end of the turn. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
lotr12131.lore: “‘For a breathless time they sat there, silent and alert...'”

lotr12132.name: Sudden Fury
lotr12132.game_text: Each time a [SHIRE] companion loses a skirmish, add a [SHIRE] token here. Skirmish: Remove a [SHIRE] token from here to make a [SHIRE] companion strength +1.
lotr12132.lore: “It raised a whip a second time, but the blow never fell.”

lotr12133.name: Tolman Cotton, Farmer of Bywater
lotr12133.subtitle: Farmer of Bywater
lotr12133.game_text: Response: If a burden is about to be added by a Shadow card, spot another Hobbit and exert Tolman Cotton to prevent that.
lotr12133.lore: “The land was rich and kindly, and though it had been long deserted when they entered it, it had before been well tilled....”

lotr12134.name: Advancing Uruk
lotr12134.game_text: Damage +1. Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) When you cannot spot another [URUK-HAI] minion, discard this minion.
lotr12134.lore: “‘Already they are scaling the bank at many points, thick as marching ants.'”

lotr12135.name: Barbaric Uruk
lotr12135.game_text: Damage +1. Assignment: Make the Free Peoples player assign this minion to an unwounded companion.
lotr12135.lore: Their lust for Man-flesh allowed Saruman to bend the Uruk-hai to his will.

lotr12136.name: Berserker Torch
lotr12136.game_text: Toil 1. (For each [URUK-HAI] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -1) Bearer must be an [URUK-HAI] Uruk-hai. Bearer is strength +2 for each wound on each character in its skirmish.
lotr12136.lore: “‘...the Orcs have brought a devilry from Orthanc....'”

lotr12137.name: Breeding Pit Conscript
lotr12137.game_text: Damage +1. Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) When you play this minion, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.
lotr12137.lore: A select few of Saruman's Uruk-hai were charged with harvesting his war-machine.

lotr12138.name: Broken Heirloom
lotr12138.game_text: Toil 2. (For each [URUK-HAI] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2) Spot an [URUK-HAI] minion to discard a possession borne by a companion who has resistance 4 or less.
lotr12138.lore: “‘...he blew the horn. But no help came. Only more orcs.'”

lotr12139.name: Broken in Defeat
lotr12139.game_text: Make an [URUK-HAI] minion strength +2. Then you may spot 6 companions to return this event to your hand.
lotr12139.lore: “‘The world of Men will fall and all will come to darkness, and my city to ruin.'”

lotr12140.name: Crushing Uruk
lotr12140.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Response: If a companion loses a skirmish involving an [URUK-HAI] minion, exert this minion to discard a possession borne by that companion.

lotr12141.name: Dark Alliance
lotr12141.game_text: Response: If an ally or companion uses a special ability, discard this condition and exert an [URUK-HAI] lurker to prevent that.
lotr12141.lore: “The power of Isengard is at your command, Sauron, Lord of the Earth.”

lotr12142.name: Merciless Uruk
lotr12142.game_text: Damage +1. Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may spot a companion who has resistance 4 or less to place this minion on the bottom of your draw deck.
lotr12142.lore: “They reached the summit of the rock; they drove towards the gates.”

lotr12143.name: Quelling Force
lotr12143.game_text: Make an [URUK-HAI] minion strength +1 for each other [URUK-HAI] minion you can spot.
lotr12143.lore: “They gained the gates. The trees, swung by strong arms, smote the timbers with a rending boom.”

lotr12144.name: Saruman, Agent of the Dark Lord
lotr12144.subtitle: Agent of the Dark Lord
lotr12144.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Skirmish: Exert Saruman to make an [URUK-HAI] minion strength +2. Each time a companion is killed, you may heal Saruman.
lotr12144.lore: “‘There will be no dawn for Men.'”

lotr12145.name: Shingle in a Storm
lotr12145.game_text: While you can spot 6 companions, each [URUK-HAI] minion is damage +1. Assignment: Discard this condition to assign an [URUK-HAI] minion to a companion who has resistance 2 or less.
lotr12145.lore: “Against the Deeping Wall the hosts of Isengard roared like a sea.”

lotr12146.name: Strange Device
lotr12146.game_text: Spot an [URUK-HAI] minion to draw 3 cards. Then discard 2 cards from hand or discard an [URUK-HAI] minion from hand.
lotr12146.lore: “...a small white hand in the centre of a black field.”

lotr12147.name: Suppressing Uruk
lotr12147.game_text: Damage +1. While there is a companion in the dead pile, each unbound companion is resistance -4.
lotr12147.lore: Few fighters are skilled enough to outstrip the natural instincts of the Uruk-hai.

lotr12148.name: Tempest of War
lotr12148.game_text: While you can spot an [URUK-HAI] minion, each unbound companion is resistance -1 for each condition he or she bears. Skirmish: Spot an [URUK-HAI] minion and a companion who has resistance 2 or less to discard from play all conditions in all player's support areas.

lotr12149.name: Uruk Common
lotr12149.game_text: Damage +1. Each time this minion is assigned to a skirmish, if it is not at a battleground site, remove (2) or discard this minion.
lotr12149.lore: Casualties of war were neither honored nor remembered by the White Hand.

lotr12150.name: Uruk Decimator
lotr12150.game_text: While this minion is at a battleground site, it is strength +2. While this minion is bearing a possession, it is damage +1.
lotr12150.lore: “The barricade was scattered as if by a thunderbolt.”

lotr12151.name: Uruk Desecrator
lotr12151.game_text: Damage +1. Each unbound companion is resistance -2 for each wound he or she has.
lotr12151.lore: Madness is seldom considered a liability, but a requisite in the ranks of the Uruk-hai.

lotr12152.name: Uruk Dominator
lotr12152.game_text: Damage +1. Skirmish: Exert this minion to make it strength +1 for each [URUK-HAI] Uruk-hai you spot (or +2 for each if you can spot a companion who has resistance 3 or less).
lotr12152.lore: The Great Orc race revels in its ability to overwhelm an enemy.

lotr12153.name: Uruk Pikeman
lotr12153.game_text: Damage +1. While this minion is skirmishing an exhausted companion, this minion is strength +3 (or +5 if that companion has resistance 4 or less).
lotr12153.lore: “The dark tide flowed up to the walls from cliff to cliff.”

lotr12154.name: Uruk Slaughterer
lotr12154.game_text: Damage +1. Each time a companion is killed in a skirmish involving an [URUK-HAI] minion, you may discard any number of cards from hand to draw the same number of cards.
lotr12154.lore: Captives of the Uruk-hai are treated with brutality and malice, but only if they survive their capture.

lotr12155.name: Uruk Zealot
lotr12155.game_text: Damage +1. To play, spot an [URUK-HAI] minion. Each companion who has resistance 0 is strength -3. Each time Uruk Zealot wins a skirmish, you may draw 3 cards.
lotr12155.lore: The Uruk-hai do not question the authority of the White Hand. They know its cause is righteous.

lotr12156.name: Uruk-hai Guard
lotr12156.game_text: Damage +1. Assignment: Exert this minion and spot a companion to prevent the Free Peoples player from assigning that companion to this minion.
lotr12156.lore: “‘Wolves and orcs were housed in Isengard, for Saruman was mustering a great force....'”

lotr12157.name: Uruk-hai Troop
lotr12157.game_text: Damage +1. Each character skirmishing this minion looses all strength bonuses from weapons.
lotr12157.lore: Attacking in swarming hordes, the Uruk-hai close with the enemy rapidly to make weapons useless.

lotr12158.name: Vicious Uruk
lotr12158.game_text: Damage +1. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may draw a card for each wound on a character it is skirmishing.
lotr12158.lore: “...the sweet grass of Rohan had been bruised and blackened as they passed.”

lotr12159.name: Weapon of Opportunity
lotr12159.game_text: Bearer must be an [URUK-HAI] minion. When you play this possession on a minion that has twilight cost of 4 or more, draw a card.
lotr12159.lore: The fighting Uruk-hai will use any resource available to carry out the will of Saruman.

lotr12160.name: Worthy of Mordor
lotr12160.game_text: At the start of the regroup phase, you may remove (1) to make an [URUK-HAI] minion gain muster until the end of the regroup phase. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
lotr12160.lore: Tasked by Sauron, Saruman moved swiftly to build the army demanded of him.

lotr12161.name: Black Rider
lotr12161.game_text: Fierce. This minion is strength +1 for each companion you can spot.
lotr12161.lore: “‘The Nine are abroad again. They have crossed the River secretly and are moving westward. They have taken the guise of riders in black.'”

lotr12162.name: Dark Approach
lotr12162.game_text: Play a Nazgul. His twilight cost is -1 for each forest site you can spot (limit -4).
lotr12162.lore: “Frodo hesitated for a second: curiosity or some other feeling was struggling with his desire to hide.”

lotr12163.name: Dark Temptation
lotr12163.game_text: Each time you play a Nazgul, you may heal the Ring-bearer twice to add a burden.
lotr12163.lore: “He felt that he had only to slip it on, and then he would be safe.”

lotr12164.name: Echo of Hooves
lotr12164.game_text: Toil 2. (For each [WRAITH] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2) Spot your Nazgul at a battleground or forest site to play a mount on him from your draw deck.
lotr12164.lore: “...the black horses leaped down the hill in pursuit, and from the Riders came a terrible cry....”

lotr12165.name: In the Ringwraith's Wake
lotr12165.game_text: If a Nazgul wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player chooses to either exert the Ring-bearer or add a burden.
lotr12165.lore: “‘He is fading.... We must get him to my father.'”

lotr12166.name: Lingering Shadow
lotr12166.game_text: Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a character skirmishing a Nazgul. Each time a wound is removed from bearer, add a burden.
lotr12166.lore: “‘I am wounded... wounded; it will never really heal.'”

lotr12167.name: Minas Morgul Answers
lotr12167.game_text: Toil 2. (For each [WRAITH] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2) Spot a Nazgul to discard a Free Peoples condition from play.
lotr12167.lore: “There was a flare of livid lightnings: forks of blue flame springing up from the tower and from the encircling hills into the sullen clouds.”

lotr12168.name: Nazgul Blade
lotr12168.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. While bearer is at a battleground or forest site, he is strength +1.
lotr12168.lore: Fear and terror may be the greatest weapons the Nazgûl wield, but their steel is just as perilous.

lotr12169.name: Sauron's Gaze
lotr12169.game_text: Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a character skirmishing a Nazgul. The Free Peoples player cannot use bearer's special abilities.
lotr12169.lore: “‘Then suddenly he seemed to see me, and he laughed at me. It was cruel. It was like being stabbed with knives.'”

lotr12170.name: Sense of Obligation
lotr12170.game_text: To play, spot a [WRAITH] minion. Bearer must be an unbound companion. Limit 1 per bearer. At the end of each assignment phase, if bearer is not assigned to a skirmish and a companion who does not bear a [WRAITH] condition is, add a burden.

lotr12171.name: Shadowy Mount
lotr12171.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. While bearer is at a battleground or forest site, he is fierce. Assignment: Make the Free Peoples player assign bearer to an unbound companion bearing a [WRAITH] condition.
lotr12171.lore: “‘...why do these black horses endure such riders?'”

lotr12172.name: Steed of Mordor
lotr12172.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. Bearer gains muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may draw 2 cards.
lotr12172.lore: “...the Black Riders rode like a gale....”

lotr12173.name: Ulaire Attea, Black Predator
lotr12173.subtitle: Black Predator
lotr12173.game_text: Fierce. Skirmish: Remove (2) and discard a [WRAITH] card from hand to make Ulaire Attea strength +3.
lotr12173.lore: “Frodo thought that he heard a faint hiss as of venomous breath and felt a thin piercing chill.”

lotr12174.name: Ulaire Cantea, Black Assassin
lotr12174.subtitle: Black Assassin
lotr12174.game_text: Fierce. Assignment: Assign Ulaire Cantea to a companion who has resistance 0. Skirmish: Spot 6 companions and another [WRAITH] card to kill a companion Ulaire Cantea is skirmishing.
lotr12174.lore: “‘Flee them! Speak no words to them! They are deadly.'”

lotr12175.name: Ulaire Enquea, Black Threat
lotr12175.subtitle: Black Threat
lotr12175.game_text: Fierce.Toil 1. (For each [WRAITH] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -1) Response: If you are playing a [WRAITH] event that has toil X, exert Ulaire Enquea to reduce that event's twilight cost by X.
lotr12175.lore: “‘...the Shire is no longer any protection to you.'”

lotr12176.name: Ulaire Lemenya, Black Enemy
lotr12176.subtitle: Black Enemy
lotr12176.game_text: When you play Ulaire Lemenya, you may play a [WRAITH] mount from your discard pile.
lotr12176.lore: “Out of the gate in the trees that they had just left rode a Black Rider.”

lotr12177.name: Ulaire Nelya, Black Hunter
lotr12177.subtitle: Black Hunter
lotr12177.game_text: Fierce. Each time Ulaire Nelya wins a skirmish, you may draw a card.
lotr12177.lore: “‘...peril is now both before you and behind you, and upon either side.'”

lotr12178.name: Ulaire Nertea, Black Horseman
lotr12178.subtitle: Black Horseman
lotr12178.game_text: The twilight cost of each mount is -1. While Ulaire Nertea is mounted, each Nazgul is strength +1 and has muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)
lotr12178.lore: “‘Watch every shadow! ...Black horsemen have passed through Bree.'”

lotr12179.name: Ulaire Otsea, Black Specter
lotr12179.subtitle: Black Specter
lotr12179.game_text: Shadow: Exert Ulaire Otsea and discard a [WRAITH] condition from hand to discard a Free Peoples condition from play.
lotr12179.lore: “‘We can feel their presence – it troubled our hearts, as soon as we came here, and before we saw them; they feel ours more keenly.'”

lotr12180.name: Ulaire Toldea, Black Shadow
lotr12180.subtitle: Black Shadow
lotr12180.game_text: Fierce. When you play Ulaire Toldea, you may exert him to take a [WRAITH] event from your discard pile into hand.
lotr12180.lore: “So black were they that they seemed like black holes in the deep shade behind them.”

lotr12181.name: Unending Life
lotr12181.game_text: While you can spot 6 companions, each Nazgul is strength +3. Skirmish: Discard this condition to heal a Nazgul.
lotr12181.lore: “‘The power of their master is in them, and they stand or fall by him.'”

lotr12182.name: Unimpeded
lotr12182.game_text: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a Nazgul strength +1 for each of the following that is true: he is at a battleground or forest site; he is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less; he is bearing a possession; he is in a fierce skirmish.

lotr12183.name: The Witch-king, Black Lord
lotr12183.subtitle: Black Lord
lotr12183.game_text: Fierce. The Witch-King is twilight cost -1 for each wound on the Ring-bearer. Each time a companion is played, you may reveal this card from hand to exert the Ring-bearer.
lotr12183.lore: “He sprang forward and bore down on Frodo.”

lotr12184.name: The Witch-king's Beast, Fell Creature
lotr12184.subtitle: Fell Creature
lotr12184.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. If bearer is The Witch-king, after all skirmishes and fierce skirmishes have been resolved, you may exert him twice to make him participate in one additional assignment and skirmish phase.
lotr12184.lore: “The great shadow descended like a falling cloud.”

lotr12185.name: The Angle
lotr12185.game_text: Forest. Shadow: Play a Nazgul (or spot 6 companions and discard 2 cards from hand) to draw a card.

lotr12186.name: The Bridge of Khazad-dum
lotr12186.game_text: Battleground. Underground. The Balrog is twilight cost -3.

lotr12187.name: Emyn Muil
lotr12187.game_text: Mountain. Maneuver: Remove 2 and exert your minion that is not fierce to make that minion fierce until the regroup phase.

lotr12188.name: Hill of Sight
lotr12188.game_text: Battleground. Forest. While you can spot 3 minions (or 6 companions), each unbound companion is resistance -2.

lotr12189.name: Hobbiton Market
lotr12189.game_text: Dwelling. When the fellowship moves from this site, wound each minion that is not a lurker.

lotr12190.name: Northern Pelennor
lotr12190.game_text: Battleground. Plains. Shadow: Make your lurker minion lose lurker until the regroup phase.

lotr12191.name: Shores of Nen Hithoel
lotr12191.game_text: River. Shadow: Spot 5 [ORC] Orcs to prevent the fellowship from moving again this turn.

lotr12192.name: Slopes of Orodruin
lotr12192.game_text: Mountain. Shadow: Remove 2 and discard 2 Free Peoples cards from hand to draw a card.

lotr12193.name: Starkhorn
lotr12193.game_text: Mountain. Each time your Dwarf wins a skirmish, you may draw a card.

lotr12194.name: Wold Battlefield
lotr12194.game_text: Plains. Skirmish: Exert your Man (except an enduring Man) to make him or her damage +1.

lotr13001.name: Celeborn, The Wise
lotr13001.subtitle: The Wise
lotr13001.game_text: While the fellowship is at a forest site, each Elf who has resistance 7 or more gains muster. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may take an [ELVEN] event into hand from your discard pile.
lotr13001.lore: “‘I did not know that your plight was so evil.'”

lotr13002.name: Galadriel, Sorceress of the Hidden Land
lotr13002.subtitle: Sorceress of the Hidden Land
lotr13002.game_text: To play, spot 3 Elves. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may reveal a card from the top of your draw deck for each forest on the adventure path to heal an Elf for each [ELVEN] card revealed.
lotr13002.lore: “‘Do not let your hearts be troubled....'”

lotr13003.name: Legolas, of the Grey Company
lotr13003.subtitle: of the Grey Company
lotr13003.game_text: Archer. At the start of each archery phase, you may reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [ELVEN] card, wound a minion.
lotr13003.lore: “‘My heart bids me go on... but we must hold together. I will follow your counsel.'”

lotr13004.name: Gandalf, Bearer of Obligation
lotr13004.subtitle: Bearer of Obligation
lotr13004.game_text: While Gandalf is the Ring-bearer, each time the fellowship moves, add 3 burdens unless you spot 2 other companions and discard 2 [GANDALF] cards from hand.
lotr13004.lore: “‘But all worthy things that are in peril as the world now stands, those are my care.'”

lotr13005.name: Pallando, Far-travelling One
lotr13005.subtitle: Far-travelling One
lotr13005.game_text: Aid - (2). Each time you transfer this to a companion, except a [GANDALF] companion, exert bearer twice. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may discard a condition from play.
lotr13005.lore: Brought as a companion by Alatar, he traveled the South and East to aid the Free Peoples.

lotr13006.name: Deagol, Fateful Finder
lotr13006.subtitle: Fateful Finder
lotr13006.game_text: To play, spot Smeagol. Aid - Add a burden. Skirmish: If bearer is not assigned to a skirmish, discard this from play to play an artifact or possession from your draw deck on bearer.
lotr13006.lore: “‘...there in his hand lay a beautiful golden ring.'”

lotr13007.name: Aragorn, Isildur's Heir
lotr13007.subtitle: Isildur's Heir
lotr13007.game_text: Aragorn is strength +1 for each [GONDOR] card that has a culture token on it. At the start of each assignment phase, you may exert Aragorn to make an unbound companion that has resistance 7 or more defender +1 until the regroup phase.
lotr13007.lore: “Thus came Aragorn, son of Arathorn, Elessar....”

lotr13008.name: Denethor, Last Ruling Steward
lotr13008.subtitle: Last Ruling Steward
lotr13008.game_text: Denethor is resistance +1 for each [GONDOR] possession in your discard pile. Maneuver: Spot a [GONDOR] possession borne by a companion and remove that possession from the game to exert a minion twice.
lotr13008.lore: “...he took up the staff of his Stewardship that lay at his feet and broke it on his knee.”

lotr13009.name: Voice of the Desert, Southron Troop
lotr13009.subtitle: Southron Troop
lotr13009.game_text: To play, spot a [MEN] minion. While the fellowship is in region 1, each [MEN] minion cannot take wounds. While the fellowship is in region 2, each [MEN] minion is an archer. While the fellowship is in region 3, each [MEN] minion is fierce.

lotr13010.name: Chamber Patrol
lotr13010.game_text: To play, spot an [ORC] minion. While the fellowship is in region 1, [ORC] Orcs cannot take wounds. While the fellowship is in region 2, the current site gains underground. While the fellowship is in region 3, each [ORC] Orc is strength +2.

lotr13011.name: Orc Crusher
lotr13011.game_text: To play, spot an [ORC] Orc. This minion is twilight cost -1 for each burden. Each time a Ring-bound companion loses a skirmish involving an [ORC] minion, you may reveal this card from hand to add a burden.

lotr13012.name: Eomer, Heir to Meduseld
lotr13012.subtitle: Heir to Meduseld
lotr13012.game_text: While Eomer bears a mount, he is damage +1. While no other companion is assigned to a skirmish, Eomer is strength +1 for each other [ROHAN] companion you can spot.
lotr13012.lore: “‘I have no child. Théodred my son is slain. I name Éomer my sister-son to be my heir.'”

lotr13013.name: Theoden, The Renowned
lotr13013.subtitle: The Renowned
lotr13013.game_text: While you can spot Eowyn, Theoden is defender +1. While you can spot Eomer, Theoden is damage +1. While you can spot Theodred, the move limit is +1.
lotr13013.lore: “‘Let horse be bridled, horn be sounded!'”

lotr13014.name: Sauron, Dark Lord of Mordor
lotr13014.subtitle: Dark Lord of Mordor
lotr13014.game_text: Damage +1. Fierce. When you play Sauron, you may exert any number of minions. For each minion you exert, Sauron is twilight cost -X, where X is the current region number.

lotr13015.name: Frodo, Frenzied Fighter
lotr13015.subtitle: Frenzied Fighter
lotr13015.game_text: Ring-bound. While you can spot more minions than companions, Frodo cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled. Skirmish: If Frodo is not assigned to a skirmish, exert Frodo to have him replace a Ring-bound companion skirmishing a minion.

lotr13016.name: Sam, Bearer of Great Need
lotr13016.subtitle: Bearer of Great Need
lotr13016.game_text: Ring-bound. Sam is resistance +1 for each Hobbit you can spot. Regroup: Exert Sam and transfer a follower he is bearing to your support area to discard a minion from play.
lotr13016.lore: “‘...the last of all the Company. The errand must not fail.'”

lotr13017.name: Uruk Blitz
lotr13017.game_text: To play, spot an [URUK-HAI] minion. While the fellowship is in region 1, each Uruk-hai is damage +1. While the fellowship is in region 2, each companion is strength -1. While the fellowship is in region 3, each unbound companion is resistance -2.

lotr13018.name: Uruk Rogue
lotr13018.game_text: Damage +1. Skirmish: If no other minions are assigned to a skirmish, you may exert this minion twice to make it fierce and strength +4 until the regroup phase.
lotr13018.lore: Some minions prefer to fight alone.

lotr13019.name: Let Fly
lotr13019.game_text: Spot 3 Elves, spot a Shadow race, and choose a Shadow player to wound each of that player?s minions which is not of that race.
lotr13019.lore: “‘Yet I make my tale twenty at the least. But that is only a few leaves in a forest.'”

lotr13020.name: Lorien Protector
lotr13020.game_text: While another companion is assigned to a skirmish, during each skirmish, prevent all wounds to this companion after the first wound.
lotr13020.lore: “There was a sound of soft laughter over their heads, and then another clear voice spoke in an elven-tongue.”

lotr13021.name: Many Miles
lotr13021.game_text: Spot 2 Elf archers to make the fellowship archery total +1 (or +2 if a Shadow player has replaced the fellowship?s current site this turn).
lotr13021.lore: “‘I can see a darkness. There are shapes moving in it, great shapes far away upon the bank of the river; but what they are I cannot tell.'”

lotr13022.name: Secluded Homestead
lotr13022.game_text: To play, spot 2 Elves. When you play this, add an [ELVEN] token here for each forest site and each river site on the adventure path. Regroup: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to reconcile your hand.

lotr13023.name: Shrouded Elf
lotr13023.game_text: Response: If you play an event during a skirmish involving this companion, exert this companion to place that event on top of your draw deck.
lotr13023.lore: Cloaked by Elven garments and by darkness, warriors led by Haldir reinforced Helm's Deep.

lotr13024.name: Sprang Forth Nimbly
lotr13024.game_text: Make an Elf strength +1 for each card that has an [ELVEN] token on it.
lotr13024.lore: “...the Elf had no boots, but wore only light shoes, as he always did....”

lotr13025.name: Standing Tall
lotr13025.game_text: Skirmish: Discard this condition from play to make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -1 for each of the following that is true: it is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or more; it is wounded; you can spot an Elf archer; the fellowship is at a forest site.
lotr13025.lore: “‘Yrch,' said Legolas, falling into his own tongue.”

lotr13026.name: Take Up the Bow
lotr13026.game_text: Toil 2. (For each [ELVEN] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Archery: Discard this from play and spot 3 Elf archers to discard a minion from play. Each of those archers loses archer and cannot gain archer.
lotr13026.lore: “Stringing the bow and fitting an arrow....”

lotr13027.name: Wells of Deep Memory
lotr13027.game_text: At the end of your turn, discard this from play if the fellowship did not move more than once this turn. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may draw a card for each of the following you can spot: Arwen, Celeborn, or Galadriel.

lotr13028.name: Alatar, Final Envoy
lotr13028.subtitle: Final Envoy
lotr13028.game_text: Aid - (2). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (2) to transfer this to a companion.) Each time you transfer this to a companion, you may reinforce a [GANDALF] token. While you can spot a [GANDALF] companion, each minion skirmishing bearer is strength -1.
lotr13028.lore: Third of the Istari to be named, he was clad in sea-blue.

lotr13029.name: Dasron, Merchant from Dorwinion
lotr13029.subtitle: Merchant from Dorwinion
lotr13029.game_text: At the start of the fellowship phase, you may remove 2 Free Peoples culture tokens to take a [GANDALF] event into hand from your discard pile.
lotr13029.lore: ...its inhabitants, traditional trading partners of Esgaroth and Dale, now look to their northern allies for protection against the wild Easterlings....

lotr13030.name: Fear and Great Wonder
lotr13030.game_text: When you play this, add a [GANDALF] token here. Maneuver: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to spot a [GANDALF] companion. That companion gains muster until end of turn.
lotr13030.lore: “The Hosts of Isengard roared, swaying this way and that, turning from fear to fear.”

lotr13031.name: The Flame of Anor
lotr13031.game_text: Spell. Spot 3 [GANDALF] companions to make a minion skirmishing a companion strength -3.
lotr13031.lore: The power of the flame is like that of the Sun – beautiful yet blinding.

lotr13032.name: For a While Less Dark
lotr13032.game_text: Spell. Make a [GANDALF] companion strength +2 (or +4 if that companion bears a follower).
lotr13032.lore: “The Nazgûl gave a long wailing cry and swerved away; and with that the four others waivered....”

lotr13033.name: Gandalf, Bearer of Obligation
lotr13033.subtitle: Bearer of Obligation
lotr13033.game_text: While Gandalf is the Ring-bearer, each time the fellowship moves, add 3 burdens unless you spot 2 other companions and discard 2 [GANDALF] cards from hand.
lotr13033.lore: “‘But all worthy things that are in peril as the world now stands, those are my care.'”

lotr13034.name: Look to My Coming
lotr13034.game_text: You may remove from the game 4 other [GANDALF] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game. Spot Gandalf to make your [GANDALF] companion strength +3.

lotr13035.name: No Colour Now
lotr13035.game_text: Discard your [GANDALF] condition from play to discard a condition from play and draw a card.
lotr13035.lore: “He raised his hand, and spoke slowly in a clear cold voice. ‘Saruman, your staff is broken.'”

lotr13036.name: The Palantir of Orthanc, Recovered Seeing Stone
lotr13036.subtitle: Recovered Seeing Stone
lotr13036.game_text: Bearer must be Gandalf. To play this, if you can spot The Palantir of Orthanc, discard it. At the start of the fellowship phase, you may add a burden to reveal a Shadow player's hand. He or she must choose a revealed minion and discard it from hand.
lotr13036.lore: “...a heavy shining thing came hurtling down from above.”

lotr13037.name: Pallando, Far-travelling One
lotr13037.subtitle: Far-travelling One
lotr13037.game_text: Aid - (2). Each time you transfer this to a companion, except a [GANDALF] companion, exert bearer twice. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may discard a condition from play.
lotr13037.lore: Brought as a companion by Alatar, he traveled the South and East to aid the Free Peoples.

lotr13038.name: Radagast, Tender of Beasts
lotr13038.subtitle: Tender of Beasts
lotr13038.game_text: Aid - (2). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (2) to transfer this to a companion.) While you can spot 2 [GANDALF] companions, minions skirmishing bearer do not gain strength bonuses from possessions.
lotr13038.lore: “‘It would have been useless in any case to try and win over the honest Radagast to treachery.'”

lotr13039.name: Return to Us
lotr13039.game_text: Discard 2 Shadow cards from hand to take a [GANDALF] event into hand from your discard pile.
lotr13039.lore: “‘Yes, that was the name. I was Gandalf.'”

lotr13040.name: Shadowfax, Roaring Wind
lotr13040.subtitle: Roaring Wind
lotr13040.game_text: Bearer must be a Wizard. When you play Shadowfax, you may reinforce a [GANDALF] token. Skirmish: Remove 2 [GANDALF] tokens to wound a minion skirmishing bearer.
lotr13040.lore: “Then Shadowfax gathered himself together and sprang away, and the night flowed over him....”

lotr13041.name: Strange Meeting
lotr13041.game_text: Each companion bearing a follower gains muster (and is strength +1 if that companion is a [GANDALF] companion).
lotr13041.lore: “‘Gandalf obviously expected to find Treebeard here; and Treebeard might almost have been loitering about near the gates on purpose to meet him.'”

lotr13042.name: Traveler's Homestead
lotr13042.game_text: To play, spot a Wizard. When you play this, add X [GANDALF] tokens here, where X is the current region number. Maneuver: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to discard a Shadow condition from play.
lotr13042.lore: Of the Wizards, it was Gandalf that chose no home.

lotr13043.name: Vapour and Steam
lotr13043.game_text: Skirmish: Exert your [GANDALF] companion and add a burden to make that companion damage +1.
lotr13043.lore: “‘There was none to see, or perhaps in after ages songs would still be sung of the Battle of the Peak.'”

lotr13044.name: Chasm's Edge
lotr13044.game_text: Gollum is strength +1 for each Ring-bound companion you can spot.
