lotr13044.lore: “...Gollum, dancing like a mad thing, held aloft the ring... It shown now as if verily it was wrought of living fire.”

lotr13045.name: Cunningly Hidden
lotr13045.game_text: You may remove from the game 4 [GOLLUM] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card. Spot Gollum to make a minion strength +2.
lotr13045.lore: “‘No one ever found out what had become of Déagol....'”

lotr13046.name: Deagol, Fateful Finder
lotr13046.subtitle: Fateful Finder
lotr13046.game_text: To play, spot Smeagol. Aid - Add a burden. Skirmish: If bearer is not assigned to a skirmish, discard this from play to play an artifact or possession from your draw deck on bearer.
lotr13046.lore: “‘...there in his hand lay a beautiful golden ring.'”

lotr13047.name: Duality
lotr13047.game_text: Spot Smeagol to choose a Shadow player who must discard a Shadow card from hand or remove (2).
lotr13047.lore: Gollum had two loyalties: The Ring and The Ring.

lotr13048.name: Fishing Boat
lotr13048.game_text: Bearer must be Smeagol. When you play Fishing Boat, you may reinforce a [GOLLUM] token. Each time Smeagol is about to be overwhelmed in a skirmish, you may remove 2 [GOLLUM] tokens to make him strength +2 until the end of that skirmish.

lotr13049.name: Gladden Homestead
lotr13049.game_text: To play, spot Smeagol. When you play this, add a [GOLLUM] token here for each [GOLLUM] card you can spot. Maneuver: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to spot a Shadow condition and place that condition on top of its owner?s draw deck.

lotr13050.name: Gollum, Her Sneak
lotr13050.subtitle: Her Sneak
lotr13050.game_text: While a card titled Deagol is removed from the game, Gollum is strength +2 and fierce. Shadow: Remove a card titled Deagol in your discard pile from the game to play this minion from your discard pile.
lotr13050.lore: “Of that deadly gleam and of the dark eyeholes Frodo and Sam were always conscious.”

lotr13051.name: It's My Birthday
lotr13051.game_text: Make Gollum strength +2 (or +4 if you can spot Smeagol or Deagol).

lotr13052.name: Little Snuffler
lotr13052.game_text: If the fellowship is in region 1, spot Gollum to wound a companion. If the fellowship is in region 2, spot Gollum to exert a companion. If the fellowship is in region 3, play a [GOLLUM] minion from your discard pile.

lotr13053.name: Naked Waste
lotr13053.game_text: You may remove from the game 4 other [GOLLUM] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game. Spot Smeagol to make a Ring-bound companion strength +3.
lotr13053.lore: “‘Nothing can hide from them. Curse the White Face!'”

lotr13054.name: Out of All Knowledge
lotr13054.game_text: Spot Smeagol or exert Gollum to make Smeagol strength +2 and you may reinforce a [GOLLUM] token.
lotr13054.lore: “‘And he thought suddenly: “It would be cool and shady under those mountains. The Sun could not watch me there.”'”

lotr13055.name: Smeagol, Simple Stoor
lotr13055.subtitle: Simple Stoor
lotr13055.game_text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. For each card titled Deagol in your discard pile, Smeagol is strength +2 and resistance -1. Each time Smeagol wins a skirmish, you may take a [GOLLUM] card from your draw deck and place it in your discard pile.
lotr13055.lore: “‘...his head and his eyes were downward.'”

lotr13056.name: Softly Up Behind
lotr13056.game_text: Spot Smeagol and discard 2 [GOLLUM] cards from hand to return a minion with strength 6 or less to its owner?s hand. While this is in your discard pile, Smeagol gains muster.
lotr13056.lore: “‘The Ring went into the shadows with him, and even the maker... could learn nothing of it.'”

lotr13057.name: Trap Is Sprung
lotr13057.game_text: To play, discard Gollum from play. Heal the Ring-bearer to add a burden. If the fellowship is not in region 1, you may repeat this for each other wound on the Ring-bearer.
lotr13057.lore: “‘Crumbs on his jacket. He took it. He took it!'”

lotr13058.name: Wild Light of Madness
lotr13058.game_text: Spot Gollum to make the Free Peoples player choose to either add a burden or exert a companion.
lotr13058.lore: “...for at that moment many things happened.”

lotr13059.name: Aragorn, Isildur's Heir
lotr13059.subtitle: Isildur's Heir
lotr13059.game_text: Aragorn is strength +1 for each [GONDOR] card that has a culture token on it. At the start of each assignment phase, you may exert Aragorn to make an unbound companion that has resistance 7 or more defender +1 until the regroup phase.
lotr13059.lore: “Thus came Aragorn, son of Arathorn, Elessar....”

lotr13060.name: Away on the Wind
lotr13060.game_text: Response: If Faramir is about to take a wound, discard this condition from play and place Boromir or Denethor in the dead pile from play to prevent that and heal Faramir twice.
lotr13060.lore: “‘...then I will have naught: neither life diminished, nor love halved, nor honour abated.'”

lotr13061.name: Banners Blowing
lotr13061.game_text: You may remove from the game 4 other [GONDOR] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game. Make your [GONDOR] Man strength +3.
lotr13061.lore: “And so... with less than six thousands... the Captains of the West came at last to challenge the Black Gate....”

lotr13062.name: Boromir, Doomed Heir
lotr13062.subtitle: Doomed Heir
lotr13062.game_text: Boromir is resistance -1 for each lurker minion you can spot. Skirmish: Exert Boromir to make him strength +1 for each possession he bears.
lotr13062.lore: “‘I shall go to Minas Tirith, alone if need be, for it is my duty.'”

lotr13063.name: Brego, Loyal Steed
lotr13063.subtitle: Loyal Steed
lotr13063.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] companion. When you play Brego, you may reinforce a [GONDOR] token. Maneuver: Exert bearer and remove 2 [GONDOR] tokens to wound a minion.
lotr13063.lore: “‘Turn this fellow free. He has seen enough of war.'”

lotr13064.name: Denethor, Last Ruling Steward
lotr13064.subtitle: Last Ruling Steward
lotr13064.game_text: Denethor is resistance +1 for each [GONDOR] possession in your discard pile. Maneuver: Spot a [GONDOR] possession borne by a companion and remove that possession from the game to exert a minion twice.
lotr13064.lore: “...he took up the staff of his Stewardship that lay at his feet and broke it on his knee.”

lotr13065.name: Elendil, High-king of Gondor
lotr13065.subtitle: High-king of Gondor
lotr13065.game_text: Knight. To play, spot 2 [GONDOR] knights or exert 2 [GONDOR] Men. Each of your [GONDOR] companions is resistance +1. Maneuver: Remove a [GONDOR] token to make an unbound companion resistance +1 until the regroup phase.
lotr13065.lore: “‘...and Elendil of Westernesse who overthrew Sauron....'”

lotr13066.name: Faramir, Prince of Ithilien
lotr13066.subtitle: Prince of Ithilien
lotr13066.game_text: While you can spot Boromir, Faramir is twilight cost -1. While you can spot Denethor, Faramir is twilight cost -1. While Faramir bears a [GONDOR] possession, he is defender +1.
lotr13066.lore: “‘Do you wish then... that our places had been exchanged?'”

lotr13067.name: Guard of the White Tree
lotr13067.game_text: Knight. Skirmish: Discard a [GONDOR] condition from your support area to make this companion strength +2.
lotr13067.lore: “This was the livery of the heirs of Elendil, and none wore it now in all Gondor, save the Guards of the Citadel....”

lotr13068.name: Guarded City
lotr13068.game_text: Spot a [GONDOR] companion to reinforce a [GONDOR] token for each possession borne by that companion.
lotr13068.lore: “...so strong and old that it seemed to have been not builded but carven by giants out of the bones of the earth.”

lotr13069.name: Heirs of Gondor
lotr13069.game_text: When you play this, add a [GONDOR] token here. Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to make a [GONDOR] companion bearing a hand weapon strength +2.
lotr13069.lore: “‘And Eldarion our son is a man full-ripe for kingship.'”

lotr13070.name: Hope Renewed
lotr13070.game_text: Discard a [GONDOR] possession from play to discard a possession from play and you may reinforce a [GONDOR] token.
lotr13070.lore: “...Frodo saw the old king's head: it was lying rolled away by the roadside... ‘Look! The king has got a crown again!'”

lotr13071.name: Isildur, Heir of Elendil
lotr13071.subtitle: Heir of Elendil
lotr13071.game_text: Knight. Isildur is resistance +1 for each card in your hand. At the end of any phase, if Isildur has resistance 0, place him in your dead pile. Each time you reconcile, you may draw a card.
lotr13071.lore: “‘...Elendil's son cut the Ring from Sauron's hand....'”

lotr13072.name: Kings' Legacy
lotr13072.game_text: Each time Elendil wins a skirmish, make a [GONDOR] or [ELVEN] companion strength +2 until the start of the regroup phase. Each time Isildur wins a skirmish, heal a Man. Each time Aragorn wins a skirmish, make a [GONDOR] Man damage +1 until the start of the regroup phase.

lotr13073.name: Kingsfoil
lotr13073.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. Fellowship: Discard this possession from play to heal a companion and, if that companion is a [SHIRE] companion, you may discard a condition he or she bears.
lotr13073.lore: “‘Life to the dying / In the king's hand lying!'”

lotr13074.name: Rally the Company
lotr13074.game_text: Make a [GONDOR] companion strength +2 (or +4 if that companion has resistance 6 or more).
lotr13074.lore: Aragorn was able to keep the way open for escape from the Chamber of Mazarbul.

lotr13075.name: Stewards' Legacy
lotr13075.game_text: Each time Denethor exerts, he gains muster until the end of the regroup phase. Each time Boromir exerts, you may exert a minion. Each time Faramir exerts, you may spot a minion to prevent it from using special abilites until the regroup phase.

lotr13076.name: Storied Homestead
lotr13076.game_text: When you play this, add a [GONDOR] token here for each [GONDOR] companion who has resistance 7 or more. Response: If a minion?s special ability is used, discard this condition or remove 2 [GONDOR] tokens from here to cancel its effect.
lotr13076.lore: “...a silent company of tall images graven in cold stone.”

lotr13077.name: Tradesman From Lebennin
lotr13077.game_text: At the start of each fellowship phase, you may add (2) to reinforce a [GONDOR] token.
lotr13077.lore: Fearful of the spreading Shadow, many from southern Gondor sought refuge behind the walls of Minas Tirith.

lotr13078.name: Alatar Deceived
lotr13078.game_text: Each time a Wizard wins a skirmish, this condition becomes a fierce, damage +1 Wizard minion until the start of the regroup phase that has 11 strength and 1 vitality, and cannot take wounds or bear other cards. This card is still a condition.
lotr13078.lore: “‘...the world of Men, which We must rule.'”

lotr13079.name: Pallando Deceived
lotr13079.game_text: At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert a Wizard to make this condition a fierce Wizard minion until the start of the regroup phase that has 10 strength and 1 vitality, and cannot take wounds or bear other cards. This card is still a condition.

lotr13080.name: Radagast Deceived
lotr13080.game_text: Each time a Wizard heals, this condition becomes a fierce Wizard minion until the start of the regroup phase that has 12 strength and 1 vitality, and cannot take wounds or bear other cards. This card is still a condition.

lotr13081.name: Staff of Saruman, Fallen Istar's Stave
lotr13081.subtitle: Fallen Istar's Stave
lotr13081.game_text: Bearer must be a Wizard. Regroup: If Saruman is the only minion you can spot, discard this artifact from play to return him to your hand.
lotr13081.lore: He raised his staff and it engulfed Gandalf in flames.

lotr13082.name: Bring Down the Wall
lotr13082.game_text: Spot a companion to make a [MEN] minion strength +1 for each wound on that companion.
lotr13082.lore: “‘Helm's Deep has one weakness. Its outer wall is solid rock but for a small culvert at its base, which is little more than a drain.'”

lotr13083.name: Caravan From the South
lotr13083.game_text: To play, spot a [MEN] minion. When you play this, if you spot a plains site on the adventure path, reinforce 3 [MEN] tokens. Each time the Free Peoples player plays the fellowship?s next site, you may discard a possession from play.

lotr13084.name: Corsair Champion
lotr13084.game_text: Each time a Free Peoples possession is played, you may spot a [MEN] card and reveal this minion from hand to make the Free Peoples player exert a companion. While each companion is wounded, this minion is fierce.
lotr13084.lore: Rumor of his approach strikes terror.

lotr13085.name: Cruel Dunlending
lotr13085.game_text: Skirmish: If this minion is not assigned to a skirmish, you may exert him to make another [MEN] minion fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr13085.lore: Burning with a rage stoked by Saruman, the Wild Hillmen made the Rohirrim villagers suffer.

lotr13086.name: Desert Wind
lotr13086.game_text: To play, spot a [MEN] minion. While you can spot 5 or more culture tokens, the minion archery total is +2.
lotr13086.lore: Silent Haradrim assassins strike as if from nowhere.

lotr13087.name: Driven From the Plains
lotr13087.game_text: Skirmish: Discard this condition from play to make a [MEN] minion damage +1 for each of the following that is true: it is at a plains site; it is bearing a possession; it is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less.
lotr13087.lore: The Hillmen sent the villagers before them like lambs to the slaughter.

lotr13088.name: Dunlending Patriarch
lotr13088.game_text: When you play this, you may spot another [MEN] minion to make this minion twilight cost -1 for each wound on the Ring-bearer. While each companion is wounded, this minion is fierce.
lotr13088.lore: The wisdom of Dunland is passed from elder to youth.

lotr13089.name: Dunlending Trapper
lotr13089.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved before any others.) To play, spot a [MEN] minion. Assignment: Discard a [MEN] card from your hand to assign this minion to an unbound companion.
lotr13089.lore: His traps catch men as well as beasts.

lotr13090.name: Easterling Runner
lotr13090.game_text: Shadow: Exert this minion, spot another [MEN] minion, and remove a culture token to reinforce a [MEN] token.
lotr13090.lore: The key to coordinating the columns of the Easterling army is their use of swift couriers.

lotr13091.name: Fires Brightly Burning
lotr13091.game_text: You may remove from the game 4 [MEN] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card. Make your [MEN] minion strength +2.
lotr13091.lore: The torches of hate carried by the Dunlendings were kindled by the voice of Saruman.

lotr13092.name: Grima, Footman of Saruman
lotr13092.subtitle: Footman of Saruman
lotr13092.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Each time a Free Peoples character is killed, you may spot another [MEN] minion to exert each companion.
lotr13092.lore: “‘He was crafty: dulling men's wariness, or working on their fears, as served the occasion.'”

lotr13093.name: Harmless
lotr13093.game_text: Response: If a companion loses a skirmish involving a [MEN] minion, transfer this condition from your support area to that companion. Limit 1 per companion. Minions cannot take wounds during skirmishes involving bearer.
lotr13093.lore: The Dunlendings prey on weak village folk.

lotr13094.name: Howdah
lotr13094.game_text: When you play this, add a [MEN] token here for each [MEN] archer you spot. At the start of the archery phase, you may discard this condition from play or remove 2 tokens from here to make the minion archery total +1.
lotr13094.lore: Wooden towers perched on the backs of the Mûmakil.

lotr13095.name: Lying in Wait
lotr13095.game_text: Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to your [MEN] minion. (Limit 1 per bearer.) Bearer is strength +1 for each other [MEN] minion you can spot. Each time a [MEN] minion wins a skirmish, make bearer strength +1 until the regroup phase.

lotr13096.name: Merciless Dunlending
lotr13096.game_text: While you can spot another [MEN] minion, this minion is strength +2 for each companion assigned to a skirmish.
lotr13096.lore: Victims of the Dunlendings receive no quarter.

lotr13097.name: Pirate Cutthroat
lotr13097.game_text: To play, spot a [MEN] card in your support area. Shadow: Exert this minion and spot a Free Peoples condition to reinforce a [MEN] token for each card you spot that has the same card title as that condition.
lotr13097.lore: Prisoners are never taken by the Corsairs of Umbar.

lotr13098.name: Southron Murderer
lotr13098.game_text: Archer. While you can spot 4 or more culture tokens, this minion cannot take wounds except during skirmishes.
lotr13098.lore: In Harad, death is often swift, but seldom painless.

lotr13099.name: Stragglers
lotr13099.game_text: When you play this, add a [MEN] token here. Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to make a [MEN] minion strength +2 for each [MEN] minion not assigned to a skirmish.
lotr13099.lore: When finished ransacking a homestead, Dunlendings slaughtered fleeing villagers.

lotr13100.name: Vicious Dunlending
lotr13100.game_text: Skirmish: If this minion is not assigned to a skirmish, you may exert him to make another [MEN] minion damage +1.
lotr13100.lore: A swath of terror cut across the fields of Rohan.

lotr13101.name: Voice of the Desert, Southron Troop
lotr13101.subtitle: Southron Troop
lotr13101.game_text: To play, spot a [MEN] minion. While the fellowship is in region 1, each [MEN] minion cannot take wounds. While the fellowship is in region 2, each [MEN] minion is an archer. While the fellowship is in region 3, each [MEN] minion is fierce.

lotr13102.name: Worn Battleaxe
lotr13102.game_text: Bearer must be a [MEN] minion. While you can spot a culture token, bearer is strength +1 for each companion assigned to a skirmish.
lotr13102.lore: Arms of the Hillmen of Dunland are crude but effective.

lotr13103.name: Always Threatening
lotr13103.game_text: When you play this, you may add an [ORC] token here for each [ORC] condition you can spot. Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to make a lurker minion strength +2.

lotr13104.name: Chamber Patrol
lotr13104.game_text: To play, spot an [ORC] minion. While the fellowship is in region 1, [ORC] Orcs cannot take wounds. While the fellowship is in region 2, the current site gains underground. While the fellowship is in region 3, each [ORC] Orc is strength +2.

lotr13105.name: Defiled
lotr13105.game_text: You may remove from the game 4 [ORC] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card. Make your [ORC] lurker minion strength +2.
lotr13105.lore: ...transmogrified to trophies by the advancing hordes.

lotr13106.name: Enemy Upon Enemy
lotr13106.game_text: Regroup: Spot an [ORC] lurker minion to stack that minion here. Shadow: Remove a burden to play a lurker minion stacked here as if from hand. That minion is twilight cost -3.
lotr13106.lore: “On they came, reckless of their loss as they approached.”

lotr13107.name: Expendable Servants
lotr13107.game_text: If you can spot more [ORC] conditions than [ORC] minions, you may discard your [ORC] condition from play to play an [ORC] minion from your discard pile.
lotr13107.lore: Sauron's minions were loyal to his rule. Their loyalty was repaid in blood: the enemy's or their own.

lotr13108.name: Forced March
lotr13108.game_text: To play, spot 2 [ORC] minions. Regroup: Make the Free Peoples player spot another [ORC] condition, discard it from play, and remove (3) to make the Free Peoples player choose to move again this turn (if the move limit allows). Discard this condition.

lotr13109.name: Howling Orc
lotr13109.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved before any others.) Each time an [ORC] minion is killed in a skirmish, you may make this minion strength +2 until the regroup phase.
lotr13109.lore: Losses served only to enrage the besiegers.

lotr13110.name: Isengard Informant
lotr13110.game_text: Regroup: Exert this minion to play an [ORC] Troll from your discard pile.
lotr13110.lore: Some remained in Isengard to propel the war machine.

lotr13111.name: Massing Strength
lotr13111.game_text: Discard any number of your [ORC] minions from play to make an [ORC] minion strength +3 for each one discarded.
lotr13111.lore: “...the Dark Power, moving its armies like pieces on the board, was gathering them together.”

lotr13112.name: Orc Crusher
lotr13112.game_text: To play, spot an [ORC] Orc. This minion is twilight cost -1 for each burden. Each time a Ring-bound companion loses a skirmish involving an [ORC] minion, you may reveal this card from hand to add a burden.

lotr13113.name: Orc Line-breaker
lotr13113.game_text: At the end of each skirmish involving this minion, if you can spot a Free Peoples culture token, this minion is fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr13113.lore: Fell captains moved Sauron's forces from the Gorgoroth plains.

lotr13114.name: Orc Plains Runner
lotr13114.game_text: Regroup: Discard this minion from play (or exert this minion if the fellowship?s next site is an underground site) and spot another [ORC] minion to return that minion to your hand.
lotr13114.lore: Saruman unleashed the remaining minions to ravage the countryside of Rohan.

lotr13115.name: Orc Raid Commander
lotr13115.game_text: To play, spot an [ORC] card in your support area. When you play this, spot a Free Peoples condition to discard from play each other card that has the same card title as that condition.
lotr13115.lore: Once inside the walls of the City, the besiegers were ordered to kill on sight.

lotr13116.name: Orc Reaper
lotr13116.game_text: While you can spot a Free Peoples culture token, each minion that has the title Orc Reaper is strength +2.
lotr13116.lore: As they overrun the lands of the Free Peoples, the forces of the Shadow destroy all available resources.

lotr13117.name: Ordnance Grunt
lotr13117.game_text: Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot an [ORC] minion. Shadow: Discard an [ORC] condition from play to play this minion from your discard pile.
lotr13117.lore: Only Trolls had the strength to man the siege catapults.

lotr13118.name: Picket Denizen
lotr13118.game_text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Response: If another [ORC] minion is about to take a wound, exert this minion to prevent that.
lotr13118.lore: Frontline minions drew the fire of parapet archers.

lotr13119.name: Underdeeps Denizen
lotr13119.game_text: While this minion is at an underground site, it cannot take wounds.
lotr13119.lore: “There was a crash on the door, followed by crash after crash... How many there were the Company could not count.”

lotr13120.name: Unforgiving Depths
lotr13120.game_text: While you can spot 3 underground sites, each [ORC] Orc gains muster. Shadow: Discard this condition from play and spot an [ORC] minion to replace the fellowship?s current site with an underground site from your adventure deck.

lotr13121.name: Whatever Means
lotr13121.game_text: Make an [ORC] Orc strength +2 (or +6 if you remove 2 burdens).
lotr13121.lore: The besiegers believed not that the flames would burn the city walls, but the souls of those behind them.

lotr13122.name: Bitter Tidings
lotr13122.game_text: If Theoden is about to take a wound in a skirmish, you may discard from play Eomer or Theodred to prevent that. If Theodred is about to take a wound in a skirmish, you may discard from play Eomer or Eowyn to prevent that.

lotr13123.name: Eomer, Heir to Meduseld
lotr13123.subtitle: Heir to Meduseld
lotr13123.game_text: While Eomer bears a mount, he is damage +1. While no other companion is assigned to a skirmish, Eomer is strength +1 for each other [ROHAN] companion you can spot.
lotr13123.lore: “‘I have no child. Théodred my son is slain. I name Éomer my sister-son to be my heir.'”

lotr13124.name: Eowyn, Restless Warrior
lotr13124.subtitle: Restless Warrior
lotr13124.game_text: Each possession you play on Eowyn during the fellowship phase is twilight cost -1. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may reinforce a [ROHAN] token (or reinforce 2 [ROHAN] tokens if you can spot Eomer or Theoden).
lotr13124.lore: “‘Let her be as lord to the Eorlingas, while we are gone.'”

lotr13125.name: Ferthu Theoden Hal
lotr13125.game_text: To play, spot 2 [ROHAN] Men. Unless you can spot a companion who has resistance 3 or less, discard a possession from play.
lotr13125.lore: “‘Receive now this cup and drink in happy hour.'”

lotr13126.name: Firefoot, Mearas of the Mark
lotr13126.subtitle: Mearas of the Mark
lotr13126.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. When you play Firefoot, you may reinforce a [ROHAN] token. At the start of the maneuver phase, if bearer is Eomer, you may remove 2 [ROHAN] tokens to make him defender +1 and strength +1 until the regroup phase.

lotr13127.name: Freely Across Our Land
lotr13127.game_text: When you play this, add a [ROHAN] token here. Regroup: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to play a [ROHAN] possession from your discard pile on your [ROHAN] companion.

lotr13128.name: Hama, Captain of the King's Guard
lotr13128.subtitle: Captain of the King's Guard
lotr13128.game_text: Hama is strength +1 for each Shadow possession you can spot. Each time Hama wins a skirmish, you may discard a possession from play.
lotr13128.lore: “‘Do not hope too much! These are dark days.'”

lotr13129.name: Hamstrung
lotr13129.game_text: Make a [ROHAN] companion strength +2 (or +5 if the fellowship has moved twice this turn).
lotr13129.lore: Spears and arrows from Rohan brought down the mighty Mûmakil.

lotr13130.name: Hurried Barrows
lotr13130.game_text: You may remove from the game 4 other [ROHAN] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game. Make your mounted [ROHAN] companion strength +3.

lotr13131.name: King's Board
lotr13131.game_text: Skirmish: Exert Eomer to make Eowyn or Theoden strength +2. Skirmish: Exert Eowyn to make Eomer or Theoden strength +2. Skirmish: Exert Theoden to make Eomer or Eowyn strength +2.
lotr13131.lore: Also wakened in Edoras was hospitality.

lotr13132.name: Merchant of Westfold
lotr13132.game_text: Each time the fellowship moves, you may add (1) and remove a Free Peoples culture token to reinforce a [ROHAN] token.
lotr13132.lore: Villagers from the surrounding farmlands fled to Helm's Deep seeking safety.

lotr13133.name: Riddermark Tactician
lotr13133.game_text: When you play this, you may reinforce a [ROHAN] token. Each time a Shadow player replaces the fellowship?s current site, you may spot another [ROHAN] Man to make, until the regroup phase, the fellowship archery total +2 and the minion archery total -2.

lotr13134.name: Ride With Me
lotr13134.game_text: Make your [ROHAN] companion strength +2 (or exert Theoden to make that companion strength +5 and damage +1 instead.)
lotr13134.lore: “‘Maybe we shall cleave a road, or make such an end as will be worth a song – if any be left to sing of us hereafter.'”

lotr13135.name: Rider's Bow
lotr13135.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. If bearer is mounted, he or she is strength +1. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may choose a Shadow player who must wound one of his or her minions.
lotr13135.lore: Riders of the Mark carried short bows easily fired from horseback.

lotr13136.name: Snowmane, Noble Mearas
lotr13136.subtitle: Noble Mearas
lotr13136.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. When you play Snowmane, you may reinforce a [ROHAN] token. Skirmish: If bearer is Theoden, you may remove 2 [ROHAN] tokens to exhaust a minion he is skirmishing.
lotr13136.lore: “‘Where now the horse and the rider?'”

lotr13137.name: Theoden, The Renowned
lotr13137.subtitle: The Renowned
lotr13137.game_text: While you can spot Eowyn, Theoden is defender +1. While you can spot Eomer, Theoden is damage +1. While you can spot Theodred, the move limit is +1.
lotr13137.lore: “‘Let horse be bridled, horn be sounded!'”

lotr13138.name: Theodred, Second Marshal of the Mark
lotr13138.subtitle: Second Marshal of the Mark
lotr13138.game_text: While you can spot a [ROHAN] Man who has resistance of 7 or more, Theodred is twilight cost -1. At the start of each skirmish involving Theodred, you may exert each minion he is skirmishing.
lotr13138.lore: The son of Théoden defended Rohan at the Fords of Isen.

lotr13139.name: Wind-swept Homestead
lotr13139.game_text: To play, spot 2 [ROHAN] companions. When you play this, add a [ROHAN] token here for each plains site and each battleground site on the adventure path. At the start of each regroup phase, add a [ROHAN] token here for each of your companions that has muster.

lotr13140.name: Sauron, Dark Lord of Mordor
lotr13140.subtitle: Dark Lord of Mordor
lotr13140.game_text: Damage +1. Fierce. When you play Sauron, you may exert any number of minions. For each minion you exert, Sauron is twilight cost -X, where X is the current region number.

lotr13141.name: Sceptre of the Dark Lord
lotr13141.game_text: Bearer must be Sauron. He is damage +1. Each time Sauron wins a skirmish and the companion he is skirmishing is not killed, you may assign X wounds to other companions, where X is the current region number.

lotr13142.name: Bilbo, Aged Ring-bearer
lotr13142.subtitle: Aged Ring-bearer
lotr13142.game_text: Ring-bound. While Bilbo is not assigned to a skirmish, each Ring-bound Hobbit is strength +1. At the start of each skirmish involving Bilbo, you may remove a burden for each other Ring-bound Hobbit you can spot.
lotr13142.lore: “‘...I am quite ready to go on another journey....'”

lotr13143.name: Bill the Pony, Dearly-loved
lotr13143.subtitle: Dearly-loved
lotr13143.game_text: Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit. When you play Bill the Pony, you may reinforce a [SHIRE] token. Regroup: Spot 2 minions and remove 2 [SHIRE] tokens to make a Shadow player discard a minion from play.
lotr13143.lore: “Sam would not go to bed until he had visited Bill....”

lotr13144.name: Daddy Twofoot, Next-door Neighbor
lotr13144.subtitle: Next-door Neighbor
lotr13144.game_text: Aid - Add a burden. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a burden to transfer this to a companion.) Each time you transfer this to a companion, you may take a [SHIRE] event into hand from your discard pile.
lotr13144.lore: “‘That's a dark bad place, if half the tales be true.'”

lotr13145.name: Don't Let Go
lotr13145.game_text: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a Hobbit strength +1 for each of the following that is true: he or she is participating in a fierce skirmish; he or she has resistance 7 or more; he or she is at a dwelling site; you can spot an unwounded Hobbit.
lotr13145.lore: “‘Don't you give up on me Mr. Frodo!'”

lotr13146.name: Everything but My Bones
lotr13146.game_text: You may remove from the game 4 other [SHIRE] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game. Make your Hobbit at a dwelling or forest site strength +3.

lotr13147.name: Faith in Friendship
lotr13147.game_text: When you play this, add a [SHIRE] token here. At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard this from play or remove a token from here to heal a [SHIRE] companion.
lotr13147.lore: “I'm going to take care of you.”

lotr13148.name: Fates Entwined
lotr13148.game_text: Each time a Hobbit wins a skirmish, you may heal another Hobbit once (or heal another Hobbit twice if the Hobbit that won the skirmish was Frodo or Bilbo).
lotr13148.lore: “‘Yes, I am coming... The Ring-bearers should go together.'”

lotr13149.name: Frodo, Frenzied Fighter
lotr13149.subtitle: Frenzied Fighter
lotr13149.game_text: Ring-bound. While you can spot more minions than companions, Frodo cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled. Skirmish: If Frodo is not assigned to a skirmish, exert Frodo to have him replace a Ring-bound companion skirmishing a minion.

lotr13150.name: Frodo Gamgee, Son of Samwise
lotr13150.subtitle: Son of Samwise
lotr13150.game_text: Aid - Add 2 burdens. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add 2 burdens to transfer this to a companion.) To play, spot a Ring-bound Hobbit. Bearer is strength +1 for each Ring-bound Hobbit you can spot.
lotr13150.lore: ...Rose and me had settled to call him Frodo, with your leave...'

lotr13151.name: The Gaffer, Master Gardener
lotr13151.subtitle: Master Gardener
lotr13151.game_text: Aid - Add a burden. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a burden to transfer this to a companion.) When you transfer The Gaffer to a [SHIRE] companion, heal bearer (or heal bearer twice if he or she is at a dwelling site.)
lotr13151.lore: “...the Gaffer was recognized as the leading authority....”

lotr13152.name: Humble Homestead
lotr13152.game_text: To play, spot 2 Hobbits. When you play this, add a [SHIRE] token here for each forest site and each dwelling site on the adventure path. Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove 3 tokens from here to cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit.

lotr13153.name: Mithril-coat, Dwarf-mail
lotr13153.subtitle: Dwarf-mail
lotr13153.game_text: Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit. Each minion skirmishing bearer loses all damage bonuses. Skirmish: Exert bearer to make each minion he is skirmishing lose fierce and unable to gain fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr13153.lore: “‘...cold as ice, and harder than steel.'”

lotr13154.name: New Chapter
lotr13154.game_text: To play, spot 2 Hobbits. Each time you play a follower, you may heal a companion (or heal Sam twice).
lotr13154.lore: “And so it was settled. Sam Gamgee married Rosie Cotton in the spring of 1420....”

lotr13155.name: Phial of Galadriel, The Light of Earendil
lotr13155.subtitle: The Light of Earendil
lotr13155.game_text: Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit. While bearer is in region 1, bearer gains muster. While bearer is in region 2, each of your [SHIRE] companions gains muster. While bearer is in region 3, each character gains muster.

lotr13156.name: Sam, Bearer of Great Need
lotr13156.subtitle: Bearer of Great Need
lotr13156.game_text: Ring-bound. Sam is resistance +1 for each Hobbit you can spot. Regroup: Exert Sam and transfer a follower he is bearing to your support area to discard a minion from play.
lotr13156.lore: “‘...the last of all the Company. The errand must not fail.'”

lotr13157.name: Westfarthing Businessman
lotr13157.game_text: This companion is strength +1 for each [SHIRE] card that has a culture token on it.
lotr13157.lore: “‘There's a tidy bit of money tucked away up there, I hear tell....'”

lotr13158.name: Assault Commander
lotr13158.game_text: Damage +1. Shadow: Exert this minion and spot a Free Peoples condition to make an unbound companion resistance -1 for each card that has the same card title as that condition.
lotr13158.lore: Fear is a potent weapon in the hands of an Uruk-hai.

lotr13159.name: Assault Denizen
lotr13159.game_text: Damage +1. This minion is strength +1 for each Free Peoples culture token you can spot.
lotr13159.lore: Theories and tactics of warfare were tested upon the battlefields of Middle-earth.

lotr13160.name: Cavern Denizen
lotr13160.game_text: Damage +1. While you can spot a Free Peoples culture token, this minion cannot take wounds except during skirmishes.
lotr13160.lore: Saruman uses the enemy's strength to his own advantage.

lotr13161.name: Endless Assault
lotr13161.game_text: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make an [URUK-HAI] minion strength +1 for each of the following that is true: it is at a battleground site; it is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less; it is bearing a possession; you can spot an [URUK-HAI] minion not assigned to a skirmish.

lotr13162.name: Enemy Without Number
lotr13162.game_text: To play, spot 2 [URUK-HAI] minions. Shadow: Discard 2 cards from hand to add (1). Regroup: Spot an [URUK-HAI] minion and discard this condition from play to add (3).
lotr13162.lore: Valour could not prevent the breach of the Deeping Wall.

lotr13163.name: Entranced Uruk
lotr13163.game_text: Damage +1. Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Possessions borne by this minion cannot be discarded by Free Peoples cards.
lotr13163.lore: An Uruk is disarmed only when it hurls its weapon.

lotr13164.name: Fearless Approach
lotr13164.game_text: To play, spot an [URUK-HAI] minion. When you play this, if you spot a battleground site on the adventure path, reinforce 3 [URUK-HAI] tokens. Each time the Free Peoples player plays the fellowship?s next site, you may discard a condition from play.

lotr13165.name: Isengard Infiltrator
lotr13165.game_text: Damage +1. While the fellowship is at a forest site, the fellowship archery total is -1. Each [ELVEN] companion skirmishing this minion is strength -2.
lotr13165.lore: The Uruk-hai trained to engage the enemy in its own territory.

lotr13166.name: New Enemy
lotr13166.game_text: You may remove from the game 4 [URUK-HAI] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card. Make your [URUK-HAI] minion skirmishing a companion with resistance 4 or less strength +2.

lotr13167.name: Signs of War
lotr13167.game_text: While you can spot 3 [URUK-HAI] lurker minions, at the start of each skirmish involving an [URUK-HAI] lurker minion, each companion skirmishing that minion must exert.
lotr13167.lore: “Horsemen were galloping on the grass of Rohan; wolves poured from Isengard.”

lotr13168.name: Uruk Aggressor
lotr13168.game_text: Damage +1. When you play this, you may spot a companion who has resistance 0 to make this minion twilight cost -2.
lotr13168.lore: The defenses of the Hornburg were exploited, exposing their weakest points.

lotr13169.name: Uruk Blitz
lotr13169.game_text: To play, spot an [URUK-HAI] minion. While the fellowship is in region 1, each Uruk-hai is damage +1. While the fellowship is in region 2, each companion is strength -1. While the fellowship is in region 3, each unbound companion is resistance -2.

lotr13170.name: Uruk Distractor
lotr13170.game_text: Damage +1. Skirmish: If this minion is not assigned to a skirmish, you may exert it to discard a possession borne by a companion skirmishing another [URUK-HAI] minion.
lotr13170.lore: Wounds do not always remove the Uruk-hai from their assault.

lotr13171.name: Uruk Invader
lotr13171.game_text: Damage +1. This minion is twilight cost -1 for each companion who has resistance 2 or less.
lotr13171.lore: To sense weakness is to assume victory.

lotr13172.name: Uruk Outrider
lotr13172.game_text: This minion is damage +1 for each character in the dead pile.
lotr13172.lore: The lesser the enemy, the greater the rage.

lotr13173.name: Uruk Reserve
lotr13173.game_text: Damage +1. Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Each time your [URUK-HAI] minion is about to be killed in a skirmish, you may place that minion on the bottom of your draw deck instead.

lotr13174.name: Uruk Rogue
lotr13174.game_text: Damage +1. Skirmish: If no other minions are assigned to a skirmish, you may exert this minion twice to make it fierce and strength +4 until the regroup phase.
lotr13174.lore: Some minions prefer to fight alone.

lotr13175.name: Uruk Tactician
lotr13175.game_text: Damage +1. Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a companion skirmishing an [URUK-HAI] lurker minion strength -2.
lotr13175.lore: Select warriors had been tasked with advancing the assault beyond the Deeping Wall.

lotr13176.name: War Machine
lotr13176.game_text: Exert your [URUK-HAI] lurker minion to play an [URUK-HAI] hand weapon from your discard pile on your [URUK-HAI] minion.
lotr13176.lore: “...on the front of their iron helms was set an S-rune, wrought of some white metal.”

lotr13177.name: Weapons of Control
lotr13177.game_text: When you play this, add an [URUK-HAI] token here for each wounded companion. Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to make a companion skirmishing an [URUK-HAI] minion strength -1.

lotr13178.name: Dark Fell About Him
lotr13178.game_text: To play, exert your Nazgul twice and spot an exhausted companion. Heal that companion to add a burden. If the fellowship is not in region 1, you may repeat this for each other wound on that companion.
lotr13178.lore: “Men cast from the saddle lay grovelling on the ground.”

lotr13179.name: From Hideous Eyrie
lotr13179.game_text: You may remove from the game 4 [WRAITH] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card. Make your Nazgul in a fierce skirmish strength +2.
lotr13179.lore: “Down, down it came, and then, folding its fingered webs, it gave a croaking cry....”

lotr13180.name: Shadow in the East
lotr13180.game_text: Toil 1. (For each [WRAITH] character you exert when playing this, it is twilight cost -1.) To play, spot a [WRAITH] card in your support area. Spot a companion to draw a card for each wound on that companion (and draw an additional card if you can spot a Nazgul).
lotr13180.lore: “‘...it is called Minas Morgul, the Tower of Sorcery.'”

lotr13181.name: They Came From Mordor
lotr13181.game_text: When you play this, you may add a [WRAITH] token here for each [WRAITH] card in your support area. Shadow: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to play a [WRAITH] mount from your draw deck on your [WRAITH] minion.
lotr13181.lore: “‘That is the worst news that has come to Bree....'”

lotr13182.name: Ulaire Enquea, Sixth of the Nine Riders
lotr13182.subtitle: Sixth of the Nine Riders
lotr13182.game_text: Fierce. When you play Ulaire Enquea, if you can spot 2 other Nazgul, you may exert 2 unbound companions (or exert each companion if you can spot 6 companions).
lotr13182.lore: “‘It is many a year since the Nine walked abroad.'”

lotr13183.name: Ulaire Lemenya, Servant of the Shadow
lotr13183.subtitle: Servant of the Shadow
lotr13183.game_text: Fierce. Shadow: Exert Ulaire Lemenya and discard a Nazgul from your hand to discard a condition from play.
lotr13183.lore: “‘As the Shadow grows once more, they too may walk again.'”

lotr13184.name: Ulaire Nertea, Servant of the Shadow
lotr13184.subtitle: Servant of the Shadow
lotr13184.game_text: Fierce. While you can spot a companion who has resistance 3 or less, Ulaire Nertea is twilight cost -2.
lotr13184.lore: “From inside the hood came a noise as of someone sniffling to catch an elusive scent....”

lotr13185.name: Abandoned Mine Shaft
lotr13185.game_text: Underground. If this site is not in region 1 when the fellowship moves from here during the regroup phase, add a burden.

lotr13186.name: Caves of Aglarond
lotr13186.game_text: Underground. When the fellowship moves to this site during the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player may remove 2 burdens.

lotr13187.name: City of Kings
lotr13187.game_text: Battleground. When the fellowship moves to this site during the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player may draw a card.

lotr13188.name: Courtyard Parapet
lotr13188.game_text: Dwelling. When the fellowship moves to this site, the first Shadow player may discard 2 cards from hand to add a burden.

lotr13189.name: Crossroads of the Fallen Kings
lotr13189.game_text: Forest. When the fellowship moves to this site during the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player may heal a companion of each culture.

lotr13190.name: Doors of Durin
lotr13190.game_text: Marsh. Each companion of a race that has the most companions is strength -1 until the regroup phase.

lotr13191.name: Fords of Isen
lotr13191.game_text: River. Each character is strength +1 for each card borne by that character.

lotr13192.name: The Great Gates
lotr13192.game_text: Battleground. While a player can spot more companions than minions, each minion is strength +1.

lotr13193.name: Isenwash
lotr13193.game_text: Battleground. Plains. At the start of the regroup phase, each Shadow player may exert a minion to exert a companion.

lotr13194.name: Redhorn Pass
lotr13194.game_text: Mountain. Culture tokens cannot be added, removed, or reinforced.

lotr14001.name: Dain Ironfoot, King Under the Mountain
lotr14001.subtitle: King Under the Mountain
lotr14001.game_text: Each of your other Dwarves and [GANDALF] Men is twilight cost -1. At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a [DWARVEN] or [GANDALF] condition from play to discard a minion from play.
lotr14001.lore: “‘The time of my thought is my own to spend.'”

lotr14002.name: Elladan, Son of Elrond
lotr14002.subtitle: Son of Elrond
lotr14002.game_text: Elrohir is twilight cost -2. Each time you play an [ELVEN] event during a skirmish involving Elladan or Elrohir, that event is twilight cost -2.
lotr14002.lore: The Lady Celebrían bore Elrond two sons, the identical twins Elladan and Elrohir; elder brothers ofArwen, and grandchildren of Galadriel.

lotr14003.name: Elrohir, Son of Elrond
lotr14003.subtitle: Son of Elrond
lotr14003.game_text: Elladan is twilight cost -2. Each time you play an [ELVEN] event during a skirmish involving Elrohir or Elladan, each minion in that skirmish is strength -2.
lotr14003.lore: “‘From the North we came with this purpose, and from Elrond our father we brought this very counsel. We will not turn back.'”

lotr14004.name: Gildor Inglorion, of the House of Finrod
lotr14004.subtitle: of the House of Finrod
lotr14004.game_text: At the start of each archery phase, if you can spot more minions than companions, each of your companions is an archer.
lotr14004.lore: “‘Elves seldom give unguarded advice, for advice is a dangerous gift, even from the wise to the wise, and all courses may run ill.'”

lotr14005.name: Brand, King of Dale
lotr14005.subtitle: King of Dale
lotr14005.game_text: Each of your Dwarves and other [GANDALF] Men is strength +1. While you can spot more minions than companions, the fellowship archery total is +X, where X is the number of minions minus the number of companions.
lotr14005.lore: “...he had the aid of the Dwarves of Erebor.”

lotr14006.name: Grimbeorn, Beorning Chieftain
lotr14006.subtitle: Beorning Chieftain
lotr14006.game_text: At the start of each turn, heal Grimbeorn. At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert Grimbeorn twice and discard a minion from hand to make Grimbeorn strength +X until the regroup phase, where X is that minion's strength.
lotr14006.lore: He was perhaps a shape-shifter like his father.

lotr14007.name: Duilin, Ranger from Blackroot Vale
lotr14007.subtitle: Ranger from Blackroot Vale
lotr14007.game_text: Ranger. While the fellowship is at a forest or river site, Duilin is strength +3.
lotr14007.lore: To Minas Tirith Duinhir brought both of his sons, Derufin and Duilin, to defend the Free Peoples of Middle-earth.

lotr14008.name: Duinhir, Tall Man of Blackroot Vale
lotr14008.subtitle: Tall Man of Blackroot Vale
lotr14008.game_text: While you can spot a mount, Duinhir is damage +1. Each time Duinhir wins a skirmish, if you can spot more minions than companions, you may exert him to discard a minion that has strength 7 or less.
lotr14008.lore: The garrison at Osgiliath fought valiantly.

lotr14009.name: Halbarad, Ranger of the North
lotr14009.subtitle: Ranger of the North
lotr14009.game_text: Ranger. While the Ring-bearer has resistance 9 or more, Halbarad's twilight cost is -1. At the start of the maneuver phase, you may discard a [GONDOR] card from hand to heal a [GONDOR] companion.
lotr14009.lore: “He was tall, a dark standing shadow.”

lotr14010.name: Furious Hillman
lotr14010.game_text: Response: If the Free Peoples player plays an event, spot another [MEN] Man and discard this minion from play to cancel that event.
lotr14010.lore: No village pitchfork could provide defense against the rages of the Wild Men.

lotr14011.name: Swarming Hillman
lotr14011.game_text: At the start of the regroup phase, if you can spot more Man characters than any other race, make the move limit -1 this turn.
lotr14011.lore: Roving in mindless mobs, the Dunlendings destroyed many Rohirrim homesteads.

lotr14012.name: Half-troll of Far Harad
lotr14012.game_text: At the start of each assignment phase, if you can spot more companions than minions, you may remove (2) to play an [ORC] Orc from your discard pile.
lotr14012.lore: ...bred for battle in the southern reaches ofHaradwaith....

lotr14013.name: Horror of Harad
lotr14013.game_text: Ambush (1). Damage +1. Fierce. Lurker. Muster. Toil 2.
lotr14013.lore: The troll-men sprinted on to the Pelennor to bathe their blades in the blood of the enemy.

lotr14014.name: Uruk-hai Healer
lotr14014.game_text: Damage +1. At the start of each assignment phase, you may heal an Uruk-hai for each companion you can spot.
lotr14014.lore: Restoratives were in short supply within the ranks of the White Hand.

lotr14015.name: Uruk-hai Scout
lotr14015.game_text: Damage +1. When you play this, choose one of the following keywords: battleground, mountain, plains, or underground. The fellowship's current site gains that keyword until the end of the turn.
lotr14015.lore: “...swart, slant-eyed, with thick legs and large hands.”

lotr15001.name: The One Ring, The Ring of Doom
lotr15001.subtitle: The Ring of Doom
lotr15001.game_text: While wearing The One Ring, the Ring-bearer gains hunter 3, and each time he or she is about to take a wound in a skirmish, add a burden instead. Skirmish: Add a burden to wear The One Ring until the regroup phase.
lotr15001.lore: “...the earth shook, the plain heaved and cracked, and Orodruin reeled.”

lotr15002.name: Well-crafted Armor
lotr15002.game_text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Each time bearer takes a wound, you may reinforce a [DWARVEN] token. Skirmish: Discard a [DWARVEN] card from hand to make bearer damage +1.
lotr15002.lore: Dwarven armor is among the strongest crafted in Middle-earth.

lotr15003.name: Legolas, of the Woodland Realm
lotr15003.subtitle: of the Woodland Realm
lotr15003.game_text: Archer. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) Archery: Exert Legolas to make the fellowship archery total +1 for each hunter minion you can spot. (limit +3)
lotr15003.lore: “You would die before your stroke fell!”

lotr15004.name: The Mirror of Galadriel, Dangerous Guide
lotr15004.subtitle: Dangerous Guide
lotr15004.game_text: To play, spot 3 Elves. Each time you are about to draw a card, you may exert an Elf to look at the top three cards of your draw deck instead. Take a Free Peoples card into your hand and place the other cards on the bottom of your draw deck.

lotr15005.name: Gandalf, Powerful Guide
lotr15005.subtitle: Powerful Guide
lotr15005.game_text: To play, spot 2 Hobbits. Each time you play a spell, you may add a burden to wound a minion. At the start of each skirmish involving Gandalf, you may draw a card and then discard a card from your hand.

lotr15006.name: One Last Surprise
lotr15006.game_text: Spell. Spot Gandalf and an unbound companion skirmishing a minion to use Gandalf?s resistance to resolve that skirmish instead of that companion?s strength.
lotr15006.lore: “The dragon passed like an express train...and burst over Bywater with a deafening explosion.”

lotr15007.name: Quickbeam, Hastiest of All Ents
lotr15007.subtitle: Hastiest of All Ents
lotr15007.game_text: Quickbeam is twilight cost -1 for each Ent you can spot. Maneuver: Discard this companion to place another [GANDALF] companion from your discard pile on the bottom of your draw deck and reinforce a [GANDALF] token.
lotr15007.lore: “‘A punch from an Ent-fist crumples up iron...'”

lotr15008.name: Smeagol, Wretched and Hungry
lotr15008.subtitle: Wretched and Hungry
lotr15008.game_text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Each Ring-bound companion is resistance +1. Skirmish: Exert 2 Ring-bound Hobbits to make Smeagol strength +1 and prevent him from being overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.
lotr15008.lore: “...this creature is in some way bound up with my errand.'”

lotr15009.name: Aragorn, Thorongil
lotr15009.subtitle: Thorongil
lotr15009.game_text: Ranger. Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.) Maneuver: Add a threat to exert a non-hunter minion with strength less than Aragorn's.

lotr15010.name: Madril, Defender of Osgiliath
lotr15010.subtitle: Defender of Osgiliath
lotr15010.game_text: Ranger. Hunter 1. While you can spot 2 [GONDOR] rangers, Madril is twilight cost -2. At the start of the maneuver phase, each minion is site number +1 for each threat you can spot until the start of the regroup phase.
lotr15010.lore: “‘For that is the ruin of Osgiliath...'”

lotr15011.name: Black Land Chieftain
lotr15011.game_text: To play, spot an [ORC] minion. When you play Black Land Chieftain, you may add a threat for each Free Peoples possession and each Free Peoples artifact you can spot.
lotr15011.lore: Orcs frequently used the weapons of their fallen enemies as their own.

lotr15012.name: Gorbag, Filthy Rebel
lotr15012.subtitle: Filthy Rebel
lotr15012.game_text: Hunter 3. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +3.) When you play Gorbag, you may discard a card from the top of the Free Peoples player?s deck for each hunter character you can spot.
lotr15012.lore: “I'm gonna bleed you...like a stuck pig!”

lotr15013.name: Eomer, Horsemaster
lotr15013.subtitle: Horsemaster
lotr15013.game_text: Valiant. Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.) While you can spot a [ROHAN] Man, Eomer?s twilight cost is -1. Skirmish: Discard a [ROHAN] card from hand to make Eomer strength +2.

lotr15014.name: Sentry Uruk
lotr15014.game_text: To play, spot an [URUK-HAI] minion. While you can spot a fierce minion, this minion is fierce. While you can spot a hunter, this minion gains hunter 1. While you can spot a character that is damage +1, this minion is damage +1.

lotr15015.name: Ulaire Attea, Desirous of Power
lotr15015.subtitle: Desirous of Power
lotr15015.game_text: Fierce. Ulaire Attea is strength +1 for every 3 twilight tokens you can spot.
lotr15015.lore: The Nazgûl were strongest, and most terrifying, at night.

lotr15016.name: Ulaire Lemenya, Eternally Threatening
lotr15016.subtitle: Eternally Threatening
lotr15016.game_text: Fierce. When you play Ulaire Lemenya, you may remove (1) to add a threat for each Free Peoples culture you can spot.
lotr15016.lore: “Soon there could be no doubt: three or four tall black figures were standing on the slope, looking down on them.”

lotr15017.name: Ulaire Nelya, Fell Rider
lotr15017.subtitle: Fell Rider
lotr15017.game_text: Fierce. While you can spot 6 companions, [WRAITH] minions cannot take wounds (except during skirmish phases). Skirmish: If this minion is mounted, exert him twice to wound a companion bearing a [WRAITH] condition.

lotr15018.name: Mount Doom
lotr15018.game_text: Battleground. Mountain. Underground. Until the end of the game, sites in this region cannot be replaced.

lotr15060.name: Forth the Three Hunters!
lotr15060.game_text: Archery: Exert Legolas and exert Aragorn to wound a minion. Skirmish: Exert Aragorn and spot Gimli to make a minion strength -1 (or -3 if Aragorn and Gimli are hunters). Regroup: Exert Gimli and spot Legolas to draw a card (or 2 cards if Gimli and Legolas are hunters).

lotr15019.name: Legolas, of the Woodland Realm
lotr15019.subtitle: of the Woodland Realm
lotr15019.game_text: Archer. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) Archery: Exert Legolas to make the fellowship archery total +1 for each hunter minion you can spot. (limit +3)
lotr15019.lore: “You would die before your stroke fell!”

lotr15020.name: Lorien's Blessing
lotr15020.game_text: Spot an [ELVEN] follower to make the minion archery total -3.
lotr15020.lore: “‘We have drunk the cup of parting...and the shadows fall between us.'”

lotr15021.name: Mighty Shot
lotr15021.game_text: Spot an Elf to make the fellowship archery total +1 for each minion with twilight cost 2 or less that you can spot.
lotr15021.lore: “‘But who can say what it hit?'”

lotr15022.name: The Mirror of Galadriel, Dangerous Guide
lotr15022.subtitle: Dangerous Guide
lotr15022.game_text: To play, spot 3 Elves. Each time you are about to draw a card, you may exert an Elf to look at the top three cards of your draw deck instead. Take a Free Peoples card into your hand and place the other cards on the bottom of your draw deck.

lotr15023.name: Point Blank Range
lotr15023.game_text: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +4 if you can spot 3 archers).
lotr15023.lore: “How many there were the company could not count.”

lotr15024.name: Spied From Afar
lotr15024.game_text: To play, spot 3 Elves. While you can spot an [ELVEN] follower, the twilight cost of each Shadow possession is +1. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make an [ELVEN] companion strength +1 for each archer companion you can spot.

lotr15025.name: Sword of the Fallen
lotr15025.game_text: Bearer must be an Elf. Each minion skirmishing bearer is strength -1 for each wound on that minion. Skirmish: Exert bearer to exert a minion skirmishing bearer.
lotr15025.lore: Elven weapons remain in use for centuries.

lotr15026.name: Uruviel, Woodland Maid
lotr15026.subtitle: Woodland Maid
lotr15026.game_text: Aid - (1). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add(1) to transfer this to a companion.) Each time you transfer this to a companion, you may exert an Elf to make the fellowship?s current site a forest until the end of the turn.

lotr15027.name: Be Gone!
lotr15027.game_text: Spell. Exert your [GANDALF] companion X times to make a minion strength -2 until the regroup phase, for each time that [GANDALF] companion exerted.
lotr15027.lore: “You did not kill me, you will not kill him!”

lotr15028.name: Ent Avenger
lotr15028.game_text: While you can spot 3 Ents, this companion is strength +2.
lotr15028.lore: “As they drew near the flash and flicker of their eyes could be seen.”

lotr15029.name: Gandalf, Powerful Guide
lotr15029.subtitle: Powerful Guide
lotr15029.game_text: To play, spot 2 Hobbits. Each time you play a spell, you may add a burden to wound a minion. At the start of each skirmish involving Gandalf, you may draw a card and then discard a card from your hand.

lotr15030.name: Leaflock, Finglas
lotr15030.subtitle: Finglas
lotr15030.game_text: Leaflock?s twilight cost is -1 for each Ent you can spot. While you can spot 4 other Ents, Leaflock is strength +4.
lotr15030.lore: When roused to action, little could stop the destructive power of the Ents.

lotr15031.name: Mellon!
lotr15031.game_text: To play, spot 2 [GANDALF] companions. At the start of the maneuver phase, discard this condition to make each player count the number of cards in his or?her hand, discard each of them and draw the same number of cards from the top of his or her draw deck.

lotr15032.name: Momentous Gathering
lotr15032.game_text: Choose one: spot an Ent to take a [GANDALF] companion into hand from your draw deck; or spot 2 Ents to take a [GANDALF] companion and a [GANDALF] condition into hand from your draw deck. Shuffle your draw deck.
lotr15032.lore: “‘...I have managed to make a fair number promise to come.'”

lotr15033.name: One Last Surprise
lotr15033.game_text: Spell. Spot Gandalf and an unbound companion skirmishing a minion to use Gandalf?s resistance to resolve that skirmish instead of that companion?s strength.
lotr15033.lore: “The dragon passed like an express train...and burst over Bywater with a deafening explosion.”

lotr15034.name: Quickbeam, Hastiest of All Ents
lotr15034.subtitle: Hastiest of All Ents
lotr15034.game_text: Quickbeam is twilight cost -1 for each Ent you can spot. Maneuver: Discard this companion to place another [GANDALF] companion from your discard pile on the bottom of your draw deck and reinforce a [GANDALF] token.
lotr15034.lore: “‘A punch from an Ent-fist crumples up iron...'”

lotr15035.name: Shadow of the Wood
lotr15035.game_text: This companion is twilight cost -1 for each [GANDALF] companion you can spot. Fellowship: Place this companion in the dead pile to remove (5).
lotr15035.lore: Treebeard's call to the Ent Moot could not be refused.

lotr15036.name: Shepherd of the Trees
lotr15036.game_text: While you can spot 4 Ents, this companion is strength +3. Maneuver: Exert this companion to reveal the bottom card of your draw deck. If it is a [GANDALF] character, you may play it.
lotr15036.lore: Ents rarely interacted with Men, but Saruman's devilry demanded action.

lotr15037.name: Skinbark, Elder Ent
lotr15037.subtitle: Elder Ent
lotr15037.game_text: Skinbark is twilight cost -1 for each [GANDALF] condition you can spot. Each time Skinbark wins a skirmish, you may place a [GANDALF] card from your discard pile beneath your draw deck.
lotr15037.lore: “‘...a man that hacks once at an Ent never gets the chance of a second blow.'”

lotr15038.name: Treebeard, Enraged Shepherd
lotr15038.subtitle: Enraged Shepherd
lotr15038.game_text: To play, spot 3 [GANDALF] companions. Each time Treebeard wins a skirmish, the first Shadow player must exert X minions, where X is the difference between Treebeard?s strength and the losing character?s strength.

lotr15039.name: Called to Mordor
lotr15039.game_text: Bearer must be Smeagol. While you can spot 2 Ring-bound Hobbits, each time an opponent uses a skirmish special ability in a skirmish involving Gollum or Smeagol, you may wound a minion.
lotr15039.lore: “It won't be long now. He will soon be ready.”

lotr15040.name: Connected by Fate
lotr15040.game_text: To play, spot Smeagol. While you can spot 2 Ring-bound Hobbits, each Shadow event is twilight cost +1. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make each Ring-bound companion strength +1 until the regroup phase.
lotr15040.lore: “Thief, thief! Baggins! We hates it for ever!”

lotr15041.name: Controlled by the Ring
lotr15041.game_text: Bearer must be Gollum. Skirmish: If Gollum is not assigned to a skirmish, discard this condition to have him replace a minion skirmishing a companion.
lotr15041.lore: Gollum's appetite for the One Ring could not be quenched.

lotr15042.name: Desperate Move
lotr15042.game_text: Discard a [GOLLUM] minion from play to discard a companion. The Free Peoples player may make the move limit -1 this turn to prevent that.
lotr15042.lore: “‘He leaped into the waters, but the Ring slipped from his finger as he swam...'”

lotr15043.name: Gollum, Hopeless
lotr15043.subtitle: Hopeless
lotr15043.game_text: At the start of each skirmish involving Gollum, he is strength +X until the end of that skirmish, where X is the Ring-bearer?s strength.
lotr15043.lore: “Give it to us raw and wriggling!”

lotr15044.name: Herbs and Stewed Rabbit
lotr15044.game_text: While you can spot Frodo, Smeagol is resistance +1. While you can spot Sam, Smeagol is strength +1. While you can spot Bilbo, Smeagol is damage +1.

lotr15045.name: Hurry Hobbitses
lotr15045.game_text: Make Smeagol strength +1 for each Ring-bound Hobbit you can spot.

lotr15046.name: Nice Fish
lotr15046.game_text: Each time Smeagol wins a skirmish, place a companion for each [GOLLUM] token here. Regroup: Heal a Ring-bound companion for each token here. Discard this condition.

lotr15047.name: Not This Time!
lotr15047.game_text: Skirmish: Exert Gollum and remove a threat to wound a companion Gollum is skirmishing.

lotr15048.name: Release Them
lotr15048.game_text: Spot Smeagol to prevent a Ring-bound Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled. While this card is in your discard pile, Smeagol is resistance +1.
lotr15048.lore: “If you let them go, your life will be forfeit.”

lotr15049.name: Smeagol, Wretched and Hungry
lotr15049.subtitle: Wretched and Hungry
lotr15049.game_text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Each Ring-bound companion is resistance +1. Skirmish: Exert 2 Ring-bound Hobbits to make Smeagol strength +1 and prevent him from being overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.
lotr15049.lore: “...this creature is in some way bound up with my errand.'”

lotr15050.name: Something Slimy
lotr15050.game_text: Spot Smeagol to play a Free Peoples condition from your draw deck. If that condition was a [GOLLUM] condition, you may make an opponent place a random card from his or her hand beneath his or her draw deck. Shuffle your draw deck.
lotr15050.lore: “What he was chewing, they did not ask or like to think.”

lotr15051.name: Sudden Strike
lotr15051.game_text: Spot Gollum or Smeagol to play a minion?from your draw deck. If that minion is a [GOLLUM] minion, you may also play a Shadow possession or Shadow condition from your draw deck. Shuffle your draw deck.
lotr15051.lore: “...she drove her huge bulk down on him again.”

lotr15052.name: Swear By the Precious
lotr15052.game_text: Spot Frodo and Smeagol to discard a minion. That minion?s owner may make each minion strength -2 until the end of the turn to prevent that.
lotr15052.lore: “'I will serve the master of the Precious.'”

lotr15053.name: Unseen Foe
lotr15053.game_text: Discard a [GOLLUM] minion from play to wound each companion with strength 8 or more.
lotr15053.lore: “...all the while he hissed, but spoke no words.”

lotr15054.name: Aragorn, Swift Hunter
lotr15054.subtitle: Swift Hunter
lotr15054.game_text: Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) Skirmish: Exert Aragorn to make a hunter companion strength +1.
lotr15054.lore: “Ride out with me. Ride out and meet them.”

lotr15055.name: Aragorn, Thorongil
lotr15055.subtitle: Thorongil
lotr15055.game_text: Ranger. Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.) Maneuver: Add a threat to exert a non-hunter minion with strength less than Aragorn's.

lotr15056.name: Aragorn's Bow, Ranger's Longbow
lotr15056.subtitle: Ranger's Longbow
lotr15056.game_text: Bearer must be Aragorn. He is an archer. Archery: Add a threat to wound a minion?with the lowest strength.
lotr15056.lore: The bow can reach what the sword cannot.

lotr15057.name: Damrod, Dunadan of Gondor
lotr15057.subtitle: Dunadan of Gondor
lotr15057.game_text: Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) At the start of each fellowship phase, you may add (1) to heal a ranger.

lotr15058.name: Decorated Barricade
lotr15058.game_text: Fortification. This condition is twilight cost -1 for each [GONDOR] ranger you spot. Skirmish: Exert 2 [GONDOR] Men to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [GONDOR] Man.
lotr15058.lore: In times of war, the beauty of the walls matters little.

lotr15059.name: Dunedain of the South
lotr15059.game_text: Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) Each time this companion wins a skirmish, you may make a [GONDOR] ranger strength +2 until the regroup phase.
lotr15059.lore: “‘We come to ambush the Men of Harad.'”

lotr15061.name: Gondorian Prowler
lotr15061.game_text: Ranger. Hunter 1. When this companion is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -1. Skirmish: Remove a [GONDOR] token or exert a [GONDOR] Man to make the site number of a minion +2.
lotr15061.lore: Rangers use all five senses to hunt their prey.

lotr15062.name: Ithilien Blade
lotr15062.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. While you can spot a roaming minion, bearer is strength +1. Maneuver: Exert bearer twice to discard a roaming minion.
lotr15062.lore: Most Rangers of Ithilien carried spears, bows, and swords while marching.

lotr15063.name: Mablung, Ranger of Ithilien
lotr15063.subtitle: Ranger of Ithilien
lotr15063.game_text: Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) Skirmish: Exert Mablung to wound a roaming minion he is skirmishing.
lotr15063.lore: “‘We come to teach them another lesson.'”

lotr15064.name: Madril, Defender of Osgiliath
lotr15064.subtitle: Defender of Osgiliath
lotr15064.game_text: Ranger. Hunter 1. While you can spot 2 [GONDOR] rangers, Madril is twilight cost -2. At the start of the maneuver phase, each minion is site number +1 for each threat you can spot until the start of the regroup phase.
lotr15064.lore: “‘For that is the ruin of Osgiliath...'”

lotr15065.name: No Quicker Path
lotr15065.game_text: Each time Aragorn wins a skirmish, you may make a hunter [DWARVEN] companion or hunter [ELVEN] companion strength +1 until the regroup phase. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [GONDOR] Man strength +2.
lotr15065.lore: “‘...we no longer need any trail to tell us which way...'”

lotr15066.name: No Travellers In This Land
lotr15066.game_text: Exert a [GONDOR] Man to wound a minion (or wound that minion twice if it is a hunter).
lotr15066.lore: “‘...only the servants of the Dark Tower, or of the White.'”

lotr15067.name: Portico
lotr15067.game_text: Fortification. This condition is twilight cost -1 for each [GONDOR] ranger you spot. Skirmish: Exert a [GONDOR] Man or spot 2 rangers to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [GONDOR] Man.
lotr15067.lore: The doors of Minas Tirith were meant to keep out more than Orcs.

lotr15068.name: Ranger's Cloak
lotr15068.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. While bearer is a ranger or at a forest site, each minion skirmishing bearer is site number +2. Skirmish: Add a threat or exert bearer to make a minion skirmishing a [GONDOR] Man site number +2.

lotr15069.name: Silent Traveler
lotr15069.game_text: Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) At the start of each skirmish involving this companion and a roaming minion, you may reinforce a [GONDOR] token.
lotr15069.lore: “‘We have not found what we sought...'”

lotr15070.name: Tremendous Wall
lotr15070.game_text: Fortification. Characters skirmishing bearer cannot take wounds from losing a skirmish involving bearer. Skirmish: Exert a [GONDOR] Man or spot 3 rangers to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [GONDOR] Man.

lotr15071.name: Unyielding Ranger
lotr15071.game_text: Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) This companion is strength +1 for each roaming minion you can spot.
lotr15071.lore: “Their faces were hooded and masked with green, except for their eyes...”

lotr15072.name: Bill Ferny, Agent of Saruman
lotr15072.subtitle: Agent of Saruman
lotr15072.game_text: If Bill Ferny is unwounded, the Free Peoples player cannot assign him to skirmish a companion. Shadow: Exert Bill Ferny twice and spot a site you control to add (2).
lotr15072.lore: “‘...he would sell anything to anybody; or make mischief for amusement.'”

lotr15073.name: Bold Easterling
lotr15073.game_text: Skirmish: If this minion is skirmishing, discard this minion to play a [MEN] minion from your discard pile. That minion is fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr15073.lore: “‘They hold the northward road; and many have passed on into Anórien.'”

lotr15074.name: Chieftain of Dunland
lotr15074.game_text: Fierce. Skirmish: Spot a site you control and remove (2) to make a [MEN] Man strength +2. Skirmish: Spot 2 sites you control and remove (2) to make a [MEN] Man strength +3. Skirmish: Spot 3 sites you control and remove (2) to make a [MEN] Man strength +4.

lotr15075.name: Courageous Easterling
lotr15075.game_text: Skirmish: If this minion is skirmishing, discard this minion to play a [MEN] minion from your discard pile. That minion is fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr15075.lore: Easterlings came to Mordor to aid Sauron in his final assualt.

lotr15076.name: Destroyed Homestead
lotr15076.game_text: When you play this, spot 2 [MEN] Men to randomly reveal a site from the Free Peoples player?s adventure deck. Note its cardtitle. Each site on the adventure path with the same card title as the selected site loses its gametext.

lotr15077.name: Easterling Scout
lotr15077.game_text: Skirmish: If this minion is skirmishing, discard this minion to play a [MEN] minion from your discard pile. That minion is fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr15077.lore: In battle, Easterlings surprise their foes with a great number of different techniques.

lotr15078.name: Engrossed Hillman
lotr15078.game_text: At the start of the maneuver phase, if you can spot another [MEN] Man and 8 characters (or if you can spot 3 Free Peoples cultures), you may take control of a site.
lotr15078.lore: Years of anger have a tendency to bring focus to one's rage.

lotr15079.name: Enraged Herdsman
lotr15079.game_text: While you can spot more companions than minions, each [MEN] hunter is strength +2 and is an archer.
lotr15079.lore: Dunlendings don't mind being outnumbered in battle.

lotr15080.name: Great Axe
lotr15080.game_text: Bearer must be a [MEN] Man. While bearer is skirmishing a hunter companion, bearer is strength +2.
lotr15080.lore: To his surprise, Frodo's cloak served as an effective camoflague among the rocks.

lotr15081.name: Grieving the Fallen
lotr15081.game_text: To play, spot a [MEN] Man. Bearer must be a companion. Bearer cannot take wounds during the archery phase. At the start of the regroup phase, discard this condition.

lotr15082.name: Grousing Hillman
lotr15082.game_text: While you control a site, this minion is strength +3 and fierce.
lotr15082.lore: Acquiring more territories only increases the rage of the Dunlendings.

lotr15083.name: Hunting Herdsman
lotr15083.game_text: Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) This minion is strength +3 for each follower you can spot.
lotr15083.lore: Hunters are valuable members of Dunlending tribes.

lotr15084.name: Last Gasp
lotr15084.game_text: Wound 3 [MEN] archers to exhaust a companion.
lotr15084.lore: Southron archers know that they must press through their exhaustion to win the battle.

lotr15085.name: Lying Counsel
lotr15085.game_text: Exert your [MEN] Man and spot an unbound companion bearing 3 or more cards to return each Free Peoples card that companion bears to its owner?s hand. The Free Peoples player may add a burden to discard those cards instead.
lotr15085.lore: “‘Let your counsellor Gríma keep all things...'”

lotr15086.name: Mumak Commander, Giant Among the Swertings
lotr15086.subtitle: Giant Among the Swertings
lotr15086.game_text: Maneuver: Exert Mumak Commander twice to exert a companion twice (except the Ring-bearer).
lotr15086.lore: “...high upon his neck still desperately clung a tiny figure—the body of a mighty warrior...”

lotr15087.name: Primitive Savage
lotr15087.game_text: While you can spot a companion of strength 12 or more, this minion is strength +5. Each time this minion wins a skirmish, if he bears a hand weapon, you may take control of a site.
lotr15087.lore: The only thing scarier than a Wild Man is a Wild Man with an axe.

lotr15088.name: Pursuing Horde
lotr15088.game_text: To play, spot a [MEN] Man. Bearer must be a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Limit 1 per companion. Each time the fellowship moves, add (1).
lotr15088.lore: Once the Dunlendings track their enemy they will not lose their trail.

lotr15089.name: Rapid Reload
lotr15089.game_text: While you can spot a [MEN] Man, the Free Peoples player cannot replace a site in the current region. Archery: Spot a [MEN] Man and remove (3) to exert an unbound companion.
lotr15089.lore: The Men of Harad kept a large supply of arrows at hand.

lotr15090.name: Rapt Hillman
lotr15090.game_text: At the start of the regroup phase, the Free People?s player may liberate a site. You may spot 3 Men to prevent this. Maneuver: Spot another [MEN] Man and exert this minion to take control of a site.

lotr15091.name: Ravaging Wild Man
lotr15091.game_text: While you can spot a hunter, this minion gains hunter 1. Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert 2 [MEN] Men to discard a follower.
lotr15091.lore: No villager is safe when the Wild Men attack.

lotr15092.name: Savage Southron
lotr15092.game_text: Maneuver: If the Free People?s player has at least 1 site in his or her adventure deck, exert 2 [MEN] Men to randomly choose a site from that deck. Replace the fellowship?s current site with that site.
lotr15092.lore: The Southrons are skilled at fighting in many different kinds of terrain.

lotr15093.name: Swarthy Hillman
lotr15093.game_text: While you control a site, this minion is an archer.
lotr15093.lore: The Wild Men will defend their territories at all costs.

lotr15094.name: Wandering Hillman
lotr15094.game_text: To play, spot a [MEN] Man. While you can spot a companion of strength 10 or more, this minion is strength +3. Maneuver: Remove 2 burdens or 2 threats to control a site.
lotr15094.lore: The Hillmen are always searching for lands to conquer.

lotr15095.name: Battlefield Recruit
lotr15095.game_text: Skirmish: Discard this minion to make a minion strength +2.

lotr15096.name: Battlefield Veteran
lotr15096.game_text: Skirmish: Discard this minion to make a minion strength +1.
lotr15096.lore: Though he had seen it many times before, Grond's destructive power never ceased to amaze.

lotr15097.name: Beasts of Burden
lotr15097.game_text: To play, spot 2 [ORC] minions. At the start of your Shadow phase, you may discard an [ORC] condition from play to play an [ORC] minion. It is twilight cost -2 (or -4 if you can spot 6 or more companions).
lotr15097.lore: “...some great beast...would go mad and spread stamping ruin...”

lotr15098.name: Black Gate Sentry
lotr15098.game_text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a companion it is skirmishing.
lotr15098.lore: Very few tried to sneak into Mordor. Even fewer succeeded.

lotr15099.name: Black Land Chieftain
lotr15099.game_text: To play, spot an [ORC] minion. When you play Black Land Chieftain, you may add a threat for each Free Peoples possession and each Free Peoples artifact you can spot.
lotr15099.lore: Orcs frequently used the weapons of their fallen enemies as their own.

lotr15100.name: Black Land Commander
lotr15100.game_text: While you can spot a companion of strength 12 or more, this minion is strength +5. Skirmish: Remove 2 threats to make a character skirmishing this minion strength -2.
lotr15100.lore: “‘...do they just live on foul air and poison?'”

lotr15101.name: Black Land Observer
lotr15101.game_text: When you play this minion, you may spot an [ORC] condition to add a threat. While you can spot a companion of strength 10 or more, this minion is strength +3.
lotr15101.lore: Orcs must always watch for attacks from their enemies...and from their own.

lotr15102.name: Black Land Overlord
lotr15102.game_text: Maneuver: Remove a threat and spot another [ORC] minion to exert an unbound companion.

lotr15103.name: Black Land Runner
lotr15103.game_text: To play, spot an [ORC] Orc. While you can spot more sites on the adventure path than minions, this minion is strength +5.
lotr15103.lore: When commanded to, Orcs could travel great distances with great speed.

lotr15104.name: Black Land Shrieker
lotr15104.game_text: To play, spot an [ORC] condition. Black Land Shrieker is twilight cost -1 for each threat you spot.
lotr15104.lore: No sound from an Orc was more frightening.

lotr15105.name: Black Land Spy
lotr15105.game_text: When you play this minion, you may spot an [ORC] possession to add a threat. While you can spot a companion of strength 13 or more, this minion is strength +7.
lotr15105.lore: Frodo's quest could be undone with one glance.

lotr15106.name: Coordinated Effort
lotr15106.game_text: To play, spot 2 [ORC] minions. Each time the Free Peoples player plays a possession, add (2).
