lotr15106.lore: Breaking a Gondorian fortification is not easily done.

lotr15107.name: Desolation Orc
lotr15107.game_text: To play, spot 3 Free Peoples cultures or discard 2 [ORC] conditions from play.
lotr15107.lore: Neither Man nor beast can withstand the fury of the Orcs.

lotr15108.name: Destructive Orc
lotr15108.game_text: When you play Destructive Orc, you may discard a fortification for each [ORC] possession and each [ORC] artifact you can spot.
lotr15108.lore: At Minas Tirith, some Orcs chose to attack the city before it's inhabitants.

lotr15109.name: Gorbag, Filthy Rebel
lotr15109.subtitle: Filthy Rebel
lotr15109.game_text: Hunter 3. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +3.) When you play Gorbag, you may discard a card from the top of the Free Peoples player?s deck for each hunter character you can spot.
lotr15109.lore: “I'm gonna bleed you...like a stuck pig!”

lotr15110.name: Isengard Marauder
lotr15110.game_text: To play, discard 3 cards from your hand. While you can spot 2 other [ORC] minions, this minion is fierce.
lotr15110.lore: Wargs and riders sent by Saruman disrupted the villagers' retreat to Helm's Deep.

lotr15111.name: Moria Menace
lotr15111.game_text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player shuffle his or her draw deck and reveal the top card of that draw deck. Make this minion strength +X, where X is the twilight cost of the revealed card.
lotr15111.lore: Orcs attacked in sunlight only when absolutely necessary.

lotr15112.name: Mountain-troll
lotr15112.game_text: When you play this minion, you may discard 5 [ORC] minions from play to make it twilight cost -10 and fierce. Shadow: Remove (3) to play an [ORC] Orc from your discard pile. Its twilight cost is -2.
lotr15112.lore: “Thrice the great ram boomed. And suddenly on the last stroke the Gate of Gondor broke.”

lotr15113.name: Orkish Camp
lotr15113.game_text: While you can spot a [ORC] Orc, the Free Peoples player cannot replace the fellowship?s current site. Shadow: Exert an [ORC] minion and remove (2) to reveal the bottom card of your draw deck. If it is an [ORC] Orc, take it into hand. Otherwise, discard it.

lotr15114.name: Orkish Hunting Spear
lotr15114.game_text: Bearer must be an [ORC] Orc. Bearer gains hunter X (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +X.), where X is the number of Free Peoples cultures you can spot.
lotr15114.lore: Orcs hunt for Men, ponies, and their own kind.

lotr15115.name: Pummeling Blow
lotr15115.game_text: To play, exert an [ORC] minion. Plays on the fellowship?s current site. This site cannot be replaced. While the fellowship is at this site, each Troll is strength +1.
lotr15115.lore: Where battering rams failed, Trolls did not.

lotr15116.name: Scouting Orc
lotr15116.game_text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a companion it is skirmishing.
lotr15116.lore: “...it was of a small breed...with wide and snuffling nostrils: evidently a tracker of some kind.”

lotr15117.name: Tower Troll
lotr15117.game_text: For each companion over 5, this minion is damage +1. Assignment: Exert this minion twice to assign it to a companion (except the Ring-bearer). If you cannot spot 6 companions, the Free Peoples player may exert a companion to prevent this.

lotr15118.name: Unmistakable Omen
lotr15118.game_text: While you can spot a threat, the site number of each [ORC] Orc is -1. Regroup: Remove 3 threats and discard 3 [ORC] Orcs from play to make the Free Peoples player spot a companion and place that companion in the dead pile. Discard this condition.

lotr15119.name: Unreasonable Choice
lotr15119.game_text: Spot 2 [ORC] minions to discard a Free Peoples condition. The Free Peoples player may add (2) for each Free Peoples condition you can spot to prevent that.
lotr15119.lore: An attacking swarm of Orcs leaves few desirable options.

lotr15120.name: Veteran War Chief
lotr15120.game_text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a companion it is skirmishing.
lotr15120.lore: “‘...I'll stick you, if you don't shut it down, see?'”

lotr15121.name: Brilliant Light
lotr15121.game_text: Make a [ROHAN] companion strength +2 (or +3 and damage +1 if he or she is a hunter companion).
lotr15121.lore: “The Orcs reeled and screamed and cast aside both sword and spear.”

lotr15122.name: Burial Mounds
lotr15122.game_text: Make a [ROHAN] companion defender +1 and minions skirmishing that companion cannot take wounds during a skirmish involving that companion until the regroup phase.
lotr15122.lore: “Their hearts were heavy, remembering the many men that had fallen in battle in this place.”

lotr15123.name: Eomer, Horsemaster
lotr15123.subtitle: Horsemaster
lotr15123.game_text: Valiant. Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.) While you can spot a [ROHAN] Man, Eomer?s twilight cost is -1. Skirmish: Discard a [ROHAN] card from hand to make Eomer strength +2.

lotr15124.name: Eomer's Spear, Trusty Weapon
lotr15124.subtitle: Trusty Weapon
lotr15124.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. If bearer is Eomer and he is unwounded, he is damage +1 and resistance +1. Skirmish: If bearer is Eomer, discard this possession to wound a minion he is skirmishing.

lotr15125.name: Eowyn, Willing Fighter
lotr15125.subtitle: Willing Fighter
lotr15125.game_text: Valiant. Response: If a hunter companion or valiant Man is about to take a wound, exert Eowyn to prevent that wound.

lotr15126.name: Gamling, The Old
lotr15126.subtitle: The Old
lotr15126.game_text: Valiant. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) To play, spot a [ROHAN] Man. While you can spot 3 hunters, Gamling is strength +3.
lotr15126.lore: “‘Dawn is not far off.... But dawn will not help us, I fear.'”

lotr15127.name: Grim Trophy
lotr15127.game_text: Make a [ROHAN] Man strength +1 for each hunter you can spot (or if you can spot more valiant Men than hunters, make a [ROHAN] Man strength +1 for each valiant Man you can spot).
lotr15127.lore: “‘At least they will not love the Orcs.'”

lotr15128.name: Haleth, Son of Hama
lotr15128.subtitle: Son of Hama
lotr15128.game_text: While you can spot 2 mounts, Haleth is strength +2. While you can spot 3 mounts, Haleth is damage +1. While you can spot 4 Free Peoples mounts, those mounts can not be discarded by a Shadow player.

lotr15129.name: Horse of Great Stature
lotr15129.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. At the start of each skirmish involving?bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert. Skirmish: Exert bearer to make a [ROHAN] Man strength +1.
lotr15129.lore: “Aragorn saw a shadow on the distant green, a dark swift-moving blur.”

lotr15130.name: Horseman of the North
lotr15130.game_text: While you can spot a valiant Man, this companion?s twilight cost is -1. While no opponent controls a site, this companion is strength +2.
lotr15130.lore: “‘And they became our allies, and have ever proved true to us...'”

lotr15131.name: Our Inspiration
lotr15131.game_text: Spot a [ROHAN] Man to play a possession from your discard pile for each hunter character you can spot.
lotr15131.lore: Decorative armor adorned the hallways and armories of Helm's Deep.

lotr15132.name: Last Days of My House
lotr15132.game_text: Spot 2 [ROHAN] Men (or 1 hunter [ROHAN]?Man) to play a [ROHAN] companion or a [ROHAN]?follower?from your draw deck.
lotr15132.lore: “No parent should have to bury their child.”

lotr15133.name: Rider's Mount
lotr15133.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.
lotr15133.lore: “Their horses were of great stature, strong and clean-limbed; their grey coats glistened, their long tails flowed in the wind....”

lotr15134.name: Rohan Stable Master
lotr15134.game_text: Aid - (1). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (1) to transfer this to a companion.) To play, spot a [ROHAN] Man. Bearer is considered to be mounted.
lotr15134.lore: Rohirrim warriors were seldom seen without their mount.

lotr15135.name: Rohan Worker
lotr15135.game_text: Aid - (1). Each time you transfer this to a companion, except a [ROHAN] companion, exert bearer twice. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may liberate a site.
lotr15135.lore: In preparation for the Battle of Helm's Deep, everyone helped fortify the doors and walls.

lotr15136.name: Rohirrim Axe
lotr15136.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. While bearer is skirmishing a hunter minion, bearer is damage +1.
lotr15136.lore: Rohirrim young and old were given weapons of all kinds to defend Helm's Deep.

lotr15137.name: Rohirrim Doorwarden
lotr15137.game_text: Aid - (2). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (2) to transfer this to a companion.) To play, spot a [ROHAN] Man. Bearer is strength +1 for each possession he or she bears.
lotr15137.lore: “‘...any weapon that you bear, be it only a staff, you must leave it on the threshold.'”

lotr15138.name: Rohirrim Soldier
lotr15138.game_text: Valiant. While you can spot a [ROHAN] Man, this companion?s twilight cost is -1. This companion is strength +1 for each hunter minion you can spot.

lotr15139.name: Rohirrim Warrior
lotr15139.game_text: Valiant. At the start of the maneuver phase, you may spot a hunter minion (or exert 2 valiant Men) to make this companion defender +1 until the regroup phase.
lotr15139.lore: “‘...a warrior should have more skills and knowledge than only the craft of weapons and slaying...'”

lotr15140.name: Spear of the Mark
lotr15140.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. If bearer is mounted, bearer is defender +1.
lotr15140.lore: Rohirrim spears are much deadlier when the bearer is on horseback.

lotr15141.name: Sturdy Shield
lotr15141.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. While no opponent controls a site, bearer is strength +1. Regroup: Discard this to liberate a site (or two sites if bearer is mounted).
lotr15141.lore: Sometimes the best offense is a good defense.

lotr15142.name: Swift Stroke
lotr15142.game_text: Spot your [ROHAN] Man bearing a possession to discard all possessions from one character.
lotr15142.lore: “...she drove her sword between crown and mantle, as the great shoulders bowed before her.”

lotr15143.name: Community Living
lotr15143.game_text: Spot a Hobbit to play a [SHIRE] follower from your draw deck.
lotr15143.lore: “...ease and peace had left this people still curiously tough.”

lotr15144.name: Frodo, Weary From the Journey
lotr15144.subtitle: Weary From the Journey
lotr15144.game_text: Ring-bearer. Ring-bound. While skirmishing a minion of strength 8 or less, Frodo is strength +2.
lotr15144.lore: “‘Let's...get out of this cursed place as quick as we can—if we can!'”

lotr15145.name: Hobbit Sword
lotr15145.lore: “These are for you. Keep them close.”

lotr15146.name: Hobbiton Brewer, Maker of Fine Ales
lotr15146.subtitle: Maker of Fine Ales
lotr15146.game_text: Aid - Add 2 burdens. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add 2 burdens to transfer this to a companion.) To play, spot a Hobbit. Response: If bearer is about to take a wound, transfer Hobbiton Brewer to your support area to prevent that wound.

lotr15147.name: Hobbiton Farmer, Lover of Pipeweed
lotr15147.subtitle: Lover of Pipeweed
lotr15147.game_text: Aid - Add a burden. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a burden to transfer this to a companion.) To play, spot 2 Hobbits. Bearer is strength +1 for each fierce minion you can spot.
lotr15147.lore: “...for ages folk in the Shire smoked various herbs...”

lotr15148.name: Little Golden Flower
lotr15148.game_text: Each Hobbit bearing a hand weapon is vitality +1. Each Hobbit bearing a follower is resistance +1. Each unwounded Hobbit is strength +1.
lotr15148.lore: “‘...she is very beautiful, and is going to be beautifuller still.'”

lotr15149.name: Merry, The Tall One
lotr15149.subtitle: The Tall One
lotr15149.game_text: While Merry bears a follower, he is strength +2. Skirmish: If Merry is skirmishing a hunter minion, add a threat to make Merry strength +2.

lotr15150.name: No Visitors
lotr15150.game_text: Transfer a follower from a Hobbit to your support area to cancel a skirmish involving that Hobbit.

lotr15151.name: Pippin, The Short One
lotr15151.subtitle: The Short One
lotr15151.game_text: Each [SHIRE] follower is twilight cost -1. Skirmish: If Pippin is skirmishing?a hunter minion, exert the Ring-bearer to make Pippin strength +2.

lotr15152.name: Relaxation
lotr15152.game_text: Response: If a Shadow card is about to add any number of burdens, discard a [SHIRE] follower and this condition from play to prevent that and discard that Shadow card.
lotr15152.lore: “As for the Hobbits of the Shire...they were a merry folk.”

lotr15153.name: Sam, Innocent Traveler
lotr15153.subtitle: Innocent Traveler
lotr15153.game_text: Ring-bound. While Sam bears the One Ring, he is resistance -4. Maneuver: If Sam is bearing a follower, exert him to heal another Hobbit. Response: If Frodo is killed, make Sam the Ring-bearer.

lotr15154.name: Second Breakfast
lotr15154.game_text: Add a threat and exert your Ring-bearer to wound each non-hunter minion skirmishing your [SHIRE] Ring-bearer.
lotr15154.lore: “Don't think he knows about second breakfast, Pip.”

lotr15155.name: Advancing Horde
lotr15155.game_text: Damage +1. This minion is strength +1 for each site you control.

lotr15156.name: Charging Uruk
lotr15156.game_text: Fierce. During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it is strength +3 and gains hunter 1 (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
lotr15156.lore: “They kept no order... yet their speed was very great.”

lotr15157.name: Chasing Uruk
lotr15157.game_text: Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may spot 4 hunters (or Ugluk) to control a site.
lotr15157.lore: “‘But why not kill them quick, kill them now?'”

lotr15158.name: Covetous Uruk
lotr15158.game_text: Damage +1. This minion is strength +1 for each possession you spot.
lotr15158.lore: The Uruk-hai pillage the remains of the fallen merely to satisfy their bloodlust.

lotr15159.name: Defensive Rush
lotr15159.game_text: While you can spot an [URUK-HAI] minion, the Free Peoples player cannot replace a site. At the start of each skirmish, you may remove (3) to heal an [URUK-HAI] minion (or heal an [URUK-HAI] minion twice if you control a site.)
lotr15159.lore: Though the arrows rained down, the Uruk formation did not break.

lotr15160.name: Following Uruk
lotr15160.game_text: Fierce. Hunter 1. Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert a companion not assigned to a skirmish.
lotr15160.lore: “The hobbits were left with the Isengarders: a grim dark band...of large, swart, slant-eyed Orcs with great bows and short broad-bladed swords.”

lotr15161.name: Hunting Uruk
lotr15161.game_text: While this minion is at a battleground site, he gains hunter 1 (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)

lotr15162.name: Lurtz, Now Perfected
lotr15162.subtitle: Now Perfected
lotr15162.game_text: Damage +1. Each time Lurtz wins a skirmish, the Free People?s player must exert X companions, where X is the current region number.

lotr15163.name: Lurtz's Sword, Mighty Longsword
lotr15163.subtitle: Mighty Longsword
lotr15163.game_text: Bearer must be an [URUK-HAI] Uruk-hai. Bearer gains hunter 1 (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) If bearer is Lurtz, he is fierce.
lotr15163.lore: Defeating an Uruk with a broad-bladed sword is not easily done.

lotr15164.name: Mauhur, Relentless Hunter
lotr15164.subtitle: Relentless Hunter
lotr15164.game_text: Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.). Assignment: Exert Mauhur to assign him to a non-hunter character (except the Ring-bearer).

lotr15165.name: Merciless Berserker
lotr15165.game_text: Damage +1. Shadow: Exert this minion to exert X companions and add X threats, where X is the number of Free Peoples cultures you spot over 2.
lotr15165.lore: “These are Uruk-hai. Their armor is thick and their shields broad.”

lotr15166.name: Poised for Assault
lotr15166.game_text: Each time a companion loses a skirmish involving an [URUK-HAI] minion, place an [URUK-HAI] token here. Skirmish: Remove 2 [URUK-HAI] tokens from here to take control of a site.
lotr15166.lore: “Over the wall...the last assault came sweeping like a dark wave upon a hill of sand.”

lotr15167.name: Pursuing Uruk
lotr15167.game_text: Fierce. During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it gains hunter 4.
lotr15167.lore: “‘I wish to kill, and then go back north.'”

lotr15168.name: Searching Uruk
lotr15168.game_text: Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) Searching Uruk is strength +1 for each other [URUK-HAI] hunter you can spot.

lotr15169.name: Seeking Uruk
lotr15169.game_text: Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it is strength +1 for each hunter you can spot.
lotr15169.lore: “‘Rest while you can! We'll find a use for your legs before long.'”

lotr15170.name: Sentry Uruk
lotr15170.game_text: To play, spot an [URUK-HAI] minion. While you can spot a fierce minion, this minion is fierce. While you can spot a hunter, this minion gains hunter 1. While you can spot a character that is damage +1, this minion is damage +1.

lotr15171.name: Tracking Uruk
lotr15171.game_text: Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
lotr15171.lore: “‘We are servants of Saruman the Wise, the White Hand: the Hand that gives us man's-flesh to eat.'”

lotr15172.name: Ugluk, Ugly Fellow
lotr15172.subtitle: Ugly Fellow
lotr15172.game_text: Fierce. Hunter 3. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +3.) At the start of each skirmish involving Ugluk, each non-hunter skirmishing Ugluk must exert.

lotr15173.name: Ugluk's Sword, Weapon of Command
lotr15173.subtitle: Weapon of Command
lotr15173.game_text: Bearer must be an [URUK-HAI] Uruk-hai. While you control 2 or more sites, bearer can not take wounds (except during skirmish phases). If bearer is Ugluk, he is damage +1.

lotr15174.name: Uruk Cavern Striker
lotr15174.game_text: Damage +1. Skirmish: Spot a Free Peoples player?s site on the adventure path and exert this minion twice to exchange the spotted site with a site you control. You now control the spotted site.

lotr15175.name: Uruk Infantry
lotr15175.game_text: Damage +1. While you can spot a companion of strength 10 or more, this minion is strength +2. Regroup: Exert 4 [URUK-HAI] minions (or discard 3 [URUK-HAI] minions) to take control of a site.
lotr15175.lore: “March to Helm's Deep! Leave none alive!”

lotr15176.name: Uruk Village Assassin
lotr15176.game_text: Damage +1. At the start of the maneuver phase, you may spot another [URUK-HAI] minion and remove 3 [URUK-HAI] tokens to take control of a site or discard a follower.
lotr15176.lore: “Rohan, my Lord, is ready to fall.”

lotr15177.name: Uruk Village Rager
lotr15177.game_text: Damage +1. Each time this minion wins a skirmish, take control of a site. While you control a site, this minion cannot take wounds (except during the skirmish phase).

lotr15178.name: Uruk Village Stormer
lotr15178.game_text: Damage +1. While you can spot a companion of strength 12 or more, this minion is strength +4. Each time a companion or ally is killed during a skirmish involving an [URUK-HAI] minion, you may take control of a site.

lotr15179.name: Violent Hurl
lotr15179.game_text: Make an [URUK-HAI] minion strength +2 (and damage +1 if that minion is a hunter).
lotr15179.lore: Uruk-hai weaponry was built to be used offensively and defensively, depending on the situation.

lotr15180.name: With All Possible Speed
lotr15180.game_text: Each unwounded hunter [URUK-HAI] minion is strength +1. Response: If your hunter minion is about to take a wound during a skirmish, discard that minion to exert a non-hunter companion.
lotr15180.lore: “They seemed to have left winter clinging to the hills behind.”

lotr15181.name: Later Than You Think
lotr15181.game_text: Remove 2 threats to play a Nazgul. That Nazgul is twilight cost -2 and gains hunter?2 (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.) until the start of the regroup phase.

lotr15182.name: A Shadow Fell Over Them
lotr15182.game_text: Each time a Nazgul wins a skirmish, you may exert 2 Nazgul (or a Nazgul twice) to add a threat. Assignment: Spot a Nazgul and remove (4) to play a Nazgul from your discard pile.
lotr15182.lore: “...a blind fear and a deadly cold fell on them. Cowering they looked up.”

lotr15183.name: They Feel the Precious
lotr15183.game_text: Response: If a Nazgul is about to take a wound, remove a threat to prevent that wound.
lotr15183.lore: “‘Three times is a threat. They feel us here...'”

lotr15184.name: Ulaire Attea, Desirous of Power
lotr15184.subtitle: Desirous of Power
lotr15184.game_text: Fierce. Ulaire Attea is strength +1 for every 3 twilight tokens you can spot.
lotr15184.lore: The Nazgûl were strongest, and most terrifying, at night.

lotr15185.name: Ulaire Lemenya, Eternally Threatening
lotr15185.subtitle: Eternally Threatening
lotr15185.game_text: Fierce. When you play Ulaire Lemenya, you may remove (1) to add a threat for each Free Peoples culture you can spot.
lotr15185.lore: “Soon there could be no doubt: three or four tall black figures were standing on the slope, looking down on them.”

lotr15186.name: Ulaire Nelya, Fell Rider
lotr15186.subtitle: Fell Rider
lotr15186.game_text: Fierce. While you can spot 6 companions, [WRAITH] minions cannot take wounds (except during skirmish phases). Skirmish: If this minion is mounted, exert him twice to wound a companion bearing a [WRAITH] condition.

lotr15187.name: Anduin River
lotr15187.game_text: River. The fellowship archery total is -3.

lotr15188.name: Breeding Pit of Isengard
lotr15188.game_text: Underground. The twilight cost of the first hunter minion played each shadow phase is -2.

lotr15189.name: City Gates
lotr15189.game_text: When the Fellowship moves to this site, add a threat (or 2 if you can spot a hunter minion) for each companion over 4.

lotr15190.name: East Wall of Rohan
lotr15190.game_text: At the start of the Fellowship phase, you may exert two hunter companions to play a hunter companion from your draw deck.

lotr15191.name: Gate of Mordor
lotr15191.game_text: Battleground. Each time the fellowship moves to this site add (1) for each culture you can spot.

lotr15192.name: Isengard Ruined
lotr15192.game_text: Battleground. Each time a follower is transferred to a character, the first Shadow player may exert a companion twice.

lotr15193.name: Mount Doom
lotr15193.game_text: Battleground. Mountain. Underground. Until the end of the game, sites in this region cannot be replaced.

lotr15194.name: Westfold Village
lotr15194.game_text: Plains. Each hunter character is strength +1.

lotr16001.name: Barrow-wight Stalker
lotr16001.game_text: Enduring. Each [WRAITH] Wraith cannot take wounds (except during skirmishes). Shadow: Remove a burden to play a [WRAITH] Wraith. That minion's twilight cost is -2.
lotr16001.lore: “The icy touch froze his bones, and he remembered no more.”

lotr16002.name: Candle Corpses
lotr16002.game_text: Enduring. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to a companion, you may spot another [WRAITH] Wraith and remove (2) to wound that companion.
lotr16002.lore: “...here and there they twisted like ghostly sheets unfurled by hidden hands.”

lotr16003.name: Covetous Wisp
lotr16003.game_text: Enduring. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns Covetous Wisp to a companion, you may spot another [WRAITH] Wraith and remove (2) to add a burden.
lotr16003.lore: “‘Only shapes to see, perhaps, not to touch.'”

lotr16004.name: Dead Faces
lotr16004.game_text: Enduring. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to a companion, you may spot another [WRAITH] Wraith and remove (2) to discard a condition.
lotr16004.lore: “‘There are dead things, dead faces in the water!'”

lotr16005.name: Spirit of Dread
lotr16005.game_text: Enduring. While you can spot another [WRAITH] Wraith, wounds cannot be healed and burdens can not be removed (except by Wraiths). Skirmish: Exert Spirit of Dread to make another [WRAITH] Wraith strength +1.
lotr16005.lore: “...across their three necks lay one long naked sword.”

lotr16006.name: Undead of Angmar
lotr16006.game_text: Enduring. While you can spot another [WRAITH] Wraith, each wounded companion is resistance -2. Shadow: Exert Undead of Angmar twice to play a [WRAITH] Wraith from your draw deck, then reshuffle.
lotr16006.lore: “In the dark there was a snarling noise.”

lotr17001.name: Ring of Artifice
lotr17001.game_text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Bearer is damage +1. Bearer is strength +1 for each [DWARVEN] artifact in your discard pile. Regroup: Discard this to take a non-event [DWARVEN] card into hand from your discard pile.
lotr17001.lore: "'Beyond the Shadow it waits for you still...'"

lotr17002.name: Glamdring, Orc Beater
lotr17002.subtitle: Orc Beater
lotr17002.game_text: Bearer must be Gandalf. Bearer is damage +1. Each time a companion is about to take a wound, you may discard a companion from hand to prevent that.
lotr17002.lore: "...in his other hand Glamdring gleamed, cold and white."

lotr17003.name: Shadowfax, Greatest of the Mearas
lotr17003.subtitle: Greatest of the Mearas
lotr17003.game_text: Bearer must be a [GANDALF] Wizard. Discard all other possessions on bearer and bearer may not bear a hand weapon. Fellowship: Add a threat to remove a burden.
lotr17003.lore: "There are no horses like those that are bred in that great vale between the Misty Mountains and the White."

lotr17004.name: Gwaihir, The Windlord
lotr17004.subtitle: The Windlord
lotr17004.game_text: Aid - Add a threat. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a threat to transfer this to a companion.) If bearer is a [GANDALF] Wizard, each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert a minion (if that minion is a Wizard, wound it instead).

lotr17005.name: Anduril, Sword That Was Broken
lotr17005.subtitle: Sword That Was Broken
lotr17005.game_text: Bearer must be Aragorn. He is damage +1. Each time Aragorn wins a skirmish, you may exert him to liberate a site or discard a condition borne by a companion.

lotr17006.name: Faramir, Bearer of Quality
lotr17006.subtitle: Bearer of Quality
lotr17006.game_text: While Faramir is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or 2 threats. Skirmish: While Faramir is the Ring-bearer, you may wound Faramir to make a minion skirmishing a [GONDOR] Man roaming until the end of turn.

lotr17007.name: Narsil, Forged by Telchar
lotr17007.subtitle: Forged by Telchar
lotr17007.lore: "...and the sword of Elendil filled Orcs and Men with fear...."

lotr17008.name: Throne of Minas Tirith
lotr17008.game_text: To play, spot Denethor (or 2 [GONDOR] companions). Each time a minion is killed or discarded from play during a skirmish, you may reinforce a [GONDOR] token. Skirmish: Remove 3 [GONDOR] tokens to discard a possession.

lotr17009.name: Throne of Isengard
lotr17009.game_text: Each time you play Saruman, spot a minion. That minion is fierce until the start of the regroup phase. Each Wizard is strength +3 and damage +1.
lotr17009.lore: From the heights of Orthanc, Saruman spied on Middle-earth and plotted his rise to power.

lotr17010.name: Stampeding Chief
lotr17010.game_text: Damage +1. Fierce. If you play Stampeding Chief from your hand, remove (3) and spot another [MEN] minion or discard Stampeding Chief.
lotr17010.lore: But no more would Rohan stand against his kind.

lotr17011.name: Orkish Invader
lotr17011.game_text: At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may reveal an [ORC] condition from hand to wound the companion this minion is skirmishing twice and then discard this minion.
lotr17011.lore: Spawned from terrible acts, the Orcs emerged as ruined and terrible forms of life.

lotr17012.name: Aragorn, Defender of Rohan
lotr17012.subtitle: Defender of Rohan
lotr17012.game_text: Valiant. While the Ringbearer is assigned to a skirmish, each [ROHAN] companion gains hunter 1.
lotr17012.lore: "'No enemy has yet taken the Hornburg. Depart, or not one of you will be spared.'"

lotr17013.name: Throne of the Golden Hall
lotr17013.game_text: To play, spot Theoden (or 2 [ROHAN] companions). Saruman and Grima cannot be assigned to skirmishes. Response: If a [ROHAN] Man is about to take a wound, exert another [ROHAN] Man and add (2) to prevent that.

lotr17014.name: Theoden, Northman, King of Rohan
lotr17014.subtitle: Northman, King of Rohan
lotr17014.game_text: While the Ringbearer is assigned to a skirmish, each [ROHAN] companion is strength +1. Regroup: Spot 2 [ROHAN] followers and exert Theoden to liberate a site.
lotr17014.lore: "When last I looked, Théoden, was King of Rohan."

lotr17015.name: Throne of the Dark Lord
lotr17015.game_text: To play, spot 2 minions. While you can spot Sauron, each other minion is damage +1. While the fellowship is in the same region as Mount Doom, each companion is resistance -2.
lotr17015.lore: "One for the Dark Lord on his dark throne."

lotr17016.name: Ulaire Otsea, Duplicitous Specter
lotr17016.subtitle: Duplicitous Specter
lotr17016.game_text: Fierce. When you play Ulaire Otsea, you may spot another Nazgul to draw a card for each wounded companion you can spot. Regroup: Exert Ulaire Otsea and discard a [WRAITH] card from hand to add a burden.
lotr17016.lore: "Blinded by their greed, they took them without question."

lotr17017.name: Ring of Savagery
lotr17017.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must either add a burden or exert a companion. Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.

lotr17018.name: Ring of Terror
lotr17018.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. Bearer is damage +1. When you play this artifact, you may remove two threats to take a [WRAITH] card into hand from your discard pile. Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.

lotr17019.name: Guidance of the Istari
lotr17019.game_text: Make a [GANDALF] companion strength +1 for each [GANDALF] Man you can spot.
lotr17019.lore: "Hold them back. Do not give in to fear! Stand your posts! Fight!"

lotr17020.name: Gwaihir, The Windlord
lotr17020.subtitle: The Windlord
lotr17020.game_text: Aid - Add a threat. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a threat to transfer this to a companion.) If bearer is a [GANDALF] Wizard, each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert a minion (if that minion is a Wizard, wound it instead).

lotr17021.name: Long-stemmed Pipe
lotr17021.game_text: Pipeweed. When you play this, you may search your deck for a [GANDALF] card and place it in your discard pile. Regroup: Discard another pipeweed from play to discard a condition. Discard this condition.
lotr17021.lore: The smoke from his pipe drifted up, obscuring his face.

lotr17022.name: Meneldor, Misty Mountain Eagle
lotr17022.subtitle: Misty Mountain Eagle
lotr17022.game_text: Aid - (1). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (1) to transfer this to a companion.) To play, spot a [GANDALF] follower. Bearer is strength +1 for each other [GANDALF] follower you can spot.
lotr17022.lore: To many he was known as the swift.

lotr17023.name: Scintillating Bird
lotr17023.game_text: Spell. Fellowship: Exert your Wizard and choose an opponent to name either Free Peoples or Shadow. Reveal the top three cards of your deck. If you revealed at least two of the chosen card type, take those cards into hand, otherwise, discard those cards.

lotr17024.name: Shadowfax, Greatest of the Mearas
lotr17024.subtitle: Greatest of the Mearas
lotr17024.game_text: Bearer must be a [GANDALF] Wizard. Discard all other possessions on bearer and bearer may not bear a hand weapon. Fellowship: Add a threat to remove a burden.
lotr17024.lore: "There are no horses like those that are bred in that great vale between the Misty Mountains and the White."

lotr17025.name: The Sap is in the Bough
lotr17025.game_text: Discard a companion from hand to make a [GANDALF] companion strength +3 (or +4 if you can spot 3 Ents).
lotr17025.lore: "'Together we will take the road that leads into the west/ and far away, we'll find a land where both our hearts may rest.'"

lotr17026.name: Woodland Onod
lotr17026.game_text: Skirmish: Discard a companion from hand to make an Ent strength +2.

lotr17027.name: Anduril, Sword That Was Broken
lotr17027.subtitle: Sword That Was Broken
lotr17027.game_text: Bearer must be Aragorn. He is damage +1. Each time Aragorn wins a skirmish, you may exert him to liberate a site or discard a condition borne by a companion.

lotr17028.name: Faramir, Bearer of Quality
lotr17028.subtitle: Bearer of Quality
lotr17028.game_text: While Faramir is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or 2 threats. Skirmish: While Faramir is the Ring-bearer, you may wound Faramir to make a minion skirmishing a [GONDOR] Man roaming until the end of turn.

lotr17029.name: Faramir's Bow, Ithilien Longbow
lotr17029.subtitle: Ithilien Longbow
lotr17029.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] ranger. If bearer is Faramir, he is an archer. The site number of each minion skirmishing a [GONDOR] ranger is +1. Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to exhaust a minion Faramir is skirmishing.

lotr17030.name: Madril, Loyal Lieutenant
lotr17030.subtitle: Loyal Lieutenant
lotr17030.game_text: Ranger. Hunter 1. While you can spot a roaming minion, your [GONDOR] conditions cannot be discarded from play by Shadow cards. Maneuver: Exert 2 rangers to make a minion site number +2 until the regroup phase.

lotr17031.name: Narsil, Forged by Telchar
lotr17031.subtitle: Forged by Telchar
lotr17031.game_text: Bearer must be Elendil or Isildur. Bearer is damage +1. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert him to discard a Shadow possession.
lotr17031.lore: "...and the sword of Elendil filled Orcs and Men with fear...."

lotr17032.name: Nimble Attack
lotr17032.game_text: Spot 2 [GONDOR] companions and add a threat to discard a Shadow possession.
lotr17032.lore: "'We shall be pursued as soon as news of our deed reaches the Enemy...'"

lotr17033.name: Ranger of the White Tree
lotr17033.game_text: Ranger. Hunter 1. When this is in your starting fellowship and you can spot an unbound [GONDOR] companion with cost 3 or more, his twilight cost is -2. Maneuver: Exert this companion and spot a roaming minion to make him defender +1 until the start of the regroup phase.

lotr17034.name: Spirit of the White Tree
lotr17034.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] companion. An opponent can not play skirmish events or use skirmish special abilities during skirmishes involving bearer. Each time a Shadow player adds a burden, discard this condition.

lotr17036.name: Throne of Minas Tirith
lotr17036.game_text: To play, spot Denethor (or 2 [GONDOR] companions). Each time a minion is killed or discarded from play during a skirmish, you may reinforce a [GONDOR] token. Skirmish: Remove 3 [GONDOR] tokens to discard a possession.

lotr17037.name: Saruman, Instigator of Insurrection
lotr17037.subtitle: Instigator of Insurrection
lotr17037.game_text: Saruman cannot be assigned to a skirmish. While you can spot 6 companions, each minion gains hunter 2. Response: If a hunter minion is about to take a wound, exert Saruman to prevent that.

lotr17038.name: Saruman, Servant of Sauron
lotr17038.subtitle: Servant of Sauron
lotr17038.game_text: Aid - (1). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may remove (1) to transfer this to a minion.) Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert a companion.
lotr17038.lore: "'I gave you the chance of aiding me willingly, but you have elected the way of pain.'"

lotr17039.name: Throne of Isengard
lotr17039.game_text: Each time you play Saruman, spot a minion. That minion is fierce until the start of the regroup phase. Each Wizard is strength +3 and damage +1.
lotr17039.lore: From the heights of Orthanc, Saruman spied on Middle-earth and plotted his rise to power.

lotr17040.name: Beast of War
lotr17040.game_text: Bearer must be a [MEN] Man. While you can spot a threat, bearer is fierce. While you can spot 3 threats, bearer is damage +1. While you can spot 5 threats, you may play this from your discard pile.
lotr17040.lore: "...mûmakil were bellowing as they were goaded to war."

lotr17041.name: Ceremonial Armor
lotr17041.game_text: Each time a [MEN] minion is discarded during the maneuver phase, you may stack it here. Response: Discard a minion stacked here or discard this to prevent a wound to a [MEN] minion.
lotr17041.lore: Scarlet cloaks and bronze armor adorned the marching forces

lotr17042.name: Easterling Dispatcher
lotr17042.game_text: When you play this minion, you may spot 2 other [MEN] Men to add (1) for each possession you spot.
lotr17042.lore: The men of Rhûn's preparation for battle was second to none.

lotr17043.name: Easterling Sneak
lotr17043.game_text: While you control 2 sites, Easterling Sneak is fierce. While you control 4 sites, each [MEN] minion is strength +1 and fierce.
lotr17043.lore: "The dark is gathering all armies to him."

lotr17044.name: Grima's Dagger
lotr17044.game_text: Bearer must be a [MEN] Man. If bearer is Grima, he is strength +1 for each Free Peoples culture you can spot over 2. Response: If a skirmish event is played, discard this possession to cancel that event.
lotr17044.lore: The blade of a pathetic creature.

lotr17045.name: In the Wild Men's Wake
lotr17045.game_text: Spot a [MEN] possession in your support area and a [MEN] minion. Make that minion strength +1 for each minion stacked on that possession. You may discard that possession to make that minion damage +1.
lotr17045.lore: "Too long have these peasants stood against you."

lotr17046.name: Pandemonium
lotr17046.game_text: Play a [MEN] minion stacked on a [MEN] possession as if from hand.
lotr17046.lore: Few could escape the oncoming pillage of the Dunlending's savage stampede.

lotr17047.name: Primitive Brand
lotr17047.game_text: Bearer must be a [MEN] minion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish you may transfer this possession to another [MEN] minion. If you do, stack a [MEN] minion from play on a [MEN] possession in your support area.
lotr17047.lore: The men of Dunland took even the most basic of tools to be weapons against Rohan.

lotr17048.name: Saruman, Coldly Still
lotr17048.subtitle: Coldly Still
lotr17048.game_text: Each [MEN] minion bearing a possession is strength +2. Skirmish: Exert Saruman to play a [MEN] possession from your discard pile.
lotr17048.lore: "Take back what they stole from you!"

lotr17049.name: Stampeding Chief
lotr17049.game_text: Damage +1. Fierce. If you play Stampeding Chief from your hand, remove (3) and spot another [MEN] minion or discard Stampeding Chief.
lotr17049.lore: But no more would Rohan stand against his kind.

lotr17050.name: Stampeding Hillsman
lotr17050.game_text: Regroup: Spot a [MEN] minion in your discard pile and discard this minion to place that minion on your [MEN] support area possession.

lotr17051.name: Stampeding Madman
lotr17051.game_text: To play, spot 2 [MEN] Men. When you play this minion, you may make the Free Peoples player exert a companion for each site you control.
lotr17051.lore: "'"Death to the robbers of the North!"'"

lotr17052.name: Stampeding Ransacker
lotr17052.game_text: To play, spot 2 [MEN] Men. Each time this minion wins a skirmish and you can spot a site you control, exhaust an unbound companion.

lotr17053.name: Stampeding Savage
lotr17053.game_text: Maneuver: Discard this minion and X minions stacked on a [MEN] possession to play a [MEN] minion from your discard pile. That minion is twilight cost -X.

lotr17054.name: Stampeding Shepherd
lotr17054.game_text: Fierce. Maneuver: Discard this minion and a [MEN] minion with a twilight cost 2 or less from play to play Stampeding Chief from your draw deck. It is twilight cost -8.

lotr17055.name: Sunland Guard
lotr17055.game_text: Maneuver: Exert this minion to play a [MEN] minion (or 2 if you spot 6 companions) from a [MEN] possession as if from hand.
lotr17055.lore: They prepare for the last war.

lotr17056.name: Sunland Scout
lotr17056.game_text: This minion is strength +1 for each [MEN] possession with a [MEN] minion stacked on it. Maneuver: spot a [MEN] possession and discard this minion from play to discard a condition.
lotr17056.lore: The Southrons did not march into war blindly.

lotr17057.name: Sunland Skirmisher
lotr17057.game_text: This minion is strength +1 for each [MEN] minion stacked on each [MEN] possession. At the start of the maneuver phase, you may play a minion stacked on a [MEN] possession as if from hand.
lotr17057.lore: Vile servants of Sauron marched to their master.

lotr17058.name: Sunland Sneak
lotr17058.game_text: This minion is twilight cost -1 for each [MEN] minion stacked on a [MEN] possession.
lotr17058.lore: Southron men were always ready for war.

lotr17059.name: Sunland Trooper
lotr17059.game_text: This minion is strength +2 for each [MEN] possession with a [MEN] minion stacked on it. Maneuver: Spot X [MEN] minions stacked on a [MEN] possession and discard this minion to add (X).

lotr17060.name: Sunland Warrior
lotr17060.game_text: Maneuver: Spot a [MEN] possession and discard this minion from play to make each [MEN] minion you spot strength +2 until the start of the regroup phase.

lotr17061.name: Sunland Weaponmaster
lotr17061.game_text: To play, spot 2 [MEN] Men. While this minion bears a possession, he is strength +2 for each Free Peoples culture you can spot.
lotr17061.lore: "War will make corpses of us all."

lotr17062.name: Vengeful Savage
lotr17062.game_text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may stack a [MEN] minion from your discard pile on a [MEN] possession in your support area.

lotr17063.name: Vengeful Wild Man
lotr17063.game_text: At the start of the maneuver phase, spot another [MEN] Man and exert this minion to add a threat. Then add an additional threat for each companion you spot over 4.
lotr17063.lore: The pawns of Saruman are relentless in their tasks.

lotr17064.name: Vengeful Pillager
lotr17064.game_text: When you play this minion from your draw deck or from your [MEN] possesion it is fierce until the regroup phase.

lotr17065.name: Vengeful Primitive
lotr17065.game_text: You may play this minion any time you could play a maneuver event. When you play this minion in the maneuver phase, you may discard X [MEN] minions from play to add (X).
lotr17065.lore: Incited by Saruman, they created pandemonium in the land of Rohan.

lotr17066.name: Wildman's Oath
lotr17066.game_text: Each time a [MEN] minion is discarded during the maneuver phase, you may stack it here. Skirmish: Discard this possession to make a [MEN] Man strength +2.
lotr17066.lore: "Take back the lands they stole from you!"

lotr17067.name: A Defiled Charge
lotr17067.game_text: To play, exert your mounted [ORC] Orc. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns a mounted [ORC] Orc to a companion, he or she must choose to either exert that companion or add (2).
lotr17067.lore: "The wolf snarled and sprang towards them with a great leap."

lotr17068.name: Chaotic Clash
lotr17068.game_text: To play, spot no minions. Each time you play a minion, it is twilight cost +1. While you can spot an [ORC] minion, each companion is strength -1.
lotr17068.lore: An Orc often was spurred into battle as if death was preferable to the torment of its orkish life.

lotr17069.name: Cry and Panic
lotr17069.game_text: Each time a mounted [ORC] Orc wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must reveal his or her hand and place two Free Peoples cards revealed on the bottom of his or her draw deck.

lotr17070.name: Feral Ride
lotr17070.game_text: Make an [ORC] minion strength +2 (or +4 if it is mounted).
lotr17070.lore: It was hard at times to tell who was truly the master, the warg or the Orc.

lotr17071.name: Grishnakh, Treacherous Captain
lotr17071.subtitle: Treacherous Captain
lotr17071.game_text: Hunter 2. While you can spot an [URUK-HAI] minion, each [ORC] Orc gains hunter 1 (if that [URUK-HAI] minion is Ugluk, each [ORC] Orc gains an additional hunter 1). Shadow: Exert Grishnakh twice to play an [URUK-HAI] hunter minion from your draw deck.

lotr17072.name: Orkish Assassin
lotr17072.game_text: While you can spot a follower attached to a companion, each [ORC] minion is strength +2.
lotr17072.lore: Vile villain of all that opposed his master.

lotr17073.name: Orkish Berserker
lotr17073.game_text: When this minion wins a skirmish, discard an [ORC] minion from play.

lotr17074.name: Orkish Cavalry
lotr17074.game_text: Each time you play an [ORC] mount, you may draw a card. Assignment: If this minion is mounted, exert it twice to assign it to a companion of strength 9 or more.
lotr17074.lore: With speed and numbers, these feared riders were not easily avoided.

lotr17075.name: Orkish Dreg
lotr17075.game_text: Each time you play this minion, you may spot another [ORC] minion to exert a companion for each Free Peoples culture you can spot over 2.
lotr17075.lore: Under the cover of darkness the Orcs came.

lotr17076.name: Orkish Fiend
lotr17076.game_text: To play, spot an [ORC] Orc. While at an underground site, this minion is fierce and the Free Peoples player may not replace sites or play a site from his or her adventure deck.
lotr17076.lore: Dwellers of foul pits and tunnels.

lotr17077.name: Orkish Flanker
lotr17077.game_text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, if it is mounted, exert a companion. Shadow: Exert 3 [ORC] minions and spot an [ORC] mount to discard a condition.
lotr17077.lore: Quick to contain their fleeing victims, the Orkish riders were always feared.

lotr17078.name: Orkish Footman
lotr17078.game_text: This minion is strength +1 for each twilight token you can spot.
lotr17078.lore: They feared their master more than any enemy.

lotr17079.name: Orkish Invader
lotr17079.game_text: At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may reveal an [ORC] condition from hand to wound the companion this minion is skirmishing twice and then discard this minion.
lotr17079.lore: Spawned from terrible acts, the Orcs emerged as ruined and terrible forms of life.

lotr17080.name: Orkish Lackey
lotr17080.game_text: Maneuver: Spot 2 [ORC] conditions and discard this minion from play to wound an unbound companion.
lotr17080.lore: They came from dark and evil places.

lotr17081.name: Orkish Maurader
lotr17081.game_text: This minion is strength +1 for each [ORC] condition in your discard pile.
lotr17081.lore: As the Orcs silently approached, the fear they brought multiplied.

lotr17082.name: Orkish Rider
lotr17082.game_text: Each mounted [ORC] Orc is strength +1. Shadow: discard an [ORC] card from your hand to play an [ORC] mount from your discard pile.
lotr17082.lore: They formed the cavalry of the Orc legions.

lotr17083.name: Orkish Runner
lotr17083.game_text: Shadow: Exert this minion and spot another [ORC] minion to add (X), where X is the number of the current region.
lotr17083.lore: Orcs were kept in check by the light of the Sun.

lotr17084.name: Orkish Scout
lotr17084.game_text: Shadow: Exert this minion to add (X), where X is the current site's Shadow number.

lotr17085.name: Orkish Traveler
lotr17085.game_text: Each [ORC] mount is twilight cost -1. Skirmish: Remove (3) to make a mounted [ORC] Orc strength +2.
lotr17085.lore: There is not much that is fouler than Orcs.

lotr17086.name: Orkish Veteran
lotr17086.game_text: Each time you play an [ORC] mount, you may reinforce an [ORC] token. Regroup: Exert Orkish Veteran to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lotr17086.lore: Skin as dark as wood that has been charred by flame.

lotr17087.name: Orkish Warg-master
lotr17087.game_text: Each time a mounted [ORC] minion wins a skirmish, you may make the Free Peoples player place a card from his or her hand on top of his or her draw deck. Shadow: Exert bearer to play an [ORC] mount from your discard pile.

lotr17088.name: Orkish Warrior
lotr17088.game_text: While you can spot a companion of strength 12 or more, this minion is strength +4. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, discard this minion.
lotr17088.lore: These Orcs were loathsome as Elves were fair.

lotr17089.name: Relentless Warg
lotr17089.game_text: Bearer must be an [ORC] Orc with strength 10 or less. Bearer is fierce. When you play this possession, spot a race. While bearer is skirmishing a companion of that race, bearer is strength +3 and damage +1.

lotr17090.name: Rider's Gear
lotr17090.game_text: Bearer must be an [ORC] Orc. While bearer is mounted, it cannot take wounds except during the skirmish phase.
lotr17090.lore: Foul of smell but light to bear, a warg would often allow its rider little leeway.

lotr17091.name: Threatening Warg
lotr17091.game_text: Bearer must be an [ORC] Orc with strength 10 or less. Bearer is fierce. When you play this, you may spot 2 [ORC] Orcs that are not bearing mounts to play an [ORC] mount from your draw deck.
lotr17091.lore: "'The wolf that one hears is worse than the orc that one fears.'"

lotr17092.name: Vicious Warg
lotr17092.game_text: Bearer must be an [ORC] Orc with strength 9 or less. Bearer is fierce.
lotr17092.lore: "'...where the warg howls, there also the orc prowls.'"

lotr17093.name: Aragorn, Defender of Rohan
lotr17093.subtitle: Defender of Rohan
lotr17093.game_text: Valiant. While the Ringbearer is assigned to a skirmish, each [ROHAN] companion gains hunter 1.
lotr17093.lore: "'No enemy has yet taken the Hornburg. Depart, or not one of you will be spared.'"

lotr17094.name: Dispatched with Haste
lotr17094.game_text: While at a plains site, each mounted companion is strength +1. Regroup: Spot 2 [ROHAN] Men and discard a [ROHAN] possession to discard a possession.
lotr17094.lore: "Assemble the army at Dunharrow, as many men as can be found."

lotr17095.name: Eomer, Northman
lotr17095.subtitle: Northman
lotr17095.game_text: Damage +1. While the Ringbearer is assigned to a skirmish, Eomer is strength +3. Maneuver: If Eomer is mounted, exert him to make him defender +1 until the end of turn.
lotr17095.lore: "We cannot achieve victory through strength of arms."

lotr17096.name: Eowyn, Northwoman
lotr17096.subtitle: Northwoman
lotr17096.game_text: While the Ringbearer is assigned to a skirmish, Eowyn cannot take wounds while skirmishing. Assignment: Exert Eowyn and assign a minion to the Ring-bearer to make that minion lose all keywords and unable to gain keywords until the regroup phase.

lotr17097.name: For Death and Glory
lotr17097.game_text: While the Ringbearer is assigned to a skirmish, each minion skirmishing a [ROHAN] companion loses hunter and is unable to gain hunter. Skirmish: Exert a [ROHAN] companion to make that companion gain hunter 1 until the start of the regroup phase.

lotr17098.name: Throne of the Golden Hall
lotr17098.game_text: To play, spot Theoden (or 2 [ROHAN] companions). Saruman and Grima cannot be assigned to skirmishes. Response: If a [ROHAN] Man is about to take a wound, exert another [ROHAN] Man and add (2) to prevent that.

lotr17099.name: Hama, Northman
lotr17099.subtitle: Northman
lotr17099.game_text: While the Ringbearer is assigned to a skirmish, each minion skirmishing Hama loses strength bonuses and damage bonuses from possessions.

lotr17100.name: Into the Caves
lotr17100.game_text: To play, spot 3 [ROHAN] companions. Assignment: Assign a minion to Frodo to make that minion lose all keywords of your choice and unable to gain keywords until the regroup phase.
lotr17100.lore: "Saruman's arm will have grown long indeed if he thinks he can reach us here."

lotr17101.name: Soldier of Rohan
lotr17101.game_text: While the Ringbearer is assigned to a skirmish, this companion is strength +2.
lotr17101.lore: For ages, the people of Rohan have been allied to Gondor.

lotr17102.name: Theoden, Northman, King of Rohan
lotr17102.subtitle: Northman, King of Rohan
lotr17102.game_text: While the Ringbearer is assigned to a skirmish, each [ROHAN] companion is strength +1. Regroup: Spot 2 [ROHAN] followers and exert Theoden to liberate a site.
lotr17102.lore: "When last I looked, Théoden, was King of Rohan."

lotr17103.name: Where Now the Horse
lotr17103.game_text: Spot a [ROHAN] companion to make Frodo strength +5. If Frodo loses the skirmish, discard that [ROHAN] companion.
lotr17103.lore: "'They have passed like rain in the mountains, like the wind in the meadow.'"

lotr17104.name: Warrior of Rohan
lotr17104.game_text: Possessions cannot be transferred from this companion to another character. Fellowship: Play a possession on this companion to liberate a site.
lotr17104.lore: Rohirrim territories are not easily taken.

lotr17105.name: Throne of the Dark Lord
lotr17105.game_text: To play, spot 2 minions. While you can spot Sauron, each other minion is damage +1. While the fellowship is in the same region as Mount Doom, each companion is resistance -2.
lotr17105.lore: "One for the Dark Lord on his dark throne."

lotr17106.name: Halfling Leaf
lotr17106.game_text: Pipeweed. To play, spot a Hobbit. Skirmish: Discard a pipeweed from play to cancel a skirmish involving an unbound Hobbit.
lotr17106.lore: "'It feels good, and it smells good.'"

lotr17107.name: Merry, In the Bloom of Health
lotr17107.subtitle: In the Bloom of Health
lotr17107.game_text: Add 1 to the number of Ents you can spot. Regroup: Exert Merry to place a pipeweed from your discard pile beneath your draw deck.
lotr17107.lore: "'I think we may have made a mistake leaving the Shire, Pippin.'"

lotr17108.name: Hornblower Leaf
lotr17108.game_text: Pipeweed. To play, spot an unbound Hobbit. Regroup: Discard a pipeweed from play to remove a threat. Regroup: Discard a pipeweed from play to discard a minion.

lotr17109.name: Pippin, In the Bloom of Health
lotr17109.subtitle: In the Bloom of Health
lotr17109.game_text: Add 1 to the number of Ents you can spot. Maneuver: Discard 2 pipeweed cards from play to remove a burden.
lotr17109.lore: "Ents are - well Ents are all different for one thing."

lotr17110.name: Southfarthing Leaf
lotr17110.game_text: Pipeweed. To play, spot an unbound Hobbit. Skirmish: Discard a pipeweed from play to make an unbound Hobbit strength +2. Regroup: Discard this pipeweed from play to play a pipeweed from your draw deck. Reshuffle your draw deck.

lotr17111.name: Southlinch Leaf
lotr17111.game_text: Pipeweed. To play, spot a Hobbit. Skirmish: Discard a pipeweed from play to prevent an unbound Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless that Hobbit's strength is tripled.
lotr17111.lore: "'How it came here, I can't imagine. For Saruman's private use, I fancy.'"

lotr17112.name: Blade of the White Hand
lotr17112.game_text: Bearer must be an [URUK-HAI] Uruk-hai. While you can spot 2 controlled sites, this minion is damage +1. While you can spot 4 controlled sites, this minion is damage +3.
lotr17112.lore: The servants of the White Hand laid waste to the Pride of Gondor.

lotr17113.name: Deathly Roar
lotr17113.game_text: Each time the Free Peoples player plays a possession or artifact, place an [URUK-HAI] token here. Each time an [URUK-HAI] minion wins a skirmish, you may remove an [URUK-HAI] token to exert a companion.
lotr17113.lore: The Uruk-hai assault on Helm's Deep was relentless.

lotr17114.name: Land Had Changed
lotr17114.game_text: Make an Uruk-hai strength +2 (or spot a site you control to make that Uruk-hai strength +3 instead). You may then liberate a site to make that Uruk-hai strength +2 and damage +1.
lotr17114.lore: "'The Deeping Wall is taken, lord, and all the defense swept away...'"

lotr17115.name: Saruman, Curunir
lotr17115.subtitle: Curunir
lotr17115.game_text: Each time an [URUK-HAI] hunter wins a skirmish, heal a different [URUK-HAI] minion. Skirmish: Exert Saruman twice to make a companion lose the hunter keyword until the start of the regroup phase.
lotr17115.lore: "'He has claimed lordship over all this land...'"

lotr17116.name: Saruman, Master of the White Hand
lotr17116.subtitle: Master of the White Hand
lotr17116.game_text: Each companion is resistance -1. Skirmish: Exert Saruman to discard a condition borne by a companion skirmishing an [URUK-HAI] minion.
lotr17116.lore: "A new power is rising. Its victory is at hand."

lotr17117.name: Spear of the White Hand
lotr17117.lore: "We will drive the machine of war with the sword and the spear..."

lotr17118.name: Vile Pit
lotr17118.game_text: To play, spot an [URUK-HAI] hunter. At the start of each Shadow phase, you may discard 2 [URUK-HAI] cards from hand to play an [URUK-HAI] hunter from your discard pile. Regroup: Discard this condition to return an [URUK-HAI] hunter from play to your hand.
lotr17118.lore: Saruman gazed on his creations with great pride

lotr17119.name: White Hand Aggressor
lotr17119.game_text: Damage +1. While you control a site, this minion cannot take wounds, except during the skirmish phase.
lotr17119.lore: "It's Saruman's army! The war has started."

lotr17120.name: White Hand Attacker
lotr17120.game_text: Damage +1. While this minion is assigned to a skirmish, each site on the adventure path gains each terrain keyword from each site you control.

lotr17121.name: White Hand Berserker
lotr17121.game_text: Damage +1. At the start of the archery phase, if you control a site, you may add 2 to the minion archery total for each Free Peoples culture you can spot over 2.
lotr17121.lore: "...there was a crash and a flash of flame and smoke."

lotr17122.name: White Hand Butcher
lotr17122.game_text: Hunter 6 (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +6.)

lotr17123.name: White Hand Captain
lotr17123.game_text: Fierce. While this minion is assigned to a skirmish, each hunter character is strength +1.
lotr17123.lore: They wore black armor and mail that was marked with the white hand of Saruman.

lotr17124.name: White Hand Destroyer
lotr17124.game_text: Fierce. This minion gains hunter 3 for each site you control.
lotr17124.lore: "'This is no parley. You have nothing to say.'"

lotr17125.name: White Hand Enforcer
lotr17125.game_text: Damage +1. When you play this minion, you may liberate a site to add (X) where X is the Shadow number of the liberated site.
lotr17125.lore: The Uruks were tireless in the pursuit of their prey.

lotr17126.name: White Hand Guard
lotr17126.game_text: Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.). Skirmish: Exert this minion to make an [URUK-HAI] hunter minion strength +2.
lotr17126.lore: Under the banner of the white hand, they came in great numbers.

lotr17127.name: White Hand Intruder
lotr17127.game_text: Damage +1. Each time this minion wins a skirmish, if you do not control a site, you may take control of a site.

lotr17128.name: White Hand Invader
lotr17128.game_text: Damage +1. When you play this minion, exert a companion for each site you control.
lotr17128.lore: "There will be no dawn for men."

lotr17130.name: White Hand Scout
lotr17130.game_text: Damage +1. Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.) The roaming penalty for each [URUK-HAI] minion you play is -1.
lotr17130.lore: "'You've got no guts outside your own sties.'"

lotr17131.name: White Hand Slayer
lotr17131.game_text: Fierce. Each time a player plays an event in a skirmish involving this minion, that player may exert a non-hunter character.
lotr17131.lore: "'...and there has been war between us for many months.'"

lotr17132.name: White Hand Taskmaster
lotr17132.game_text: Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.). When you play this minion, you may spot another [URUK-HAI] minion to add a threat for each Free Peoples culture you can spot.
lotr17132.lore: White Hand warriors fell to evil deeds with a passion.

lotr17133.name: White Hand Trooper
lotr17133.game_text: Fierce. While this minion is assigned to a skirmish, each hunter companion loses its special abilities and skirmish events may not be played in those companions skirmishes.

lotr17134.name: White Hand Vanquisher
lotr17134.game_text: Fierce. This minion is damage +1 for each [URUK-HAI] hunter assigned to a skirmish.
lotr17134.lore: "'They have a blasting fire, and with it they took the wall.'"

lotr17135.name: White Hand Veteran
lotr17135.game_text: Damage +1. When you play this minion, if you control a site, you may take an [URUK-HAI] event into hand from your discard pile.

lotr17136.name: White Hand Warrior
lotr17136.game_text: Fierce. Hunter 4 (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +4.). Each time this minion is assigned to a non-hunter companion, you may heal a hunter.

lotr17137.name: You Do Not Know Fear
lotr17137.game_text: Discard a condition for each [URUK-HAI] minion you can spot.
lotr17137.lore: Endangering and entangling all those that stood before them, the Uruk-hai shrunk before none.

lotr17138.name: You Do Not Know Pain
lotr17138.game_text: Each time you take control of a site, you may spot 3 [URUK-HAI] minions to exert an unbound companion. Skirmish: Liberate a site to make an [URUK-HAI] minion damage +1.
lotr17138.lore: "If the wall is breached, Helm's Deep will fall."

lotr17139.name: Ulaire Cantea, Duplicitous Assassin
lotr17139.subtitle: Duplicitous Assassin
lotr17139.game_text: Fierce. Each unbound companion is resistance -1 for each card he or she bears. Skirmish: Exert Ulaire Cantea to exert a companion with resistance 2 or less.
lotr17139.lore: "Drawn to the power of the one. They will never stop hunting you."

lotr17140.name: Ulaire Enquea, Duplicitous Lieutenant
lotr17140.subtitle: Duplicitous Lieutenant
lotr17140.game_text: Fierce. Each time the Free Peoples player heals a companion, you may add a burden. Maneuver: Exert Ulaire Enquea twice to discard a condition (or two conditions if you can spot 5 Free Peoples player's conditions).
lotr17140.lore: "At all times they feel the presence of the ring."

lotr17141.name: Ulaire Otsea, Duplicitous Specter
lotr17141.subtitle: Duplicitous Specter
lotr17141.game_text: Fierce. When you play Ulaire Otsea, you may spot another Nazgul to draw a card for each wounded companion you can spot. Regroup: Exert Ulaire Otsea and discard a [WRAITH] card from hand to add a burden.
lotr17141.lore: "Blinded by their greed, they took them without question."

lotr17142.name: Ring of Savagery
lotr17142.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must either add a burden or exert a companion. Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.

lotr17143.name: Ring of Terror
lotr17143.game_text: Bearer must be a Nazgul. Bearer is damage +1. When you play this artifact, you may remove two threats to take a [WRAITH] card into hand from your discard pile. Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.

lotr17144.name: The Witch-king, Conqueror of Arthedain
lotr17144.subtitle: Conqueror of Arthedain
lotr17144.game_text: Fierce. Each time the Witch-king wins a fierce skirmish, you may exert a companion for each companion you can spot over 4.

lotr17145.name: Dol Guldur
lotr17145.game_text: Regroup: Exert your minion and remove a threat to make the Free Peoples player discard one of his or her conditions.

lotr17146.name: Falls of Rauros
lotr17146.game_text: River. When the fellowship moves to this site in region 2, the Free Peoples player places a card from the dead pile out of play.

lotr17147.name: Imladris
lotr17147.game_text: River. When the fellowship moves to this site, if it is a Sanctuary, remove 2 burdens.

lotr17148.name: Nurn
lotr17148.game_text: Plains. While you control this site, each of your hunter minions is strength +1.

lotr18001.name: Arwen's Bow
lotr18001.game_text: Bearer must be an [ELVEN] companion. Archery: If bearer is Arwen, discard 2 [ELVEN] cards from hand to wound a minion.
lotr18001.lore: Arwen had skill with a bow matched only by her beauty.

lotr18002.name: Arwen's Dagger
lotr18002.game_text: Bearer must be an [ELVEN] companion. Bearer may bear this hand weapon in addition to 1 other hand weapon. Maneuver: If bearer is Arwen, exert her to draw 2 cards.
lotr18002.lore: Woe be to any against whom she wielded it.

lotr18003.name: Galadriel's Silver Ewer
lotr18003.game_text: To play, spot Galadriel or Celeborn. While Galadriel is the Ring-bearer, she is strength +2 and resistance +2. Each time you play an [ELVEN] skirmish event, you may reinforce an [ELVEN] token.

lotr18004.name: Beorning Axe
lotr18004.game_text: Bearer must be a [GANDALF] Man. While Grimbeorn is bearing this possession, each time he wins a skirmish, you may take a [GANDALF] card from your discard pile into hand.
lotr18004.lore: No Orc or wolf dared enter the land of the Beornings.

lotr18005.name: Radagast's Herb Bag
lotr18005.game_text: Bearer must be a [GANDALF] Wizard. Each time you play a [GANDALF] spell, you may exert bearer to wound a minion.
lotr18005.lore: The tools of a master of herb and beast-lore were often confined to the simplest of places.

lotr18006.name: Shelob, Menace
lotr18006.subtitle: Menace
lotr18006.game_text: Fierce. Each time Shelob wins a skirmish, you may add threats up to the number of burdens you can spot. Each time Shelob wins a skirmish, you may play Gollum from your discard pile; he is strength +3 and fierce until the end of turn.

lotr18007.name: Crown of Gondor
lotr18007.game_text: To play, spot Aragorn, Elendil, or Isildur. Skirmish: Spot a [GONDOR] Man with 3 or more vitality and discard a [GONDOR] card from hand to make that Man strength +2.
lotr18007.lore: "Et Eärello Endorenna utúlien. Sinome maruvan ar Hildinyar tenn' Ambar-metta!"

lotr18008.name: Denethor's Sword
lotr18008.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. While bearer is Denethor, his game text does not apply.
lotr18008.lore: "But if doom denies this to me, then I will have naught: neither life diminished, nor love halved, nor honour abated."

lotr18009.name: Watcher at Sarn Ford, Ranger of the North
lotr18009.subtitle: Ranger of the North
lotr18009.game_text: Ranger. Skirmish: Exert a [GONDOR] Man with a resistance 6 or more to make that Man strength +3.
lotr18009.lore: "'Little do they know of our long labour for the safekeeping of their borders, and yet I grudge it not.'"

lotr18010.name: Gothmog, Morgul Leader
lotr18010.subtitle: Morgul Leader
lotr18010.game_text: Each the fellowship and minion archery totals are +3. Regroup: Remove (2) to play an [ORC] minion from your discard pile. That minion comes into play exhausted.
lotr18010.lore: "Fear. The city is rank with it."

lotr18011.name: Erkenbrand's Horn
lotr18011.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. Fellowship: Exert bearer to play a follower from your draw deck. Reshuffle your draw deck. Skirmish: Discard a follower from play to make bearer strength +4 (if bearer is Erkenbrand, he is strength +5 instead).

lotr18012.name: Erkenbrand's Shield
lotr18012.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. The minion archery total is -1. Skirmish: If bearer is Erkenbrand, you may add (2) to cancel a fierce skirmish involving him. Response: If a [ROHAN] Man is about to take a wound, spot Gandalf and exert bearer to prevent that wound.

lotr18013.name: Rohirrim Diadem
lotr18013.game_text: To play, spot Theoden. Skirmish: Spot a [ROHAN] Man bearing a possession and discard a [ROHAN] possession from hand to make that Man strength +2.
lotr18013.lore: With Gríma's treacherous whispers removed and Saruman's grasp released, none doubted the might and lordship of Théoden, the King of Rohan.

lotr18014.name: Theoden, Ednew
lotr18014.subtitle: Ednew
lotr18014.game_text: While you can spot Gandalf, Theoden is resistance +2. While you can spot Eomer, Theoden is damage +1. While you can spot 3 mounted [ROHAN] companions, Theoden is strength +2.
lotr18014.lore: "Now for wrath! Now for ruin! And a red dawn!"

lotr18015.name: Fredegar Bolger, Fatty
lotr18015.subtitle: Fatty
lotr18015.game_text: While the fellowship is in region 1 and you can spot 2 other [SHIRE] companions, Fredegar Bolger is strength +3.
lotr18015.lore: "'You'll wish you were back here with me before this time tomorrow.'"

lotr18016.name: Sting, Elven Long Knife
lotr18016.subtitle: Elven Long Knife
lotr18016.game_text: Bearer must be Bilbo or Frodo. Regroup: Exert bearer to remove a threat.
lotr18016.lore: "My old sword, Sting! Here! Take it, take it!"

lotr18017.name: Shagrat, Tower Captain
lotr18017.subtitle: Tower Captain
lotr18017.game_text: Damage +1. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) While you can spot 7 possessions, Shagrat is fierce and cannot take wounds (except during skirmish phases).
lotr18017.lore: "I don't take orders from stinking Morgul rats!"

lotr18018.name: Pull of the Ring
lotr18018.game_text: Remove a burden to choose one: assign a [WRAITH] minion to a companion who has resistance 0; or have a [WRAITH] minion lose fierce and gain hunter 2 until the regroup phase.
lotr18018.lore: "I'm naked in the dark. There's nothing, no veil between me and the Wheel of Fire. I can see him with my waking eyes!"

lotr18019.name: Drawn to Full Height
lotr18019.game_text: Spell. Spot a [GANDALF] Wizard to make a minion lose all strength bonuses from possessions.
lotr18019.lore: "I am not trying to rob you. I'm trying to help you."

lotr18020.name: Ents Marching
lotr18020.game_text: If the fellowship is in region 1 or region 2, exert 2 Ents to make an Ent defender +1. If the fellowship is in region 3, spot a [GANDALF] companion to draw a card.
lotr18020.lore: "The old that is strong does not wither; Deep roots are not reached by the frost."

lotr18021.name: Last Stand
lotr18021.game_text: Fellowship: Exert a [GANDALF] Man to add 2 [GANDALF] tokens here. Skirmish: Remove 3 [GANDALF] tokens from here to make a companion strength +3.
lotr18021.lore: To give his people time to escape, Brand stood against the Mordor army until he was slain. His friend, the dwarf Dain Ironfoot, stood over him until he too was slain.

lotr18022.name: Librarian, Keeper of Ancient Texts
lotr18022.subtitle: Keeper of Ancient Texts
lotr18022.game_text: While you can spot 2 [GANDALF] tokens, each of your [GANDALF] Men is strength +2. Regroup: Discard a follower from play to choose one: draw a card; or take a [GANDALF] skirmish event from your discard pile into hand.
lotr18022.lore: A guide through books and scrolls from floor to ceiling.

lotr18023.name: One-Upsmanship
lotr18023.game_text: Spell. Spot 2 pipeweed cards to remove a burden for each [GANDALF] Wizard you can spot.
lotr18023.lore: Gandalf regarded the smoke ring for a moment, sucked his cheeks in, and blew out a majestic, full-rigged ship that sailed right through the ring.

lotr18024.name: Our Time
lotr18024.game_text: Spell. To play, exert Gandalf. When you play this condition, remove (3). At the start of the maneuver phase, add (4) and remove this condition from the game.
lotr18024.lore: "All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given to us."

lotr18025.name: Perspective
lotr18025.game_text: Maneuver: Add 2 threats and spot a Wizard to prevent a Shadow player from using special abilities on Shadow cards until the regroup phase.
lotr18025.lore: "Hobbits really are amazing creatures! You can learn all that there is to know about their ways in a month, and yet after a hundred years, they can still surprise you."

lotr18026.name: Radagast's Herb Bag
lotr18026.game_text: Bearer must be a [GANDALF] Wizard. Each time you play a [GANDALF] spell, you may exert bearer to wound a minion.
lotr18026.lore: The tools of a master of herb and beast-lore were often confined to the simplest of places.

lotr18027.name: Ship of Smoke
lotr18027.game_text: Pipeweed. Each time you play a pipeweed card, you may spot Gandalf to reveal the top 3 cards of your draw deck. Take all Free Peoples cards revealed into hand and discard the remaining cards.
lotr18027.lore: "Old Toby. The finest weed in the Southfarthing."

lotr18028.name: Countless Cords
lotr18028.game_text: Spot Shelob to make a minion strength +1 for each threat you can spot.
lotr18028.lore: "'But don't go on, master! Don't go down to that den! Now's our only chance. Now let's get out of this foul hole!'"

lotr18029.name: Deceit
lotr18029.game_text: Response: If a Free Peoples player's card is about to discard your other [GOLLUM] condition, remove (1) to prevent that.
lotr18029.lore: "Presently they were under the shadow, and there in the midst of it they saw the opening of a cave. 'This is the way in,' said Gollum softly."

lotr18030.name: Enemy in Your Midst
lotr18030.game_text: Heal a Ring-bound companion to reinforce a [GOLLUM] token.
lotr18030.lore: Earning pity and trust was the first step of Gollum's plan to reclaim his precious.

lotr18031.name: It Draws Him
lotr18031.game_text: Spot a [GOLLUM] card to play a minion. Its twilight cost is -1 (or -3 if it is roaming).
lotr18031.lore: "He will never be rid of his need for it. He hates and loves the Ring, as he hates and loves himself."

lotr18032.name: Not Easily Avoided
lotr18032.game_text: Shadow: Remove (3) to take a [GOLLUM] card into hand from your draw deck, then randomly discard a card from your hand. Skirmish: Discard a [GOLLUM] card from hand to make a [GOLLUM] minion strength +2.
lotr18032.lore: "'But I still feel that they are looking at me, or thinking about me: making some other plan, perhaps.'"

lotr18033.name: Set Up
lotr18033.game_text: Spot Gollum or Smeagol to return a follower to its owner's hand.
lotr18033.lore: "He took it!! I've seen him. He is always stuffing his face when Master is not looking."

lotr18034.name: Shelob, Menace
lotr18034.subtitle: Menace
lotr18034.game_text: Fierce. Each time Shelob wins a skirmish, you may add threats up to the number of burdens you can spot. Each time Shelob wins a skirmish, you may play Gollum from your discard pile; he is strength +3 and fierce until the end of turn.

lotr18035.name: Sting of Shelob
lotr18035.game_text: To play, spot Shelob. The Free Peoples player chooses two companions. He or she then chooses to place one of those companions in the dead pile and return the other to his or her hand.

lotr18036.name: Time for Food
lotr18036.game_text: If a skirmish event is played, spot Smeagol to cancel that event.
lotr18036.lore: "Oh yes we could! Spoil nice fish. Give it to usss rrraw... and wrrriggling! You keep nasty chips."

lotr18037.name: Trusted Promise
lotr18037.game_text: Reinforce a [GOLLUM] token. Each Shadow player may draw a card.
lotr18037.lore: "We swears to serve the master of the preciousss. We will swear on... on the precious."

lotr18038.name: Aragorn, Heir to the Throne of Gondor
lotr18038.subtitle: Heir to the Throne of Gondor
lotr18038.game_text: Hunter 2. While you can spot 3 Free Peoples cultures, Aragorn is defender +1. While you can spot 2 Shadow cultures, Aragorn is defender +1.

lotr18039.name: Armor of the White City
lotr18039.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. Bearer is a knight.
lotr18039.lore: "'Surely this is the greatest jest in all the history of Gondor: that we should ride with seven thousand, scarce as many as the vanguard of its army in the days of its power, to assail the mountains and the impenetrable gate of the Black Land!'"

lotr18040.name: Boromir, Proud and Noble Man
lotr18040.subtitle: Proud and Noble Man
lotr18040.game_text: Ranger. When you play Boromir (except in your starting fellowship), you may play a possession with a twilight cost of 1 or less on him from your draw deck.
lotr18040.lore: "Yes, there is weakness. There is frailty. But there is courage also, and honor to be found in Men."

lotr18041.name: Crown of Gondor
lotr18041.game_text: To play, spot Aragorn, Elendil, or Isildur. Skirmish: Spot a [GONDOR] Man with 3 or more vitality and discard a [GONDOR] card from hand to make that Man strength +2.
lotr18041.lore: "Et Eärello Endorenna utúlien. Sinome maruvan ar Hildinyar tenn' Ambar-metta!"

lotr18042.name: Denethor, On the Edge of Madness
lotr18042.subtitle: On the Edge of Madness
lotr18042.game_text: Each time the fellowship moves from a site, add a burden. Skirmish: Exert another [GONDOR] Man to make him of her strength +1 and damage +1.
lotr18042.lore: "No tomb for Denethor and Faramir. No long, slow sleep of death embalmed."

lotr18043.name: Denethor's Sword
lotr18043.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. While bearer is Denethor, his game text does not apply.
lotr18043.lore: "But if doom denies this to me, then I will have naught: neither life diminished, nor love halved, nor honour abated."

lotr18044.name: Defenses Long Held
lotr18044.game_text: Make a ranger strength +2 and you may reinforce a [GONDOR] token.
lotr18044.lore: "Let the armies of Mordor know this: Never again will the land of my people fall into enemy hands!"

lotr18045.name: Dunadan's Bow
lotr18045.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] ranger. Archery: Discard 2 [GONDOR] cards from hand to make the fellowship archery total +1.
lotr18045.lore: Well trained and deadly accurate, a ranger's bow was more an extension of himself than a weapon of wood.

lotr18046.name: Disarmed
lotr18046.game_text: Bearer cannot bear any Shadow cards. When this condition is transferred to bearer, discard all Shadow cards it bears. Maneuver: Exert a [GONDOR] Man or spot a ranger to transfer this condition from your support area to minion.
lotr18046.lore: In a flurry of swordplay, Aragorn sliced his arm off.

lotr18047.name: Elendil's Army
lotr18047.game_text: Aid - Exert a [GONDOR] companion. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert a [GONDOR] companion to transfer this to a companion.)
lotr18047.lore: "...and on the slopes of Mount Doom they fought for the freedom of Middle-earth."

lotr18048.name: Faramir, Captain of Ithilien
lotr18048.subtitle: Captain of Ithilien
lotr18048.game_text: Ranger. Hunter 2. If Faramir is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -1. Maneuver: Exert Faramir to heal a companion with resistance 5 or more.
lotr18048.lore: "There are no travelers in this land. Only servants of the Dark Tower."

lotr18049.name: Faramir's Company
lotr18049.game_text: Aid - Add a threat. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a threat to transfer this to a companion.) When you attach this card to a companion, spot a [GONDOR] possession to heal that companion.
lotr18049.lore: Cloaked rangers armed with deadly arrows and swords.

lotr18050.name: The Faithful Stone
lotr18050.game_text: Tale. Each time a non-[WRAITH] minion is played, you may spot a Man to put a [GONDOR] token here. Maneuver: Remove 3 [GONDOR] tokens from here to spot a minion. That minion cannot be assigned to a skirmish until the regroup phase.
lotr18050.lore: Each turn was guarded by Púkel-men stones with their huge, clumsy arms folded across their round bellies.

lotr18051.name: For Gondor!
lotr18051.game_text: Exert a knight to make him or her strength +3.
lotr18051.lore: "This city was once the jewel of our kingdom. A place of light and beauty and music. And so it shall be once more!"

lotr18052.name: Gondorian Servant, Denethor's Handman
lotr18052.subtitle: Denethor's Handman
