lotr18052.game_text: Aid - (1). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (1) to transfer this to a companion.) Each time you attach this to a companion, except a [GONDOR] Man, add (4).
lotr18052.lore: If the personal servants of Denethor were aware of his madness, they were wise to conceal it.

lotr18053.name: Horn of Boromir, The Great Horn
lotr18053.subtitle: The Great Horn
lotr18053.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. Maneuver: Exert bearer and discard a follower from play to make bearer strength +4 until the regroup phase (if bearer is Boromir, he is also defender +1 and cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled).

lotr18054.name: Isildur, Sword-bearer
lotr18054.subtitle: Sword-bearer
lotr18054.game_text: Knight. Each time Isildur loses a skirmish, exert a companion. Each time Isildur wins a skirmish, heal a companion.
lotr18054.lore: "It was in this moment, when all hope had faded, that Isildur, son of the king, took up his father's sword."

lotr18055.name: Ranger of the North
lotr18055.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. Maneuver: If the fellowship is in region 1 or region 2, you may exert bearer to make him or her defender +1. Regroup: Discard this to heal a companion.
lotr18055.lore: "This is no mere ranger. He is Aragorn, son of Arathorn. You owe him your allegiance."

lotr18056.name: Ranger of the South
lotr18056.game_text: Ranger. While you can spot a [GONDOR] token, this companion is strength +2.
lotr18056.lore: "All had swords at their sides, and were clad in green and brown of varied hues, as if the better to walk unseen in the glades of Ithilien."

lotr18057.name: Shield of the White Tree
lotr18057.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. The minion archery total is -1. Regroup: Discard this possession from play to make each opponent shuffle his or her hand into his or her draw deck and draw 8 cards.
lotr18057.lore: Tipped with silver, and adorned with the White Tree.

lotr18058.name: Soldier's Cache
lotr18058.game_text: Fortification. At the start of your maneuver phase, you may spot 3 rangers or exert a [GONDOR] Man to transfer this condition to a minion. Wound that minion. Regroup: Exert a ranger to reinforce a [GONDOR] token.

lotr18059.name: Watcher at Sarn Ford, Ranger of the North
lotr18059.subtitle: Ranger of the North
lotr18059.game_text: Ranger. Skirmish: Exert a [GONDOR] Man with a resistance 6 or more to make that Man strength +3.
lotr18059.lore: "'Little do they know of our long labour for the safekeeping of their borders, and yet I grudge it not.'"

lotr18060.name: Corsair Boarding Axe
lotr18060.game_text: Bearer must be a [MEN] minion. Skirmish: Remove (3) to reinforce a [MEN] token and make bearer fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr18060.lore: Small and light, the boarding axe is ideal for close-quarters fighting aboard ships or in confined spaces.

lotr18061.name: Corsair Bow
lotr18061.game_text: Bearer must be a [MEN] minion. Bearer is an archer. Each time a companion is killed during the archery phase, you may control a site.
lotr18061.lore: Not nearly as ornate or as accurate as the Gondorian bows, the short-bows of the Corsairs killed just as well.

lotr18062.name: Corsair Grappling Hook
lotr18062.game_text: Bearer must be a [MEN] minion. When you play this possession you may reinforce a [MEN] token twice. Each time a companion is killed during a skirmish phase, you may control a site.
lotr18062.lore: A tool equally useful in times of peace and in times of war.

lotr18063.name: Corsair Halberd
lotr18063.game_text: Bearer must be a [MEN] minion. Bearer is damage +1. Shadow: Remove a companion in the dead pile from the game to control a site.
lotr18063.lore: Long handled and heavy, a single powerful swing of this weapon could cleave through even some of the thickest armor.

lotr18064.name: Corsair Scimitar
lotr18064.game_text: Bearer must be a [MEN] minion. Bearer is strength +1 for each [MEN] token you can spot (limit +5).
lotr18064.lore: A largely stylistic weapon, scimitars are favored for their light weight yet powerful strikes.

lotr18065.name: Declined Business
lotr18065.game_text: If the Free Peoples player plays a companion, discard a [MEN] card from hand to return that companion to its owner's hand.
lotr18065.lore: During the War of the Ring, the streets of Bree were filled mainly with Southern ruffians and thieves, and Bree-folk were afraid to leave their homes.

lotr18066.name: Fleet of Corsair Ships
lotr18066.game_text: When you play this possession, you may add a [MEN] token here. Regroup: Remove 4 [MEN] tokens from here to place a [MEN] card from your discard pile on the top of your draw deck.
lotr18066.lore: "They'll be in the city in two days. You're outnumbered, Aragorn."

lotr18067.name: Grima, Witless Worm
lotr18067.subtitle: Witless Worm
lotr18067.game_text: Regroup: Exert Grima to add (2). Regroup: Remove a [MEN] token to add (2). Regroup: Remove (4) to exert an unbound companion.
lotr18067.lore: "'You are held wise, my friend Wormtongue, and are doubtless a great support to your master.'"

lotr18068.name: Harry Goatleaf
lotr18068.game_text: While the fellowship is in region 1, this minion is strength +4. While the fellowship is in region 2, this minion is strength +2.

lotr18069.name: Henchman's Dagger
lotr18069.game_text: Bearer must be a [MEN] minion. Bearer may bear this hand weapon in addition to 1 other hand weapon.
lotr18069.lore: Carved from bone or forged from iron, no warrior would enter the fields of battle without a trusty, simple blade.

lotr18070.name: Ill News Is An Ill Guest
lotr18070.game_text: Exert a [MEN] minion to discard a follower from play (if you can spot Grima, also draw a card).
lotr18070.lore: "Late is the hour in which this conjurer chooses to appear."

lotr18071.name: Mumakil Commander, Bold and Grim
lotr18071.subtitle: Bold and Grim
lotr18071.game_text: While at a battleground, this minion is strength +2. Each mounted Man is strength +1. Regroup: Shuffle any number of your [MEN] mounts in play into your draw deck.
lotr18071.lore: With a sound of his horn, a line of Mûmakil appeared and the Pelennor field was filled with chaos.

lotr18072.name: Ruffian
lotr18072.game_text: While the fellowship is in region 1, this minion is strength +4. While the fellowship is in region 2, this minion is strength +2.

lotr18073.name: Rough Man of the South
lotr18073.game_text: While the fellowship is in region 1, this minion is strength +4. While the fellowship is in region 2, this minion is strength +2.
lotr18073.lore: Making money and making mischief was often inspiration enough for these louts. The taking of Bree and the Shire was easy work.

lotr18074.name: Squint-eyed Southerner
lotr18074.game_text: While the fellowship is in region 1, this minion is strength +4. While the fellowship is in region 2, this minion is strength +2.
lotr18074.lore: A man of Dunland, this outlaw was a prized agent of Saruman and a spy for the Witch-king.

lotr18075.name: Ted Sandyman, Chief's Men's Ally
lotr18075.subtitle: Chief's Men's Ally
lotr18075.game_text: Maneuver: Liberate a site you control to make each [MEN] minion strength +2 until the regroup phase. Regroup: Exert Ted Sandyman to stack a [MEN] Man in play on a possession.
lotr18075.lore: "'You can't touch me. I'm a friend o' Boss's. But he'll touch you all right, if I have any more of your mouth.'"

lotr18076.name: Treachery
lotr18076.game_text: Spot Grima to exert an unbound companion. That companion cannot use his or her game text until the regroup phase.
lotr18076.lore: "This order does not come from me. It comes from the king. He signed it this morning."

lotr18077.name: Whisper in the Dark
lotr18077.game_text: Bearer must be a follower. At the start of the maneuver phase, the Free Peoples player must exert an unbound companion.
lotr18077.lore: "My lord, Gandalf the Grey is coming. He's a herald of woe."

lotr18078.name: Destroyers and Usurpers
lotr18078.game_text: Each companion loses all defender bonuses and cannot gain defender bonuses. Maneuver: Spot 2 [ORC] minions to make the fellowship's current site gain battleground until the regroup phase.
lotr18078.lore: "They come with fire, they come with axes. Gnawing, biting, breaking, hacking, burning!"

lotr18079.name: Frenzy of Arrows
lotr18079.game_text: Spot an [ORC] minion to add 2 to the minion archery total. Then add an additional 2 to the minion archery total for each follower you can spot.
lotr18079.lore: The black fletched arrows of Sauron's armies found many targets.

lotr18080.name: Gothmog, Morgul Leader
lotr18080.subtitle: Morgul Leader
lotr18080.game_text: Each the fellowship and minion archery totals are +3. Regroup: Remove (2) to play an [ORC] minion from your discard pile.
lotr18080.lore: "Fear. The city is rank with it."

lotr18081.name: Gothmog's Warg, Leader's Mount
lotr18081.subtitle: Leader's Mount
lotr18081.game_text: Bearer must be an [ORC] Orc with strength 9 or less (or bearer must be Gothmog). Bearer is fierce. While bearer is Gothmog, he is damage +1 in fierce skirmishes.

lotr18082.name: Grond, Forged With Black Steel
lotr18082.subtitle: Forged With Black Steel
lotr18082.game_text: To play, spot an [ORC] minion. Each time the fellowship moves in the regroup phase, you may discard this possession to search the Free Peoples player's draw deck and remove up to 2 Free Peoples cards from the game.

lotr18083.name: Gruesome Meal
lotr18083.game_text: Make a companion skirmishing an [ORC] minion strength -2 (or -3 if he or she is an archer).
lotr18083.lore: They dined on the flesh of all that lived and breathed in Middle-earth.

lotr18084.name: Orkish Ax
lotr18084.game_text: Bearer must be an [ORC] Orc. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may add a threat.
lotr18084.lore: Crude blood rusted steel axes were dragged by Orcs from battle to battle.

lotr18085.name: Orkish Aggressor
lotr18085.game_text: While at a battleground, this minion is strength +2.
lotr18085.lore: Enraged by Sauron, the frenzied Orcs streamed to the battlefields.

lotr18086.name: Orkish Archer Troop
lotr18086.game_text: To play, spot an [ORC] card. The minion archery total is +1 for each hunter companion you can spot.
lotr18086.lore: "...the enemy is moving. Sauron's forces are massing in the east..."

lotr18087.name: Orkish Breeder
lotr18087.game_text: Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) Shadow: Exert this minion to play an [URUK-HAI] hunter at twilight cost -2.
lotr18087.lore: Deep in the Isengard pits, Orcs tended the mud from which the Uruk-hai were pulled from.

lotr18088.name: Orkish Defender
lotr18088.game_text: While the fellowship is at a battleground or underground site, this minion cannot take wounds in the archery phase.
lotr18088.lore: "'Many Elves and many mighty Men, and many of their friends, had perished in the war.'"

lotr18089.name: Orkish Headsman
lotr18089.game_text: Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) This minion is strength +3 for each companion in the dead pile (limit +6).
lotr18089.lore: As the free people of Middle-earth fell, Mordor's strength grew.

lotr18090.name: Orkish Skirmisher
lotr18090.game_text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert him twice to wound a companion.
lotr18090.lore: Pain. Pain was part of each Orc's life.

lotr18091.name: Orkish Sneak
lotr18091.game_text: Assignment: Spot another [ORC] Orc to assign this minion to skirmish a non-[SHIRE] Ring-bearer. The Free Peoples player may add a burden or exert the Ring-bearer twice to discard this minion.
lotr18091.lore: The Orcs attacked the Alliance, rushing across the field that separated the armies.

lotr18092.name: War Preparations
lotr18092.game_text: Remove a threat to reinforce an [ORC] token.
lotr18092.lore: "The old world will burn in the fires of industry. The forests will fall. A new order will rise. We will drive the machine of war with the sword and the spear and the iron fists of the Orc. We have only to remove those who oppose us."

lotr18093.name: Wary Orc
lotr18093.game_text: This minion is strength +1 for each hunter companion you can spot.
lotr18093.lore: "War is brewing. The mountains are fair teeming with goblins."

lotr18094.name: Cast From the Hall
lotr18094.game_text: Each time you play a [ROHAN] possession, add a [ROHAN] token here. Skirmish: Remove 3 [ROHAN] tokens from here to make a [ROHAN] companion strength +1 and damage +1.
lotr18094.lore: "Your leechcraft would have had me crawling on all fours like a beast!"

lotr18095.name: Eomer's Bow
lotr18095.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. If bearer is mounted, he or she is strength +1. Archery: If bearer is Eomer, exert him to choose a Shadow player who must exert one of his or her minions.
lotr18095.lore: The short bows of Rohan brought down many a foe on the fields of battle.

lotr18096.name: Erkenbrand's Horn
lotr18096.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. Fellowship: Exert bearer to play a follower from your draw deck. Reshuffle your draw deck. Skirmish: Discard a follower from play to make bearer strength +4 (if bearer is Erkenbrand, he is strength +5 instead).

lotr18097.name: Erkenbrand's Shield
lotr18097.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. The minion archery total is -1. Skirmish: If bearer is Erkenbrand, you may add (2) to cancel a fierce skirmish involving him. Response: If a [ROHAN] Man is about to take a wound, spot Gandalf and exert bearer to prevent that wound.

lotr18098.name: Fall back to Helm's Deep
lotr18098.game_text: If the fellowship is at a plains site, exert a [ROHAN] companion to return a minion to its owner's hand.
lotr18098.lore: "This is not a defeat. We will return."

lotr18099.name: Gamling, Dutiful Marshal
lotr18099.subtitle: Dutiful Marshal
lotr18099.game_text: Valiant. Skirmish: Transfer a [ROHAN] possession that Gamling can bear to him.

lotr18100.name: Gamling's Horn
lotr18100.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man or Merry. Skirmish: Discard a follower from play to make bearer strength +4. If bearer is Gamling, you may also spot another companion to make him or her strength +4 until the regroup phase.

lotr18101.name: Precise Attack
lotr18101.game_text: Discard a [ROHAN] possession from play to choose one: Wound an unwounded minion; exert a minion; or discard a Shadow card the Ring-bearer is bearing.
lotr18101.lore: Éomer's spear, now thrown, brought down the Haradrim leader.

lotr18102.name: Rohirrim Diadem
lotr18102.game_text: To play, spot Theoden. Skirmish: Spot a [ROHAN] Man bearing a possession and discard a [ROHAN] possession from hand to make that Man strength +2.
lotr18102.lore: With Gríma's treacherous whispers removed and Saruman's grasp released, none doubted the might and lordship of Théoden, the King of Rohan.

lotr18103.name: Rohirrim Recruit
lotr18103.game_text: Valiant. While you can spot a [ROHAN] token, this companion is strength +2.
lotr18103.lore: Even the older men of Rohan had talents in the arts of war.

lotr18104.name: Surrendered Weapons
lotr18104.game_text: Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot a [ROHAN] companion to discard a possession a character is bearing from play. Skirmish: Add (1) to transfer a [ROHAN] possession borne by a companion to another eligible bearer.
lotr18104.lore: "I cannot allow you before Théoden-King so armed."

lotr18105.name: Theoden, Ednew
lotr18105.subtitle: Ednew
lotr18105.game_text: While you can spot Gandalf, Theoden is resistance +2. While you can spot Eomer, Theoden is damage +1. While you can spot 3 mounted [ROHAN] companions, Theoden is strength +2.
lotr18105.lore: "Now for wrath! Now for ruin! And a red dawn!"

lotr18106.name: A Dragon's Tale
lotr18106.game_text: Tale. To play, spot a Hobbit. Maneuver: Discard a tale from play to choose a Shadow player who must exert one of his or her minions.
lotr18106.lore: "If you're referring to the incident with the dragon, I was barely involved. All I did was give your uncle a little nudge out of the door."

lotr18107.name: Fredegar Bolger, Fatty
lotr18107.subtitle: Fatty
lotr18107.game_text: While the fellowship is in region 1 and you can spot 2 other [SHIRE] companions, Fredegar Bolger is strength +3.
lotr18107.lore: "'You'll wish you were back here with me before this time tomorrow.'"

lotr18108.name: Golden Perch Ale
lotr18108.game_text: Each time a [SHIRE] companion wins a skimish, you may add a [SHIRE] token here. Fellowship: Remove a [SHIRE] token here to remove a burden.
lotr18108.lore: "'The best beer in the Eastfarthing, or used to be: it is a long time since I tasted it.'"

lotr18109.name: Make a Run For It
lotr18109.game_text: Remove 2 [SHIRE] tokens to cancel a skirmish involving an unbound Hobbit.
lotr18109.lore: "As soon as he saw the dark shapes creep from the garden he knew that he must run for it, or perish. And run he did, out of the back door, through the garden, and over the fields."

lotr18110.name: Prized Lagan
lotr18110.game_text: At the start of each turn, you may add (2) to heal a [SHIRE] companion. Maneuver: Add a threat to spot a minion. That minion loses fierce and cannot gain fierce until the regroup phase.
lotr18110.lore: "We are sitting on the field of victory, enjoying a few well-earned comforts."

lotr18111.name: Robin Smallburrow, Shirriff Cock-Robin
lotr18111.subtitle: Shirriff Cock-Robin
lotr18111.game_text: Aid - (2). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (2) to transfer this to a companion.) Each time you attach this follower to a [SHIRE] companion, you may discard X cards from hand to draw X cards.

lotr18112.name: Scouring of the Shire
lotr18112.game_text: Tale. When there are 4 [SHIRE] tokens here, discard this condition from play. Response: If a [SHIRE] condition or [SHIRE] possession is about to be discarded from play by a Shadow card, add a [SHIRE] token here to prevent that.

lotr18113.name: Sting, Elven Long Knife
lotr18113.subtitle: Elven Long Knife
lotr18113.game_text: Bearer must be Bilbo or Frodo. Regroup: Exert bearer to remove a threat.
lotr18113.lore: "My old sword, Sting! Here! Take it, take it!"

lotr18114.name: Cleaved
lotr18114.game_text: Regroup: Exert an [URUK-HAI] hunter twice to transfer this condition from your support area to an unbound companion. Archery: Spot an [URUK-HAI] minion to transfer this condition from your support area to a Free Peoples archer.

lotr18115.name: Final Triumph
lotr18115.game_text: Spot your Uruk-hai skirmishing a companion to use vitality to resolve that skirmish instead of strength.
lotr18115.lore: Now left alone, it stopped before its foe. With a snarl it pulled back the bow, ready to deliver the last blow.

lotr18116.name: Fury of the Evil Army
lotr18116.game_text: Bearer must be an [URUK-HAI] minion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may choose one: discard a follower from play; heal an [URUK-HAI] minion; or control a site.
lotr18116.lore: "What can men do against such reckless hate?"

lotr18117.name: Ghastly Wound
lotr18117.game_text: Make an [URUK-HAI] minion strength +2 and damage +1.
lotr18117.lore: That force of ten-thousand Uruk-hai was designed for the downfall of Man - and all those that allied with them.

lotr18118.name: Lurtz, Halfling Hunter
lotr18118.subtitle: Halfling Hunter
lotr18118.game_text: Archer. Damage +1. Maneuver: Spot 6 companions to make Lurtz fierce until the regroup phase. Assignment: Exert Lurtz twice to assign it to an unbound companion. The Free Peoples player may exert that companion or add a burden to prevent this.

lotr18119.name: Lurtz's Bow, Black-fletch Bow
lotr18119.subtitle: Black-fletch Bow
lotr18119.game_text: Bearer must be an Uruk-hai. When you play this possession on Lurtz, you may draw a card. Archery: If bearer is Lurtz, discard 2 [URUK-HAI] cards from hand to exert an unbound companion.
lotr18119.lore: The bow of the Uruk captain dealt a powerful blow.

lotr18120.name: New Forges Built
lotr18120.game_text: Exert an [URUK-HAI] minion to reinforce an [URUK-HAI] token.
lotr18120.lore: "'I looked on it and saw that, whereas it had once been green and fair, it was now filled with pits and forges.'"

lotr18121.name: Pikes Upon Pikes
lotr18121.game_text: Each [URUK-HAI] minion bearing a hand weapon cannot take wounds during the archery phase. Skirmish: Discard this condition from play to make an [URUK-HAI] minion bearing a possession strength +2.
lotr18121.lore: Many a crude weapon was forged for his forces.

lotr18122.name: Shagrat, Tower Captain
lotr18122.subtitle: Tower Captain
lotr18122.game_text: Damage +1. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) While you can spot 7 possessions, Shagrat is fierce and cannot take wounds (except during skirmish phases).
lotr18122.lore: "I don't take orders from stinking Morgul rats!"

lotr18123.name: Tracking the Prize
lotr18123.game_text: While you can spot 3 [URUK-HAI] hunters, at the start of each skirmish involving an [URUK-HAI] hunter, each companion skirmishing that minion must exert.
lotr18123.lore: Though bred for battle, the Uruks could track prey like the best of hunters.

lotr18124.name: White Hand Attacker
lotr18124.game_text: Damage +1. While at a battleground, this minion is strength +2.
lotr18124.lore: The Uruk-hai army stopped and growled in anticipation of the upcoming battle.

lotr18125.name: White Hand Exorciser
lotr18125.game_text: Damage +1. When you play this minion, you may heal an [URUK-HAI] minion.
lotr18125.lore: "March to Helms Deep! Leave none alive!"

lotr18126.name: White Hand Marchers
lotr18126.game_text: Damage +1. This minion is strength +1 for each other [URUK-HAI] minion you can spot.
lotr18126.lore: The enormous Uruk-hai armies marched with great speed.

lotr18127.name: White Hand Marshal
lotr18127.game_text: Damage +1. Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may control a site.
lotr18127.lore: The Men and Elves looked out into the darkness, and through the rain they saw, lit by the thousands of torches, the huge advancing Uruk-hai army.

lotr18128.name: White Hand Mystic
lotr18128.game_text: Damage +1. Response: If an [URUK-HAI] minion is about to take a wound, exert this minion to prevent that wound.

lotr18129.name: White Hand Sieger
lotr18129.game_text: Damage +1. To play, spot an [URUK-HAI] minion and you must control a site.
lotr18129.lore: The flood of Uruk-hai storming the Deeping Wall seemed to be unstoppable.

lotr18130.name: White Hand Traveler
lotr18130.game_text: Damage +1. Skirmish: Spot 2 other [URUK-HAI] minions and remove (2) to make this minion strength +1 and damage +1.
lotr18130.lore: The Uruk-hai troop snuck along through the forest following the three boats carrying the Fellowship.

lotr18131.name: White Hand Uruk
lotr18131.game_text: Damage +1. To play, spot an [URUK-HAI] minion.

lotr18132.name: All Life Flees
lotr18132.game_text: To play, spot a Nazgul. Remove (X) to choose one: discard a follower from play that has a twilight cost of X; or play from deck a [WRAITH] minion that has a twilight cost of X.
lotr18132.lore: "A sudden unreasoning fear of discovery laid hold of Frodo, and he thought of his Ring."

lotr18133.name: Pull of the Ring
lotr18133.game_text: Remove a burden to choose one: assign a [WRAITH] minion to a companion who has resistance 0; or have a [WRAITH] minion lose fierce and gain hunter 2.
lotr18133.lore: "I'm naked in the dark. There's nothing, no veil between me and the Wheel of Fire. I can see him with my waking eyes!"

lotr18134.name: Doorway to Doom
lotr18134.game_text: Mountain. When the fellowship moves to this site, each player wounds two of his characters.

lotr18135.name: Foot of Mount Doom
lotr18135.game_text: Mountain. Each card that is about to be placed into the discard pile is removed from the game instead.

lotr18136.name: Mithlond
lotr18136.game_text: River. When the fellowship moves to this site, each player heals each of his or her characters.

lotr18137.name: Morannon Plains
lotr18137.game_text: Battleground. Plains. When the fellowship moves to this site, each player may reinforce a culture token.

lotr18139.name: Steward's Tomb
lotr18139.game_text: Wounds cannot be prevented or healed. Burdens cannot be removed.

lotr18140.name: Streets of Bree
lotr18140.game_text: Dwelling. While the fellowship is at this site, followers cannot be transfered to a character.

lotr19001.name: The One Ring, The Great Ring
lotr19001.subtitle: The Great Ring
lotr19001.game_text: While wearing The One Ring, each time the bearer is about to take a wound, add a burden instead. Maneuver: Wear The One Ring until the regroup phase. Skirmish: Add a burden to make the Ring-bearer strength +3.

lotr19002.name: Gimli, Opinionated Guide
lotr19002.subtitle: Opinionated Guide
lotr19002.game_text: Damage +1. Fellowship. Each time you play a [DWARVEN] possession, you may draw a card.
lotr19002.lore: “If anyone was to ask for my opinion, which I note they're not, I'd say we were taking the long way round.”

lotr19003.name: Still Twitching
lotr19003.game_text: Bearer must be a [DWARVEN] companion. Bearer gains Hunter 2. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another [DWARVEN] companion. At the end of each turn, if bearer did not win a skirmish this turn, discard this condition from play.

lotr19004.name: That's Two!
lotr19004.game_text: Spot Gimli and exert a fellowship companion to have each Shadow player discard one of his or her Shadow cards from play.

lotr19005.name: Army Long Trained
lotr19005.game_text: Bearer must be an [ELVEN] companion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another [ELVEN] companion. At the start of the archery phase, you must exert bearer or return this condition to hand.

lotr19006.name: Arwen, Royal Maiden
lotr19006.subtitle: Royal Maiden
lotr19006.game_text: Ranger. While you can spot 2 [ELVEN] followers, each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -2. Maneuver: Add 3 threats to reconcile your hand.
lotr19006.lore: “I would rather share one lifetime with you than face all the ages of this world alone.”

lotr19007.name: Legolas, Skeptical Guide
lotr19007.subtitle: Skeptical Guide
lotr19007.game_text: Archer. Fellowship. Archery: Add two threats to wound a minion; Legolas does not add to the fellowship archery total.
lotr19007.lore: “Have you heard nothing Lord Elrond has said? The Ring must be destroyed!”

lotr19008.name: Gandalf, Wise Guide
lotr19008.subtitle: Wise Guide
lotr19008.game_text: Fellowship. Response: If an event is played, exert Gandalf twice to cancel that event.
lotr19008.lore: “The Ring yearns above all else to return to the hand of its master. They are one, the Ring and the Dark Lord. Frodo, he must never find it.”

lotr19009.name: Stern Words
lotr19009.game_text: To play, spot a [GANDALF] Wizard. Bearer must be a companion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another companion. At the end of each turn, return this condition to hand.

lotr19010.name: Gollum, Threatening Guide
lotr19010.subtitle: Threatening Guide
lotr19010.game_text: Gollum is strength +1 for each threat you can spot. Each time Gollum wins a skirmish, you may add a threat.
lotr19010.lore: “‘But if we was master, then we could help ourselfs, yes...'”

lotr19011.name: Smeagol, Pitiable Guide
lotr19011.subtitle: Pitiable Guide
lotr19011.game_text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Each time Smeagol wins a skirmish, you may shuffle up to 2 [GOLLUM] cards from your discard pile into your draw deck. Skirmish: Exert a Ring-bound companion to make Smeagol strength +2.
lotr19011.lore: “...now that I see him, I do pity him.”

lotr19012.name: Aragorn, Well-traveled Guide
lotr19012.subtitle: Well-traveled Guide
lotr19012.game_text: Fellowship. Ranger. While the Ring-bearer is the only other companion you can spot, Aragorn is an archer, defender +1, and can take no more than 1 wound each skirmish.
lotr19012.lore: “The skill of the Elves can reforge the sword of Kings, but only you have the power to wield it.”

lotr19013.name: Boromir, Destined Guide
lotr19013.subtitle: Destined Guide
lotr19013.game_text: Fellowship. Ranger. While you can spot two unbound Hobbits, Boromir's twilight cost is -1. Each time Boromir wins a skirmish, you may exert an unbound Hobbit to discard each minion he is skirmishing from play.
lotr19013.lore: “In a dream, I saw the eastern sky grow dark.”

lotr19014.name: Not Bound To His Fate
lotr19014.game_text: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another [GONDOR] Man. At the end of each turn, if bearer is not Aragorn, return this condition to hand.
lotr19014.lore: “Your time will come. You will face the same evil...”

lotr19015.name: Strength In My Blood
lotr19015.game_text: Bearer must be a fellowship companion. While bearer is a [GONDOR] companion, he or she is damage +1.
lotr19015.lore: “I would have followed you my Brother... my Captain... my King!”

lotr19016.name: Grima, Servant of Another Master
lotr19016.subtitle: Servant of Another Master
lotr19016.game_text: When you play Grima, you may remove (4) to exert an unbound companion. That companion cannot use special abilities until the regroup phase. Assignment: Exert Grima to assign him to an unbound companion. That companion may exert to prevent this.

lotr19017.name: Urgency
lotr19017.game_text: Weather. Each time the fellowship moves, add (2) for each Ent you can spot. Skirmish: Discard this condition from play to make a non-[WRAITH] minion strength +1.
lotr19017.lore: “If the mountain defeats you, will you risk a more dangerous road?”

lotr19018.name: The Balrog, Demon of Might
lotr19018.subtitle: Demon of Might
lotr19018.game_text: Damage +2. Fierce. While at an underground site, skip the archery phase, the maneuver phase, and The Balrog cannot be assigned to skirmish companions of strength 6 or less.
lotr19018.lore: “The flames roared up to greet it, and wreathed about it...”

lotr19019.name: Reaching Tentacle
lotr19019.game_text: Tentacle. This minion cannot bear possessions. Discard this minion from play if not at a marsh. This minion is strength +1 for each tentacle you spot.
lotr19019.lore: “Frodo felt something seize him by the ankle...”

lotr19020.name: Strong Tentacle
lotr19020.game_text: Tentacle. This minion cannot bear possessions. Discard this minion from play if not at a marsh. This minion is strength +1 for each tentacle you spot.

lotr19021.name: Watcher in the Water, Many-tentacled Creature
lotr19021.subtitle: Many-tentacled Creature
lotr19021.game_text: Discard all other minions (except tentacles). Watcher in the Water cannot bear possessions. The fellowship's current site gains marsh. Shadow: Play a tentacle from your discard pile.
lotr19021.lore: “...as if a host of snakes were swimming up...”

lotr19022.name: Pit Troll
lotr19022.game_text: Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.) To play, spot an [ORC] Orc. When you play this minion, add 2 threats. The Free Peoples player may exert the Ring-bearer to prevent this.
lotr19022.lore: Black blood. Flat feet. Scaly skin

lotr19023.name: Troll of the Deep, Cave Troll
lotr19023.subtitle: Cave Troll
lotr19023.game_text: To play, spot an [ORC] Orc. Skirmish: Remove a threat to make an [ORC] minion strength +2.
lotr19023.lore: Stones to move. Bridges to be rebuilt.

lotr19024.name: Brought Down From Inside
lotr19024.game_text: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. At the start of each skirmish you may transfer this condition to a [ROHAN] Man. At the end of each turn, if bearer did not win a skirmish this turn, return this condition to hand.
lotr19024.lore: “Bring it down! Bring it down! Bring it down!”

lotr19025.name: Eomer, Eored Captain
lotr19025.subtitle: Eored Captain
lotr19025.game_text: Valiant. Eomer is strength +2 for each wound on each minion he is skirmishing.
lotr19025.lore: “Now is the hour, Riders of Rohan, oaths you have taken! Now, fulfill them all! To Lord and Land!”

lotr19026.name: Eowyn, Lady of the Mark
lotr19026.subtitle: Lady of the Mark
lotr19026.game_text: Valiant. Fellowship: Play a [ROHAN] companion with a twilight cost of 3 or more; his or her twilight cost is -1.
lotr19026.lore: “It's tradition for the women of the court to farewell the men.”

lotr19027.name: Sauron's Might
lotr19027.game_text: Remove a Free Peoples culture token to add a threat. When you play this event, you may remove (1) to place this on the bottom of your draw deck instead of in your discard pile.
lotr19027.lore: “One by one, the free lands of Middle-earth fell to the power of the Ring.”

lotr19028.name: Frodo, Little Master
lotr19028.subtitle: Little Master
lotr19028.game_text: Fellowship. Ring-bearer. Ring-bound. While you cannot spot 4 threats, Shadow cards cannot discard cards from your hand or from the top of your draw deck.

lotr19029.name: Merry, Resolute Friend
lotr19029.subtitle: Resolute Friend
lotr19029.game_text: Fellowship. Skirmish: If Merry is not assigned to a skirmish, take 2 [SHIRE] cards from your discard pile and remove them from the game to make a companion strength +2.
lotr19029.lore: “You can trust us to stick to you through thick and thin - to the bitter end.'”

lotr19030.name: Pippin, Steadfast Friend
lotr19030.subtitle: Steadfast Friend
lotr19030.game_text: Fellowship. Pippin is strength +1 for each tale you can spot.
lotr19030.lore: “‘You must go - and therefore we must, too. Merry and I are coming with you.'”

lotr19031.name: Rabbit Stew
lotr19031.game_text: Bearer must be a [SHIRE] companion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to a fellowship companion. Each time this condition is transferred to a companion, heal that companion.

lotr19032.name: Sam, Loyal Friend
lotr19032.subtitle: Loyal Friend
lotr19032.game_text: Fellowship. Ring-bound. While Sam bears The One Ring, he is resistance -4. While you can spot 3 [SHIRE] companions, Sam is strength +2. Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer.

lotr19033.name: Lurtz, Resilient Captain
lotr19033.subtitle: Resilient Captain
lotr19033.game_text: Archer. Damage +1. Response: If Lurtz is about to take a wound or be exerted, remove (2) (or exert another Uruk-hai) to prevent that wound or exertion.
lotr19033.lore: The Uruk-hai leader walked into view on the misty hilltop beneath the dark trees. Hungry for blood.

lotr19034.name: In Twilight
lotr19034.game_text: Bearer must be a [WRAITH] minion. When you play this, you may draw a card. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another [WRAITH] minion.
lotr19034.lore: The Nazgûl's true forms were revealed to him, shining like ghostly Kings.

lotr19035.name: Ulaire Attea, Dark Predator
lotr19035.subtitle: Dark Predator
lotr19035.game_text: Fierce. While you can spot 5 twilight tokens in the twilight pool and another [WRAITH] card, Ulaire Attea is strength +3.
lotr19035.lore: Those that knew the most power as kings were placed in particular ways for the will of Sauron.

lotr19036.name: Ulaire Enquea, Dark Threat
lotr19036.subtitle: Dark Threat
lotr19036.game_text: Fierce. Maneuver: Spot 6 companions and discard a Nazgul from hand to wound an unbound companion.
lotr19036.lore: The Nine Riders were embodiments of Sauron's will, searching all of Middle-earth for his prize.

lotr19037.name: Ulaire Lemenya, Dark Enemy
lotr19037.subtitle: Dark Enemy
lotr19037.game_text: Fierce. Ulaire Lemenya is strength +1 for each [WRAITH] possession in your discard pile.
lotr19037.lore: “‘Do you wish them to find you? They are terrible!'”

lotr19038.name: Ulaire Nertea, Dark Horseman
lotr19038.subtitle: Dark Horseman
lotr19038.game_text: Fierce. When you play Ulaire Nertea, name a race. The Free Peoples player cannot assign Ulaire Nertea to skirmish a companion of the named race.
lotr19038.lore: Some accepted Sauron's gift for glory and a notion of great deeds.

lotr19039.name: Ulaire Toldea, Dark Shadow
lotr19039.subtitle: Dark Shadow
lotr19039.game_text: Fierce. Ulaire Toldea cannot be assigned to skirmish the same companion in a fierce skirmish that he has already been assigned to this turn.
lotr19039.lore: “‘Open, in the name of Mordor!' said a voice thin and menacing.”

lotr19040.name: The Witch-king, Dark Lord
lotr19040.subtitle: Dark Lord
lotr19040.game_text: Fierce. Skirmish: Discard a Nazgul from hand to make The Witch-king strength +1 (or strength +2 if you can spot that discarded Nazgul).
lotr19040.lore: “‘A great king and sorcerer he was of old, and now he wields a deadly fear.'”

lotrv0001.name: Rath Dinen
lotrv0001.game_text: When sanctuary healing at this site, the Free Peoples player heals only 3 wounds instead of 5.

lotrv1001.name: Hospitality of the Dwarves
lotrv1001.game_text: Maneuver: If the fellowship is at any sites 4 to 8, make each Dwarf lose all damage bonuses until the regroup phase, and each Dwarf bearing 2 or more items takes no more than 1 wound per phase until the regroup phase.
lotrv1001.lore: "'Roaring fires, malt beer, red meat off the bone...'"

lotrv1002.name: Deepest Delvings
lotrv1002.game_text: Each time a [dwarven] card is discarded from the top of your draw deck, you may add (1) to stack that card here. Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf to take a card stacked here into hand.
lotrv1002.lore: "'Far, far below the deepest delvings of the Dwarves, the world is gnawed by nameless things.'"

lotrv1003.name: Gimli, Vengeful Naugrim
lotrv1003.subtitle: Vengeful Naugrim
lotrv1003.game_text: Damage +1. While Gimli bears 2 items, he is strength +2.While Gimli bears 3 items, he is damage +1.
lotrv1003.lore: "'...there is one dwarf in Moria who still draws breath!'"

lotrv1004.name: I Name You Elf-Friend
lotrv1004.game_text: Exert an Elf to make a Dwarf strength +3 and damage +1 until the regroup phase.
lotrv1004.lore: "'...and may the stars shine upon the end of your road.'"

lotrv1005.name: One Dwarf in Moria
lotrv1005.game_text: Spot a Dwarf bearing 2 or more items to heal that Dwarf. Return X items on that Dwarf to their owners' hands to wound X minions.

lotrv1006.name: So Bold and So Courteous
lotrv1006.game_text: Each time the fellowship moves, you may exert an Elf to make a Dwarf defender +1 until the regroup phase.
lotrv1006.lore: "'Let none say again that Dwarves are grasping and ungracious.'"

lotrv1007.name: I Was There
lotrv1007.game_text: Tale.Spot a minion skirmishing an Elf and discard your [elven] tale to wound that minion.
lotrv1007.lore: "'...the day the strength of men failed.'"

lotrv1008.name: Lament for the Fallen
lotrv1008.game_text: To play, exert an Elf and spot a unique companion in the dead pile. Bearer must be an unbound companion.Bearer cannot be exerted, wounded, or assigned to a skirmish.At the start of the regroup phase, discard a condition on bearer (and heal bearer if Gandalf is in the dead pile).

lotrv1009.name: Legolas, Keen-eyed
lotrv1009.subtitle: Keen-eyed
lotrv1009.game_text: Archer.Archery: Make the fellowship archery total -X (to a minimum of 0) to make Legolas strength +X until the regroup phase. You cannot use archery special abilities.
lotrv1009.lore: "He saw not a shadow, nor a blur, but the small figures of horsemen."

lotrv1010.name: Let Fly the Darts of Lindon
lotrv1010.game_text: Tale. Bearer must be a unique [elven] companion.Archery: Exert bearer to make all Free Peoples archers lose archer and gain damage +1 until the regroup phase.
lotrv1010.lore: "'It recalled to me the glory of the Elder Days and the hosts of Beleriand, so many great princes and captains were assembled.'"

lotrv1011.name: Library of Rivendell
lotrv1011.game_text: Fellowship: Stack your tale or artifact from play or from hand here to draw a card.Regroup: Exert an [elven] ally to draw X cards, exert X minions, and remove up to X wounds from companions, where X is the number of Free Peoples cultures on cards stacked here. Discard this artifact.

lotrv1012.name: Three for the Elven-Kings
lotrv1012.game_text: Tale.Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot an [elven] or [gandalf] ring to place a card from hand beneath your draw deck and draw a card (and heal a companion if you can spot 3 [elven] or [gandalf] rings).
lotrv1012.lore: "'The Three, fairest of all, the Elf-lords hid from him, and his hand never touched them or sullied them.'"

lotrv1013.name: Counsel of the Wise
lotrv1013.game_text: Spot Gandalf to reveal an [elven] ally from your draw deck. You may add (X) to take that ally into hand, where X is that ally's twilight cost.
lotrv1013.lore: "Beside Glorfindel there were several other counsellors of Elrond's household, of whom Erestor was the chief; and with him was Galdor, an Elf from the Grey Havens..."

lotrv1014.name: Gandalf, Olorin
lotrv1014.subtitle: Olorin
lotrv1014.game_text: At the start of your fellowship phase, you may spot 2 [elven] allies and exert Gandalf to shuffle a [Gandalf] or [elven] card from your discard pile into your draw deck.While you can spot 3 [elven] allies, Gandalf is strength +2. While you can spot Elrond, Galadriel, and Celeborn, Gandalf is strength +2.

lotrv1015.name: Gwaihir, Lord of Eagles
lotrv1015.subtitle: Lord of Eagles
lotrv1015.game_text: To play, spot Gandalf.Each time the fellowship moves to an opponent's site, you may heal a companion with the Gandalf signet.Regroup: Discard Gwaihir to make the move limit for this turn +1; the Shadow player may take up to 2 Shadow cards into hand from their discard pile.

lotrv1016.name: My Heart Tells Me
lotrv1016.game_text: Each time a minion is about to take a wound, you may spot Gandalf to prevent that wound and heal a companion (limit once per turn).
lotrv1016.lore: "'Then do not be too eager to deal out death in judgement.'"

lotrv1017.name: Two Eyes, as Often as I Can Spare Them
lotrv1017.game_text: Spot Gandalf and Frodo to draw X cards, where X is Frodo's vitality.
lotrv1017.lore: "'You'll keep an eye on Frodo, won't you?'"

lotrv1018.name: The White Council
lotrv1018.game_text: While you can spot Gandalf and 2 [elven] allies, the first sentence of Saruman's game text does not apply.Regroup: Exert 2 [elven] allies to heal Gandalf or a companion with the Gandalf signet (limit 2 per phase).
lotrv1018.lore: "'For even the very wise cannot see all ends.'"

lotrv1019.name: Aragorn, Estel
lotrv1019.subtitle: Estel
lotrv1019.game_text: When you play Aragorn, you may take an [elven] ally with a twilight cost of 2 or less into hand from your draw deck.Skirmish: Discard an [elven] skirmish event from hand to make Aragorn strength +2.
lotrv1019.lore: "'I gave Hope to the Dúnedain, I have kept no hope for myself.'"

lotrv1020.name: Boromir, Redeemed
lotrv1020.subtitle: Redeemed
lotrv1020.game_text: Boromir is strength +2 for each minion he is skirmishing.At the start of each assignment phase, you may exert another companion with the Aragorn signet to make Boromir defender +1 until the regroup phase.
lotrv1020.lore: "'Few have gained such a victory. Be at peace!'"

lotrv1021.name: The Sons of Gondor Have Returned
lotrv1021.game_text: While Boromir is assigned to skirmish more than 1 minion, Aragorn is strength +3. While Aragorn is assigned to skirmish more than 1 minion, Boromir is strength +3.
lotrv1021.lore: "They blew a great fanfare, and the heralds cried aloud:..."

lotrv1022.name: Gilraen's Memorial
lotrv1022.game_text: To play, exert Aragorn.When Aragorn is killed, discard this artifact.Fellowship: Exert a companion with the Aragorn signet to remove a burden. Then exert Aragorn or discard this artifact.

lotrv1023.name: I Would Have Gone With You to the End
lotrv1023.game_text: Each time you play a skirmish event during a skirmish involving a companion with the Aragorn signet, you may spot Aragorn to stack that event here.Skirmish: Spot Aragorn and discard X cards here to make a skirmishing companion with the Aragorn signet strength +X (limit +3).

lotrv1024.name: You Have My Sword
lotrv1024.game_text: To play, spot Aragorn. Plays on a companion with the Aragorn signet (except Aragorn).Each time bearer wins a skirmish, exert Aragorn or discard this condition.
lotrv1024.lore: "'I am Aragorn son of Arathorn; and if by life or death I can save you, I will.'"

lotrv1025.name: Crebain Flock
lotrv1025.game_text: This minion is twilight cost -1 for each companion you can spot over 3.Maneuver: Spot 2 wounded companions (or spot Saruman) and discard this minion to place an [isengard] weather from your draw deck or discard pile on top of your draw deck.

lotrv1026.name: Crows of Isengard
lotrv1026.game_text: When you play this minion, spot a companion to add (1) for each Free Peoples card borne by that companion (limit (3)).Maneuver: Spot 2 Free Peoples items (or spot Saruman) and discard this minion to place an [isengard] item from your draw deck or discard pile on top of your draw deck.

lotrv1027.name: Frostbite
lotrv1027.game_text: To play, spot a weather condition. Plays on a companion. Limit 1 per bearer.Each time a weather card is played, add (2). When this condition is discarded by a Free Peoples card, wound bearer.

lotrv1028.name: Just a Wisp of Cloud
lotrv1028.game_text: Spell. Weather. Place Saruman from your draw deck or discard pile on top of your draw deck. You may discard up to X cards from hand, where X is the number of Crows you can spot.
lotrv1028.lore: "'It is moving fast...and against the wind.'"

lotrv1029.name: Murder of Crows
lotrv1029.game_text: While you can spot 3 Free Peoples conditions, this minion is twilight cost -3. Maneuver: Spot 3 Free Peoples conditions (or spot Saruman) and discard this minion to place an [isengard] condition from your draw deck or discard pile on top of your draw deck.
lotrv1029.lore: "...a whole regiment of birds had broken away..."

lotrv1030.name: Saruman, Fell Voice
lotrv1030.subtitle: Fell Voice
lotrv1030.game_text: While you cannot spot a weather, Saruman may not take wounds in the archery phase and may not be assigned to a skirmish.While at a site bearing a weather, each [isengard] minion is strength +2.Response: If the fellowship moves from a site bearing a weather, discard this minion to exert each companion.

lotrv1031.name: Guided by One Purpose
lotrv1031.game_text: Each time a tentacle wins a skirmish, you may stack it here.Assignment: Spot 4 tentacles stacked here and discard this condition to assign a [moria] creature to the Ring-bearer. The Free Peoples player may exert the Ring-bearer twice to prevent this.

lotrv1032.name: Terror at Its Coming
lotrv1032.game_text: Each time the fellowship moves, you may reveal The Balrog from your hand to add (2).
lotrv1032.lore: "The orcs stood still, and a dead silence fell."

lotrv1033.name: Thrashing Tentacle
lotrv1033.game_text: Tentacle. This minion may not bear possessions and is discarded if not at a marsh.Shadow: Spot 3 [moria] creatures to play this minion from your discard pile.
lotrv1033.lore: "The others swung round and saw the waters of the lake seething..."

lotrv1034.name: Out of Dark Waters
lotrv1034.game_text: Shadow: Remove (1) to stack a tentacle from hand here.Shadow: Remove (1) to play a tentacle stacked here as if from hand.Response: If this condition is about to be discarded, discard a tentacle stacked here to prevent that.

lotrv1035.name: The Darkness Grew
lotrv1035.game_text: Shadow: Stack a [moria] item from hand here.Shadow: Spot The Balrog to take a [moria] card stacked here into hand.
lotrv1035.lore: "... he seemed small, and altogether alone: grey and bent, like a wizened tree before the onset of a storm."

lotrv1036.name: Vile Tentacle
lotrv1036.game_text: Tentacle. This minion may not bear possessions and is strength -4 while not at a marsh. Shadow: Discard a [moria] card from hand to make the fellowship's current site gain marsh until the end of the turn.
lotrv1036.lore: "...it was pale-green and luminous and wet."

lotrv1037.name: Fell Voices Call
lotrv1037.game_text: Play a [ringwraith] item from your draw deck or discard pile.
lotrv1037.lore: "A breath of deadly cold pierced him like a spear..."

lotrv1038.name: Harry Goatleaf, In Thrall to the Nine
lotrv1038.subtitle: In Thrall to the Nine
lotrv1038.game_text: Nazgul are twilight cost -1.Assignment: Make the Free Peoples player assign a companion with 5 strength or more to skirmish this minion.
lotrv1038.lore: "'But you'll find maybe that more folk than old Harry at the gate will be asking you questions.'"

lotrv1039.name: Pale Crown
lotrv1039.game_text: Plays to your support area.While bearer is twilight, characters skirmishing bearer do not receive strength or damage bonuses from cards they bear.Skirmish: Remove (1) to transfer this artifact from your support area to a Nazgul.
lotrv1039.lore: "'They were once men. Great kings of men.'"

lotrv1040.name: Ringwraith in Twilight
lotrv1040.game_text: Twilight.This minion is strength +1 for each wound on the Ring-bearer.At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert this minion to make it fierce until the regroup phase. The Free Peoples player may exert the Ring-bearer to prevent this.

lotrv1041.name: Their Eyes Fell Upon Him
lotrv1041.game_text: To play, spot a twilight Nazgul.Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot a wound on the Ring-bearer to draw a card (or 2 cards if the Ring-bearer is exhausted).
lotrv1041.lore: "'...you had become visible to them, being already on the threshold of their world.'"

lotrv1042.name: Walks in Twilight
lotrv1042.game_text: Each time a twilight Nazgul wins a skirmish, you may exert a twilight Nazgul to shuffle a [ringwraith] card from your discard pile into your draw deck.
lotrv1042.lore: "The Riders made straight for you, as soon as you fled.'"

lotrv1043.name: White Faces Burned
lotrv1043.game_text: Make a skirmishing twilight Nazgul strength +1 for each wound on the Ring- bearer (and damage +1 if that Nazgul is The Witch-king).
lotrv1043.lore: "Immediately, though everything else remained as before, dim and dark, the shapes became terribly clear."

lotrv1044.name: Fell to Its Power
lotrv1044.game_text: Discard a [Sauron] Orc to add a burden. The Free Peoples player may discard a Free Peoples condition to prevent this.
lotrv1044.lore: "'If the Dark Lord knows so much as you say, Mithrandir, will he not rather smile than fear, and with his little finger crush us like a fly that tries to sting him?'"

lotrv1045.name: Gaze of the Eye
lotrv1045.game_text: Response: If your [Sauron] condition is about to be discarded, remove a burden to prevent this.
lotrv1045.lore: "Then the Eye began to rove, searching this way and that; and Frodo knew with certainty and horror that among the many things that it sought he himself was one."

lotrv1046.name: I See You
lotrv1046.game_text: The site number of each [Sauron] minion is -1 for each burden you can spot.Each [sauron] minion with site number of 1 or less is strength +1. When the Ring-bearer takes off The One Ring, discard this condition.
lotrv1046.lore: "...to pin you under its deadly gaze, naked, immovable."

lotrv1047.name: It Betrayed Isildur
lotrv1047.game_text: Spot 5 burdens and discard a [Sauron] Orc to choose one: make the move limit for this turn -1; or make the Free Peoples player choose to move again (if the move limit allows).
lotrv1047.lore: "'He leaped into the waters, but the Ring slipped from his finger as he swam, and then the Orcs saw him and killed him with arrows.'"

lotrv1048.name: Orc Ambush Troop
lotrv1048.game_text: Tracker.While you can spot an exhausted companion, this minion is an archer.While you can spot 3 exhausted companions, this minion is strength +3.
lotrv1048.lore: "'...he was waylaid by the Orcs of the Mountains, and almost all his folk were slain.'"

lotrv1049.name: A Shadow of the Past
lotrv1049.game_text: While you can spot 4 burdens, each [sauron] Orc is fierce.While you can spot 6 burdens, each [Sauron] Orc is damage +1.Discard this condition at the start of the regroup phase.
lotrv1049.lore: "'He has indeed arisen again... and returned to his ancient fastness in the Dark Tower of Mordor.'"

lotrv1050.name: Bilbo, Of Bag End
lotrv1050.subtitle: Of Bag End
lotrv1050.game_text: To play, spot 2 companions with the Frodo signet. Fellowship: If the fellowship is at a sanctuary, exert Bilbo twice to play 2 items from your draw deck on [shire] companions.
lotrv1050.lore: "'There has always been a Baggins in Bag End, and there always will be.'"

lotrv1051.name: Griffo Boffin, Uncouth Fellow
lotrv1051.subtitle: Uncouth Fellow
lotrv1051.game_text: Each time you play a [shire] ally, you may add (1) to draw a card.
lotrv1051.lore: "'Neither are they counted amongst the very wise...'"

lotrv1052.name: Merry, Of Buckland
lotrv1052.subtitle: Of Buckland
lotrv1052.game_text: Assignment: Exert Merry 3 times to prevent a minion from being assigned to a skirmish until the regroup phase. The Shadow player may exhaust that minion to prevent this.
lotrv1052.lore: "'...we are going to do our best to help you against the Enemy.'"

lotrv1053.name: Pippin, Of Tuckborough
lotrv1053.subtitle: Of Tuckborough
lotrv1053.game_text: Skirmish: Exert Pippin to prevent a skirmishing [shire] companion from being overwhelmed unless their strength is tripled (and make them strength +1 if you can spot 3 companions with the Frodo signet).
lotrv1053.lore: "'You must go - and therefore we must, too. Merry and I are coming with you.'"

lotrv1054.name: Sam, Of Bagshot Row
lotrv1054.subtitle: Of Bagshot Row
lotrv1054.game_text: Each time a companion with the Frodo signet wins a skirmish, you may exert Sam or add a burden to heal that companion.Response: If Frodo is killed, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).

lotrv1055.name: We May Yet
lotrv1055.game_text: Exert a skirmishing companion with the Frodo signet to make that companion strength +1 for each companion with the Frodo signet you can spot (limit +4).
lotrv1055.lore: "'I don't suppose we'll ever see them again.'"

lotrv1056.name: We're Coming, Too!
lotrv1056.game_text: Spot Merry and Pippin to heal two companions with the Frodo signet.
lotrv1056.lore: "'We hobbits ought to stick together, and we will. I shall go, unless they chain me up.'"

lotrv1057.name: Bag End Study
lotrv1057.game_text: When the fellowship moves from here, you may exert a [shire] companion to play a [shire] condition from your draw deck.

lotrv1058.name: Prancing Pony Spare Room
lotrv1058.game_text: Each time a minion of strength 6 or less is played, make it strength +3 until the regroup phase (unless you can spot a [gandalf] card).

lotrv1059.name: Rivendell Gateway
lotrv1059.game_text: Forest. Sanctuary. Fellowship: Exert a companion to make one of another culture strength +1 until the end of the turn (limit +6).

lotrv1060.name: Moria Crossroads
lotrv1060.game_text: Underground. While you can spot a unique [moria] minion, skirmishes involving [moria] minions may not be canceled.

lotrv1061.name: Lorien Throne Room
lotrv1061.game_text: Forest. Sanctuary. Each time a companion exerts here, you may exert an [elven] ally to heal that companion.

lotrv1062.name: Valley of the Anduin
lotrv1062.game_text: River. At the start of each skirmish phase, wound each unwounded character in that skirmish.

lotrv1063.name: Nen Hithoel
lotrv1063.game_text: River. When the fellowship moves to Nen Hithoel, each Shadow player may draw a card for each companion over 4.

lotrv1064.name: Amon Hen Ruins
lotrv1064.game_text: Forest. Each minion is damage +1 for each wound on that minion.

lotrv1065.name: Sirannon Dam
lotrv1065.game_text: Rivers and sites with no other terrain keywords gain marsh.Companions are defender +1.Skirmish: Remove 2 burdens to have Watcher in the Water replace a tentacle skirmishing an unbound companion.
lotrv1065.lore: "But either Gandalf was astray, or else the land had changed in recent years..."

lotrv1066.name: Writhing Tentacle
lotrv1066.game_text: Tentacle. This minion may not bear possessions and is discarded if not at a marsh.Shadow: If this minion is stacked on a Shadow card, play it to stack 2 tentacles from your discard pile on that card.
lotrv1066.lore: "Many coiling arms seized the doors on either side, and with horrible strength, swung them round."

lotrv2001.name: Driven into the Hills
lotrv2001.game_text: To play, spot a [Dunland] minion.For each companion you can spot over 4, the Free Peoples player must have an additional card in hand to have initiative.
lotrv2001.lore: "'Not in half a thousand years have they forgotten their grievance that the lords of Gondor gave the Mark to Eorl the Young and made alliance with him.'"

lotrv2002.name: Dunlending Raider
lotrv2002.game_text: While you have initiative, this minion's twilight cost is -2.
lotrv2002.lore: "'They bring fire...and are burning as they come, rick, cot, and tree.'"

lotrv2003.name: Dunlending Reaver
lotrv2003.game_text: While you have initiative, this minion is strength +3 and damage +1.
lotrv2003.lore: "Now they could hear, borne over the dark, the sound of harsh singing..."

lotrv2004.name: Horsemen Took Your Lands
lotrv2004.game_text: Play a non-unique [Dunland] minion from your discard pile. If you have initiative, you may play a [dunland] possession on that minion from your discard pile.
lotrv2004.lore: "They will not give way now for dusk or dawn..."

lotrv2005.name: Ritual Oath of Enmity
lotrv2005.game_text: While you can spot 18 twilight tokens in region 1, this card can be played from your draw deck.Shadow: Spot 18 twilight tokens (or 25 if in region 3) and remove (7) to add a [dunland] token here.Shadow: Spot a [dunland] token here to take control of 2 sites. Discard this artifact.

lotrv2006.name: Arwen, Lady of Rivendell
lotrv2006.subtitle: Lady of Rivendell
lotrv2006.game_text: Aragorn is strength +1. While Arwen is exhausted, Aragorn is defender +1.Each time Aragorn is about to take a wound, you may wound Arwen to prevent that wound.
lotrv2006.lore: "'Dark is the Shadow, and yet my heart rejoices; for you, Estel, shall be among the great whose valour will destroy it.'"

lotrv2007.name: Deadly Contest
lotrv2007.game_text: Spot an [elven] companion to reinforce a [dwarven] token or spot a [dwarven] companion to reinforce an [elven] token.If you can spot both Legolas and Gimli you may reinforce both an [elven] and [dwarven] token an additional time.
lotrv2007.lore: "'Good!' said Legolas. 'But my count is now two dozen. It has been knife-work up here.'"

lotrv2008.name: Haldir, Naith Commander
lotrv2008.subtitle: Naith Commander
lotrv2008.game_text: Valiant. While Haldir bears a ranged weapon, each valiant Elf is strength +1 and each valiant Elf does not add to the fellowship archery total.Each time an [elven] possession is about to be discarded by a card effect, you may exert Haldir to prevent that.

lotrv2009.name: Leithio i Phillin!
lotrv2009.game_text: Spot 2 valiant Elves to wound a minion (or wound a minion twice if each of those Elves bears a ranged weapon).
lotrv2009.lore: "'I must go and seek some arrows,' said Legolas. 'Would that this night would end, and I could have better light for shooting.'"

lotrv2010.name: Naith Armaments
lotrv2010.game_text: Bearer must be a valiant Elf.Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert bearer to heal another valiant Elf.

lotrv2011.name: To Honour That Allegiance
lotrv2011.game_text: Exert a valiant companion (or spot 2 valiant Elves) to take a valiant [elven] companion or [elven] possession into hand from your draw deck.
lotrv2011.lore: "'It is told that Elendil stood there watching for the coming of Gil-galad out of the West, in the days of the Last Alliance.'"

lotrv2012.name: Your Friends Are With You
lotrv2012.game_text: Each time your Man, Elf, or Dwarf wins a skirmish, make your Man, Elf, or Dwarf of another race strength +1 until the regroup phase.
lotrv2012.lore: "'With hope or without hope we will follow the trail of our enemies....We will make such a chase as shall be accounted a marvel among the Three Kindreds of Elves. Dwarves, and Men.'"

lotrv2013.name: Gandalf, Lathspell
lotrv2013.subtitle: Lathspell
lotrv2013.game_text: Each mounted companion gains valiant.Response: If a minion's special ability is used (except during a skirmish), spot 3 valiant companions and exert Gandalf to prevent that and wound that minion.
lotrv2013.lore: "'No counsel have I to give to those that despair. Yet counsel I could give, and words I could speak to you.'"

lotrv2014.name: Remember Your Old Strength
lotrv2014.game_text: Exert Gandalf to make Theoden and each valiant companion strength +1 until the regroup phase (or strength +2 if every unbound companion is valiant).
lotrv2014.lore: "'If this is bewitchment,' said Théoden, 'it seems to me more wholesome than your whisperings.'"

lotrv2015.name: Watching and Waiting
lotrv2015.game_text: Shadow: Spot your minion and remove (3) to draw 2 cards.Shadow: Spot 18 twilight tokens (or 25 if in region 3) and remove (3) to draw 8 cards. If in region 1, this action can be performed from your draw deck.

lotrv2016.name: Aragorn, Last Hope of Men
lotrv2016.subtitle: Last Hope of Men
lotrv2016.game_text: Valiant.At the start of each turn you may spot another valiant companion to draw a card.Skirmish: Exert Aragorn to make a skirmishing valiant companion strength +2.

lotrv2017.name: I Will Die as One of Them
lotrv2017.game_text: Exert Aragorn three times to make each valiant companion strength +2 until the regroup phase. If Aragorn dies during this turn, make each valiant companion strength +1 for the rest of the turn.
lotrv2017.lore: "'Andúril! Andúril goes to war. The Blade that was Broken shines again!'"

lotrv2018.name: Back on the Menu
lotrv2018.game_text: Skirmish: Discard a [Sauron] tracker to make an [Isengard] tracker strength +2.Skirmish: Exert an [isengard] tracker to make a [sauron] tracker fierce until the regroup phase.
lotrv2018.lore: "Five dead Orcs lay there. They had been hewn with many cruel strokes, and two had been beheaded."

lotrv2019.name: Berserk Deathseeker
lotrv2019.game_text: Damage +1.This minion is strength +1 for each wound on each character in its skirmish.When this minion is killed, add 3 [isengard] tokens to an [isengard] machine.
lotrv2019.lore: "The foremost fell with Legolas' last arrow in his throat. but the rest sprang over him."

lotrv2020.name: Berserk Fanatic
lotrv2020.game_text: Damage +1. This minion is strength +1 for each wound on each character in its skirmish.When this minion dies in a skirmish, you may remove 2 [isengard] tokens from a machine to wound a character it was skirmishing.
lotrv2020.lore: "Then the Orcs screamed, waving spear and sword, and shooting a cloud of arrows."

lotrv2021.name: Breaching Shot
lotrv2021.game_text: Remove X tokens from machines to assign an Uruk-hai costing X or less to an ally or unbound companion.
lotrv2021.lore: "'They have crept in the culvert again, while we talked, and they have lit the fire of Orthanc beneath our feet.'"

lotrv2022.name: Fell from Wisdom into Folly
lotrv2022.game_text: Shadow: Spot your minion and remove (3) to draw 2 cards.Shadow: Spot 18 twilight tokens (or 25 if in region 3) and remove (5) to take up to 4 Shadow items into hand from your draw deck. If in region 1, this action can be performed from your draw deck.

lotrv2023.name: Fires of Industry
lotrv2023.game_text: When you play this condition, spot 2 [Isengard] Orcs or a Wizard to add 2 [isengard] tokens here.At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard this condition (or remove an [isengard] token here), to heal an [Isengard] Orc.
lotrv2023.lore: "'For bole and bough are burning now, the furnace roars...'"

lotrv2024.name: Hound of Isengard
lotrv2024.game_text: Bearer must be a warg-rider .When you play this possession, you may take an [isengard] skirmish event into hand from your discard pile.
lotrv2024.lore: "'He has taken Orcs into his service, and Wolf-riders, and evil Men...'"

lotrv2025.name: Isengard Foreman
lotrv2025.game_text: When you play this minion, you may play an [isengard] Orc from your discard pile; it is strength +1 until the regroup phase.Regroup: Discard this minion to add two threats.
lotrv2025.lore: "'He has taken up with foul folk, with the Orcs.'"

lotrv2026.name: Isengard Grunt
lotrv2026.game_text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to prevent an [isengard] Orc from being overwhelmed unless its strength is tripled.
lotrv2026.lore: "...Saruman was mustering a great force on his own account, in rivalry of Sauron and not in his service yet."

lotrv2027.name: Legion of Isengard
lotrv2027.game_text: Damage +1.While you control a battleground, this minion is damage +1.While at a battleground, skirmish special abilities cannot be used during skirmishes involving this minion.
lotrv2027.lore: "...blazoned upon every helm and shield the ghastly hand of Isengard was seen..."

lotrv2028.name: Machinery of War
lotrv2028.game_text: When you play this condition, spot a Wizard to add 2 [isengard] tokens here.Each time an [isengard] Orc loses a skirmish, add an [isengard] token here.Skirmish: Discard this condition (or remove 2 [isengard] tokens here) to cancel a skirmish involving an [isengard] Orc.

lotrv2029.name: Saruman, Mind of Metal and Wheels
lotrv2029.subtitle: Mind of Metal and Wheels
lotrv2029.game_text: Saruman may not be assigned to a skirmish.Companions skirmishing [Isengard] Orcs lose all damage bonuses.Response: If an [isengard] Orc is about to take a wound, exert Saruman to prevent that wound.
lotrv2029.lore: "'I think that I now understand what he is up to. He\is plotting to become a Power.'"

lotrv2030.name: Strength of the Pack
lotrv2030.game_text: Mounted [Isengard] Orcs are strength +1.While you can spot 2 mounted [isengard] Orcs, your [isengard] mounts are twilight cost -1.
lotrv2030.lore: "At a gap in the circle a great dark wolf-shape could be seen halted, gazing at them. A shuddering howl broke from him, as if he were a captain summoning his pack to the assault."

lotrv2031.name: Trail of Savagery
lotrv2031.game_text: Each site you control gains battleground.Skirmish: Remove 2 [isengard] tokens to cancel a skirmish involving an Uruk-hai.
lotrv2031.lore: "'They are burning or despoiling all that is left in the vale.'"

lotrv2032.name: Uneasy Alliance
lotrv2032.game_text: Search.While you can spot an [Isengard] tracker and a [Sauron] tracker, trackers are strength +1.Shadow: Discard a [sauron] tracker from hand to play an [isengard] tracker from your discard pile. Discard this condition.
lotrv2032.lore: "...a quarrel seemed on the point of breaking out again between the Northerners and the Isengarders."

lotrv2033.name: Uruk Grumbler
lotrv2033.game_text: Tracker. Fierce.Each time this minion is assigned to skirmish a companion, you may spot a [sauron] tracker and discard this minion to wound that companion.
lotrv2033.lore: "'We came out of Isengard, and led you here, and we shall lead you back by the way we choose.'"

lotrv2034.name: Uruk Occupier
lotrv2034.game_text: Damage +1.This minion is strength +1 for each battleground you control.Shadow: If you control 3 battlegrounds, discard a card from hand to play this minion from your discard pile.
lotrv2034.lore: "'Our scouts have gained no news of him, and the enemy fills all the valley behind us.'"

lotrv2035.name: Uruk Shield Wall
lotrv2035.game_text: Machine. Each time an Uruk-hai costingX is about to take a wound (except during a skirmish), prevent that and exert it. X is the number of [isengard] tokens you can spot here.Maneuver: Exert an Uruk-hai to add an[isengard] token here.
lotrv2035.lore: "They held their great shields above them like a roof..."

lotrv2036.name: Wolf Pit
lotrv2036.game_text: When you play this possession, you may stack two [isengard] mounts here from your draw deck or discard pile.Shadow: Exert an [Isengard] minion to play an [Isengard] mount stacked here as if from hand.
lotrv2036.lore: "Horsemen were galloping on the grass of Rohan; wolves poured from Isengard."

lotrv2037.name: Ancient Evil
lotrv2037.game_text: Each time a [moria] minion wins a skirmish, you may stack it here.Shadow: Play a unique minion stacked here, it is twilight cost -1 for each other card stacked here. Discard this condition.
lotrv2037.lore: "'...I found myself suddenly faced by something that I have not met before.'"

lotrv2038.name: The Balrog, Lieutenant of Morgoth
lotrv2038.subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgoth
lotrv2038.game_text: Fierce. Damage +1.Each time a minion takes a wound, you may remove (1) to add a threat.Each time the Free Peoples player uses a skirmish special ability during a skirmish involving the Balrog, you may wound a companion it is skirmishing.

lotrv2039.name: From Deepest Dungeon
lotrv2039.game_text: Each time the fellowship moves, you may reveal The Balrog from your hand to add a threat.Shadow: Remove X threats. Play The Balrog from your discard pile; its twilight cost is -X.
lotrv2039.lore: "'Far, far below the deepest delving of the Dwarves, the world is gnawed by nameless things.'"

lotrv2040.name: Through Fire and Water
lotrv2040.game_text: Each time a unique [moria] minion wins a skirmish, you may remove a threat to exert a companion.
lotrv2040.lore: "'His fire was quenched, but now he was a thing of slime, stronger than a strangling snake.'"

lotrv2041.name: To Highest Peak
lotrv2041.game_text: Discard X [Moria] minions to add X threats. The Free Peoples player may exert X companions to prevent this.
lotrv2041.lore: "'There was none to see, or perhaps in after ages songs would still be sung of the Battle of the Peak.'"

lotrv2042.name: Valiant but Foolish
lotrv2042.game_text: Shadow: Spot your minion and remove (3) to draw 2 cards.Shadow: Spot 18 twilight tokens (or 25 if in region 3) and remove (6) to take up to 4 Shadow conditions into hand from your draw deck. If in region 1, this action can be performed from your draw deck.

lotrv2043.name: All Hope of Secrecy Lost
lotrv2043.game_text: Shadow: Spot your minion and remove (3) to draw 2 cards.Shadow: Spot 18 twilight tokens (or 25 if in region 3) and remove (4) to take up to 4 Shadow events into hand from your draw deck. If in region 1, this action can be performed from your draw deck.

lotrv2044.name: Threats on All Sides
lotrv2044.game_text: Shadow: Spot your minion and remove (3) to draw 2 cards.Shadow: Spot 18 twilight tokens (or 25 if in region 3) and remove (9) to add up to 6 threats. If in region 1, this action can be performed from your draw deck.

lotrv2045.name: Do Not Trust to Hope
lotrv2045.game_text: Bearer must be a [rohan] companion. Bearer is valiant.At the start of the regroup phase, wound bearer or discard this condition.
lotrv2045.lore: "'I fret in this prison,' said Théoden. 'If I could have set a spear in rest, riding before my men upon the field, maybe I could have felt again the joy of battle, and so ended. But I serve little purpose here.'"

lotrv2046.name: An End Worthy of Remembrance
lotrv2046.game_text: Spot X [rohan] conditions and remove 2 tokens from each to make 3 valiant companions strength +X until the regroup phase.
lotrv2046.lore: "Captains and champions fell or fled before them. Neither orc nor man withstood them."

lotrv2047.name: Erkenbrand, Kinsman of the House of Eorl
lotrv2047.subtitle: Kinsman of the House of Eorl
lotrv2047.game_text: When you play Erkenbrand, remove up to 3 non-unique [rohan] companions in the dead pile from the game. Each exhausted companion gains valiant.
lotrv2047.lore: "'He was a mighty man. In him lived again the valour of Helm the Hammerhand.'"

lotrv2048.name: Stronghold of My Fathers
lotrv2048.game_text: Fortification. To play, spot 3 [rohan] companions (or 2 valiant companions).Response: If a [rohan] companion is about to take a wound, discard this or 2 other [rohan] possessions to prevent that wound.
lotrv2048.lore: "'Is it not said that no foe has ever taken the Hornburg, if men defended it?'"

lotrv2049.name: Guthwine, Eomer's Blade
lotrv2049.subtitle: Eomer's Blade
lotrv2049.game_text: Bearer must be a [rohan] companion.If bearer is Eomer, he is damage +1 and each time he wins a skirmish, you may reinforce a [rohan] token.
lotrv2049.lore: "The swords flashed from the sheath as one."

lotrv2050.name: Let This Be the Hour
lotrv2050.game_text: Exert a valiant companion to make that companion defender +1. That companion is strength +1 for each minion skirmishing them until the regroup phase.
lotrv2050.lore: "At his right hand was Aragorn, Elendil's heir, behind him rode the lords of the House of Eorl the Young."

lotrv2051.name: Now for Wrath
lotrv2051.game_text: Each time a [rohan] item or [rohan] ally is discarded or killed, add a [rohan] token here.Each time a minion is exerted by a Free Peoples card, you may remove a [rohan] token here and exert a valiant companion to wound that minion.
lotrv2051.lore: "'How shall any tower withstand such numbers and such reckless hate?'"

lotrv2052.name: Now for Ruin
lotrv2052.game_text: Each time a minion is killed, spot 2 valiant companions to add a [rohan] token here.Each time there are 3 [rohan] tokens here, remove all tokens here to play a [rohan] condition or event from your discard pile. The Shadow player may then play a minion from their discard pile.

lotrv2053.name: And the Red Dawn
lotrv2053.game_text: Maneuver: Spot 3 valiant companions to discard your hand. For each Shadow card discarded, exert a minion. For each Free Peoples card discarded, heal a valiant or [rohan] companion. You cannot make any more Maneuver actions.
lotrv2053.lore: "'The end will not be long,' said the king. 'But I will not end here, taken like an old badger in a trap.'"

lotrv2054.name: Royal Guard
lotrv2054.game_text: To play, spot Theoden (or 3 [rohan] Men).Skirmish: Exert this ally to add his strength to a skirmishing Hobbit and make that Hobbit gain valiant until the regroup phase (limit once per phase).
lotrv2054.lore: "'It is not as I would have it,' said Théoden; 'for this is little like my fair house in Edoras. And your friend is gone, who should also be here.'"

lotrv2055.name: Theoden, Last of His House
lotrv2055.subtitle: Last of His House
lotrv2055.game_text: Valiant.Theoden is strength +1 for each other valiant companion assigned to a skirmish.
lotrv2055.lore: "His beard was laid like snow upon his knees; but his eyes still burned with a bright light, glinting as he gazed..."

lotrv2056.name: To the King!
lotrv2056.game_text: Spot an unassigned valiant companion to have them replace an unbound companion in a skirmish (and make them damage +1 if that unbound companion is Theoden).

lotrv2057.name: Attention of the Eye
lotrv2057.game_text: Shadow: Spot your minion and remove (3) to draw 2 cards.Shadow: Spot 18 twilight tokens (or 25 if in region 3) to play up to 2 minions from your draw deck costing (5) or more. If in region 1, this action can be performed from your draw deck.

lotrv2058.name: Down to Join the  Dead Ones
lotrv2058.game_text: To play, spot a Wraith.Regroup: Discard two twilight minions to add a burden. The Free Peoples player may wound the Ring-bearer to prevent this.
lotrv2058.lore: "'They lie in all the pools, pale faces, deep deep under the dark water.'"

lotrv2059.name: Grishnakh, Servant of Lugburz
lotrv2059.subtitle: Servant of Lugburz
lotrv2059.game_text: Tracker.The site number of each [sauron] orc is -3. Skirmish: Exert Grishnakh to make a skirmishing [sauron] Orc with a site number of 1 or less damage +1.
lotrv2059.lore: "'My dear little fellows, please believe me when I say that it was not out of kindness: that's not even one of Uglúk's faults.'"

lotrv2060.name: Lugburz Spotter
lotrv2060.game_text: Tracker. If this minion's site number is 1 or less, it is strength +5.
lotrv2060.lore: "'You're as bad as the other rabble: the maggots and the apes of Lugbúrz.'"

lotrv2061.name: Marsh Wight
lotrv2061.game_text: Twilight.To play, spot a twilight minion.This minion is twilight cost -1 for each burden you can spot.While you can spot 4 burdens, this minion is damage +1.
lotrv2061.lore: "'The Dead can't be really there! Is it some devilry hatched in the Dark Land?'"

lotrv2062.name: No One's Going to Save You Now
lotrv2062.game_text: Search.Make a [Sauron] tracker strength +1 for each search card you can spot (limit +5).
lotrv2062.lore: "'You'll wish there was more that you could tell to satisfy the Questioner, indeed you will: quite soon.'"

lotrv2063.name: Orc of Lugburz
lotrv2063.game_text: Tracker. Each [sauron] orc with a site number of 1 or less cannot take wounds except during the skirmish phase.
lotrv2063.lore: "'Is Saruman the master or the Great Eye?' said the evil voice. 'We should go back at once to Lugbúrz.'"

lotrv2064.name: Orc Searcher
lotrv2064.game_text: Tracker.The site number of each [Sauron] orc is -1.Skirmish: Discard this minion to cancel a skirmish involving an [isengard] tracker.
lotrv2064.lore: "'We'll find a use for your legs before long. You'll wish you had got none before we get home.'"

lotrv2065.name: Shapes to See, Not to Touch
lotrv2065.game_text: To play, spot a Wraith.While you can spot 3 twilight minions, twilight minions may not take wounds except during skirmishes.When the ringbearer takes off the One Ring, discard this condition.
lotrv2065.lore: "'You cannot reach them, you cannot touch them.'"

lotrv2066.name: Trapped in its Gaze
lotrv2066.game_text: Exert a Wraith to make a twilight minion strength +2. If that minion wins its skirmish you may exert it to add a burden.
lotrv2066.lore: "Very soon it would nail him down, know just exactly where he was."

lotrv2067.name: Eastemnet Hills
lotrv2067.game_text: Mountain. When the fellowship moves from here during the regroup phase, each player may discard 2 cards to draw 2 cards.

lotrv2068.name: Theodred's Tomb
lotrv2068.game_text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Play a valiant character to draw a card.

lotrv2069.name: Westfold Plains
lotrv2069.game_text: Plains. Each mount is twilight cost -1.

lotrv2070.name: Breached Wall
lotrv2070.game_text: Battleground. The count of sites each Shadow player controls is +1.

lotrv2071.name: Helm's Tower
lotrv2071.game_text: Battleground. While you can spot 6 companions, each character is damage +1.

lotrv2072.name: Desolation of Saruman
lotrv2072.game_text: When the fellowship moves to this site, each player may discard a card from their opponent's support area.

lotrv2073.name: Isengard Clefts
lotrv2073.game_text: Shadow: Exert a minion to play a Shadow possession from your discard pile.

lotrv2074.name: Path of the Fellowship
lotrv2074.game_text: Before the game begins, place this Map in your support area.Your adventure deck must only contain cards from the Fellowship site path.
lotrv2074.lore: "'It's a dangerous business, Frodo, going out your door. You step onto the Road, and if you don't keep your feet, there's no knowing where you might be swept off to."'

lotrv2075.name: Road to the Towers
lotrv2075.game_text: Before the game begins, place this Map in your support area.Your adventure deck must only contain cards from the Towers site path.
lotrv2075.lore: "'Faithless is he that says farewell when the road darkens.'"

lotrv2076.name: Journey of the King
lotrv2076.game_text: Before the game begins, place this Map in your support area.Your adventure deck must only contain cards from the King site path.
lotrv2076.lore: "'Tall ships and tall kings / Three times three,\What brought they from the foundered land /\Over the flowing sea?\Seven stars and seven stones / And one white tree.'"

lotrv2077.name: Gandalf's Staff, Old Man's Crutch
lotrv2077.subtitle: Old Man's Crutch
lotrv2077.game_text: Bearer must be Gandalf. Discard any weapon he bears. Each time Gandalf is exerted by a Free Peoples card, you may wound a minion (limit once per phase).
lotrv2077.lore: "'The staff in the hand of a wizard may be more than a prop for age.'"

lotrv3001.name: Phial of Galadriel, Bane of Darkness
lotrv3001.subtitle: Bane of Darkness
